+               {' '}Repaid in equal monthly payments. A bank lends against the wages you’re paid, and a payment may take up to {Math.round(ESTIMATE.loanShareOfPay * 100)}% of a month’s wages.
+             </p>
+             <div className="field-act">
+               <div className="field"><label htmlFor="loan-amount">{`Loan Amount (${cur})`}</label><input id="loan-amount" type="text" inputMode="decimal" value={borrow} onChange={(e) => setBorrow(e.target.value)} /></div>
+               <div className="field" style={{ flex: '0 0 auto' }}><label htmlFor="loan-months">Over</label><select id="loan-months" style={{ width: 'auto' }} value={months} onChange={(e) => setMonths(e.target.value)}>
+                 {[12, 24, 36, 48, 60, 72, 84]
+                   .filter((m) => m >= (lending.loan!.minMonths ?? ESTIMATE.loanMonths[0]) && m <= (lending.loan!.maxMonths ?? ESTIMATE.loanMonths[1]))
+                   .map((m) => <option key={m} value={m}>{m} Months</option>)}
+               </select></div>
+               {lending.loan.notFor && <div className="field" style={{ flex: '0 0 auto' }}><label htmlFor="loan-purpose">For</label><select id="loan-purpose" style={{ width: 'auto' }} value={purpose} onChange={(e) => setPurpose(e.target.value as 'other' | 'education')}>
+                 <option value="other">Anything Else</option>
+                 <option value="education">Education</option>
+               </select></div>}
+             </div>
+             {quote && ('refused' in quote
+               ? <p className="small muted" style={{ margin: 0 }}>{quote.refused}</p>
+               : <p className="small" style={{ margin: 0 }}>{pct(quote.apr)} a year: {money(quote.payment)} a month for {months} months. Every loan you hold, at any bank, counts against the same wages.</p>)}
+             <div className="field-row">
+               <div className="field"><label htmlFor="loan-into">Paid Into</label>
+                 <select id="loan-into" value={into || current?.id || ''} onChange={(e) => setInto(e.target.value)}>
+                   {mine.map((a) => <option key={a.id} value={a.id}>{a.name}, {a.institution}</option>)}
+                 </select>
+               </div>
+               <div className="field"><label htmlFor="loan-repay">Repaid From</label>
+                 <select id="loan-repay" value={repay || current?.id || ''} onChange={(e) => setRepay(e.target.value)}>
+                   {mine.map((a) => <option key={a.id} value={a.id}>{a.name}, {a.institution}</option>)}
+                 </select>
+               </div>
+             </div>
+             <div>
+               <Gated feature="bank.borrow" className="btn btn-sm" disabled={!quote || 'refused' in quote}
+                 onClick={() => { const paidInto = sim.universe.accounts[into || current?.id || '']; if (run('bank.borrow', { amount: asked, months: Number(months), bankId: bank.id, purpose, intoId: into || current?.id, repayFromId: repay || current?.id }).ok) { toast(`Your ${money(asked)} loan is in ${paidInto?.name ?? 'your account'}.`, 'positive'); setBorrow(''); setInto(''); setRepay(''); } }}>
+                 Borrow It
+               </Gated>
+             </div>
+             <Fine>Source: {lending.loan.source}. How much of your wages a payment may take is estimated.</Fine>
+           </div>
+         )}
+       </Panel>
+       )}
+
+       {/* Only where a switching service runs it: with none, until 2026-10-10 this moved everything the same day, and
+           its text said you did it yourself. The steps are in Your Banks now (`BankMoves`). */}
+       {show.includes('switch') && rule && (
+       <Panel title="Switch Bank" subtitle={switching ? `Under way, done ${formatDate(switching.at, sim.zone)}` : undefined} help="bank.other-banks">
+         {others.length === 0 ? <p className="small">There’s no other bank where you live in the game.</p> : (
+           <div className="col gap-3">
+             <p className="small" style={{ margin: 0 }}>
+               {`Through the ${rule.scheme}: ${rule.workingDays} working days, and your balances, wages and bills move with you.`}
+               {' '}An overdraft has to be cleared first. Term deposits and loans stay where they are.
+               {bank.iso === 'DE' && CASH[bank.id]?.savingsMonthly ? ` Savings over the ${formatMoney(CASH[bank.id]!.savingsMonthly!, 'EUR', { cents: false })} you can take out in a month without notice isn’t moved: notice is given on it, and it follows three months later.` : ''}
+             </p>
+             {switching && (() => {
+               // The switch's stage: what calling it off does, until when (from 2026-10-10, `bank.cancel_switch`).
+               const until = switching.payload.cancellableUntil as number | undefined;
+               const open = until !== undefined && sim.now <= until;
+               return (
+                 <div className="col gap-2">
+                   <p className="small" style={{ margin: 0 }}>
+                     Switching to {bankById(String(switching.payload.bankId))?.name} on {formatDate(switching.at, sim.zone)}. {until === undefined ? 'This service publishes no right to call a switch off: it runs to its date.' : open ? `It can be called off until ${formatDate(until, sim.zone)}: your accounts, wages and payments stay where they are, and nothing has moved yet.` : `It’s past ${formatDate(until, sim.zone)}, its last day to be called off, and under way.`}
+                     {' '}If {current?.name ?? 'the old account'} is overdrawn on the day, the old bank can’t close it: the new account opens and your payments move, and the debt stays to be cleared.
+                   </p>
+                   {switching.payload.partial === true && <p className="small" style={{ margin: 0 }}>A partial switch: your wages, standing orders and autopay move, and {current?.name ?? 'the old account'} stays open with its balance.</p>}
+                   {switching.payload.keepBalance === true && <p className="small" style={{ margin: 0 }}>Its balance transfer is stopped: your payments move, and the balance stays in the old account, which stays open.</p>}
+                   {until !== undefined && !open && switching.payload.keepBalance !== true && switching.payload.partial !== true && (!askStop
+                     ? <div><button type="button" className="btn btn-sm btn-ghost" onClick={() => setAskStop(true)}>Stop The Balance Transfer…</button></div>
+                     : <div className="row gap-2" style={{ flexWrap: 'wrap', alignItems: 'center' }}><span className="small">Your payments still move on the day, and the balance stays in {current?.name ?? 'the old account'}, which stays open.</span><Gated feature="bank.stop_balance_transfer" className="btn btn-sm btn-danger" onClick={() => { if (run('bank.stop_balance_transfer', { confirm: true }).ok) toast('Your balance stays in the old account.', 'positive'); setAskStop(false); }}>Keep The Balance There</Gated><button type="button" className="btn btn-sm btn-ghost" onClick={() => setAskStop(false)}>Move It As Planned</button><HowItWorks help="bank.stop_balance_transfer" /></div>)}
+                   {open && (!askCancel
+                     ? <div><button type="button" className="btn btn-sm btn-ghost" onClick={() => setAskCancel(true)}>Call Off The Switch…</button></div>
+                     : <div className="row gap-2"><Gated feature="bank.cancel_switch" className="btn btn-sm btn-danger" onClick={() => { if (run('bank.cancel_switch', { confirm: true }).ok) toast('The switch is called off.', 'positive'); setAskCancel(false); }}>Call It Off</Gated><button type="button" className="btn btn-sm btn-ghost" onClick={() => setAskCancel(false)}>Keep It</button></div>)}
+                 </div>
+               );
+             })()}
+             {chex && (
+               <p className="small" style={{ margin: 0 }}>
+                 {chex.bank} reported you to ChexSystems on {formatDate(chex.at, sim.zone)}, and the report stays on your record until {formatDate(chex.at + CHEX.years * 365 * 86_400_000, sim.zone)}. A bank here turns down about {Math.round((debt && debt.balance < 0 ? CHEX.declines.unpaid : CHEX.declines.paid) * 100)}% of applicants with a report, and the banks that turned you down are left off the list. Source: {CHEX.source}. That share is estimated.
+               </p>
+             )}
+             {inDebt.map((a) => <p key={a.id} className="small" style={{ margin: 0 }}>{a.name} at {a.institution} was overdrawn on the switch date, so it’s blocked to everything but payments in. It closes once what it owes is repaid.</p>)}
+             {history.length > 0 && (
+               <details className="small"><summary>Past Switches</summary>
+                 <ul style={{ margin: 0 }}>{history.map((h, i) => <li key={i}>{formatDate(h.at, sim.zone)}: {h.fromBank ? `${h.fromBank} to ` : ''}{h.toBank}, {SWITCH_OUTCOME[h.outcome]}{h.why ? `: ${h.why}` : ''}.</li>)}</ul>
+               </details>
+             )}
+             <Fine>Source: {rule.source}.</Fine>
+             {bank.iso === 'GB' && (
+               <label className="row gap-1 small" style={{ alignItems: 'center' }}><input type="checkbox" checked={partial} onChange={(e) => setPartial(e.target.checked)} /> Partial: your payments move, the old account stays open, and it takes {CASS.partialDays} working days</label>
+             )}
+             <div className="field-act">
+               <div className="field"><label htmlFor="switch-to">Switch To</label><select id="switch-to" value={target} onChange={(e) => setTarget(e.target.value)}>
+                 {/* The dearest current account first, the cheapest last. */}
+                 {[...others].sort((a, b) => (b.current.monthlyFee ?? 0) - (a.current.monthlyFee ?? 0)).map((b) => <option key={b.id} value={b.id}>{b.name}</option>)}
+               </select></div>
+               <div className="field"><label htmlFor="switch-on">On (Optional)</label><input id="switch-on" type="date" value={switchOn} onChange={(e) => setSwitchOn(e.target.value)} /></div>
+               <Gated feature="bank.switch" className="btn btn-sm" disabled={!!switching || !target}
+                 onClick={() => { const a = run<{ at: number }>('bank.switch', { bankId: target, ...(switchOn ? { on: switchOn } : {}), ...(partial ? { partial: true } : {}) }); if (a.ok) toast(`Switch set for ${formatDate(a.value!.at, sim.zone)}.`, 'positive'); }}>
+                 Switch
+               </Gated>
+             </div>
+           </div>
+         )}
+       </Panel>
+       )}
+     </div>
+   );
+ }
+
+ /**
+  * Term deposits at each bank kept with a current account, the primary's first, each funded from the current account
+  * there as `bank.open_term` funds it. Until 2026-10-13 only the primary's bank's panel was drawn, so the command's bank,
+  * taken since 2026-10-10, was never another bank's from any screen; found by that day's evidence check.
+  */
+ export function TermDeposits({ primaryBank }: { primaryBank: Bank }) {
+   const currents = useWorld((s) => checkingsOf(s, s.player));
+   const others = [...new Set(currents.map((a) => a.bankId))]
+     .map((id) => (id && id !== primaryBank.id ? bankById(id) : undefined))
+     .filter((b): b is Bank => !!b && lendingOf(b).term !== undefined);
+   return (
+     <>
+       <BankLending bank={primaryBank} show={['term']} />
+       {others.map((b) => <BankLending key={b.id} bank={b} account={currents.find((a) => a.bankId === b.id)} show={['term']} />)}
+     </>
+   );
+ }
+
+ /**
+  * SLATE — more than one bank, on the bank's screen (from 2026-10-10, `systems/bankmoves.ts`).
+  *
+  * Until then the screen offered one button, Switch Bank, which in a country with no switching service moved
+  * everything to the new bank the same day. Now each step is its own, and each says what it changes and what it
+  * doesn't: opening an account at another bank, with what that bank asks and how long it takes; which account is
+  * primary; where wages and other payments are paid; which account each standing order and each card's autopay pays
+  * from; money on its way between banks; and closing an account, with what still uses it.
+  */
+
+ import { useState } from 'react';
+ import { useGame, useWorld } from '@/app/game-context';
+ import { Panel, Fine } from '@/ui/components/primitives';
+ import { Gated } from '@/ui/guide/Guide';
+ import { HowItWorks } from '@/ui/guide/HowItWorks';
+ import { formatMoney, saveCurrency, centsFromTyped } from '@/engine/core/money';
+ import { MS_HOUR, formatDate, formatTime } from '@/engine/core/time';
+ import { Open, at } from '@/ui/looks';
+ import { SWITCHING } from '@/engine/content/banks-lending';
+ import { ESTIMATE_CARD_DAYS, ESTIMATE_SEND_DAYS, TRANSFERS } from '@/engine/content/bankopening';
+ import { bankById } from '@/engine/content/banks';
+ import { SECURITY } from '@/engine/content/security';
+ import { bankAccountsOf, banksFor, closingFeesWords, inSaveMoney, isoOf } from '@/engine/systems/banking';
+ import { checkingsOf } from '@/engine/systems/lending';
+ import { waiverWords, nth } from '@/ui/bank/feeWords';
+ import { spokenList } from '@/engine/core/text';
+ import { balanceText, heldOf } from '@/engine/systems/abroad';
+ import { homeOf } from '@/engine/systems/earnings';
+ import { paymentsOf } from '@/engine/systems/payments';
+ import { cardsOf, autopaySource } from '@/engine/systems/credit';
+ import { depositAccount, linkedTo, orderSource, DEPOSIT_LEAD, PAYER_LEAD } from '@/engine/systems/routing';
+ import { BRANCH_MINUTES, PRIMARY_DOES, applicationsOf, channelFor, closeRefusal, openRefusal, openingOf, transfersOf } from '@/engine/systems/bankmoves';
+
+ export function BankMoves() {
+   const { sim, run, toast } = useGame();
+   const cur = saveCurrency(sim.universe);
+   const money = (c: number) => formatMoney(c, cur, { cents: false });
+   const person = useWorld((s) => s.player);
+   const currents = useWorld((s) => checkingsOf(s, s.player));
+   const everyday = useWorld((s) => bankAccountsOf(s, s.player));
+   const banks = useWorld((s) => banksFor(homeOf(s.player)));
+   const applications = useWorld((s) => applicationsOf(s, s.player));
+   const transfers = useWorld((s) => transfersOf(s, s.player));
+   const pay = useWorld((s) => paymentsOf(s.player));
+   const deposits = useWorld((s) => depositAccount(s, s.player));
+   const cards = useWorld((s) => (s.player.credit ? cardsOf(s, s.player) : []));
+   const iso = isoOf(homeOf(person)) ?? '';
+   const service = SWITCHING[iso];
+   const kept = new Set(currents.map((a) => a.bankId));
+   const others = banks.filter((b) => !kept.has(b.id) && !applications.some((a) => a.bankId === b.id));
+   const [target, setTarget] = useState('');
+   const [fundFrom, setFundFrom] = useState('');
+   const [fundAmount, setFundAmount] = useState('');
+   const [remainder, setRemainder] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
+   const [sources, setSources] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
+   const chosen = bankById(target || others[0]?.id || '');
+   const rules = openingOf(chosen);
+   const refusal = chosen ? openRefusal(sim, person, chosen.id) : undefined;
+   const minimum = chosen && rules?.minimumDeposit ? inSaveMoney(sim, rules.minimumDeposit, chosen.currency) : 0;
+   const scheme = TRANSFERS[iso];
+   const name = (id: string | undefined) => (id ? sim.universe.accounts[id]?.name : undefined) ?? 'an account';
+   const label = (id: string) => { const a = sim.universe.accounts[id]; return a ? `${a.name} ···${a.last4} (${a.institution ?? ''})` : id; };
+
+   const open = () => {
+     if (!chosen) return;
+     const answer = run<{ accountId?: string; decidedAt?: number; arrivesAt?: number; cardAt?: number }>('bank.open_current', {
+       bankId: chosen.id, ...(fundFrom || minimum > 0 ? { fundFrom: fundFrom || everyday.find((a) => a.bankId !== chosen.id)?.id, amount: centsFromTyped(fundAmount) || minimum } : {}),
+     });
+     if (!answer.ok || !answer.value) return;
+     const v = answer.value;
+     toast(v.decidedAt ? `Application sent. ${chosen.name} decides by ${formatDate(v.decidedAt, sim.zone)}.` : `Your account at ${chosen.name} is open.${v.cardAt ? ` The debit card arrives ${formatDate(v.cardAt, sim.zone)}.` : ''}`, 'positive');
+     setFundAmount('');
+   };
+
+   // What the chosen bank asks and how long each step takes, and, for the line at the panel's foot, which of those figures
+   // are estimated (from 2026-10-17: until then each estimate was said inside its sentence, "SLATE’s estimate"). In four
+   // short paragraphs (from 2026-10-20, brief 16, section 7): what happens when you apply, what the account needs, what
+   // it costs, and how long money it sends takes. Until then one paragraph, five sentences to eight, in no such order.
+   const whatItTakes = (): { said: string[]; estimated: string[] } => {
+     if (!chosen) return { said: [], estimated: [] };
+     const applying: string[] = [];
+     const needs: string[] = [];
+     const estimated: string[] = [];
+     if (channelFor(person, chosen) === 'branch') {
+       applying.push(`Without a Social Security number, you apply in person at a branch with your passport and I-20, which takes ${BRANCH_MINUTES === 60 ? 'an hour' : `${BRANCH_MINUTES} minutes`}.`);
+       estimated.push('The time at the branch is estimated.');
+     }
+     applying.push(rules?.reviewDays ? `It decides an application within ${rules.reviewDays} business days, the longest it says it takes.` : 'It opens the account as soon as you apply.');
+     // The deposit leaves as you apply, and comes back if the bank turns you down (`bank.open_current`): from 2026-10-20 the
+     // panel says when it leaves.
+     needs.push(minimum > 0 ? `It asks for an opening deposit of ${money(minimum)}, sent from another of your accounts as you apply.` : rules ? 'It doesn’t ask for an opening deposit.' : 'No opening deposit was found for it, so none is asked for.');
+     if (rules?.openedWhenFunded) needs.push('The account only counts as open once money is paid in.');
+     if (rules?.fundWithinDays) needs.push(`If nothing is paid in within ${rules.fundWithinDays} days of opening, the bank closes it.`);
+     if (rules?.closesAtZeroAfterDays) needs.push(`If it sits at a zero balance for ${rules.closesAtZeroAfterDays} days, the bank may close it.`);
+     // The card's line says what `cardArrival` and `openApproved` (`systems/bankmoves.ts`) do. Until 2026-10-12 it gave
+     // Bank of America's 6 business days "with a digital card in the app meanwhile", and nothing read the 6: a digital
+     // card works from the day the account opens, and nothing arrives after it (docs/UNBITTEN.md). And where a bank
+     // publishes no days for a new card it gave SLATE's 7, while the card came in the bank's days for a replacement
+     // (`SECURITY`): Citi's 5 and SMBC's 10, at 29 of the thirteen countries' 60 banks (tests/bank-moves-card-line.test.ts).
+     const card = rules?.card;
+     const replacement = chosen ? SECURITY[chosen.id]?.standardDays : undefined;
+     applying.push(card?.digital ? 'The debit card works from the day the account opens, as a digital card in the app.'
+       : card ? `The debit card arrives in ${card.days} ${card.business ? 'business ' : ''}days.`
+         : `The debit card arrives in ${replacement ?? ESTIMATE_CARD_DAYS} business days.`);
+     if (!card && replacement !== undefined) estimated.push('The new card’s days are estimated from the bank’s time for a replacement card, as no figure for a new account’s card was found.');
+     else if (!card) estimated.push('The debit card’s days are estimated: the bank doesn’t say.');
+     // In the order `arrivalOf` (`systems/bankmoves.ts`) runs: the bank’s cut-off, its days, the country’s instant
+     // scheme, the country’s cut-off, its days. Until 2026-10-12 the country’s cut-off was never read, so a Japanese
+     // bank said SLATE’s 3-day estimate while Zengin landed the money the same day, and the bank’s cut-off was written
+     // "12:30", Citi’s, whatever the number.
+     // A cut-off is an hour of the bank’s day, written on the 12-hour clock by `formatTime`, as the house writes a
+     // time the player reads: 15.5 is 3:30 PM, the clock that many hours into a day at UTC. For part of 2026-10-12 a
+     // second formatter here wrote both cut-offs on a 24-hour clock, "before 15:30" for Zengin.
+     const cutOff = (h: number) => formatTime(h * MS_HOUR, 'UTC');
+     const sends = rules?.sameDayBefore !== undefined ? `Money it sends to another bank arrives the same business day if it’s sent before ${cutOff(rules.sameDayBefore)}, or the next business day if later.`
+       : rules?.sendDays ? `Money it sends to another bank takes ${rules.sendDays} business days.`
+         : scheme?.instant ? `Money between banks here arrives instantly, by ${scheme.scheme}.`
+           : scheme?.sameDayBefore !== undefined ? `Money between banks here goes by ${scheme.scheme}, and arrives the same business day if it’s sent before ${cutOff(scheme.sameDayBefore)}, or the next business day if later.`
+             : scheme?.days ? `Money between banks here takes ${scheme.days} business day${scheme.days === 1 ? '' : 's'}, by ${scheme.scheme}.`
+               : `Money it sends to another bank takes ${ESTIMATE_SEND_DAYS} business days.`;
+     if (rules?.sameDayBefore === undefined && !rules?.sendDays && !scheme?.instant && scheme?.sameDayBefore === undefined && !scheme?.days) estimated.push('How long money takes to another bank is estimated: the bank doesn’t say.');
+     // Its monthly fee and how the bank waives it, from the product `feeFor` (`systems/banking.ts`) charges by, as Your
+     // Accounts says it of an account held (from 2026-10-16). Until then the panel said nothing of it before Apply, and a
+     // student of 24 who opened Citi Access Checking and left it empty met its fee as an overdraft, charged off to
+     // collections sixty days on (docs/verification/remaining/banking-checklist.json, banking.s7.opening).
+     const fee = chosen.current.monthlyFee;
+     const inBank = (c: number) => formatMoney(inSaveMoney(sim, c, chosen.currency), cur);
+     const costs = fee ? `Its ${chosen.current.name} costs ${inBank(fee)} a month${waiverWords(chosen.current, inBank)}.` : `Its ${chosen.current.name} has no monthly fee.`;
+     return { said: [applying.join(' '), needs.join(' '), costs, sends], estimated };
+   };
+   const takes = whatItTakes();
+
+   return (
+     <div className="col gap-4" style={{ marginBottom: 'var(--s5)' }}>
+       <Panel title="Your Banks" subtitle={currents.length > 1 ? `${currents.length} checking accounts` : 'One checking account'} help="bank.other-banks">
+         <div className="col gap-3">
+           {currents.map((a) => {
+             const links = linkedTo(sim, person, a.id);
+             const closing = closeRefusal(sim, person, a);
+             // What closing charges of its fees, said before Close It is pressed, from the engine's own figures (from
+             // 2026-10-16: until then nothing said it unless the close was refused for it).
+             const fees = closingFeesWords(sim, a);
+             const elsewhere = everyday.filter((b) => b.id !== a.id);
+             const into = remainder[a.id] || elsewhere.find((b) => b.id === person.primaryAccountId)?.id || elsewhere[0]?.id || '';
+             return (
+               <div key={a.id} className="col gap-2" style={{ borderTop: '1px solid var(--line)', paddingTop: 'var(--s2)' }}>
+                 <p className="small" style={{ margin: 0 }}>
+                   {/* Below zero, said as overdrawn and to the cent (from 2026-10-20, brief 17): until then “-$600”, a hyphen. */}
+                   <Open subject={at('account', a.id)}><strong>{a.name}</strong></Open> at {a.institution}, {a.balance < 0 ? `overdrawn by ${balanceText(sim, a, -a.balance, a.currency ? -heldOf(a) : undefined)}` : balanceText(sim, a, a.balance, undefined, { cents: false })}
+                   {a.id === person.primaryAccountId ? '. This is your primary account.' : '.'}
+                   {a.awaitingFunds !== undefined ? ` It’s waiting for ${a.awaitingFunds > 1 ? `its opening deposit of ${money(a.awaitingFunds)}` : 'its first deposit'}${a.fundBy ? `, due by ${formatDate(a.fundBy, sim.zone)}` : ''}.` : ''}
+                   {a.plastic?.stopped === 'new' && a.plastic.replacementAt ? ` Its debit card arrives ${formatDate(a.plastic.replacementAt, sim.zone)}.` : ''}
+                   {a.closingAt !== undefined ? ` It closes ${formatDate(a.closingAt, sim.zone)}, after its pending card payments post.` : ''}
+                 </p>
+                 {links.length > 0 && <p className="xs dim" style={{ margin: 0 }}>{links.join('. ')}.</p>}
+                 <div className="row gap-2" style={{ flexWrap: 'wrap', alignItems: 'end' }}>
+                   {a.id !== person.primaryAccountId && a.closingAt === undefined && (
+                     <Gated feature="bank.set_primary" className="btn btn-sm" onClick={() => { const r = run<{ unchanged: string[] }>('bank.set_primary', { accountId: a.id }); if (r.ok) toast(`${a.name} is now your primary account.${r.value?.unchanged.length ? ' Payments already set up on another account stay there.' : ''}`, 'positive'); }}>
+                       Make Primary
+                     </Gated>
+                   )}
+                   {deposits?.id !== a.id && pay.depositChange?.to !== a.id && a.closingAt === undefined && (
+                     <Gated feature="bank.redirect_deposits" className="btn btn-sm btn-ghost" onClick={() => { const r = run<{ at: number }>('bank.redirect_deposits', { accountId: a.id }); if (r.ok && r.value) toast(`Your wages and other payments go to ${a.name} from ${formatDate(r.value.at, sim.zone)}.`, 'positive'); }}>
+                       Have Wages Paid Here
+                     </Gated>
+                   )}
+                   {a.id !== person.primaryAccountId && a.closingAt === undefined && (
+                     <>
+                       {a.balance > 0 && elsewhere.length > 0 && (
+                         <div className="field"><label htmlFor={`close-into-${a.id}`}>Send What It Holds To</label>
+                           <select id={`close-into-${a.id}`} value={into} onChange={(e) => setRemainder({ ...remainder, [a.id]: e.target.value })}>
+                             {elsewhere.map((b) => <option key={b.id} value={b.id}>{label(b.id)}</option>)}
+                           </select>
+                         </div>
+                       )}
+                       <Gated feature="bank.close_current" className="btn btn-sm btn-ghost" title={closing} disabled={!!closing}
+                         onClick={() => { const r = run<{ closedAt: number; arrivesAt?: number }>('bank.close_current', { accountId: a.id, remainderTo: into }); if (r.ok && r.value) toast(r.value.closedAt > sim.now ? `It closes ${formatDate(r.value.closedAt, sim.zone)}.` : `Account closed.${r.value.arrivesAt ? ` What it held arrives ${formatDate(r.value.arrivesAt, sim.zone)}.` : ''}`, 'positive'); }}>
+                         Close It
+                       </Gated>
+                     </>
+                   )}
+                 </div>
+                 {closing && a.id !== person.primaryAccountId && <p className="xs dim" style={{ margin: 0 }}>You can’t close it yet. {closing}</p>}
+                 {fees && a.id !== person.primaryAccountId && a.closingAt === undefined && <p className="xs dim" style={{ margin: 0 }}>{fees}</p>}
+               </div>
+             );
+           })}
+           <div className="row-between gap-2" style={{ alignItems: 'start' }}>
+             <p className="xs dim" style={{ margin: 0 }}>
+               Your primary account is the one money comes from unless you choose otherwise: {spokenList(PRIMARY_DOES)}. Making another account primary doesn’t move anything already set up.
+             </p>
+             <HowItWorks help="bank.set_primary" />
+           </div>
+           <div className="row-between gap-2" style={{ alignItems: 'start' }}>
+             {/* How moving them works, once: where they're paid now, and any move on its way, is each account's own line
+                 above (`linkedTo`). Until 2026-10-20 (brief 17) this opened by saying it again, “Your wages and other
+                 payments go to Chase Total Checking.”, under “Your wages and other payments are paid into it.” */}
+             <p className="xs dim" style={{ margin: 0 }}>
+               Have Wages Paid Here, on another account, moves your wages and other payments to it. Yale’s payroll starts paying the new account after {PAYER_LEAD['yale-payroll']} days, about one of its weekly pay cycles, as Yale says. Other payers take {DEPOSIT_LEAD.days} days, which is estimated: employers say one to two pay cycles.
+             </p>
+             <HowItWorks help="bank.redirect_deposits" />
+           </div>
+         </div>
+       </Panel>
+
+       {(pay.standingOrders.length > 0 || cards.length > 0) && currents.length > 1 && (
+         <Panel title="What Pays From Where" subtitle="Each payment stays on the account it was set up on until you move it." help="bank.payments">
+           <div className="col gap-2">
+             {pay.standingOrders.map((o) => (
+               <div key={o.id} className="field">
+                 <label htmlFor={`order-from-${o.id}`}>Standing Order Of {money(o.amount)} On The {o.day}{nth(o.day)}, Into {name(o.toId)}</label>
+                 <div className="field-act" style={{ flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
+                   <select id={`order-from-${o.id}`} value={sources[o.id] ?? orderSource(sim, person, o)?.id ?? ''} onChange={(e) => setSources({ ...sources, [o.id]: e.target.value })}>
+                     {currents.filter((a) => a.id !== o.toId).map((a) => <option key={a.id} value={a.id}>{label(a.id)}</option>)}
+                   </select>
+                   <Gated feature="bank.set_order_source" className="btn btn-sm btn-ghost" disabled={!sources[o.id] || sources[o.id] === orderSource(sim, person, o)?.id}
+                     onClick={() => { if (run('bank.set_order_source', { orderId: o.id, accountId: sources[o.id] }).ok) toast('From its next payment, it pays from that account.', 'positive'); }}>
+                     Pay From This Account
+                   </Gated>
+                 </div>
+               </div>
+             ))}
+             {cards.map((c) => (
+               <div key={c.id} className="field">
+                 <label htmlFor={`autopay-from-${c.id}`}>{c.name} Autopay Pays From</label>
+                 <div className="field-act" style={{ flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
+                   <select id={`autopay-from-${c.id}`} value={sources[c.id] ?? autopaySource(sim, person, c)?.id ?? ''} onChange={(e) => setSources({ ...sources, [c.id]: e.target.value })}>
+                     {currents.map((a) => <option key={a.id} value={a.id}>{label(a.id)}</option>)}
+                   </select>
+                   <Gated feature="card.set_autopay_from" className="btn btn-sm btn-ghost" disabled={!sources[c.id] || sources[c.id] === autopaySource(sim, person, c)?.id}
+                     onClick={() => { if (run('card.set_autopay_from', { cardId: c.id, accountId: sources[c.id] }).ok) toast('From its next due date, autopay pays from that account.', 'positive'); }}>
+                     Pay From This Account
+                   </Gated>
+                   <HowItWorks help="card.set_autopay_from" />
+                 </div>
+               </div>
+             ))}
+           </div>
+         </Panel>
+       )}
+
+       {transfers.length > 0 && (
+         <Panel title="On Its Way" subtitle="Money that has left one of your banks and hasn’t reached the other yet.">
+           <ul className="small" style={{ margin: 0 }}>
+             {transfers.map((t) => <li key={t.id}>{money(t.amount)} from {name(t.fromId)} to {t.toId ? name(t.toId) : bankById(t.toBankId)?.name ?? 'another bank'}, arriving {formatDate(t.at, sim.zone)}.</li>)}
+           </ul>
+         </Panel>
+       )}
+
+       <Panel title="Open An Account At Another Bank" subtitle={applications.length ? applications.map((a) => `${bankById(a.bankId)?.name} decides by ${formatDate(a.at, sim.zone)}`).join('; ') : undefined} help="bank.other-banks">
+         {others.length === 0 ? <p className="small">You already have an account at every bank the game has here.</p> : (
+           <div className="col gap-3">
+             <p className="small" style={{ margin: 0 }}>
+               {service
+                 ? `The ${service.scheme} below moves everything for you in ${service.workingDays} working days. Or open a second account here and keep both.`
+                 : 'There’s no switching service here. To move banks, open the new account, have your wages paid into it, move each standing order and autopay, move the money across, and then close the old account. The new account starts empty, with its own history.'}
+             </p>
+             <div className="field-row">
+               <div className="field"><label htmlFor="open-at">Bank</label>
+                 <select id="open-at" value={chosen?.id ?? ''} onChange={(e) => setTarget(e.target.value)}>
+                   {others.map((b) => <option key={b.id} value={b.id}>{b.name}</option>)}
+                 </select>
+               </div>
+             </div>
+             {/* What the bank chosen asks, costs and does, before its deposit and Apply (from 2026-10-20, brief 17, section
+                 8): until then these four paragraphs came under the button, after the deposit had been typed. */}
+             {refusal && <p className="small muted" style={{ margin: 0 }}>{refusal}</p>}
+             {takes.said.map((said) => <p key={said} className="small" style={{ margin: 0 }}>{said}</p>)}
+             <div className="field-row">
+               {minimum > 0 && (
+                 <>
+                   <div className="field"><label htmlFor="open-from">Opening Deposit From</label>
+                     <select id="open-from" value={fundFrom} onChange={(e) => setFundFrom(e.target.value)}>
+                       {everyday.filter((a) => a.bankId !== chosen?.id).map((a) => <option key={a.id} value={a.id}>{label(a.id)}</option>)}
+                     </select>
+                   </div>
+                   <div className="field"><label htmlFor="open-amount">Amount ({cur})</label>
+                     <input id="open-amount" type="text" inputMode="decimal" placeholder={String(minimum / 100)} value={fundAmount} onChange={(e) => setFundAmount(e.target.value)} />
+                   </div>
+                 </>
+               )}
+               <Gated feature="bank.open_current" className="btn btn-sm" disabled={!chosen || !!refusal} title={refusal} onClick={open}>
+                 Apply
+               </Gated>
+             </div>
+             <Fine>Source: {rules?.source ?? 'nothing published was found for this bank, so its figures here are estimated'}{scheme && !rules?.sendDays && rules?.sameDayBefore === undefined ? `; ${scheme.source}` : ''}.{takes.estimated.map((e) => ` ${e}`).join('')}</Fine>
+           </div>
+         )}
+       </Panel>
+     </div>
+   );
+ }

+ /**
+  * SLATE — how each thing is paid, on the bank's screen.
+  *
+  * The day's spending, the way the character pays it; savings linked to the
+  * current account or not; standing orders
+  * into savings; and payments set for a date (`systems/payments.ts`). How the
+  * rent and the bills were paid was chosen here too, checks in the post were

+

+   const { sim, run, toast } = useGame();

+   const money = (c: number) => formatMoney(c, cur);
+   const person = useWorld((s) => s.player);
+   const pay = useWorld((s) => paymentsOf(s.player));
+   const accounts = useWorld((s) => Object.values(s.universe.accounts).filter((a) => a.ownerId === s.player.id && !a.closedAt && (a.kind === 'checking' || a.kind === 'savings') && a.category !== 'term'));
+   const savings = accounts.filter((a) => a.kind === 'savings');
+   const current = accounts.find((a) => a.id === person.primaryAccountId);
+   const covers = useWorld((s) => linkCovers(s, s.player));
+   const linkable = covers.some((one) => one.savings);
+   const scheduled = useWorld((s) => s.universe.scheduled.filter((i) => i.kind === SCHEDULED_KIND && i.status === 'pending' && i.payload.personId === s.player.id));
+   const ceiling = current?.bankId ? FRENCH_CARDS[current.bankId] : undefined;
+   const ceilingRoom = cardCeilingRoom(sim, person);
+
+   const [soAmount, setSoAmount] = useState('');
+   const [soDay, setSoDay] = useState('1');
+   const [soTo, setSoTo] = useState('');
+   const [spFrom, setSpFrom] = useState('');
+   const [spTo, setSpTo] = useState('');
+   const [spAmount, setSpAmount] = useState('');
+   const [spDate, setSpDate] = useState('');
+   const cents = centsFromTyped;
+
+   const addOrder = () => {
+     const answer = run('bank.add_standing_order', { toId: soTo || savings[0]?.id, amount: cents(soAmount), day: Number(soDay) });
+     if (answer.ok) { toast('Standing order set up.', 'positive'); setSoAmount(''); }
+   };
+   const schedule = () => {
+     const [y, m, d] = spDate.split('-').map(Number);
+     if (!y || !m || !d) return;
+     const at = instantFromZoned({ year: y, month: m, day: d, hour: 9 }, sim.zone);
+     const from = spFrom || current?.id;
+     const to = spTo || accounts.find((a) => a.id !== from)?.id;
+     const answer = run('bank.schedule_payment', { fromId: from, toId: to, amount: cents(spAmount), at });
+     if (answer.ok) { toast(`Payment set for ${formatDate(at, sim.zone)}.`, 'positive'); setSpAmount(''); }
+   };
+
+   return (
+     <Panel title="How You Pay" subtitle="How the day’s spending is paid, and which account each payment comes from." help="bank.payments">
+       <div className="field-row">
+         <div className="field">
+           <label htmlFor="pay-everyday">The Day’s Spending</label>
+           <select id="pay-everyday" value={pay.everyday} onChange={(e) => run('bank.set_payments', { everyday: e.target.value })}>
+             <option value="cash">In Cash, Then The Debit Card</option>
+             <option value="credit">On The Credit Card</option>
+             <option value="debit">On The Debit Card</option>
+           </select>
+         </div>
+       </div>
+       <p className="small" style={{ margin: 'var(--s2) 0' }}>
+         {pay.everyday === 'debit' && ceiling && ceilingRoom !== undefined ? `The debit card pays up to its spending limit ${ceiling.window === 'month' ? 'each calendar month' : 'over any 30 days'}, and ${money(ceilingRoom)} of it is left. Past it, the day’s shopping goes on the credit card, or isn’t bought. ` : ''}
+       </p>
+       {/* Only with savings the link draws on for a current account a payment comes from (`linkCovers`), or while it's
+           On, so it can be turned Off. Until 2026-09-27 it was offered with no savings, and On changed nothing; until
+           2026-10-12 it was offered with savings only at a bank no payment came from, and On covered nothing and then
+           was refused.
+           Later the same day, until group r3b, it read the primary account's bank alone: with savings at the bank of a
+           loan's repayment account it went once Off, and said On covered nothing, though On paid that loan. */}
+       {(linkable || pay.linkSavings) && (
+         <div className="col gap-2">
+           <p className="small" style={{ margin: 0 }}>{coverText(covers)}</p>
+           <div>
+             <Gated feature="bank.set_payments" className="btn btn-sm btn-ghost" onClick={() => run('bank.set_payments', { linkSavings: !pay.linkSavings })}>
+               Savings Covers The Checking Account: {pay.linkSavings ? 'On' : 'Off'}
+             </Gated>
+           </div>
+         </div>
+       )}
+
+       {savings.length > 0 && (
+         <div style={{ marginTop: 'var(--s4)' }}>
+           <div className="eyebrow">Standing Orders</div>
+           {pay.standingOrders.map((order) => (
+             <div key={order.id} className="row-between small" style={{ padding: '3px 0' }}>
+               <span>{money(order.amount)} to {sim.universe.accounts[order.toId]?.name ?? 'savings'} on the {order.day}{ordinal(order.day)} of each month</span>
+               <Gated feature="bank.cancel_standing_order" className="btn btn-sm btn-ghost" onClick={() => run('bank.cancel_standing_order', { id: order.id })}>Cancel</Gated>
+             </div>
+           ))}
+           <div className="field-row">
+             <div className="field"><label htmlFor="so-amount">Each Month ({cur})</label><input id="so-amount" inputMode="decimal" value={soAmount} onChange={(e) => setSoAmount(e.target.value)} /></div>
+             <div className="field"><label htmlFor="so-day">Day Of The Month</label><input id="so-day" inputMode="numeric" value={soDay} onChange={(e) => setSoDay(e.target.value)} /></div>
+             {savings.length > 1 && (
+               <div className="field">
+                 <label htmlFor="so-to">Into</label>
+                 <select id="so-to" value={soTo || savings[0]!.id} onChange={(e) => setSoTo(e.target.value)}>
+                   {savings.map((a) => <option key={a.id} value={a.id}>{a.name}</option>)}
+                 </select>
+               </div>
+             )}
+           </div>
+           <Gated feature="bank.add_standing_order" className="btn btn-sm" onClick={addOrder} disabled={!soAmount}>Set Up A Standing Order Into Savings</Gated>
+         </div>
+       )}
+
+       {accounts.length > 1 && (
+         <div style={{ marginTop: 'var(--s4)' }}>
+           <div className="eyebrow">Payments Set For A Date</div>
+           <LookRegion>
+           {scheduled.map((item) => (
+             <div key={item.id} className="row-between small" style={{ padding: '3px 0' }}>
+               <span>{money(Number(item.payload.amount))} to <Open subject={at('account', String(item.payload.toId))}>{sim.universe.accounts[String(item.payload.toId)]?.name}</Open> on <Open subject={at('day', dateKey(item.at, sim.homeZone))}>{formatDate(item.at, sim.zone)}</Open></span>
+               <Gated feature="bank.cancel_scheduled" className="btn btn-sm btn-ghost" onClick={() => run('bank.cancel_scheduled', { id: item.id })}>Cancel</Gated>
+             </div>
+           ))}
+           </LookRegion>
+           <div className="field-row">
+             <div className="field">
+               <label htmlFor="sp-from">From</label>
+               <select id="sp-from" value={spFrom || current?.id} onChange={(e) => setSpFrom(e.target.value)}>
+                 {accounts.map((a) => <option key={a.id} value={a.id}>{a.name}</option>)}
+               </select>
+             </div>
+             <div className="field">
+               <label htmlFor="sp-to">To</label>
+               <select id="sp-to" value={spTo || accounts.find((a) => a.id !== (spFrom || current?.id))?.id} onChange={(e) => setSpTo(e.target.value)}>
+                 {accounts.filter((a) => a.id !== (spFrom || current?.id)).map((a) => <option key={a.id} value={a.id}>{a.name}</option>)}
+               </select>
+             </div>
+             <div className="field"><label htmlFor="sp-amount">Amount ({cur})</label><input id="sp-amount" inputMode="decimal" value={spAmount} onChange={(e) => setSpAmount(e.target.value)} /></div>
+             <div className="field"><label htmlFor="sp-date">On</label><input id="sp-date" type="date" value={spDate} onChange={(e) => setSpDate(e.target.value)} /></div>
+           </div>
+           <Gated feature="bank.schedule_payment" className="btn btn-sm" onClick={schedule} disabled={!spAmount || !spDate}>Set The Payment</Gated>
+         </div>

+
+       {/* Checks not yet cashed and direct debits to take back were listed here until 2026-10-09: only the rent and the bills went by them. */}
+     </Panel>
+   );
+ }
+
+ const andList = (items: readonly string[]): string => (items.length < 2 ? items.join('') : `${items.slice(0, -1).join(', ')} and ${items[items.length - 1]}`);
+
+ /**
+  * What the link covers, account by account, as `linkCovers` reads it: the primary for the day's spending, the account a
+  * card's autopay is set on for that autopay (from later on 2026-10-12: until then the primary was said to pay 'a card's
+  * autopay from it' even where the autopay stayed on another account), and each loan's repayment account for its loan.
+  * From 2026-10-12, group r3b: until then one line
+  * said a payment “the current account” couldn't make came from savings, or, with no easy-access savings at the primary
+  * account's bank, that On covered nothing, which was false with savings at the bank of a loan's repayment account.
+  */
+ function coverText(covers: LinkCover[]): string {
+   if (!covers.some((one) => one.savings)) return `You don’t have easy-access savings at ${coveredBanks(covers)}, so turning this on covers nothing until you open some there.`;
+   const each = covers.map((one) => {
+     const name = one.from?.name ?? 'your checking account';
+     const pays = andList([...(one.primary ? ['the day’s spending'] : []), ...one.cards.map((card) => `the ${card.name}’s autopay`), ...one.loans.map((loan) => `the ${loan.name}`)]);
+     return one.savings ? `${one.savings.name} covers ${name}, which pays ${pays}.` : `${name[0]!.toUpperCase()}${name.slice(1)}, which pays ${pays}, has no easy-access savings at ${one.from?.institution ?? 'your bank'} to cover it.`;
+   });
+   return ['When this is on, a payment your checking account can’t cover is taken from easy-access savings at the same bank, as far as the savings allows.', ...each].join(' ');
+ }
+
+ function ordinal(n: number): string {
+   const tens = n % 100;
+   if (tens >= 11 && tens <= 13) return 'th';
+   return n % 10 === 1 ? 'st' : n % 10 === 2 ? 'nd' : n % 10 === 3 ? 'rd' : 'th';
+ }
+
+ /**
+  * SLATE — the cards in the hand, on the bank's screen
+  * (`systems/security.ts`): each one's number and expiry, locking it, reporting
+  * it lost, stolen or damaged, the bills on a replaced card, a new account
+  * number where the bank gives one, and payments somebody else made, reported
+  * as not the holder's.
+  */
+
+ import { useState } from 'react';
+ import { useGame, useWorld } from '@/app/game-context';
+ import { Panel, Fine } from '@/ui/components/primitives';
+ import { Gated } from '@/ui/guide/Guide';
+ import { formatMoney, saveCurrency } from '@/engine/core/money';
+ import { dateKey, formatDate } from '@/engine/core/time';
+ import { LookRegion, Open, at } from '@/ui/looks';
+ import { bankById } from '@/engine/content/banks';
+ import { FRAUD_LAW, SECURITY, type DebitTier, type FraudLaw } from '@/engine/content/security';
+ import { disputeRefusal, ESTIMATE_YEARS, plasticView, type Which } from '@/engine/systems/security';
+ import { inSaveMoney } from '@/engine/systems/banking';
+ import { cardsOf } from '@/engine/systems/credit';
+ import type { Account } from '@/engine/core/ledger';
+ import { FRENCH_CARDS, FRENCH_CARDS_SOURCE, cardCeilingRoom } from '@/engine/systems/lending';
+
+ const WHY_WORDS = { lost: 'Lost', stolen: 'Stolen', damaged: 'Damaged', fraud: 'Used by somebody else', new: 'Not arrived yet' } as const;
+
+ /**
+  * What to do, and by when, to pay as little as the law lets you of a card payment that wasn't you: from the tiers
+  * `liabilityFor` (`systems/security.ts`) charges by and the days from the statement `disputeRefusal` allows, so it says
+  * what the game does (from 2026-10-20, brief 16, section 7). The law's own words fold away under it. Until then they were
+  * the only account of it, five sentences in the US with the deadline in the first. Where a country's law sets no limit
+  * for a credit card, the debit card's tiers are what `liabilityFor` charges a credit card too, and where both have one
+  * limit at any time, it's the same for both: the sentence says "a card payment" for either.
+  */
+ function reportByWords(law: FraudLaw, amount: (max: number) => string, credit: boolean): string {
+   const days = (n: number, business?: boolean) => `${n.toLocaleString('en-US')} ${business ? 'business ' : ''}day${n === 1 ? '' : 's'}`;
+   const clock = (t: DebitTier) => `${days(t.withinDays!, t.business)} of ${t.from === 'statement' ? 'the statement that showed it' : 'finding out'}`;
+   const pays = (max: number) => (max === 0 ? 'nothing' : `at most ${amount(max)}`);
+   const claim = law.claimDays !== undefined ? ` within ${days(law.claimDays)} of the statement that showed it` : '';
+   const bounded = law.debitTiers.filter((t) => t.withinDays !== undefined && t.max !== undefined);
+   const rest = law.debitTiers.find((t) => t.withinDays === undefined);
+   const alike = credit && (law.creditMax === undefined || (bounded.length === 0 && rest?.max === law.creditMax));
+   const what = alike ? 'a card payment' : 'a debit card payment';
+   const said: string[] = [];
+   if (bounded.length > 0) {
+     const [first, ...later] = bounded;
+     said.push(`If ${what} wasn’t you, press Report It As Not Mine within ${clock(first!)}, and you pay ${pays(first!.max!)} of it.`);
+     const after = [...later.map((t) => `within ${clock(t)}, you pay ${pays(t.max!)}`), ...(rest ? [`after that, you pay ${rest.max === undefined ? 'all of it' : pays(rest.max)}`] : [])].join(', and ');
+     if (after) said.push(`${after.charAt(0).toUpperCase()}${after.slice(1)}.`);
+   } else if (rest?.max !== undefined) said.push(`If ${what} wasn’t you, press Report It As Not Mine${claim}, and you pay ${pays(rest.max)} of it.`);
+   else said.push(`No law was found here that limits what you pay of ${what} that wasn’t you.`);
+   if (credit && !alike && law.creditMax !== undefined) said.push(`On a credit card, you pay ${pays(law.creditMax)} of one you report${claim}.`);
+   return said.join(' ');
+ }
+
+ export function BankSecurity({ bankId }: { bankId: string }) {
+   const { sim, run, toast } = useGame();
+   const [why, setWhy] = useState<'damaged' | 'lost' | 'stolen'>('lost');
+   const cur = saveCurrency(sim.universe);
+   const money = (c: number) => formatMoney(c, cur);
+   const person = useWorld((s) => s.player);
+   const rules = SECURITY[bankId];
+   const bank = bankById(bankId);
+   const law = bank ? FRAUD_LAW[bank.iso] : undefined;
+   // The debit card this bank issued, and every credit card held, each under its own bank's rules: until 2026-09-28 a person held one credit card.
+   // Every current account's debit card, at each bank (from 2026-10-10: the primary account's only until then).
+   const debits = Object.values(sim.universe.accounts).filter((a) => a.ownerId === person.id && a.kind === 'checking' && !a.closedAt && !a.nominal);
+   const cards: { which: Which; account: Account }[] = [
+     ...debits.map((account) => ({ which: 'debit' as Which, account })),
+     ...cardsOf(sim, person).map((account) => ({ which: 'credit' as Which, account })),
+   ];
+   if (cards.length === 0) return null;
+   const held = cards.some((c) => c.which === 'credit');
+   const ceiling = FRENCH_CARDS[bankId];
+   const room = cardCeilingRoom(sim, person);
+   const learned = (person.fraud ?? []).map((one, index) => ({ one, index })).filter(({ one }) => one.learnedAt <= sim.now && one.reportedAt === undefined
+     && (sim.universe.accounts[one.accountId]?.bankId === bankId || cards.some((c) => c.account.id === one.accountId)));
+
+   return (
+     <Panel title="Your Cards" subtitle="Lock a card, report it lost or stolen, or report a payment that wasn’t yours" help="bank.card-security">
+       <LookRegion className="col gap-3">
+         {cards.map(({ which, account }) => {
+           const p = plasticView(sim, account, which);
+           const own = SECURITY[account.bankId ?? bankId];
+           const ownCurrency = bankById(account.bankId ?? bankId)?.currency ?? cur;
+           const fee = which === 'debit' ? own?.replaceFeeDebit : own?.replaceFeeCredit;
+           return (
+             <div key={account.id} className="col gap-2">
+               <div className="strong small"><Open subject={at('account', account.id)}>{which === 'debit' ? 'Debit card' : account.name} ending {p.last4}</Open>, expires <Open subject={at('day', dateKey(p.expiresAt, sim.homeZone))}>{formatDate(p.expiresAt, sim.zone)}</Open></div>
+               {p.stopped && <p className="small" style={{ margin: 0 }}>{p.stopped === 'new' ? 'This is a new account’s first card' : `${WHY_WORDS[p.stopped]}: stopped`}. {p.stopped === 'new' ? 'It' : 'A new one'} arrives {p.replacementAt ? formatDate(p.replacementAt, sim.zone) : 'soon'}.</p>}
+               {p.locked && !p.stopped && <p className="small" style={{ margin: 0 }}>Locked: nothing new can go on it until you unlock it.</p>}
+               {which === 'debit' && ceiling && (
+                 <p className="small" style={{ margin: 0 }}>
+                   It pays up to {money(inSaveMoney(sim, ceiling.ceiling, 'EUR'))} {ceiling.window === 'month' ? 'a calendar month' : 'over any 30 days'}. {room !== undefined ? `${money(room)} of that is left. ` : ''}Past it, a purchase goes on the credit card, or isn’t made. Source: {FRENCH_CARDS_SOURCE}. The limit shown is the lowest the bank sets, which is estimated.
+                 </p>
+               )}
+               <div className="row gap-2" style={{ flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
+                 {!p.stopped && (
+                   <Gated feature="card.lock" className="btn btn-sm btn-ghost" onClick={() => run('card.lock', { which, locked: !p.locked, accountId: account.id })}>{p.locked ? 'Unlock It' : 'Lock It'}</Gated>
+                 )}
+                 {!p.stopped && (
+                   <>
+                     <select aria-label="Why" style={{ width: 'auto' }} value={why} onChange={(e) => setWhy(e.target.value as typeof why)}>
+                       <option value="damaged">Damaged</option>
+                       <option value="lost">Lost</option>
+                       <option value="stolen">Stolen</option>
+                     </select>
+                     <Gated feature="card.report" className="btn btn-sm" onClick={() => {
+                       const answer = run<{ arrivesAt: number; fee: number }>('card.report', { which, why, accountId: account.id });
+                       if (answer.ok) toast(`The card is stopped. The new one arrives ${formatDate(answer.value!.arrivesAt, sim.zone)}${answer.value!.fee ? `, for ${money(answer.value!.fee)}` : ''}.`, 'positive');
+                     }}>Report It</Gated>
+                     {/* Where the bank lists a rush fee or rush days, as `card.report` takes it (from 2026-10-13: until
+                         then a rush fee alone, and Wells Fargo’s and Capital One’s days drew no button). Wells Fargo’s,
+                         a fee it doesn’t publish, draws none again from later that day (`rushUnpublished`). */}
+                     {(own?.rushFee !== undefined || own?.rushDays !== undefined) && (
+                       <Gated feature="card.report" className="btn btn-sm btn-ghost" onClick={() => run('card.report', { which, why, rush: true, accountId: account.id })}>Report It And Rush The New One</Gated>
+                     )}
+                   </>
+                 )}
+               </div>
+               <Fine>
+                 {fee === undefined && own?.replaceWords ? `The bank’s terms: ${own.replaceWords} The game charges nothing for it. ` : ''}
+                 {fee === undefined && !own?.replaceWords ? 'The bank lists no fee for a new card, so the game charges nothing for one.' : fee === undefined ? '' : fee === 0 ? 'A new card is free.' : `A new card costs ${money(inSaveMoney(sim, fee, ownCurrency))}${own?.freeFor?.length ? `, or nothing when it’s ${own.freeFor.map((w) => w).join(' or ')}` : ''}.`}
+                 {own?.rushFee !== undefined ? (own.rushFee === 0 ? ' A rushed one costs nothing more.' : ` A rushed one costs ${money(inSaveMoney(sim, own.rushFee, ownCurrency))} more.`)
+                   : own?.rushDays !== undefined ? ` A rushed one comes in ${own.rushDays} business ${own.rushDays === 1 ? 'day' : 'days'}. The bank lists no fee for it, so the game charges nothing.`
+                   // A rush the bank charges for and doesn’t price (from 2026-10-13): said, and not offered.
+                   : own?.rushUnpublished ? ` ${own.rushUnpublished} With no fee published, the game doesn’t offer a rushed card.` : ''}
+                 {(which === 'credit' ? own?.cardYearsCredit ?? own?.cardYears : own?.cardYears) === undefined ? ` Cards last ${ESTIMATE_YEARS} years here. That’s estimated: the bank doesn’t say.` : ''}
+               </Fine>
+             </div>
+           );
+         })}
+         {learned.map(({ one, index }) => (
+           <div key={index} className="row-between small">
+             <span>{money(one.amount)} {one.via === 'number' ? 'taken with your account number' : `on your ${one.which} card`}, {formatDate(one.at, sim.zone)}. Wasn’t this you?</span>
+             {disputeRefusal(sim, person, index) ? <span className="xs dim">{disputeRefusal(sim, person, index)}</span> : <Gated feature="card.dispute" className="btn btn-sm" onClick={() => {
+               const answer = run<{ carried: number; refundAt: number }>('card.dispute', { index });
+               if (answer.ok) toast(`Reported. The refund comes by ${formatDate(answer.value!.refundAt, sim.zone)}${answer.value!.carried ? `, less the ${money(answer.value!.carried)} the law leaves you to pay` : ''}.`, 'positive');
+             }}>Report It As Not Mine</Gated>}
+           </div>
+         ))}
+         {rules?.newNumberOnFraud && (() => {
+           // What a new number does (`EXPOSURE`, from 2026-10-10): attempts on the old one are declined; a card's own fraud is apart.
+           const current = person.primaryAccountId ? sim.universe.accounts[person.primaryAccountId] : undefined;
+           const exposed = current?.exposed;
+           const moved = exposed && current?.number !== exposed.number;
+           return (
+             <div className="col gap-1">
+               <p className="xs" style={{ margin: 0 }}>{!exposed ? 'Your account number isn’t known to be exposed. A new number would mean a new debit card, and wouldn’t protect you from anything yet.' : moved ? `Your old number was exposed on ${formatDate(exposed.at, sim.zone)}. The account has moved to a new number, and debits tried on the old one are declined until ${formatDate(exposed.until, sim.zone)}.` : `Your account number was exposed when your debit card was used on ${formatDate(exposed.at, sim.zone)}. Somebody could try debits on it until ${formatDate(exposed.until, sim.zone)}, and a new number stops them. It doesn’t stop a card being misused: that’s a separate risk.`}</p>
+               <Gated feature="bank.new_number" className="btn btn-sm btn-ghost" onClick={() => run('bank.new_number', {})}>Move My Account To A New Number</Gated>
+             </div>
+           );
+         })()}
+         {rules?.lostCardWords && <p className="xs dim" style={{ margin: 0 }}>{rules.lostCardWords}</p>}
+         {rules?.suspectWords && <p className="xs dim" style={{ margin: 0 }}>{rules.suspectWords}</p>}
+         {/* What to do and by when, then the law's own words behind a disclosure (from 2026-10-20, brief 16, section 7):
+             until then the law's words were three paragraphs here, of up to five sentences. */}
+         {law && bank && (
+           <p className="small" style={{ margin: 0 }}>
+             {reportByWords(law, (max) => { const c = inSaveMoney(sim, max, law.inEuros ? 'EUR' : bank.currency); return formatMoney(c, cur, { cents: c % 100 !== 0 }); }, held)}
+           </p>
+         )}
+         {(law?.debitWords || (law?.creditWords && held) || law?.refundWords) && (
+           <details className="xs dim">
+             <summary>What The Law Says</summary>
+             {law?.debitWords && <p className="xs dim" style={{ margin: 'var(--s2) 0 0' }}>The law on the debit card: {law.debitWords}</p>}
+             {law?.creditWords && held && <p className="xs dim" style={{ margin: 'var(--s2) 0 0' }}>The law on the credit card: {law.creditWords}</p>}
+             {law?.refundWords && <p className="xs dim" style={{ margin: 'var(--s2) 0 0' }}>The law on a payment you report as not yours: {law.refundWords}</p>}
+           </details>
+         )}
+         {(rules || law) && <Fine>Source: {[rules?.source, law?.source].filter(Boolean).join('; ')}.</Fine>}
+       </LookRegion>
+     </Panel>
+   );
+ }

+ /**
+  * SLATE — statements, the year, and alerts, on the bank's screen.
+  *
+  * Every account the character has held, open or closed, and each statement
+  * period it had: what it opened and closed at, every entry with the balance
+  * after it, and for the card what the statement asked and what paying only
+  * the minimum would take. The year's interest, the tax the bank took and
+  * every fee. And the alerts the bank sends (`systems/statements.ts`).
+  */
+
+ import { useState } from 'react';
+ import { useGame, useWorld } from '@/app/game-context';
+ import { Panel, Fine } from '@/ui/components/primitives';
+ import { Gated } from '@/ui/guide/Guide';
+ import { formatMoney, saveCurrency, centsFromTyped } from '@/engine/core/money';
+ import { dateKey, formatDate, zonedParts } from '@/engine/core/time';
+ import { LookRegion, Open, at, type Subject } from '@/ui/looks';
+ import type { Account } from '@/engine/core/ledger';
+ import { dueAt, stateOf } from '@/engine/systems/credit';
+ import { pendingOn } from '@/engine/systems/pending';
+ import { PENDING } from '@/engine/content/pending';
+ import { LOOKAHEAD_DAYS } from '@/engine/systems/obligations';
+ import {
+   accountStatement, alertsOf, cardStatement, periodsOf, yearSummary, type StatementLine,
+ } from '@/engine/systems/statements';
+
+ const KINDS = new Set(['checking', 'savings', 'credit_card', 'loan']);
+
+ export function BankStatements() {
+   const { sim } = useGame();
+   const accounts = useWorld((s) => Object.values(s.universe.accounts)
+     .filter((a) => a.ownerId === s.player.id && !a.nominal && KINDS.has(a.kind))
+     // Open ones first, the current account first among them.
+     .sort((a, b) => Number(Boolean(a.closedAt)) - Number(Boolean(b.closedAt)) || (a.id === s.player.primaryAccountId ? -1 : b.id === s.player.primaryAccountId ? 1 : 0)));
+   const [accountId, setAccountId] = useState('');
+   const account = accounts.find((a) => a.id === accountId) ?? accounts[0];
+   const periods = account ? periodsOf(sim, account) : [];
+   const [periodIndex, setPeriodIndex] = useState(0);
+   const period = periods[Math.min(periodIndex, periods.length - 1)];
+   if (!account || !period) return null;
+
+   return (
+     <>
+       <Panel title="Statements" subtitle="Every payment in and out of each account, with the balance after it.">
+         <div className="field-row">
+           <div className="field">
+             <label htmlFor="statement-account">Account</label>
+             <select id="statement-account" value={account.id} onChange={(e) => { setAccountId(e.target.value); setPeriodIndex(0); }}>
+               {accounts.map((a) => (
+                 <option key={a.id} value={a.id}>{a.name}{a.last4 ? ` ···${a.last4}` : ''}{a.institution ? `, ${a.institution}` : ''}{a.closedAt ? ' (Closed)' : ''}</option>
+               ))}
+             </select>
+           </div>
+           <div className="field">
+             <label htmlFor="statement-period">Period</label>
+             <select id="statement-period" value={periodIndex} onChange={(e) => setPeriodIndex(Number(e.target.value))}>
+               {periods.map((p, i) => <option key={p.from} value={i}>{p.label}</option>)}
+             </select>
+           </div>
+         </div>
+         {period.rebuilt && <p className="xs dim" style={{ margin: 0 }}>Rebuilt: this statement is from before the game kept card statements, so its dates are estimated from the earliest one kept. If you moved the statement day before then, they may be a few days off.</p>}
+         {account.kind === 'credit_card' ? <CardStatementView account={account} period={period} /> : <AccountStatementView account={account} period={period} />}
+       </Panel>
+       <YearView />
+       <AlertsView />
+     </>
+   );
+ }
+
+ /**
+  * A balance as the statement writes it, below zero with a minus sign (from 2026-10-20, brief 17): until then an overdrawn
+  * account's Available Now and the balance after each line read “-$600.00”, a hyphen, beside “−$20,165.00” in In / Out.
+  */
+ const signed = (cents: number, currency: string) => (cents < 0 ? `−${formatMoney(-cents, currency)}` : formatMoney(cents, currency));
+
+ function AccountStatementView({ account, period }: { account: Account; period: ReturnType<typeof periodsOf>[number] }) {
+   const { sim } = useGame();
+   const cur = saveCurrency(sim.universe);
+   const money = (c: number) => signed(c, cur);
+   const st = accountStatement(sim, account, period);
+   const owed = account.kind === 'loan';
+   const pending = pendingOn(sim, account);
+   const look = at('account', account.id);
+   // An account kept at home, in its bank's money as the bank's statement has it, the dollars under each (from 2026-10-16).
+   const h = st.held;
+   const own = (native: number, dollars: number) => (h && account.currency ? { value: signed(native, account.currency), note: `${money(dollars)} in dollars` } : { value: money(dollars) });
+   return (
+     <LookRegion className="col gap-3">
+       {h && account.currency && <p className="xs dim" style={{ margin: 0 }}>Figures are in {account.currency}, as {account.institution ?? 'the bank'} keeps them, with each one’s value in dollars under it, at an estimated exchange rate.</p>}
+       <div className="grid grid-3">
+         <Figure look={look} label={owed ? 'Owed At The Start' : 'Opening Balance'} {...own(h?.opening ?? 0, st.opening)} />
+         <Figure look={look} label={owed ? 'Paid Off' : 'Money In'} {...own(h?.moneyIn ?? 0, owed ? st.moneyOut : st.moneyIn)} />
+         <Figure look={look} label={owed ? 'Added' : 'Money Out'} {...own(h?.moneyOut ?? 0, owed ? st.moneyIn : st.moneyOut)} />
+         {!owed && <Figure look={look} label="Interest, After Tax" {...own(h?.interest ?? 0, st.interest)} />}
+         {!owed && <Figure look={look} label="Fees" {...own(h?.fees ?? 0, st.fees)} />}
+         <Figure look={look} label={owed ? 'Owed At The End' : period.to > sim.now ? 'Available Now' : 'Closing Balance'} {...own(h?.closing ?? 0, st.closing)} />
+         {!owed && period.to > sim.now && pending !== 0 && <Figure look={look} label="Posted Balance" value={money(st.closing - pending)} note="Posted payments only: what’s pending hasn’t posted yet" />}
+       </div>
+       <Lines lines={st.lines} sign={1} empty="No money went in or out of the account in this period." card={owed} valueDated={Boolean(account.bankId && PENDING[account.bankId]?.valueDating)} currency={account.currency} />
+       {!owed && account.bankId && PENDING[account.bankId] && <PendingTerms bankId={account.bankId} />}
+     </LookRegion>
+   );
+ }
+
+ /** How the bank holds and posts what's paid, in its words, and where they're from. */
+ function PendingTerms({ bankId }: { bankId: string }) {
+   const terms = PENDING[bankId]!;
+   const said = [
+     terms.pendingWords ? `A card payment: ${terms.pendingWords}` : '',
+     terms.postingOrder ? `Overnight: ${terms.postingOrder}` : '',
+     terms.valueDating ? `Value dates: ${terms.valueDating}` : '',
+   ].filter(Boolean);
+   return (
+     <Fine>
+       {said.join(' ')}{said.length ? ' ' : ''}Source: {terms.source}.{terms.pendingDays === undefined ? ' How long a card payment stays pending is estimated: the bank doesn’t say.' : ''}
+     </Fine>
+   );
+ }
+
+ function CardStatementView({ account, period }: { account: Account; period: ReturnType<typeof periodsOf>[number] }) {
+   const { sim } = useGame();
+   const cur = saveCurrency(sim.universe);
+   const money = (c: number) => formatMoney(c, cur);
+   const st = cardStatement(sim, account, period);
+   const closed = period.to <= sim.now;
+   const due = closed ? dueAt(sim.zone, period.to, st.terms.graceDays) : undefined;
+   // A balance carried into it: paid in full, what built up since still comes on the next, as trailing interest.
+   const carried = sim.player.credit !== undefined && stateOf(sim.player, account).carrying === true && st.previous > 0;
+   // On a hardship plan the due date judges the plan’s payment, never more than the statement, and not the card’s
+   // minimum (`autopayAsk`), so a statement whose due date comes while the plan stands asks for that. Until 2026-10-13
+   // this line gave the card’s minimum, which the statement kept, and a holder who paid it on a $100 plan was charged the
+   // late fee; found by the guide’s audit of that day. From later that day the statement keeps the plan’s payment, and
+   // says it’s the plan’s (`CardState.issued`), so a plan since ended still reads as it asked. One kept before then holds
+   // the card’s minimum, and is read against the plan standing now, as this line read every statement until then.
+   const plan = sim.player.credit !== undefined ? stateOf(sim.player, account).hardship : undefined;
+   const onPlan = st.plan ?? (plan !== undefined && due !== undefined && due >= plan.since);
+   const least = onPlan && st.plan === undefined && plan ? Math.min(st.newBalance, plan.payment) : st.minimum;
+   const look = at('account', account.id);
+   return (
+     <LookRegion className="col gap-3">
+       <div className="grid grid-3">
+         <Figure look={look} label="Brought Forward" value={money(st.previous)} />
+         <Figure look={look} label="Payments And Credits" value={money(st.payments)} />
+         <Figure look={look} label="Spending" value={money(st.spending)} />
+         <Figure look={look} label="Fees" value={money(st.fees)} />
+         <Figure look={look} label="Interest" value={money(st.interest)} />
+         <Figure look={look} label={closed ? 'New Balance' : 'Balance Now'} value={money(st.newBalance)} note={!closed && pendingOn(sim, account) !== 0 ? `${money(-pendingOn(sim, account))} of it pending` : undefined} />
+         <Figure look={look} label="Average Daily Balance" value={money(st.averageDaily)} note="What interest is charged on" />
+       </div>
+       {closed && st.newBalance > 0 && st.minimum !== undefined && (
+         <p className="small" style={{ margin: 0 }}>
+           {st.terms.kind === 'charge'
+             ? `${st.terms.issuer ?? 'The bank'} takes the whole ${money(st.newBalance)} from your checking account${due ? ` on ${formatDate(due, sim.zone)}` : ''}.`
+             : `${onPlan ? 'The plan’s payment' : 'The minimum payment'} is ${money(least!)}${due ? `, due ${formatDate(due, sim.zone)}` : ''}. Pay the whole ${money(st.newBalance)}, and ${carried ? 'new spending isn’t charged interest, though the interest that built up since this statement still comes on the next one' : 'none of it is charged interest'}.`}
+         </p>
+       )}
+       {/* On a plan nothing draws interest and nothing new goes on the card, so paying the plan’s payment clears it in so many
+           months at no more than it owes (from 2026-10-13: until then this said what paying the card’s minimum would take,
+           at the card’s rate, which a plan doesn’t charge; found by that day’s guide audit). */}
+       {closed && onPlan && least !== undefined && least > 0 && st.newBalance > 0 && st.terms.kind !== 'charge' && (
+         <div className="callout small">
+           {`On the plan there’s no interest, and nothing new goes on the card. Paying ${money(least)} a month clears the ${money(st.newBalance)} in ${yearsAndMonths(Math.ceil(st.newBalance / least))}, ${money(st.newBalance)} in all, as long as no payment is missed.`}
+         </div>
+       )}
+       {closed && !onPlan && st.minimumOnly && st.terms.kind !== 'charge' && (
+         <div className="callout small">
+           {st.minimumOnly === 'never'
+             ? 'Paying only the minimum, and spending nothing more, would never pay this off: the minimum doesn’t cover the interest.'
+             : `Paying only the minimum, and spending nothing more, takes ${yearsAndMonths(st.minimumOnly.months)} and ${money(st.minimumOnly.total)} in all. ${money(st.minimumOnly.threeYears)} a month pays it off in three years, ${money(st.minimumOnly.threeYearsTotal)} in all.`}
+         </div>
+       )}
+       {st.nextInterest !== undefined && (
+         <p className="xs dim" style={{ margin: 0 }}>If none of it is paid, next month’s interest will be about {money(st.nextInterest)}.</p>
+       )}
+       <Lines lines={st.lines} sign={1} empty="The card wasn’t used or paid in this period." card />
+     </LookRegion>
+   );
+ }
+
+ function YearView() {
+   const { sim } = useGame();
+   const cur = saveCurrency(sim.universe);
+   const money = (c: number) => formatMoney(c, cur);
+   // From the first entry in the books, the life's first morning.
+   const first = zonedParts(sim.universe.transactions[0]?.at ?? sim.now, sim.zone).year;
+   const last = zonedParts(sim.now, sim.zone).year;
+   const years = Array.from({ length: last - first + 1 }, (_, i) => last - i);
+   const [year, setYear] = useState(last);
+   const y = yearSummary(sim, sim.player.id, year);
+   return (
+     <Panel title="The Year" subtitle="Interest, the tax taken off it, and every fee, as the bank reports them for the year.">
+       <div className="field" style={{ maxWidth: 240 }}>
+         <label htmlFor="statement-year">Year</label>
+         <select id="statement-year" value={year} onChange={(e) => setYear(Number(e.target.value))}>
+           {years.map((one) => <option key={one} value={one}>{one}{one === last ? ', So Far' : ''}</option>)}
+         </select>
+       </div>
+       <div className="grid grid-3" style={{ marginTop: 'var(--s3)' }}>
+         <Figure label="Interest Earned" value={money(y.interestEarned)} note="Before tax" />
+         <Figure label="Tax Taken Off It" value={money(y.taxTaken)} />
+         <Figure label="Bank Fees" value={money(y.bankFees)} />
+         <Figure label="Card Fees" value={money(y.cardFees)} />
+         <Figure label="Card Interest Paid" value={money(y.cardInterest)} />
+       </div>
+       {y.byFee.length > 0 && (
+         <div className="col gap-1" style={{ marginTop: 'var(--s3)' }}>
+           {y.byFee.map((one) => (
+             <div key={one.memo} className="row-between small"><span>{one.memo}</span><span className="mono">{money(one.amount)}</span></div>
+           ))}
+         </div>
+       )}
+     </Panel>
+   );
+ }
+
+ function AlertsView() {
+   const { sim, run, toast } = useGame();
+   const cur = saveCurrency(sim.universe);
+   const alerts = useWorld((s) => alertsOf(s.player));
+   const [low, setLow] = useState(alerts.lowBalance !== undefined ? String(alerts.lowBalance / 100) : '');
+   const [large, setLarge] = useState(alerts.largePayment !== undefined ? String(alerts.largePayment / 100) : '');
+   const cents = (v: string) => (v.trim() === '' ? null : centsFromTyped(v));
+   const save = () => {
+     const answer = run('bank.set_alerts', { lowBalance: cents(low), largePayment: cents(large) });
+     if (answer.ok) toast('Alerts saved.', 'positive');
+   };
+   return (
+     <Panel title="Alerts" subtitle={`What the bank tells you, in What Needs You. Short For A Payment tells you once when an account can’t cover a standing order, a payment set for a date, card autopay or a loan payment due from it in the next ${['no', 'one', 'two', 'three', 'four', 'five', 'six', 'seven', 'eight', 'nine'][LOOKAHEAD_DAYS] ?? LOOKAHEAD_DAYS} days. That alert is the game’s own, not a feature of a real bank.`} help="bank.set_alerts">
+       <div className="field-row">
+         <div className="field">
+           <label htmlFor="alert-low">Any Checking Account Under ({cur})</label>
+           <input id="alert-low" type="text" inputMode="decimal" placeholder="Off" value={low} onChange={(e) => setLow(e.target.value)} />
+         </div>
+         <div className="field">
+           <label htmlFor="alert-large">A Payment Over ({cur})</label>
+           <input id="alert-large" type="text" inputMode="decimal" placeholder="Off" value={large} onChange={(e) => setLarge(e.target.value)} />
+         </div>
+       </div>
+       <div className="row gap-2" style={{ flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
+         <Gated feature="bank.set_alerts" className="btn btn-sm btn-primary" onClick={save}>Save Alerts</Gated>
+         <Gated feature="bank.set_alerts" className="btn btn-sm btn-ghost" onClick={() => run('bank.set_alerts', { statements: !alerts.statements })}>
+           Statement Ready: {alerts.statements ? 'On' : 'Off'}
+         </Gated>
+         <Gated feature="bank.set_alerts" className="btn btn-sm btn-ghost" onClick={() => run('bank.set_alerts', { upcoming: alerts.upcoming === false })}>
+           Short For A Payment: {alerts.upcoming === false ? 'Off' : 'On'}
+         </Gated>
+       </div>
+     </Panel>
+   );
+ }
