+ /** A figure, labeled. */
+ function Figure({ label, value, note, look }: { label: string; value: string; note?: string; look?: Subject }) {
+   const inner = (
+     <>
+       <span className="stat-label">{label}</span>{' '}
+       <span className="stat-value mono" style={{ fontSize: 'var(--size-md)' }}>{value}</span>
+       {note && <>{' '}<span className="stat-note">{note}</span></>}
+     </>
+   );
+   return <div className="stat">{look ? <Open subject={look}>{inner}</Open> : inner}</div>;
+ }
+
+ /** The entries, newest first as a banking app shows them, each with the balance after it. */
+ function Lines({ lines, sign, empty, card, valueDated, currency }: { lines: StatementLine[]; sign: 1 | -1; empty: string; card?: boolean; valueDated?: boolean; currency?: string }) {
+   const { sim } = useGame();
+   const cur = saveCurrency(sim.universe);
+   // An account kept at home: each line and the balance after it in the bank's money (from 2026-10-16).
+   const shownIn = (dollars: number, native: number | undefined) => (currency && native !== undefined ? signed(native, currency) : signed(dollars, cur));
+   if (lines.length === 0) return <p className="small muted" style={{ margin: 0 }}>{empty}</p>;
+   return (
+     <div className="statement-lines">
+       <div className="row-between xs dim" style={{ padding: '4px 0', borderBottom: '1px solid var(--line)' }}>
+         <span style={{ flex: '0 0 110px' }}>Date</span>
+         <span style={{ flex: 1 }}>What</span>
+         <span style={{ flex: '0 0 130px', textAlign: 'right' }}>{card ? 'Charged / Paid' : 'In / Out'}</span>
+         <span style={{ flex: '0 0 130px', textAlign: 'right' }}>{card ? 'Owed After' : 'Balance'}</span>
+       </div>
+       {[...lines].reverse().map((line) => {
+         const shown = line.amount * sign;
+         const credit = card ? shown < 0 : shown > 0;
+         return (
+           <div key={line.id} className="row-between small" style={{ padding: '4px 0', borderBottom: '1px solid var(--line-soft, var(--line))' }}>
+             <span className="dim" style={{ flex: '0 0 110px' }}><Open subject={at('day', dateKey(line.at, sim.homeZone))}>{formatDate(line.at, sim.zone)}</Open></span>
+             <span style={{ flex: 1 }}><Open subject={at('transaction', line.id)}>{line.memo}</Open>{line.pending ? <span className="xs dim"> · Pending, posts {formatDate(line.postsAt!, sim.zone)}</span> : valueDated && line.postsAt !== undefined ? <span className="xs dim"> · Booked {formatDate(line.postsAt, sim.zone)}, value {formatDate(line.at, sim.zone)}</span> : null}</span>
+             <span className={`mono ${credit ? 'positive' : ''}`} style={{ flex: '0 0 130px', textAlign: 'right' }}>
+               <Open subject={at('transaction', line.id)}>{credit ? '+' : '−'}{shownIn(Math.abs(shown), line.native === undefined ? undefined : Math.abs(line.native))}</Open>
+             </span>
+             <span className="mono dim" style={{ flex: '0 0 130px', textAlign: 'right' }}>{shownIn(line.balance * sign, line.heldAfter === undefined ? undefined : line.heldAfter * sign)}</span>
+           </div>
+         );
+       })}
+     </div>
+   );
+ }
+
+ function yearsAndMonths(months: number): string {
+   const y = Math.floor(months / 12);
+   const m = months % 12;
+   const years = y === 0 ? '' : y === 1 ? 'a year' : `${y} years`;
+   const rest = m === 0 ? '' : m === 1 ? 'a month' : `${m} months`;
+   return [years, rest].filter(Boolean).join(' and ') || 'under a month';
+ }

+ /**
+  * SLATE — round-ups on the bank's screen (from 2026-10-13, `systems/roundups.ts`): what the bank's feature does, the
+  * choices it leaves to the customer, On or Off, what's counted and waiting, what came of the last transfer, what happens
+  * when the account is short, and what the bank leaves open and SLATE leaves out, with the source and the day it was read.
+  *
+  * Until 2026-10-13 it was the bank's words and an On/Off button: a bank whose amount the customer chooses had SLATE's
+  * estimate said beside it, and nothing showed what was waiting or what came of a night's transfer.
+  */
+
+ import { useState } from 'react';
+ import { useGame, useWorld } from '@/app/game-context';
+ import { Gated } from '@/ui/guide/Guide';
+ import { HowItWorks } from '@/ui/guide/HowItWorks';
+ import { WhyNot } from '@/ui/components/primitives';
+ import { formatMoney, saveCurrency } from '@/engine/core/money';
+ import { formatDate, formatDateKey } from '@/engine/core/time';
+ import { bankById } from '@/engine/content/banks';
+ import { ROUND_UPS, type RoundUpEvery } from '@/engine/content/roundups';
+ import type { RoundUpChoice } from '@/engine/domain/model';
+ import { roundUpEveryWords, roundUpMoney, roundUpRefusal, roundUpsOn, wayOf } from '@/engine/systems/roundups';
+
+ const pick = (r: RoundUpChoice | undefined): RoundUpChoice => ({ way: r?.way, unit: r?.unit, amount: r?.amount, multiplier: r?.multiplier, every: r?.every, minimum: r?.minimum });
+ const same = (a: RoundUpChoice, b: RoundUpChoice) => (['way', 'unit', 'amount', 'multiplier', 'every', 'minimum'] as const).every((k) => a[k] === b[k]);
+
+ export function RoundUps({ bankId }: { bankId: string }) {
+   const { sim, run } = useGame();
+   const person = useWorld((s) => s.player);
+   const primaryBank = useWorld((s) => s.universe.accounts[s.player.primaryAccountId ?? '']?.bankId);
+   const rule = ROUND_UPS[bankId];
+   const r = person.roundUps;
+   const here = primaryBank === bankId;
+   const mine = here && r !== undefined && (r.bankId === undefined || r.bankId === bankId);
+   const [choice, setChoice] = useState<RoundUpChoice>(() => (mine ? pick(r) : {}));
+   if (!rule) return null;
+   const name = bankById(bankId)?.name ?? 'This bank';
+   const cur = saveCurrency(sim.universe);
+   const money = (n: number) => roundUpMoney(bankId, n);
+   const on = mine && Boolean(r?.on);
+   const counting = here && roundUpsOn(sim, person);
+   const why = here ? roundUpRefusal(sim, person, choice) : `Round-ups at ${name} only work when a ${name} checking account is your primary account.`;
+   const way = wayOf(rule, choice);
+   const changed = on && !same(choice, pick(r));
+   const wayNow = wayOf(rule, r);
+   const unitNow = wayNow?.kind === 'change' ? (wayNow.units.length === 1 ? wayNow.units[0]! : r?.unit ?? 1) : 1;
+   const set = (k: keyof RoundUpChoice) => (e: { target: { value: string } }) => setChoice((c) => ({ ...c, [k]: e.target.value === '' ? undefined : k === 'every' ? (e.target.value as RoundUpEvery) : Number(e.target.value) }));
+   const select = (label: string, k: keyof RoundUpChoice, options: readonly (readonly [string | number, string])[]) => (
+     <label className="xs col" style={{ gap: 2 }}>
+       {label}
+       <select className="input input-sm" aria-label={label} value={choice[k] ?? ''} onChange={set(k)}>
+         <option value="">Choose…</option>
+         {options.map(([v, words]) => <option key={v} value={v}>{words}</option>)}
+       </select>
+     </label>
+   );
+
+   return (
+     <div data-roundups={bankId}>
+       <p className="small" style={{ margin: '0 0 4px' }}>
+         <span className="strong">Round-Ups, {rule.product}.</span> {rule.words}
+       </p>
+       <div className="row gap-2" style={{ flexWrap: 'wrap', alignItems: 'flex-end', marginBottom: 4 }}>
+         {rule.ways.length > 1 && select('How It Counts', 'way', rule.ways.map((w, i) => [i, w.kind === 'change' ? 'Rounded Up' : 'A Set Amount'] as const))}
+         {way?.kind === 'change' && way.units.length > 1 && select('Round Up To', 'unit', way.units.map((u) => [u, `The next ${money(u)}`] as const))}
+         {way?.kind === 'change' && way.multipliers && select('Multiplier', 'multiplier', way.multipliers.map((m) => [m, `×${m}${m === rule.defaultMultiplier ? ', just the change' : ''}`] as const))}
+         {way?.kind === 'flat' && way.amounts && way.amounts.length > 1 && select('Each Purchase', 'amount', way.amounts.map((a) => [a, money(a)] as const))}
+         {way?.kind === 'changePlus' && select('Amount', 'amount', way.amounts.map((a) => [a, money(a)] as const))}
+         {way?.kind === 'flat' && way.range && (
+           <label className="xs col" style={{ gap: 2 }}>
+             Each Purchase, {money(way.range.min)} To {money(way.range.max)}
+             <input className="input input-sm" type="number" aria-label="Each Purchase" min={way.range.min} max={way.range.max} step={0.01} value={choice.amount ?? ''} onChange={set('amount')} style={{ width: 110 }} />
+           </label>
+         )}
+         {rule.every && select('How Often', 'every', rule.every.map((e) => [e, roundUpEveryWords(e)[0]!.toUpperCase() + roundUpEveryWords(e).slice(1)] as const))}
+         {rule.minimumAtLeast !== undefined && (
+           <label className="xs col" style={{ gap: 2 }}>
+             Minimum Balance, At Least {money(rule.minimumAtLeast)}
+             <input className="input input-sm" type="number" aria-label="Minimum Balance" min={rule.minimumAtLeast} step={1} value={choice.minimum ?? ''} onChange={set('minimum')} style={{ width: 110 }} />
+           </label>
+         )}
+       </div>
+       <div className="row gap-2" style={{ flexWrap: 'wrap', alignItems: 'center' }}>
+         <Gated feature="bank.set_round_ups" className="btn btn-sm btn-ghost" disabled={!on && Boolean(why)} onClick={() => run('bank.set_round_ups', on ? { on: false } : { on: true, ...choice })}>
+           Round-Ups: {on ? 'On' : 'Off'}
+         </Gated>
+         {changed && (
+           <Gated feature="bank.set_round_ups" className="btn btn-sm btn-ghost" disabled={Boolean(why)} onClick={() => run('bank.set_round_ups', { on: true, ...choice })}>
+             Save These Choices
+           </Gated>
+         )}
+         <HowItWorks help="bank.round-ups" />
+       </div>
+       {!on && <WhyNot reasons={[['Turn On', why]]} />}
+       {changed && <WhyNot reasons={[['Save These Choices', why]]} />}
+       {on && !counting && <p className="xs dim" style={{ margin: 0 }}>Round-ups aren’t counting right now. {roundUpRefusal(sim, person, pick(r)) ?? 'Your primary account isn’t at this bank.'}</p>}
+       {mine && ((r?.pending ?? 0) > 0 || (r?.due ?? 0) > 0) && (
+         <p className="xs" style={{ margin: 0 }} data-roundups-waiting="">
+           Counted but not moved yet: {formatMoney(r!.pending, cur)}{(r?.due ?? 0) > 0 ? `, and ${formatMoney(r!.due!, cur)} moves at the start of the next business day` : ''}.
+         </p>
+       )}
+       {mine && (r?.whole ?? 0) > 0 && (
+         <p className="xs dim" style={{ margin: 0 }} data-roundups-whole="">
+           {r!.whole === 1 ? `One purchase since the last transfer was already a multiple of ${money(unitNow)}, so it added nothing.` : `${r!.whole} purchases since the last transfer were already a multiple of ${money(unitNow)}, so they added nothing.`}
+         </p>
+       )}
+       {mine && r?.last && (
+         <p className="xs" style={{ margin: 0 }} data-roundups-last="">
+           {r.last.moved !== undefined ? `Last moved to savings: ${formatMoney(r.last.moved, cur)}, on ${formatDate(r.last.at, sim.zone)}.` : `Not moved on ${formatDate(r.last.at, sim.zone)}: ${formatMoney(r.last.notMoved ?? 0, cur)}, because ${r.last.why}.`}
+         </p>
+       )}
+       <p className="xs dim" style={{ margin: '2px 0 0' }}>When the account is short: {rule.short}</p>
+       <details className="xs" style={{ marginTop: 2 }}>
+         <summary className="dim">What The Bank Leaves Open, And What The Game Leaves Out</summary>
+         <ul style={{ margin: 'var(--s1) 0 0', paddingLeft: 'var(--s4)' }}>
+           {rule.open.map((o) => <li key={o}>{o}</li>)}
+           {rule.notHere.map((o) => <li key={o}>Not in the game: {o}</li>)}
+         </ul>
+         {/* Read and checked on one day said once (from 2026-10-17): until then most banks read "read live October 13,
+             2026, checked October 13, 2026." */}
+         <p className="dim" style={{ margin: 'var(--s1) 0 0' }}>Source: {rule.source.endsWith(`read live ${formatDateKey(rule.checked)}`) ? rule.source.replace(/read live (?=[^,]*, \d{4}$)/, 'read live and checked ') : `${rule.source}, checked ${formatDateKey(rule.checked)}`}.</p>
+       </details>
+     </div>
+   );
+ }
+
+ /**
+  * SLATE — a current account's monthly fee and how its bank waives it, in the bank's own conditions (from 2026-10-16: moved
+  * here from `ui/workspaces/BankWorkspace.tsx`, which says it for an account held, so the opening panel,
+  * `ui/bank/BankMoves.tsx`, says it before Apply). The figures are the product's, the ones `feeFor`
+  * (`systems/banking.ts`) charges by.
+  */
+ import type { Product } from '@/engine/content/banks';
+
+ /**
+  * How a fee is waived, the way the bank puts its conditions, each one an "or", and what lowers it. From 2026-10-17 each
+  * condition is something the player does in a month ("in any month you keep $1,500 in it all month") or a time it holds
+  * ("while you’re under 24"), where it had said "waived with keeping $1,500 in it all month, or being under 24".
+  */
+ export function waiverWords(product: Product, money: (cents: number) => string): string {
+   const waiver = product.waiver;
+   // As the bank counts them: any electronic deposit where it does, and until 2026-09-27 this said wages for every bank.
+   const paidIn = product.deposits === 'electronic' ? 'of electronic deposits (wages, benefits or a tax refund) paid in' : 'of wages paid in';
+   const either = (month: string[], age: string[]): string => [month.length ? `in any month you ${month.join(', or ')}` : '', ...age].filter(Boolean).join(', or ');
+   const cut = product.reduced;
+   const lower = !cut ? '' : `; it’s ${money(cut.to)} ${either([
+     ...(cut.depositsAtLeast !== undefined ? [`have ${money(cut.depositsAtLeast)} ${paidIn}`] : []),
+     ...(cut.averageAtLeast !== undefined ? [`keep an average of ${money(cut.averageAtLeast)} in it over the month`] : []),
+   ], cut.ageBelow !== undefined ? [`while you’re under ${cut.ageBelow}`] : [])}`;
+   if (!waiver) return lower;
+   // Deutsche Bank's month of opening, free (from 2026-10-16, `Product.waiver.openingMonth`).
+   const free = [
+     ...(waiver.openingMonth ? [', free in the month it opens'] : []),
+     ...(waiver.firstMonths !== undefined ? [`, free for the first ${waiver.firstMonths} months after it opens`] : []),
+   ].join('');
+   const month: string[] = [];
+   if (waiver.depositsAtLeast !== undefined) {
+     const also = waiver.depositsAlso;
+     const extra = !also ? '' : also.either !== undefined
+       ? ` and have made ${also.either} bill or card payments in the last ${also.months} months`
+       : ` and have made ${[also.bills !== undefined ? `${also.bills} bill payments` : '', also.purchases !== undefined ? `${also.purchases} card payments` : ''].filter(Boolean).join(' or ')} in the last ${also.months} months`;
+     month.push(`have ${money(waiver.depositsAtLeast)} ${paidIn}${extra}`);
+   }
+   if (waiver.balanceAtLeast !== undefined) month.push(`keep ${money(waiver.balanceAtLeast)} in it all month`);
+   if (waiver.averageAtLeast !== undefined) month.push(`keep an average of ${money(waiver.averageAtLeast)} in it over the month`);
+   if (waiver.linkedAverageAtLeast !== undefined) month.push(`keep an average of ${money(waiver.linkedAverageAtLeast)} across your accounts at the bank`);
+   if (waiver.purchasesAtLeast !== undefined) month.push(`make ${waiver.purchasesAtLeast} card payments`);
+   const age = [
+     ...(waiver.ageBelow !== undefined ? [`while you’re under ${waiver.ageBelow}`] : []),
+     ...(waiver.ageAtLeast !== undefined ? [`once you’re ${waiver.ageAtLeast} or over`] : []),
+   ];
+   if (month.length === 0 && age.length === 0) return `${free}${lower}`;
+   return `${free}, waived ${either(month, age)}${lower}`;
+ }
+
+ /** The suffix of an ordinal day, "st" for the 1st: for a day of the month written as a figure. */
+ export function nth(n: number): string {
+   const tens = n % 100;
+   if (tens >= 11 && tens <= 13) return 'th';
+   return n % 10 === 1 ? 'st' : n % 10 === 2 ? 'nd' : n % 10 === 3 ? 'rd' : 'th';
+ }

+ /** The routes the policy allows: the School's follow-up, and a referral from someone you've worked with. */

+ /** Why It Went This Way: the last decision's factors as they were, and where they stand now. */
+ function WhyPanel({ agent }: { agent: Agent }) {
+   const { sim } = useGame();
+   const person = useWorld((s) => s.player);
+   const rel = relationOf(person, agent.id);
+   // Kept while the player is elsewhere, as a screen keeps its tab (`ui/kept.ts`): where they were looking, never the save.
+   const [open, setOpen] = useKept<boolean>(`reasons:${agent.id}`, false);
+   const now = interestOf(sim, person, agent, sim.now);
+   const why = rel?.why;
+   // A block a factor, its name and level on one line and the reason under it: a three-column table clipped its reasons
+   // inside the panel at 390 on the built app (the walk of 2026-10-21), and this reads at any width.
+   const rows = (factors: readonly { id: string; label: string; level: string; words: string }[]) => (
+     <ul className="col gap-3" style={{ margin: 0, padding: 0, listStyle: 'none' }}>
+       {factors.map((f) => (
+         <li key={f.id} className="col gap-1">
+           <div className="row gap-2" style={{ flexWrap: 'wrap', alignItems: 'baseline' }}>
+             <h4 className="small strong" style={{ margin: 0 }}>{f.label}</h4>
+             <span className={LEVEL_TONE[f.level as Level]}>{LEVEL_LABEL[f.level as Level]}</span>
+           </div>
+           <p className="small" style={{ margin: 0 }}>{f.words}</p>
+         </li>
+       ))}
+     </ul>
+   );
+   return (
+     <Panel title="Why It Went This Way" help="career.reasons">
+       <div className="col gap-3">
+         <p className="small" style={{ margin: 0 }}>{why ? `His office’s last decision was on ${formatDate(why.at, sim.zone)}. The game’s reasons for it are seven separate factors, each against a bar the game sets.` : 'His office hasn’t decided anything yet. The game’s reasons for a decision are seven separate factors, each against a bar the game sets.'}</p>
+         <div><Gated feature="ui.career-reasons" className="btn btn-sm" aria-expanded={open} onClick={() => setOpen((v) => !v)}>{open ? 'Hide The Reasons' : 'Show The Reasons'}</Gated></div>
+         {open && (
+           <div className="col gap-4">
+             {why && (
+               <div className="col gap-2">
+                 <h3 className="eyebrow" style={{ margin: 0 }}>At The Last Decision</h3>
+                 {rows(why.factors)}
+                 <p className="small" style={{ margin: 0 }}>{`${ofSeven(why.atOrBeyond)} were at the bar or beyond, and an approach needs ${countWords(why.needed)}.${why.chance !== undefined ? ` Against the year’s other actors, the game gave ${why.step === 'decision' ? 'an offer' : 'it'} about a ${Math.round(why.chance * 100)}% chance.` : ''}`}</p>
+               </div>
+             )}
+             <div className="col gap-2">
+               <h3 className="eyebrow" style={{ margin: 0 }}>As Things Stand Now</h3>
+               {rows(now.factors)}
+               <p className="small" style={{ margin: 0 }}>{`${ofSeven(now.atOrBeyond)} are at the bar or beyond, and an approach needs ${countWords(now.needed)}.${now.gate ? ` Against the year’s other actors, the game would give it about a ${Math.round(now.chance * 100)}% chance.` : ''}`}</p>
+             </div>
+           </div>
+         )}
+         <Fine>{`The bar, the ${countWords(GATE)} factors an approach needs and the chances are all the game’s own, none of them his. Better work raises the chance, and the game never makes it certain. Room On His List is drawn for each year and assumed.`}</Fine>
+       </div>
+     </Panel>
+   );
+ }

+ /** The agreement: every term in full before it's accepted, then its standing, its ends and what it leaves owed. */
+ function AgreementPanel({ agent }: { agent: Agent }) {
+   const { sim, run, toast } = useGame();
+   const person = useWorld((s) => s.player);
+   const offered = offeredAgreement(person, agent);
+   const inForce = agreementInForce(person, agent, sim.now);
+   const ended = [...(person.pro?.agreements ?? [])].filter((a) => a.agentId === agent.id && a.status === 'ended').sort((a, b) => (b.endedAt ?? 0) - (a.endedAt ?? 0))[0];
+   const shown = offered ?? inForce;
+   const answerNo = answerRefusal(sim, person, agent);
+   const ends: readonly [EndHow, string][] = [['agreement', 'End It By Agreement'], ['no-offer', `End It: No Offer In ${AGREEMENT.noOfferDays} Days`], ['too-little-work', `End It: Under ${capital(TEN)} Days’ Work`]];
+   if (!shown && !ended) return null;
+   return (
+     <Panel title="The Agreement" help="career.agreement">
+       <div className="col gap-3">
+         {offered && <p className="small" style={{ margin: 0 }}>{`He offered it on ${formatDate(offered.offeredAt, sim.zone)}, and the offer stands until ${formatDate(offered.standsUntil, sim.zone)}. Read every term before you answer.`}</p>}
+         {inForce && <p className="small" style={{ margin: 0 }}>{`You signed it on ${formatDate(inForce.signedAt!, sim.zone)}. It runs until ${formatDate(inForce.endsAt!, sim.zone)}.`}</p>}
+         {!shown && ended && <p className="small" style={{ margin: 0 }}>{`It ended on ${formatDate(ended.endedAt!, sim.zone)}. ${stillOwed(person, ended)}`}</p>}
+         {shown && (
+           <dl className="col gap-2 small" style={{ margin: 0 }}>
+             {shown.terms.map((t) => (
+               <div key={t.id}>
+                 <dt className="strong">{`${t.heading} (${t.basis === 'verified' ? 'A Published Rule' : 'The Game’s Own Term'})`}</dt>
+                 <dd style={{ margin: 0 }}>{t.words}</dd>
+               </div>
+             ))}
+           </dl>
+         )}
+         {offered && (
+           <>
+             <div className="row gap-2" style={{ flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
+               <Gated feature="pro.accept_agreement" className="btn btn-sm" disabled={!!answerNo} title={answerNo} onClick={() => { const r = run('pro.accept_agreement', { agentId: agent.id }); if (r.ok) toast(`${agent.name} represents you from today.`, 'positive'); }}>Accept The Agreement</Gated>
+               <Gated feature="pro.decline_agreement" className="btn btn-sm" disabled={!!answerNo} title={answerNo} onClick={() => { const r = run('pro.decline_agreement', { agentId: agent.id }); if (r.ok) toast('You declined the agreement.', 'neutral'); }}>Decline The Agreement</Gated>
+             </div>
+             <WhyNot reasons={[['Accept The Agreement', answerNo], ['Decline The Agreement', answerNo]]} />
+           </>
+         )}
+         {inForce && (
+           <>
+             <div className="row gap-2" style={{ flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
+               {ends.map(([how, label]) => {
+                 const no = endRefusal(sim, person, agent, how);
+                 return <Gated key={how} feature="pro.end_agreement" className="btn btn-sm" disabled={!!no} title={no} onClick={() => { const r = run('pro.end_agreement', { agentId: agent.id, how }); if (r.ok) toast('Your agreement has ended.', 'neutral'); }}>{label}</Gated>;
+               })}
+             </div>
+             <WhyNot reasons={ends.map(([how, label]) => [label, endRefusal(sim, person, agent, how)] as const)} />
+           </>
+         )}
+         <Fine>Each term marked A Published Rule follows the unions’ and New York’s published rules, with their sources in the game’s research. A term marked The Game’s Own Term is the game’s, and nothing here is his own agreement, which isn’t published.</Fine>
+       </div>
+     </Panel>
+   );
+ }

+ const capital = (s: string): string => s.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + s.slice(1);
+ /** How many of the seven factors, as a sentence opens on it: "None of the seven", "Four of the seven", "All seven". */
+ const ofSeven = (n: number): string => (n >= 7 ? 'All seven' : n === 0 ? 'None of the seven' : `${capital(countWords(n))} of the seven`);

+ /**
+  * SLATE — the first recommendation, short, with its reasoning behind Why This Recommendation (from 2026-10-20, the owner's
+  * brief 16, section 6; `adviceSummary`). The Player Profile's What To Work On Next and a brief's What To Work On draw it
+  * alike, so the two say the same thing the same way. Until then each drew every recommendation's whole reasoning inline.
+  *
+  * The details are a native disclosure: a button to the keyboard and to a screen reader, opened with Enter or Space, and
+  * shut by default. What a reader of the screen looks for keeps its mark inside it (`data-standing`, `data-assumes`,
+  * `data-attention`); the action keeps `data-next`.
+  *
+  * From 2026-10-20 (brief 17) what the record shows of it now has a line of its own under why it matters (`continuing`,
+  * `data-continuing`): how long it has led, the recent pieces it held back, how long since any work was judged.
+  */
+
+ import type { AdviceSummary } from '@/engine/systems/next-steps';
+
+ const P = { margin: 0 } as const;
+
+ export function AdviceCard({ advice, heading }: { advice: AdviceSummary; heading?: string }) {
+   return (
+     <div className="col gap-1" data-advice="">
+       {heading && <div className="eyebrow">{heading}</div>}
+       <p className="small" style={P}><strong>{advice.what}</strong>. {advice.why}</p>
+       {advice.continuing && <p className="small" style={P} data-continuing="">{advice.continuing}</p>}
+       {advice.action && <p className="small" style={P} data-next="">{advice.action}</p>}
+       {advice.estimate && <p className="small" style={P} data-estimate="">{advice.estimate}</p>}
+       {advice.unavailable && <p className="xs why-not" style={P}>{advice.unavailable}</p>}
+       {advice.details.length > 0 && (
+         <details className="advice-why small" data-why="">
+           <summary>Why This Recommendation</summary>
+           {advice.details.map((d) => (
+             <div key={d.heading} className="col gap-1" style={{ marginTop: 'var(--s2)' }}>
+               <div className="eyebrow" role="heading" aria-level={4}>{d.heading}</div>
+               {d.lines.length === 1 || !d.list
+                 ? d.lines.map((l, i) => <p key={i} className="xs" style={P} {...(d.mark && i === 0 ? { [`data-${d.mark}`]: '' } : {})}>{l}</p>)
+                 : <ul className="xs" style={P}>{d.lines.map((l, i) => <li key={i}>{l}</li>)}</ul>}
+               {d.after?.map((l, i) => <p key={`after-${i}`} className="xs" style={P}>{l}</p>)}
+             </div>
+           ))}
+         </details>
+       )}
+     </div>
+   );
+ }

It grows a little with every night in front of an audience and every solo showing. To train it, practice Graded Exposure under Attributes And Craft on your Player Profile.</p>

'alone' : Number(draft) }); if (r.ok) toast(`Reading with ${r.value!.reader}.`, 'positive'); }}>Read With Them</Gated>
+       </div>
+       {no && <p className="xs dim" style={{ margin: 0 }}>{no}</p>}
+       <p className="xs dim" style={{ margin: 0 }}>{rec?.reader && mates[rec.reader.mate] ? `${mates[rec.reader.mate]!.name} has it ${pct(rec.reader.prep)} prepared with you: Rehearse It On Your Feet brings them along, and so does running it with them.` : `A recording answers on cue and never slips, but it can’t listen.`}</p>
+     </div>
+   );
+ }
+ const pct = (x: number) => `${Math.round(x * 100)}%`;
+ const isAbility = (id: string) => ABILITY_DEFS.some((d) => d.id === id);
+
+ /**
+  * What an hour and a half of study says, here and on the Player Profile: the work studied and the familiarity it came
+  * to (from 2026-10-12: until then Study It and Study The Genre said nothing, the work studied, `study`'s `with`, was read
+  * by nothing, and here a study that left familiarity under practice changed nothing on the screen).
+  */
+ export const studiedWords = (genre: string, r: { familiarity: number; with: string }) => `${GENRE_BY_ID[genre]?.label ?? genre}: an hour and a half with ${r.with}. Familiarity ${r.familiarity.toFixed(1)} of 100.`;
+
+ /**
+  * How the reader plays the other part, in words (from 2026-10-12, `READER_PLAYS`): its label, and what playing against
+  * it asks, the dimensions it leans and the abilities it draws on. Until then the take leaned on it and the scene didn't
+  * say, and `READER_PLAYS`' labels were read by nothing.
+  */
+ export function readerPlaysWords(b: import('@/engine/content/briefs').Brief): string | undefined {
+   if (b.medium === 'voice') return undefined;
+   const plays = READER_PLAYS[b.readerPlays ?? 'steady'];
+   const leans = (Object.keys(plays.lean) as (keyof typeof DIMENSION_LABEL)[]).map((d) => DIMENSION_LABEL[d].toLowerCase());
+   const draws = [...new Set(Object.values(plays.inputs).flatMap((xs) => (xs ?? []).map((x) => ABILITY_DEFS.find((d) => d.id === x.ability)?.label.toLowerCase() ?? x.ability)))];
+   const and = (xs: string[]) => (xs.length > 1 ? `${xs.slice(0, -1).join(', ')} and ${xs.at(-1)}` : xs[0] ?? '');
+   if (!leans.length && !draws.length) return `${plays.label}: playing opposite it asks nothing more than the scene does.`;
+   return `${plays.label}: playing opposite it, the tape counts ${and(leans)} for more${draws.length ? ` and leans on your ${and(draws)}` : ''}.`;
+ }
+
+ /**
+  * A brief's pane for a genre: `practice` renders the way to train an ability or technique, as the profile does. `brief`
+  * opens it at one brief of the genre, as a suggestion names one (from 2026-10-12; until then a suggestion opened the
+  * genre at its first brief, whichever it named).
+  */
+ export function BriefPane({ genre, brief, onOpen, practice }: { genre: string; brief?: string; onOpen: (genre: string, brief?: string) => void; practice: (id: string) => ReactNode }) {
+   const { sim, run, toast } = useGame();
+   const person = useWorld((s) => s.player);
+   const briefs = briefsOf(genre);
+   const [which, setWhich] = useState(() => Math.max(0, briefs.findIndex((x) => x.id === brief)));
+   const b = briefs[Math.min(which, briefs.length - 1)];
+   const rec = b ? person.briefs?.[b.id] : undefined;
+   const [reading, setReading] = useState<string | undefined>(rec?.reading);
+   if (!b) return <p className="small">No brief has been written for {GENRE_BY_ID[genre]?.label ?? genre} yet.</p>;
+   const draftReading = reading ?? rec?.reading ?? b.readings[0]!.id;
+   const material = briefMaterial(b);
+   const req = requiredOf(b);
+   const turns = turnsOf(b);
+   const known = genreKnown(person, b);
+   const prep = rec?.prep ?? { interpretation: 0, memorization: 0, rehearsal: 0 };
+   const now = forecast(sim, person, b);
+   const purpose = rec?.reading ? purposeOf(rec, now.overall) : undefined;
+   const tape = tapeRefusal(sim, person, genre, b);
+   const last = rec?.takes.at(-1);
+   const lastWork = last ? [...(person.work ?? [])].reverse().find((w) => w.inputs.key === last.key) : undefined;
+   // The last take worked out again from what it kept, for its beats: one kept under other rules isn't.
+   const lastEval = lastWork && TASK_PROFILES[lastWork.task] ? replay(lastWork, TASK_PROFILES[lastWork.task]!) : undefined;
+   const levelLabel = (id: string) => (isAbility(id) ? `${ABILITY_DEFS.find((d) => d.id === id)!.label} ${Math.round(abilityOf(sim, person, id as AbilityId))}` : `${TECHNIQUE_LABEL[id as keyof typeof TECHNIQUE_LABEL] ?? id} ${Math.round(person.craft?.[id as keyof typeof TECHNIQUE_LABEL] ?? 0)} of ${MASTERED}`);
+   // What To Work On as the Player Profile reads it (from 2026-10-12): the days since each exercise, for the focus, and
+   // the weakness the work so far keeps coming back to (`Identity.recurring`), said with its pieces and first within half
+   // a point of the top. Until then the pane passed neither, so the same weakness read "Steady to begin" here and
+   // "Spaced" on the Profile, and the identity reached only the suggestions below.
+   const identity = identityOf(person);
+   const recs = adviceFor(sim, person);
+   // An ability or technique only (from 2026-10-12: until then only a preparation was passed over, so a day's condition
+   // or a fit could be named the weakness, with a brief suggested for it at 0% of the work and practice offered for it).
+   const top = recs.find((r) => !r.target.includes(':'));
+   const ideas = suggestions(person, top ? { target: top.target, label: top.label, level: levelOf(sim, person, top.target as never), full: isAbility(top.target) ? abilityFull(sim, person, top.target as AbilityId) : MASTERED } : undefined, identity).filter((s) => s.brief !== b.id);
+   // A technique no brief reads (audition, cold reading, script analysis) is suggested no brief, and said so here (from
+   // 2026-10-12: until then a brief was suggested for it "(0% of the work)").
+   const unread = top && !briefsRead(person, top.target);
+   const step = (s: BriefStep) => {
+     const r = run<{ moved: number; minutes: number }>('brief.prepare', { brief: b.id, step: s });
+     if (r.ok) toast(`${BRIEF.steps[s].label}: ${r.value!.minutes} minutes, ${pct(r.value!.moved)} further.`, 'positive');
+   };
+   const study = studyRefusal(sim, person, genre);
+   const plays = readerPlaysWords(b);
+   const scenesGenre = b.kinds[0]!;
+   const asked = concernsOf(scenesGenre);
+   /** A limit's note with the genre's concern behind it, where its register asked for that ability. */
+   const withConcern = (chief: string | undefined, c: Concern | undefined) => (chief ? `${chief}${c ? `: ${concernNote(scenesGenre, c)}` : ''}.` : '');
+   const nowConcern = concernBehind(b, now);
+   return (
+     <div className="col gap-3" data-brief={b.id}>
+       <div className="row gap-2 wrap" style={{ alignItems: 'baseline' }}>
+         <h3 style={{ margin: 0 }}>{b.title}</h3>
+         <span className="xs dim">A practice brief for {b.kinds.map((g) => GENRE_BY_ID[g]?.label ?? g).join(', ')}: an original scene written for SLATE, {b.medium === 'voice' ? 'recorded alone at a microphone' : 'taped to a reader off camera'}.</span>
+         {briefs.length > 1 && (
+           <select aria-label="Which Brief" value={which} onChange={(e) => { setWhich(Number(e.target.value)); setReading(undefined); }}>
+             {briefs.map((x, i) => <option key={x.id} value={i}>{x.title}</option>)}
+           </select>
+         )}
+       </div>
+       <p className="small" style={{ margin: 0 }}>{b.logline}</p>
+
+       <div className="col gap-1">
+         <div className="eyebrow">The Scene</div>
+         <dl className="small" style={{ margin: 0 }}>
+           <dt>Where And When</dt><dd>{b.circumstances}</dd>
+           <dt>The Two Of You</dt><dd>{b.relationship}</dd>
+           <dt>You Play</dt><dd>{b.you}</dd>
+           <dt>{b.medium === 'voice' ? 'You Speak To' : 'The Reader Plays'}</dt><dd>{b.reader}</dd>
+           {plays && <><dt>How They Play It</dt><dd>{plays}</dd></>}
+           {/* The register of the genre it was written for (from 2026-10-16, `GENRE_REGISTER`): what every take of it reads. */}
+           {asked.length > 0 && <><dt>The Genre Asks</dt><dd><ul className="small" style={{ margin: 0, paddingLeft: '1.1em' }}>{asked.map((c) => <li key={c}>{concernWords(c)}</li>)}</ul><span className="xs dim">{scenesGenre !== genre ? `It’s a ${GENRE_BY_ID[scenesGenre]?.label ?? scenesGenre} scene, played in that genre’s register. ` : ''}{registerBasisWords(scenesGenre)}</span></dd></>}
+           <dt>What You Want</dt><dd>{b.objective}</dd>
+           <dt>What’s In The Way</dt><dd>{b.obstacle}</dd>
+         </dl>
+         <div className="eyebrow">Where It Turns</div>
+         <ol className="small" style={{ margin: 0 }}>
+           {b.beats.map((beat, i) => <li key={i}>{beat.what} <span className="xs dim">({beat.tones.map((t) => TONE[t]).join(' and ')}{beat.tones.length > 1 ? ', held at once' : ''})</span></li>)}
+         </ol>
+         {/* The beats' arc (`why.beats`) is said once, after the Tone line of What It Asks below, where `briefMaterial` gives
+             it as the turns' reason (from 2026-10-19, brief 15, at material-b's suggestion): until then this line said it
+             too, and the pane read it twice. */}
+         <p className="xs dim" style={{ margin: 0 }}>{turns.transitions} change{turns.transitions === 1 ? '' : 's'} of tone between beats and {turns.blends} beat{turns.blends === 1 ? '' : 's'} held two ways. Rehearsal is complete at {pct(req.rehearsal!)} in a beat, up to {pct(PIECE.brief.perTurn)} more in a beat a change leads into, and {pct(PIECE.brief.perBlend)} more in one held two ways.</p>
+       </div>
+
+       <MaterialDemands material={material} />
+
+       <div className="col gap-1">
+         <div className="eyebrow">What The Tape Is Judged On, Read This Way</div>
+         <div className="table-scroll">
+           <table>
+             <thead><tr><th scope="col">Quality</th><th scope="col" className="num">Share</th><th scope="col">What It Uses, Yours Now</th></tr></thead>
+             <tbody>
+               {asksOf(person, b, draftReading).map((a) => (
+                 <tr key={a.dimension}><td className="nowrap">{a.label}</td><td className="num mono">{pct(a.share)}</td><td className="xs">{a.reads.map(levelLabel).join(', ')}</td></tr>
+               ))}
+             </tbody>
+           </table>
+         </div>
+       </div>
+
+       <div className="col gap-1">
+         <div className="row-between"><div className="eyebrow">Preparation</div><HowItWorks help="brief.prepare" /></div>
+         <div className="grid grid-3">
+           <Stat label="The Breakdown" value={`${pct(prep.interpretation)} of ${pct(req.interpretation!)}`} />
+           <Stat label="The Lines" value={`${pct(prep.memorization)} of ${pct(req.memorization!)}`} />
+           <Stat label="Rehearsal" value={`${pct(prep.rehearsal)} of ${pct(req.rehearsal!)}`} note="More in a beat a change leads into: beat by beat below" />
+           <Stat label="Knowing The Genre" value={`${pct(known)} of ${pct(req.genre!)}`} note="Studied, or worked in: the better of the two" />
+         </div>
+         <div className="row gap-2 wrap">
+           {(['read', 'lines', 'rehearse'] as BriefStep[]).map((s) => {
+             const no = prepareRefusal(sim, person, b, s);
+             return <Gated key={s} feature="brief.prepare" className="btn btn-sm" disabled={Boolean(no)} title={no ?? BRIEF.steps[s].what} onClick={() => step(s)}>{`${BRIEF.steps[s].label} (${stepMinutes(b, s)} Min)`}</Gated>;
+           })}
+           <Gated feature="genre.study" className="btn btn-sm btn-ghost" disabled={Boolean(study)} title={study ?? 'An hour and a half with a work of the kind'} onClick={() => { const r = run<{ familiarity: number; with: string }>('genre.study', { genre }); if (r.ok) toast(studiedWords(genre, r.value!), 'positive'); }}>Study The Genre</Gated>
+           <HowItWorks help="genre.study" label="How Genres Work" />
+         </div>
+         <WhyNot reasons={(['read', 'lines', 'rehearse'] as BriefStep[]).map((s) => [BRIEF.steps[s].label, prepareRefusal(sim, person, b, s)] as const)} />
+       </div>
+
+       <div className="col gap-1">
+         <div className="row-between"><div className="eyebrow">Your Reading</div><HowItWorks help="brief.choose" /></div>
+         {b.readings.map((r) => {
+           const full = preview(sim, person, b, r.id, { ...(rec?.playing?.pace ? { pace: rec.playing.pace } : {}), ...(rec?.playing?.scale ? { scale: rec.playing.scale } : {}), ...(rec?.playing?.structure ? { structure: rec.playing.structure } : {}) }).overall;
+           return (
+             <label key={r.id} className="row gap-1" style={{ alignItems: 'flex-start' }}>
+               <input type="radio" name={`reading-${b.id}`} checked={draftReading === r.id} onChange={() => setReading(r.id)} />
+               <span className="small"><strong>{r.label}</strong>{rec?.reading === r.id ? ', Chosen' : ''}. {r.reading} <span className="xs dim">It rests on: {r.rests} Fully prepared, it would come to {full.toFixed(1)} for you now.</span></span>
+             </label>
+           );
+         })}
+         <div>
+           <Gated feature="brief.choose" className="btn btn-sm" disabled={rec?.reading === draftReading} onClick={() => { const r = run<{ interpretation: number; readingChanged: boolean }>('brief.choose', { brief: b.id, reading: draftReading, ...(rec?.playing ? { pace: rec.playing.pace, scale: rec.playing.scale, structure: rec.playing.structure } : {}) }); if (r.ok) toast(`Reading it as ${readingOf(b, draftReading)!.label}.${r.value!.readingChanged ? ` The breakdown keeps ${pct(BRIEF.readingKept)} of what it was: ${pct(r.value!.interpretation)} now.` : ''}`, 'positive'); }}>{rec?.reading ? 'Change The Reading' : 'Read It This Way'}</Gated>
+         </div>
+         <Fine>Every reading here is one the brief supports, and none is the right answer. Each reading shifts what the tape is judged on toward different abilities, without adding to the total. Changing it keeps {pct(BRIEF.readingKept)} of your breakdown.</Fine>
+       </div>
+
+       {rec?.callback && <p className="small" style={{ margin: 0 }}><strong>A Callback.</strong> {rec.callback.why} It’s pitched harder than a first take.</p>}
+       {rec?.reading && (
+         <PlayingChooser material={material} scene={sceneOf(b, readingOf(b, rec.reading))} current={rec.playing} direction={rec.callback ? { [rec.callback.axis]: rec.callback.side } as Partial<Record<Axis, typeof rec.callback.side>> : undefined} feature="brief.choose" preview={(c) => preview(sim, person, b, rec.reading!, c)} onChoose={(c) => { const r = run('brief.choose', { brief: b.id, reading: rec.reading, ...c }); if (r.ok) toast('Chosen. Rehearse it on your feet to make it work.', 'positive'); }} />
+       )}
+
+       {b.medium !== 'voice' && <ReaderChoice b={b} />}
+
+       <div className="col gap-1">
+         <div className="row-between"><div className="eyebrow">The Take</div><HowItWorks help="practice.self_tape" /></div>
+         <p className="small" style={{ margin: 0 }}>
+           {rec?.reading ? <>Taped now, with today’s preparation and condition, it would come to about <strong>{now.overall.toFixed(1)}</strong> ({BAND_LABEL[bandOfQuality(now.overall)]}). {chiefLimit(now, 'now') ? withConcern(chiefLimit(now, 'now'), nowConcern) : 'There’s nothing holding it back.'} {grainWords(grainRead(now))} {purpose ? PURPOSE_WORDS[purpose] : ''}</> : 'Choose a reading first.'}
+         </p>
+         <div>
+           <Gated feature="practice.self_tape" className="btn btn-sm" disabled={Boolean(tape)} title={tape ?? `An hour: ${b.title}, ${readingOf(b, rec?.reading)?.label ?? ''}`} onClick={() => { const r = run<{ overall: number; purpose: string; band: string }>('practice.self_tape', { genre, brief: b.id }); if (r.ok) toast(`Taped: ${r.value!.overall.toFixed(1)}, ${BAND_LABEL[r.value!.band as keyof typeof BAND_LABEL]}.`, 'positive'); }}>Tape It (60 Min)</Gated>
+         </div>
+         {tape && <p className="xs dim" style={{ margin: 0 }}>{tape}</p>}
+         {rec?.reading && <Segments e={now} caption="Beat By Beat, Taped Now" />}
+       </div>
+
+       {rec?.reading && <WorkThrough piece={`brief:${b.id}`} />}
+
+       {last && (
+         <div className="col gap-1">
+           <div className="eyebrow">The Last Take, {formatDate(last.at, sim.zone)}</div>
+           <p className="small" style={{ margin: 0 }}><strong>{last.overall.toFixed(1)}</strong>, {BAND_LABEL[last.band as keyof typeof BAND_LABEL]}: {readingOf(b, last.reading)?.label}{last.sides.length ? `, played ${last.sides.join(' and ')}` : ''}. {PURPOSE_WORDS[last.purpose]} {withConcern(last.chief, last.concern)}{last.grain ? ` ${takeGrainWords(last.grain)}` : ''}{last.callback ? (last.answered ? ' The callback’s note was answered.' : ' Played against the callback’s note: the callback is still yours.') : ''}</p>
+           {last.together && <p className="small" style={{ margin: 0 }}><strong>With {last.together.reader}.</strong> {last.together.words} A casting office sees the tape with its reader, and that’s what decides a callback.</p>}
+           {lastEval && <Segments e={lastEval} caption="The Last Take, Beat By Beat" />}
+           {lastWork && (
+             <div className="table-scroll">
+               <table>
+                 <thead><tr><th scope="col">Quality</th><th scope="col" className="num">Result</th></tr></thead>
+                 <tbody>{Object.entries(lastWork.dims).map(([d, q]) => <tr key={d}><td>{DIMENSION_LABEL[d as keyof typeof DIMENSION_LABEL]}</td><td className="num mono">{(q ?? 0).toFixed(1)}</td></tr>)}</tbody>
+               </table>
+             </div>
+           )}
+           {/* Each limit as a piece of work's look says it, points off the quality and off the whole (from 2026-10-20, brief 17):
+               until then “12.3 points of Connection”, and the stat above said “part by part below” of the beats' table. */}
+           {lastWork && lastWork.limits.length > 0 && <ul className="xs" style={{ margin: 0 }}>{lastWork.limits.map((l, i) => <li key={i}>{l.label}: {l.by} points off {DIMENSION_LABEL[l.dimension].toLowerCase()}{l.whole !== undefined ? `, ${l.whole} off the whole` : ''}</li>)}</ul>}
+         </div>
+       )}
+
+       {top && (
+         <div className="col gap-1">
+           {/* Short, with the reasoning behind Why This Recommendation, as the Player Profile draws it (from 2026-10-20, brief 16). */}
+           <AdviceCard advice={adviceSummary(sim, person, recs, top)!} heading="What To Work On" />
+           {unread && <p className="xs dim" style={{ margin: 0 }}>No practice brief calls on {top.label.toLowerCase()}, so a tape won’t show it and none is suggested for it.</p>}
+           <div>{practice(top.target)}</div>
+         </div>
+       )}
+       {ideas.length > 0 && (
+         <div className="col gap-1">
+           <div className="eyebrow">Where It Would Show Next</div>
+           <ul className="small" style={{ margin: 0 }}>{ideas.map((s) => <li key={s.brief}>{s.why} <button type="button" className="btn btn-sm btn-ghost" onClick={() => onOpen(s.genre, s.brief)}>{`Open ${GENRE_BY_ID[s.genre]?.label ?? s.genre}`}</button></li>)}</ul>
+         </div>
+       )}
+
+       {rec && rec.takes.length > 0 && (
+         <div className="col gap-1">
+           <div className="eyebrow">Your Takes Of It</div>
+           <div className="table-scroll">
+             <table data-takes="">
+               <thead><tr><th scope="col">When</th><th scope="col">Reading</th><th scope="col">Played</th><th scope="col">For</th><th scope="col" className="num">Result</th><th scope="col">Held Back Most By</th></tr></thead>
+               <tbody>
+                 {[...rec.takes].reverse().map((t) => (
+                   <tr key={t.key}><td className="nowrap">{formatDate(t.at, sim.zone)}</td><td>{readingOf(b, t.reading)?.label}</td><td className="xs">{t.sides.length ? t.sides.join(', ') : 'Left open'}{t.callback ? ', a callback' : ''}</td><td className="xs">{PURPOSE_WORDS[t.purpose]}</td><td className="num mono">{t.overall.toFixed(1)}</td><td className="xs">{t.chief ? `${t.chief}${t.concern ? `: ${concernNote(scenesGenre, t.concern)}` : ''}` : 'Nothing'}</td></tr>
+                 ))}
+               </tbody>
+             </table>
+           </div>
+         </div>
+       )}
+       <Fine>A brief’s preparation is the breakdown, the lines and rehearsal on your feet. Each step goes further the less is left, and half as far again the same day, and a beat a change of tone leads into needs more rehearsal than the rest. A tape is judged beat by beat (each beat’s rehearsal, where stamina tells, a slip and its recovery), and the whole is the average of its beats. A Strong tape with a reader earns a callback: a harder pitch, with a note on how to play it given before you tape, answered only by a tape played that way. The sizes are estimated; the shape of a breakdown (where and when, the relationship, what you want, what’s in the way, where it turns) is the acting texts’.</Fine>
+     </div>
+   );
+ }
+
+ /**
+  * The class's moments on the School's Coursework tab (`systems/classmates.ts`,
+  * from 2026-10-08): what a classmate has brought you and is waiting on an
+  * answer for, each answer a button with the reason it can't be given where it
+  * can't; and the last few moments had, and how you answered.
+  */
+
+ import { useGame, useWorld } from '@/app/game-context';
+ import { Panel, Fine, WhyNot } from '@/ui/components/primitives';
+ import { Gated } from '@/ui/guide/Guide';
+ import { formatDate, formatTime } from '@/engine/core/time';
+ import { CITIES } from '@/engine/content/geography';
+ import { YALE_DRAMA } from '@/engine/content/school';
+ import { courseworkOf } from '@/engine/systems/coursework';
+ import { CHOICES, MOMENT_TITLE, momentsOf, respondRefusal, sharedWork } from '@/engine/systems/classmates';
+ import { sceneById } from '@/engine/content/coursework';
+ import { useState } from 'react';
+
+ const zone = () => CITIES.require(YALE_DRAMA.cityId).timeZone;
+
+ export function ClassMoments() {
+   const { sim, run, toast } = useGame();
+   const person = useWorld((s) => s.player);
+   const [scene, setScene] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
+   const cw = courseworkOf(sim, person);
+   if (!cw) return null;
+   const all = momentsOf(cw);
+   const open = all.filter((m) => m.status === 'open');
+   const past = all.filter((m) => m.status !== 'open').slice(-6).reverse();
+   if (!open.length && !past.length) return null;
+   const answerOf = (kind: keyof typeof CHOICES, id?: string) => CHOICES[kind].find((c) => c.id === id)?.label;
+   return (
+     <Panel title="Your Class" subtitle="What classmates bring you, and how you answered" help="school.respond">
+       <div className="col gap-3">
+         {open.map((m) => {
+           const mate = person.school!.classmates[m.mate]!;
+           // Running lines works on a scene you share with them (from 2026-10-10): which one, where there's a choice.
+           const shared = m.kind === 'study' ? sharedWork(sim, person, m.mate) : [];
+           const play = (id: string) => sceneById(shared.find((a) => a.id === id)?.sceneId ?? '')?.play ?? 'a scene';
+           return (
+             <div key={m.id} className="col gap-1">
+               <div className="small"><strong>{mate.name}: {MOMENT_TITLE[m.kind]}.</strong> {m.text} <span className="xs dim">Answer by {formatTime(m.until, zone())}, {formatDate(m.until, zone())}.</span></div>
+               {m.kind === 'study' && (shared.length === 0
+                 ? <div className="xs dim">You and {mate.name.split(' ')[0]} don’t have a scene together right now, so you’d run their lines. That helps them, but not your own preparation.</div>
+                 : shared.length === 1
+                   ? <div className="xs dim">You’d run {play(shared[0]!.id)}, the scene you share.</div>
+                   : (
+                     <div className="field"><label htmlFor={`study-${m.id}`}>Which Scene You Share</label>
+                       <select id={`study-${m.id}`} value={scene[m.id] ?? shared[0]!.id} onChange={(e) => setScene({ ...scene, [m.id]: e.target.value })}>
+                         {shared.map((a) => <option key={a.id} value={a.id}>{play(a.id)}, lines {Math.round(a.prep.memorization * 100)}%</option>)}
+                       </select>
+                     </div>
+                   ))}
+               <div className="row gap-2" style={{ flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
+                 {CHOICES[m.kind].map((c) => {
+                   const no = respondRefusal(sim, person, m, c.id);
+                   return (
+                     <Gated key={c.id} feature="school.respond" className="btn btn-sm btn-ghost" disabled={Boolean(no)} title={no ?? c.label}
+                       onClick={() => { const r = run<{ done: string }>('school.respond', { momentId: m.id, choice: c.id, ...(m.kind === 'study' && c.id === 'yes' && shared.length ? { assignmentId: scene[m.id] ?? shared[0]!.id } : {}) }); if (r.ok) toast(r.value!.done, 'neutral'); }}>
+                       {c.label}
+                     </Gated>
+                   );
+                 })}
+               </div>
+               <WhyNot reasons={CHOICES[m.kind].map((c) => [c.label, respondRefusal(sim, person, m, c.id)] as const)} />
+             </div>
+           );
+         })}
+         {past.map((m) => (
+           <div key={m.id} className="xs dim">
+             {formatDate(m.at, zone())}, {person.school!.classmates[m.mate]!.name}: {MOMENT_TITLE[m.kind]}{m.status === 'answered' ? ` · ${answerOf(m.kind, m.choice)}` : m.status === 'lapsed' ? ' · Not Answered' : ''}
+           </div>
+         ))}
+         <Fine>Who brings what follows what each classmate cares about and what has happened between you; how often a moment comes, and what each answer does to their trust and your bond, are estimated.</Fine>
+       </div>
+     </Panel>
+   );

+ export function CourseworkPane() {
+   const { sim } = useGame();

+   const cw = courseworkOf(sim, person);
+   if (!cw) return null;
+   // Soonest due first (from 2026-10-16, `urgentWork`): until then in the order each piece was set.
+   const urgent = urgentWork(sim, person);

+   const short = urgent.filter((u) => u.short.length > 0).slice(0, 3);
+   const past = cw.assignments.filter((a) => a.status !== 'open' && a.status !== 'revising').slice(-12).reverse();
+   // The first week leads while a session is still to come or to catch up, and goes below the work once all five are done

+   // done two years before, ahead of Due Soonest.
+   const weekDone = ORIENTATION.every((o) => cw.orientation.done[o.task] !== undefined);
+   return (
+     <div className="col gap-5">
+       {!cw.orientation.behind && !weekDone && <FirstWeek />}
+       {short.length > 0 && (
+         <Panel title="Due Soonest" help="school.prepare">
+           <ul className="small" data-due-soonest="" style={{ margin: 0, paddingLeft: '1.1rem' }}>
+             {short.map(({ a, due, forecast, short: parts }) => {

+               return <li key={a.id}><strong>{courseName(a.course)}: {t.title}</strong>, due {dayOfKey(due)}. Shown today, it would come to about {forecast.toFixed(1)} of 100 ({BAND_LABEL[bandFor(a, forecast)]}). Still to finish: {parts.map((d) => `${t.dims[d]!.label} (${remedyWords(a, d)})`).join('; ')}.</li>;
+             })}
+           </ul>
+         </Panel>
+       )}
+       {/* Once the School has ended no course sets work (from 2026-10-16: until then a graduate read “Nothing set yet: each

+       {open.length === 0

Each course sets its work in class, and in your first week the orientation session The Courses And What They Ask sets the first pieces.' : `${person.school.standing === 'graduated' ? 'Your degree is conferred' : 'You’ve left the School'}, so no course sets work now.`}</p></Panel>

+       <NotesLedger />

+       {!cw.orientation.behind && weekDone && <FirstWeek />}
+     </div>
+   );

'Your answers differ from last time’s.' : 'So far your answers match last time’s.'}</span>}</div>}

+ function TableWork({ a }: { a: Assignment }) {
+   const { run, toast } = useGame();
+   const choose = useFeature('school.choose');
+   // A text not yet read far enough, said and grayed (from 2026-10-16): until then the select took an answer the command
+   // refused, and said so only in a toast after the choice.
+   const unread = choose.open ? tableWorkRefusal(a) : undefined;
+   return (
+     <div className="col gap-2">
+       <div className="row-between"><div className="eyebrow">Table Work</div><HowItWorks help="school.choose" /></div>
+       {unread && <WhyNot reasons={[['Table Work', unread]]} />}
+       {questionsFor(a).map(({ q, options }) => (
+         <div key={q.id} className="field" style={{ margin: 0 }}>
+           <label htmlFor={`${a.id}-${q.id}`}>{q.label}</label>
+           <select id={`${a.id}-${q.id}`} value={a.answers[q.id] ?? ''} disabled={!choose.open || Boolean(unread)} title={choose.reason ?? unread} onChange={(e) => { if (!e.target.value) return; const r = run<{ supported: boolean }>('school.choose', { assignmentId: a.id, question: q.id, option: e.target.value }); if (r.ok) toast('Answer chosen.', 'neutral'); }}>
+             <option value="">Not Decided</option>
+             {options.map((o) => <option key={o.id} value={o.id}>{o.text}</option>)}
+           </select>
+           {a.shown && (() => { const o = options.find((x) => x.id === a.answers[q.id]); return o?.why ? <div className="xs dim">{o.supported ? 'Why the text supports it' : 'Why the text doesn’t support it'}: {o.why}</div> : null; })()}
+         </div>
+       ))}
+       <Fine>Each answer takes ten minutes. Some questions have more than one answer the text supports, and each of them counts the same. Once the piece is shown, each answer says why the text supports it or doesn’t. Which answers the text supports is the game’s own judgment of the play.</Fine>
+     </div>
+   );
+ }

+ function Rehearsals({ a }: { a: Assignment }) {
+   const { sim, run, toast } = useGame();
+   const person = useWorld((s) => s.player);
+   const mate = person.school!.classmates[a.partner!]!;
+   const first = mate.name.split(' ')[0];
+   const due = a.status === 'revising' ? a.revision!.dueOn : a.dueOn;
+   const days: { key: string; label: string; parts: { year: number; month: number; day: number } }[] = [];
+   const now = zonedParts(sim.now, zone());
+   for (let n = 0; n < 14; n += 1) {
+     const d = new Date(Date.UTC(now.year, now.month - 1, now.day + n));
+     const p = { year: d.getUTCFullYear(), month: d.getUTCMonth() + 1, day: d.getUTCDate() };
+     const key = `${p.year}-${String(p.month).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(p.day).padStart(2, '0')}`;
+     if (key >= due) break;
+     days.push({ key, label: formatDate(instantFromZoned({ ...p, hour: 12 }, zone()), zone()), parts: p });
+   }
+   const [day, setDay] = useState(days[0]?.key ?? '');
+   const [hour, setHour] = useState(19);
+   const pick = days.find((d) => d.key === day) ?? days[0];
+   const when = pick ? instantFromZoned({ ...pick.parts, hour, minute: 0 }, zone()) : NaN;
+   const q = askRefusal(sim, person, a, when);
+   const m = mateRecord(mate);
+   return (
+     <div className="col gap-2">
+       <div className="row-between"><div className="eyebrow">Rehearsing With {first}</div><HowItWorks help="school.ask_partner" /></div>
+       <div className="xs dim">{`Trust ${Math.round(trustOf(mate))} of 100 · ${(m.kept ?? 0) + (m.stoodUp ?? 0) ? `Came to ${m.kept ?? 0} of ${(m.kept ?? 0) + (m.stoodUp ?? 0)} rehearsals agreed` : 'No rehearsals agreed yet'}${m.missedByYou ? ` · You missed ${m.missedByYou}` : ''}${m.reliability !== undefined ? ` · Reliability ${pct(m.reliability)}` : ''}`}</div>
+       {days.length > 0 ? (
+         <div className="row gap-2" style={{ alignItems: 'flex-end', flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
+           <div className="field" style={{ margin: 0 }}>
+             <label htmlFor={`${a.id}-day`}>Day</label>
+             <select id={`${a.id}-day`} value={pick?.key} onChange={(e) => setDay(e.target.value)}>{days.map((d) => <option key={d.key} value={d.key}>{d.label}</option>)}</select>
+           </div>
+           <div className="field" style={{ margin: 0 }}>
+             <label htmlFor={`${a.id}-hour`}>Time</label>
+             <select id={`${a.id}-hour`} value={hour} onChange={(e) => setHour(Number(e.target.value))}>
+               {Array.from({ length: WORK.rehearsal.until - WORK.rehearsal.from - 1 }, (_, i) => WORK.rehearsal.from + i).map((h) => <option key={h} value={h}>{formatTime(instantFromZoned({ ...(pick?.parts ?? { year: 2026, month: 9, day: 1 }), hour: h, minute: 0 }, zone()), zone())}</option>)}
+             </select>
+           </div>
+           <Gated feature="school.ask_partner" className="btn btn-sm" disabled={Boolean(q.refused)} title={q.refused ?? q.declines ?? `Ask ${first} to rehearse, ${WORK.rehearsal.minutes} minutes`}
+             onClick={() => { const r = run<{ accepted: boolean; reason?: string }>('school.ask_partner', { assignmentId: a.id, at: when }); if (r.ok) toast(r.value!.accepted ? `${first} said yes.` : `${first} can’t: ${r.value!.reason}`, r.value!.accepted ? 'positive' : 'neutral'); }}>
+             Ask {first}
+           </Gated>
+         </div>
+       ) : <p className="small muted" style={{ margin: 0 }}>There are no days left to rehearse before it’s due.</p>}
+       {(a.asks ?? []).filter((k) => k.status === 'open').map((k) => {
+         const yes = answerRefusal(sim, person, a, k.id, true);
+         return (
+           <div key={k.id} className="col gap-1">
+             <div className="small">{first} asks to rehearse on {formatDateTime(k.at, zone())}. Answer by {formatTime(k.until, zone())} that day.</div>
+             <div className="row gap-2">
+               <Gated feature="school.answer_partner" className="btn btn-sm" disabled={Boolean(yes)} title={yes ?? 'Yes: It Goes On Your Calendar'} onClick={() => { const r = run<{ booked: boolean }>('school.answer_partner', { assignmentId: a.id, askId: k.id, yes: true }); if (r.ok) toast('It’s on your calendar.', 'positive'); }}>Say Yes</Gated>
+               {yes && <span className="xs dim">{yes}</span>}
+               <Gated feature="school.answer_partner" className="btn btn-sm btn-ghost" title="No: They’ll Know, And It Costs Nothing" onClick={() => { if (run('school.answer_partner', { assignmentId: a.id, askId: k.id, yes: false }).ok) toast(`You told ${first} you can’t.`, 'neutral'); }}>Say No</Gated>
+             </div>
+           </div>
+         );
+       })}
+       {a.rehearsals.map((r) => (
+         <div key={r.id} className="col">
+         <div className="row-between small">
+           <span>{formatDateTime(r.at, zone())}</span>
+           {r.status === 'booked'
+             ? <Gated feature="school.cancel_rehearsal" className="btn btn-sm btn-ghost" title={r.at - sim.now < 86_400_000 ? `Short notice: ${first} will mind` : 'With notice'} onClick={() => { if (run('school.cancel_rehearsal', { assignmentId: a.id, rehearsalId: r.id }).ok) toast('Called off.', 'neutral'); }}>Call It Off</Gated>
+             : <span className="xs">{{ kept: 'Rehearsed', missedByYou: 'You Didn’t Come', missedByThem: `${first} Didn’t Come`, cancelled: 'Called Off', excused: 'You Were Ill', booked: '' }[r.status]}</span>}
+         </div>
+         {r.said && <div className="xs dim">{r.said} <span>(A summary of your preparation, not {first}’s own words.)</span></div>}
+         </div>
+       ))}
+     </div>
+   );
+ }
+
+ function FeedbackBlock({ a }: { a: Assignment }) {
+   const { run } = useGame();
+   const f = a.feedback!;
+   return (
+     <div className="col gap-1">
+       <div className="row-between"><div className="eyebrow">Feedback{a.shown ? `: ${BAND_LABEL[a.shown.band]}, ${Math.round(a.shown.score * 100)} Of 100` : ''}{f.kind ? ` · ${kindLabel(f)}` : ''}</div><HowItWorks help="school.read_feedback" /></div>

+       {!f.seen && <div><Gated feature="school.read_feedback" className="btn btn-sm btn-ghost" onClick={() => run('school.read_feedback', { assignmentId: a.id })}>Mark As Read</Gated></div>}
+     </div>
+   );
+ }

+ const KIND_LABEL: Record<NoteKind, string> = { new: 'A New Note', recurring: 'Still There', partial: 'Better, Not There Yet', applied: 'Note Taken', advanced: 'The Next Step' };
+ /**
+  * What the feedback is, as its label says it: where nothing held the piece back, The Next Step only where the words gave
+  * one (from 2026-10-20, brief 17: a first Strong, a best and a strong piece despite the day are acknowledged without
+  * one), and What Held It Back where something other than the preparation did. A save's feedback from before has no
+  * situation, and reads as it did.
+  */
+ const kindLabel = (f: NonNullable<Assignment['feedback']>): string =>
+   f.kind === 'advanced' && f.situation === 'held' ? 'What Held It Back' : f.kind === 'advanced' && f.step === false ? 'Nothing Held It Back' : KIND_LABEL[f.kind!];
+
+ /** Why an assignment asks what it asks first: the note that keeps coming back, or the part this course hasn't asked of you lately. */
+ function objectiveWhy(a: Assignment, notes: readonly NoteRecord[]): string {
+   const dim = OBJECTIVE_DIM[a.objective!];
+   const rec = notes.find((n) => n.key === `dim:${dim}` && n.status === 'open' && n.given >= 2);
+   return rec ? `Your notes have named it ${timesWords(rec.given)} since ${dayOfKey(rec.first)}, so it counts for more when you show this piece.` : 'Your course hasn’t asked for it lately, so it counts for more when you show this piece.';
+ }
+
+ /** The ledger: every note given, by what it's about, across courses; open ones first. */
+ function NotesLedger() {
+   const { sim } = useGame();
+   const person = useWorld((s) => s.player);
+   const cw = courseworkOf(sim, person);
+   const notes = cw ? notesOf(cw).filter((n) => !n.key.startsWith('advanced:')) : [];
+   if (!notes.length) return null;
+   const sorted = [...notes].sort((x, y) => (x.status === y.status ? (x.last < y.last ? 1 : -1) : x.status === 'open' ? -1 : 1));
+   return (
+     <Panel title="Your Notes" subtitle="Every note your pieces have been given, across all your courses, and where each one stands" help="school.read_feedback">
+       <div className="col gap-1">
+         {sorted.map((n) => (
+           <div key={n.key} className="row-between small">
+             <span>{noteSubject(n.key)} <span className="xs dim">· {n.given === 1 ? `Given once, on ${dayOfKey(n.first)}` : `Given ${n.given === 2 ? 'twice' : `${n.given} times`}, first ${dayOfKey(n.first)}, last ${dayOfKey(n.last)}`}</span></span>
+             <span className="xs">{n.status === 'resolved' ? `Taken ${dayOfKey(n.resolvedOn!)}` : n.history.at(-1)?.kind === 'partial' ? 'Better, Not There Yet' : 'Open'}</span>
+           </div>
+         ))}
+         <Fine>These notes are simulated: the game’s assessment of your work, never a real teacher’s words. Once you take a note, it isn’t given again unless that part slips back.</Fine>
+       </div>
+     </Panel>
+   );
+ }

'a classmate'}` : ''} · {a.status === 'missed' ? 'Not Shown' : a.status === 'excused' ? 'Excused, Not Shown' : a.status === 'lapsed' ? 'Not Shown Before The Term Ended' : a.shown ? BAND_LABEL[a.shown.band] : 'Done'}
+               {/* A revision missed has no `applied`, only `missed` (from 2026-10-16: until then this line was drawn only where
+                   `applied` was set, so a missed revision stood at its first band with nothing said, while the term's review
+                   counted it Unready; found by tests/remaining-school-term.test.ts). */}

+               {a.feedback && <div className="xs dim">{a.feedback.text}</div>}

+ function Partners() {

(() => { const n = boundaryLiftsAfter(p.boundary) - p.boundary.keptSince; return ` · Wants A Day’s Notice (Until ${n} More ${n === 1 ? 'Rehearsal Is' : 'Rehearsals Are'} Kept)`; })() : ''}{stoppedAsking(m, sim.now) ? ' · Has Stopped Asking You To Run Lines' : owesYouLines(m, sim.now) ? ' · Owes You Lines' : ''}</span>

'Twenty minutes, in person'} onClick={() => { if (run('school.make_amends', { mate: i }).ok) toast(`You made it right with ${m.name.split(' ')[0]}.`, 'positive'); }}>Make Amends</Gated>

+ /**

It won’t take the note by itself: you still take it at a showing.</span></div>;

+ /**
+  * A tax lien's record on Papers (from the remaining-gaps pass of 2026-10-11): which authority filed it and why, what it
+  * secured, where it's recorded, its fees, its dates and what's next; the request a release asks where the authority's
+  * rule asks one, refused with its reason where it can't be made; and the request to withdraw one filed in error, drawn
+  * only on a lien that was (from 2026-10-16: until then drawn on every lien, refused with its reason, below). Beside it,
+  * Oregon's three-year penalty and its waiver.
+  */
+ import { useGame, useWorld } from '@/app/game-context';
+ import { Fine, WhyNot } from '@/ui/components/primitives';
+ import { Gated } from '@/ui/guide/Guide';
+ import { HowItWorks } from '@/ui/guide/HowItWorks';
+ import { formatDate } from '@/engine/core/time';
+ import { formatMoney, saveCurrency } from '@/engine/core/money';
+ import { agencyOf, lienDisputeRefusal, lienReleaseRefusal, lienReleaseWords, rulesOf, stateName, waiverRefusal, waiverShare, type Lien } from '@/engine/systems/statetax';
+ import { FEDERAL_LIEN, federalLienInError, federalLienWithdrawRefusal, returnsOf } from '@/engine/systems/taxreturn';
+
+ const STATUS: Record<Lien['status'], string> = {
+   intent: 'Notice Of Intent Sent',
+   filed: 'Filed',
+   paid: 'Paid: Release To Come',
+   released: 'Released',
+   disputed: 'Asked To Be Withdrawn',
+   withdrawn: 'Withdrawn',
+   dropped: 'Not Filed',
+ };
+
+ function LienFacts({ l, money, zone }: { l: Lien; money: (c: number) => string; zone: string }) {
+   return (
+     <>
+       {/* A lien only announced, or announced and never filed, says so (from 2026-10-19, brief 15: until then both said "It
+           was filed for … and recorded in …", which hadn't happened). */}
+       <p className="small" style={{ margin: 0 }}>
+         <strong>{l.name}</strong> · {STATUS[l.status]}. {l.status === 'intent'
+           ? `It’s to be filed for ${money(l.amount)}, with ${l.recordedAt}, unless you pay it or set up a payment plan first.`
+           : l.status === 'dropped'
+             ? 'It was never filed, because what it was for was paid or put under a payment plan first.'
+             : <>It was filed for {money(l.amount)} {l.trigger === 'plan' ? 'because the payment plan requires one' : 'when collection reached that stage'}, and recorded in {l.recordedAt}{l.filedAt !== undefined ? ` on ${formatDate(l.filedAt, zone)}` : ''}.</>}
+         {l.fee ? ` Its recording fee of ${money(l.fee)} was added to what you owe.` : ''}
+         {l.releaseDue !== undefined && l.status === 'paid' ? ` It’s to be released by ${formatDate(l.releaseDue, zone)}.` : ''}
+         {l.releasedAt !== undefined ? ` Released ${formatDate(l.releasedAt, zone)}.` : ''}
+         {l.decideAt !== undefined && l.status === 'disputed' ? ` A decision is due by ${formatDate(l.decideAt, zone)}.` : ''}
+         {l.withdrawnAt !== undefined ? ` Withdrawn ${formatDate(l.withdrawnAt, zone)}.` : ''}
+       </p>
+       {l.history.length > 0 && (
+         <details className="small"><summary>The Lien’s History</summary>
+           <ul style={{ margin: 0 }}>{l.history.map((h, i) => <li key={i}>{formatDate(h.at, zone)}: {h.what}{h.amount !== undefined ? `, ${money(h.amount)}` : ''}.</li>)}</ul>
+         </details>
+       )}
+     </>
+   );
+ }
+
+ /** A state's or city's lien on a year, and Oregon's three-year penalty. */
+ export function StateLienAndPenalty({ year, state }: { year: number; state: string }) {
+   const { sim, run, toast } = useGame();
+   const person = useWorld((s) => s.player);
+   const r = returnsOf(person)[String(year)];
+   const sd = r?.stateDue?.[state];
+   const rules = rulesOf(state);
+   const cur = saveCurrency(sim.universe);
+   const money = (c: number) => formatMoney(c, cur);
+   if (!r || !sd || !rules) return null;
+   const l = sd.lien;
+   const release = lienReleaseRefusal(sim, person, r, state);
+   const dispute = lienDisputeRefusal(r, state);
+   // The withdrawal as filed in error, offered only on a lien the engine finds was (`lienInError`): one on a state's
+   // assessment that your own return, in its place, showed you'd paid. Any other filed lien says why it isn't, in the
+   // engine's words, and its next step is its release. From 2026-10-16: until then the button was drawn shut on every
+   // lien, and on Connecticut's, the only state a life files in, no state could open it, since DRS takes a payment to its
+   // penalty and interest first, files only while tax is owed and assesses from the return's own figures; the line beside
+   // it said a lien filed in error is withdrawn on request (the integration pass's tax item 2).
+   const inError = !dispute;
+   const secured = l !== undefined && ['filed', 'paid', 'released'].includes(l.status) ? dispute : undefined;
+   const waive = waiverRefusal(sim, r, state);
+   return (
+     <>
+       {l && rules.lien && (
+         <div className="col gap-1">
+           <div className="eyebrow">{`${agencyOf(state)}’s Lien`}</div>
+           <LienFacts l={l} money={money} zone={sim.zone} />
+           <p className="xs dim" style={{ margin: 0 }}>{rules.lien.effect} It’s released {lienReleaseWords(rules.lien)}.{inError ? ` Because it was filed in error, you can ask for it to be withdrawn: ${rules.lien.error.how}.` : secured ? ` ${secured}` : ''}</p>
+           <div className="row gap-2" style={{ flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
+             <Gated feature="tax.lien_release" className="btn btn-sm btn-ghost" disabled={Boolean(release)} title={release} onClick={() => { const a = run<{ releaseDue?: number }>('tax.lien_release', { state, year }); if (a.ok) toast(a.value!.releaseDue !== undefined ? `Asked. It’s to be released by ${formatDate(a.value!.releaseDue, sim.zone)}.` : 'Released.', 'positive'); }}>Ask For Its Release</Gated>
+             {inError && <Gated feature="tax.lien_dispute" className="btn btn-sm btn-ghost" onClick={() => { const a = run<{ decideAt: number }>('tax.lien_dispute', { state, year }); if (a.ok) toast(`Asked. ${agencyOf(state)} decides by ${formatDate(a.value!.decideAt, sim.zone)}.`, 'positive'); }}>Ask For Its Withdrawal As Filed In Error</Gated>}
+             <HowItWorks help="taxes.lien" />
+           </div>
+           <WhyNot reasons={[['Ask For Its Release', release]]} />
+         </div>
+       )}
+       {sd.threeYear && rules.threeYear && (
+         <div className="col gap-1">
+           <div className="eyebrow">Three Years Unfiled</div>
+           <p className="small" style={{ margin: 0 }}>
+             {money(sd.threeYear.amount)} was added on {formatDate(sd.threeYear.at, sim.zone)}: a penalty of {Math.round(rules.threeYear.share * 100)}% of the year’s tax, because no {stateName(state)} return was filed for three years in a row (ORS 305.992). The year’s penalties are capped at its tax.
+             {sd.threeYear.waived !== undefined ? ` ${money(sd.threeYear.waived)} of it was waived on ${formatDate(sd.threeYear.waivedAt!, sim.zone)}.` : ` If you ask for a waiver now, its schedule waives ${Math.round(waiverShare(r, state) * 100)}%.`}
+           </p>
+           <div className="row gap-2"><Gated feature="tax.request_waiver" className="btn btn-sm btn-ghost" disabled={Boolean(waive)} title={waive} onClick={() => { const a = run<{ waived: number }>('tax.request_waiver', { state, year }); if (a.ok) toast(`Waived: ${money(a.value!.waived)}.`, 'positive'); }}>Ask For Its Waiver</Gated><HowItWorks help="tax.request_waiver" /></div>
+           <WhyNot reasons={[['Ask For Its Waiver', waive]]} />
+         </div>
+       )}
+     </>
+   );
+ }

+ /** The IRS's notice of federal tax lien on a year. */
+ export function FederalLien({ year }: { year: number }) {
+   const { sim, run, toast } = useGame();
+   const person = useWorld((s) => s.player);
+   const r = returnsOf(person)[String(year)];
+   const cur = saveCurrency(sim.universe);
+   const money = (c: number) => formatMoney(c, cur);
+   if (!r?.lien) return null;
+   const no = federalLienWithdrawRefusal(person, r, sim.now);
+   const error = federalLienInError(r);
+   return (
+     <div className="col gap-1">
+       <div className="eyebrow">The IRS’s Lien</div>
+       <LienFacts l={r.lien} money={money} zone={sim.zone} />
+       <p className="xs dim" style={{ margin: 0 }}>{FEDERAL_LIEN.effect} It’s released within {FEDERAL_LIEN.releaseDays} days of payment in full. After that, you can ask for it to be withdrawn on Form 12277, if your last three years’ returns are filed. A lien filed in error is released as erroneous within {FEDERAL_LIEN.errorDays} days.</p>
+       <div className="row gap-2"><Gated feature="tax.federal_lien_withdraw" className="btn btn-sm btn-ghost" disabled={Boolean(no)} title={no} onClick={() => { const a = run<{ decideAt: number; error: boolean }>('tax.federal_lien_withdraw', { year }); if (a.ok) toast(`${a.value!.error ? 'Asked for its release as erroneous' : 'Form 12277 sent'}. The IRS decides by ${formatDate(a.value!.decideAt, sim.zone)}.`, 'positive'); }}>{error ? 'Ask For Its Release As Erroneous' : 'Ask For Its Withdrawal (Form 12277)'}</Gated><HowItWorks help="taxes.lien" /></div>
+       <WhyNot reasons={[['Ask For Its Withdrawal', no]]} />
+       <Fine>Source: {FEDERAL_LIEN.source}.</Fine>
+     </div>
+   );
+ }

+ /**
+  * SLATE — what a piece of material asks, and how the player chooses to play it (from 2026-10-10;
+  * `content/material.ts`, `content/approaches.ts`, `systems/material.ts`).
+  *
+  * Everything a choice does is shown before it's made: the material's features and the text's reasons for each; any
+  * side the material or the director doesn't take, and why; the abilities each side draws on; and what the work would
+  * come to, fully prepared, played each way (the evaluation's own expected result, with no draw). A change of mind
+  * keeps half of what was rehearsed in, said on the button.
+  */
+
+ import { useState } from 'react';
+ import { Fine } from '@/ui/components/primitives';
+ import { Gated } from '@/ui/guide/Guide';
+ import { HowItWorks } from '@/ui/guide/HowItWorks';
+ import { AXES, APPROACH_EFFECT, MISFIT, PLAYING } from '@/engine/content/approaches';
+ import type { Axis, AxisValue, MaterialProfile } from '@/engine/content/material';
+ import { misfitOf, sidesOf, transitionsOf, type Playing } from '@/engine/systems/material';
+ import { abilityDef } from '@/engine/systems/attributes';
+ import type { Evaluation } from '@/engine/systems/evaluation';
+ import { SKILLS } from '@/engine/content/school';

+ import { requiredFor, sceneOfMaterial, suitabilityOf, type Scene } from '@/engine/systems/interpretation';

+ const LEVEL = ['None', 'Some', 'Much', 'Built On It'];
+ const FEATURE_WORD: Record<string, string> = { timing: 'Timing', physical: 'Physical Work', partner: 'Playing Off The Partner', vocal: 'Vocal Demand', improvisation: 'Freedom To Improvise' };
+ const LANGUAGE_WORD: Record<MaterialProfile['language'], string> = { everyday: 'Everyday Speech', heightened: 'Heightened Prose', verse: 'Verse' };
+
+ type Choice = Omit<Playing, 'chosenAt' | 'prep'>;
