+ /**
+  * A material's demands, with the text's reasons. A stage scene's circumstances too, each with its reason (from 2026-10-16,
+  * later): until then each of the 86 class scenes and plays had a reason written for each circumstance, and no screen
+  * showed it, while The Scene named the circumstance alone.
+  */
+ export function MaterialDemands({ material }: { material: MaterialProfile }) {
+   const features = (['timing', 'physical', 'partner', 'vocal', 'improvisation'] as const).filter((f) => material[f] > 0);
+   const circumstances = (Object.entries(material.circumstances ?? {}) as [keyof typeof CIRCUMSTANCE_AFFINITY, number][]).filter(([, level]) => level > 0);
+   const tech = Object.keys(material.techniques ?? {}).map((k) => SKILLS.find((s) => s.id === k)?.label ?? k);
+   return (
+     <div className="col gap-1">
+       <div className="eyebrow">What {material.title} Asks</div>
+       <ul className="small" style={{ margin: 0 }}>
+         <li><strong>{LANGUAGE_WORD[material.language]}</strong>{material.medium === 'camera' ? ', on camera' : ''}{material.why.language ? `: ${material.why.language}` : ''}</li>
+         {features.map((f) => <li key={f}><strong>{FEATURE_WORD[f]}: {LEVEL[material[f]]}</strong>{material.why[f] ? `. ${material.why[f]}` : ''}</li>)}
+         {circumstances.map(([c, level]) => <li key={c} data-circumstance={c}><strong>{CIRCUMSTANCE_AFFINITY[c].label}: {LEVEL[level]}</strong>{material.why[c] ? `. ${material.why[c]}` : ''}</li>)}
+         {/* The count by the brief pane's own name for it, changes of tone (from 2026-10-19, brief 15, at material-b's
+             suggestion): until then “N transitions to play”. */}
+         <li><strong>{material.tones.length > 1 ? `Tone: ${material.tones.join(' to ')}` : `Tone: ${material.tones[0]}`}</strong>, {transitionsOf(material)} change{transitionsOf(material) === 1 ? '' : 's'} of tone to play{material.why.tones ? `. ${material.why.tones}` : material.why.turns ? `. ${material.why.turns}` : ''}</li>
+         {tech.length > 0 && <li><strong>Techniques It Asks: {tech.join(', ')}</strong>{material.why.techniques ? `. ${material.why.techniques}` : ''}</li>}
+         {material.allows && <li><strong>It Only Takes: {Object.values(material.allows).flat().map((v) => APPROACH_EFFECT[v as AxisValue].label).join(', ')}</strong>{material.why.allows ? `. ${material.why.allows}` : ''}</li>}
+       </ul>
+     </div>
+   );
+ }

+ export function PlayingChooser({ material, scene, current, direction, preview, feature, help, onChoose }: {
+   material?: MaterialProfile;
+   /** What the scene is beyond its material (from 2026-10-16): a brief's genre register, its reader, the reading taken. */
+   scene?: Scene;
+   current?: Playing;
+   direction?: Partial<Record<Axis, AxisValue>>;
+   preview: (c: Choice) => Evaluation;
+   feature: string;
+   /**
+    * The guide's entry for the choice (from 2026-10-12), by its id or a feature it covers: How This Works beside How
+    * You’ll Play It. The caller names it, so its own file holds the help for the control it gates.
+    */
+   help?: string;
+   onChoose: (c: Choice) => void;
+ }) {
+   const [draft, setDraft] = useState<Choice>({ ...(current?.pace ? { pace: current.pace } : {}), ...(current?.scale ? { scale: current.scale } : {}), ...(current?.structure ? { structure: current.structure } : {}) });
+   const same = (a: Choice, b: Choice) => a.pace === b.pace && a.scale === b.scale && a.structure === b.structure;
+   const whole = preview({});
+   const open = whole.overall;
+   // A piece judged in its movements, a brief's beats or a scene's parts reads stamina only as tiring late in it
+   // (`judgePiece`), so it isn't listed as what a side draws on there (from 2026-10-12: until then Driven listed Stamina
+   // for a part, which a night never read through the side). Work judged whole, with no scene, still lists and reads it; a
+   // scene of one tone was judged whole too until 2026-10-16 (`scenePiece`).
+   const movements = whole.piece !== undefined;
+   const now = preview(draft);
+   const changed = current ? !same(draft, current) : sidesOf({ ...draft, chosenAt: 0, prep: 0 }).length > 0;
+   const asked = Object.entries(direction ?? {}) as [Axis, AxisValue][];
+   // How much of the choice's rehearsal completes it (from 2026-10-16): less with the scene's grain, more against it.
+   const draftSides = sidesOf({ ...draft, chosenAt: 0, prep: 0 });
+   // The scene as the take reads it: the caller's, or a class scene's or a play's own genre (`sceneOfMaterial`).
+   const sceneRead = scene ?? sceneOfMaterial(material);
+   const completeAt = requiredFor(draftSides, material, sceneRead);
+   return (
+     <div className="col gap-2">
+       {help ? <div className="row-between"><div className="eyebrow">How You’ll Play It</div><HowItWorks help={help} /></div> : <div className="eyebrow">How You’ll Play It</div>}
+       {asked.length > 0 && <p className="small" style={{ margin: 0 }}>The director has asked for it {asked.map(([, v]) => APPROACH_EFFECT[v].label.toLowerCase()).join(' and ')}: {asked.map(([, v]) => APPROACH_EFFECT[v].words).join(' ')}</p>}
+       <div className="table-scroll">
+         <table>
+           <thead><tr><th scope="col">Aspect</th><th scope="col">Choice</th><th scope="col">The Scene</th><th scope="col">Abilities It Uses</th><th scope="col" className="num">Fully Prepared</th></tr></thead>
+           <tbody>
+             {(Object.keys(AXES) as Axis[]).flatMap((axis) => AXES[axis].values.map((side, i) => {
+               const e = APPROACH_EFFECT[side];
+               const why = misfitOf(axis, side, material, direction);
+               const chosen = draft[axis] === side;
+               const result = preview({ ...draft, [axis]: side }).overall;
+               // How well the side suits the scene (from 2026-10-16, `systems/interpretation.ts`): its band and what it rests on.
+               const suit = suitabilityOf(side, material, sceneRead);
+               const rests = suit.signals.filter((g) => Math.abs(g.v) >= 0.1).slice(0, 3);
+               const draws = [...new Set(Object.values(e.inputs).flat().filter((x) => !movements || x!.ability !== 'stamina').map((x) => abilityDef(x!.ability).label))].join(', ');
+               return (
+                 <tr key={side}>
+                   <td className="nowrap">{i === 0 ? AXES[axis].label : ''}</td>
+                   <td>
+                     <label className="row gap-1" style={{ alignItems: 'flex-start' }}>
+                       <input type="radio" name={`axis-${axis}`} checked={chosen} onChange={() => setDraft({ ...draft, [axis]: side })} />
+                       <span><strong>{e.label}</strong> <span className="xs">{e.words}</span>{why && <span className="xs" style={{ display: 'block', color: 'var(--warning, inherit)' }}>Doesn’t fit: {why}</span>}</span>
+                     </label>
+                   </td>
+                   <td className="xs" data-suit={suit.band}><strong>{GRAIN_LABEL[suit.band]}</strong>{rests.length ? <ul style={{ margin: 0, paddingLeft: '1.1em' }}>{rests.map((g) => <li key={g.source}>{g.source}: {g.v > 0 ? 'for it' : 'against it'}</li>)}</ul> : <span style={{ display: 'block' }}>Nothing in the scene leans either way.</span>}</td>
+                   <td className="xs">{draws}</td>
+                   <td className="num mono">{result.toFixed(1)}</td>
+                 </tr>
+               );
+             }))}
+           </tbody>
+         </table>
+       </div>
+       <div className="row gap-2" style={{ flexWrap: 'wrap', alignItems: 'center' }}>
+         {(Object.keys(AXES) as Axis[]).map((axis) => draft[axis] && <button key={axis} type="button" className="btn btn-sm btn-ghost" onClick={() => { const next = { ...draft }; delete next[axis]; setDraft(next); }}>Leave The {AXES[axis].label} Open</button>)}
+       </div>
+       <p className="small" style={{ margin: 0 }}>
+         Fully prepared and on a good day, playing it this way would come to {now.overall.toFixed(1)}, {now.overall.toFixed(1) === open.toFixed(1) ? 'the same as' : `against ${open.toFixed(1)}`} with nothing chosen.
+         {current && sidesOf(current).length > 0 ? ` You’ve rehearsed your current choice to ${Math.round(current.prep * 100)}% so far (it’s complete at ${Math.round(requiredFor(sidesOf(current), material, sceneRead) * 100)}%). Work on your feet rehearses it.` : ' Choosing a way to play it isn’t rehearsing it: once you choose, work on your feet rehearses it.'}
+         {draftSides.length > 0 ? ` This choice is complete once it’s rehearsed to ${Math.round(completeAt * 100)}%: ${completeAt < PLAYING.complete ? 'it suits the scene, so it asks less' : completeAt > PLAYING.complete ? 'it goes against the scene, so it asks more' : 'the scene neither favors nor resists it'}.` : ''}
+         {changed && current && sidesOf(current).length > 0 ? ` If you change it, you keep ${Math.round(PLAYING.keptOnChange * 100)}% of that rehearsal.` : ''}
+       </p>
+       <div>
+         <Gated feature={feature} className="btn btn-sm" disabled={!changed} onClick={() => onChoose(draft)}>{current && sidesOf(current).length ? 'Change How You Play It' : 'Play It This Way'}</Gated>
+       </div>
+       <Fine>Each way of playing shifts what counts most in your work toward what it is, and uses the abilities shown. It moves the balance without adding to it, so at full ability every choice that fits reaches 100; below that, a choice that leans on what you do well shows you at your best. A choice the material or the director doesn’t take holds the qualities it leans on to {Math.round(MISFIT * 100)}% of themselves. A choice that fits can still suit the scene or go against it, by what the scene is (its genre, its reader, its tones and turns, its features and language, its circumstances, the medium and the reading you’ve taken): one that suits it is easier to make work and needs less rehearsal, one that goes against it is harder and needs more, and at full ability either reaches 100.{movements ? ' Judged movement by movement, the piece only counts stamina as tiring late in it, however it’s played, so no choice uses it here.' : ''} The sizes are estimated.</Fine>
+     </div>
+   );
+ }

+ /**
+  * A casting's rehearsal process on the School's casting tab
+  * (`systems/production.ts`, from 2026-10-07): the part's lines and blocking,
+  * blocking missed, the director's notes and whether each was taken, the dress
+  * rehearsal's reading, and the actor's own work on the part between calls.
+  *
+  * From 2026-10-12 a note on the craft names what the part's forecast shows, where in the play, with the ways at it:
+  * Work On The Note takes one of them, its evidence is kept on the note, and the next call says whether it was
+  * answered. The part's forecast is shown in its movements (`systems/piece.ts`), the nights together with the company
+  * beside it, and the part can be worked through between calls (`WorkThrough`). Until then "A Night's Readiness" was
+  * shown as what a night would come to; from 2026-10-09 it reached a night's growth only, and it's said so now.
+  *
+  * From 2026-10-16 (brief 10) The Evening's Workload under A Night Now says what the night asks of stamina from the
+  * forecast's own figures: the drain at the curtain's fall and the energy it costs, and, from 2026-10-20 (brief 17) under
+  * How It's Worked Out, the running time and its breaks, the part's share, the workload and where the running time comes
+  * from (`workloadWords`, a part at a time). Until then all of it was one paragraph.
+  */

+ import { useState } from 'react';
+ import { useGame, useWorld } from '@/app/game-context';
+ import { Stat, Fine, WhyNot } from '@/ui/components/primitives';
+ import { Gated } from '@/ui/guide/Guide';
+ import { HowItWorks } from '@/ui/guide/HowItWorks';
+ import { formatDate } from '@/engine/core/time';
+ import { CITIES } from '@/engine/content/geography';
+ import { YALE_DRAMA } from '@/engine/content/school';
+ import { ADJUSTMENTS, WORKBOOK } from '@/engine/content/workbook';
+ import { PROCESS, hasProcess, nightFactor, ownWorkRefusal, partPlayingRefusal, reworkable, solutionsOf, type DirectorNote, type Holder, type Which } from '@/engine/systems/production';
+ import { MaterialDemands, PlayingChooser } from '@/ui/components/PlayingChooser';

+ const zone = () => CITIES.require(YALE_DRAMA.cityId).timeZone;
+ const pct = (x: number) => `${Math.round(x * 100)}%`;
+ const DRESS_WORD: Record<string, string> = { off: 'An Off Run', solid: 'Solid', strong: 'Strong', remarkable: 'Remarkable' };
+
+ /**
+  * A note's state in words (from 2026-10-16, `NoteOutcome`): what became of it, so a way that changed nothing reads as
+  * tried and learned from, not taken. A note from before has no outcome and reads as it did.
+  */
+ const OUTCOME_WORD = { resolved: '· Resolved', better: '· Taken: Better', learned: '· Tried: Learned From, Not Moved', unchanged: '· Not Taken' } as const;
+ const noteState = (n: DirectorNote, notYet: string) => (n.outcome ? OUTCOME_WORD[n.outcome] : n.taken === undefined ? (n.worked ? '· Worked On' : `· ${notYet}`) : n.taken ? '· Taken' : '· Not Taken');
+
+ export function RehearsalProcess({ casting, which }: { casting: Holder; which: Which }) {
+   const { sim, run, toast } = useGame();
+   const person = useWorld((s) => s.player);
+   const p = hasProcess(casting) ? casting.process : undefined;
+   const part = ownWorkRefusal(sim, person, which, 'part');
+   const blocking = ownWorkRefusal(sim, person, which, 'blocking');
+   const note = ownWorkRefusal(sim, person, which, 'note');
+   const last = p?.notes.at(-1);
+   const piece = useWorld((s) => workPiece(s, s.player, `part:${which}`), [which]);
+   const forecast = piece?.forecast();
+   const load = forecast && workloadWords(forecast) ? { cost: workloadWords(forecast, 'cost')!, working: workloadWords(forecast, 'working')! } : undefined;
+   const ways = solutionsOf(piece, last);
+   const [way, setWay] = useState(0);
+   const chosen = ways[Math.min(way, ways.length - 1)];
+   // The way chosen is refused here as the command refuses it, by its own checks and minutes (from 2026-10-12).
+   const noteWhy = note ?? (piece && chosen ? wayRefusal(sim, person, piece, chosen.adjustment) : undefined);
+   const work = () => {
+     const r = run<{ before?: number; after?: number; pending?: boolean }>('school.work_note', { which, ...(chosen ? { solution: chosen.adjustment, ...(chosen.option ? { option: chosen.option } : {}) } : {}) });
+     // Said as it measured (from 2026-10-16): a way that moved nothing says so, and isn't called an answer.
+     const moved = r.ok && r.value!.before !== undefined ? r.value!.after! - r.value!.before : 0;
+     if (r.ok) toast(r.value!.before !== undefined ? `Worked ${chosen?.label.toLowerCase() ?? 'on it'}: ${r.value!.before} to ${r.value!.after}.${Math.abs(moved) < WORKBOOK.evidence ? ' It didn’t move it: worth knowing, and not yet the answer.' : ''}${r.value!.pending ? ' Keep it or put it back, below.' : ' The next call will show it.'}` : 'Worked on: the next call will show it.', 'positive');
+   };
+   return (
+     <div className="col gap-2">
+       <div className="row-between"><div className="eyebrow">The Rehearsal Process</div><HowItWorks help="school.learn_part" /></div>
+       <div className="grid grid-3">
+         <Stat label="Lines" value={pct(p?.lines ?? 0)} note={`You’re asked to be off book ${pct(PROCESS.blockingShare)} of the way through`} />
+         <Stat label="Blocking" value={pct(p?.blocking ?? 0)} note={p?.blockingMissed ? `${p.blockingMissed} Missed To Catch Up` : 'Set at the blocking calls'} />
+         <Stat label="Growth From A Night" value={`${Math.round(nightFactor(casting) * 100)}%`} note="How much a night would grow your craft, against keeping every call. It doesn’t change the night’s result" />
+         {forecast && <Stat label="A Night Now" value={forecast.overall.toFixed(1)} note="A forecast: what a night would come to if it opened now, without good or bad luck" />}
+       </div>
+       {/* What the evening does to you first, how it's worked out beneath it (from 2026-10-20, brief 17, section 8): until then
+           one paragraph of four sentences and the running time's source, the drain and the energy first. */}
+       {load && (
+         <div className="small col gap-1" data-workload="">
+           <div><strong>The Evening’s Workload.</strong> {load.cost}</div>
+           <details className="fine">
+             <summary className="xs dim">How It’s Worked Out</summary>
+             <p className="xs dim" style={{ margin: 'var(--s1) 0 0' }}>{load.working}{forecast?.inputs.piece?.night ? ` The running time: ${forecast.inputs.piece.night.from}.` : ''}</p>
+           </details>
+         </div>
+       )}
+       {p?.dress && <div className="small">The dress rehearsal: {DRESS_WORD[p.dress] ?? p.dress}.</div>}
+       {p?.together && p.together.n > 0 && <div className="small"><strong>The Nights Together.</strong> With the company, your nights have averaged {Math.round(p.together.sum / p.together.n)} of 100{p.together.slips ? `, ${p.together.slips === 1 ? 'one' : p.together.slips} with a slip by someone else${p.together.covered ? `, ${p.together.covered === p.together.slips ? (p.together.slips === 1 ? 'which you covered' : 'all of which you covered') : `${p.together.covered} of which you covered`}` : ''}` : ''}. How the show goes together changes how a night leaves you feeling, but your own night is your result.</div>}
+       {p?.reflection && <div className="small"><strong>Looking Back.</strong> {p.reflection.text} <span className="xs dim">A summary of your run, not the director’s own words.</span></div>}
+       {last && (
+         <div className="small col gap-1">
+           <div className="row-between" style={{ alignItems: 'flex-start' }}>
+             <div>
+               The director’s last note, {formatDate(last.at, zone())}: {last.text}
+               <span className="xs dim"> {noteState(last, 'Not Worked On Yet')}</span>
+             </div>
+             <HowItWorks help="school.work_note" />
+           </div>
+           {/* The way by its own label, as the notes so far name it (from 2026-10-13: until then a movement played to a
+               side read “Worked play this part another way” here, after the list below had been given the label; found by
+               that day’s guide audit). */}
+           {last.answer?.solution && <div className="xs">Worked {(last.answer.label ?? ADJUSTMENTS[last.answer.solution as keyof typeof ADJUSTMENTS]?.label ?? last.answer.solution).toLowerCase()}: {last.answer.before} before, {last.answer.after} after{last.answer.now !== undefined ? `; ${last.answer.now} at the next call` : ''}.</div>}
+           {/* Shown again once a way is put back (`reworkable`, from 2026-10-12): until then it stayed hidden, and Work On
+               The Note worked whatever place was last chosen in the shorter list of the ways left. */}
+           {ways.length > 0 && (!last.worked || (p !== undefined && reworkable(p))) && (
+             <label className="row gap-2 wrap xs" style={{ alignItems: 'center' }}>
+               <span>Ways to work on it:</span>
+               <select aria-label="A Way To Work On The Note" value={Math.min(way, ways.length - 1)} onChange={(e) => setWay(Number(e.target.value))}>
+                 {ways.map((o, i) => <option key={`${o.adjustment}:${o.option ?? ''}`} value={i}>{o.label}</option>)}
+               </select>
+               <span className="dim">{chosen?.words}</span>
+             </label>
+           )}
+           <div className="xs dim">These notes are simulated: the game’s words, not a real director’s.</div>
+         </div>
+       )}
+       {p && p.notes.length > 1 && <div className="xs dim">{`Notes taken: ${p.notes.filter((n) => n.taken).length} of ${p.notes.filter((n) => n.taken !== undefined).length}.${p.notes.some((n) => n.outcome === 'learned') ? ` Worked and learned from without moving: ${p.notes.filter((n) => n.outcome === 'learned').length}.` : ''}`}</div>}
+       {/* The notes before the last, each with what came of it (from 2026-10-13): until then a note's outcome went from
+           the screen when the next call gave another, and a player couldn't see whether the note they worked was taken,
+           only a count. History, read from the process: it changes nothing. */}
+       {p && p.notes.length > 1 && (
+         <details className="xs" data-notes="">
+           <summary>The Director’s Notes So Far</summary>
+           <ol style={{ margin: 'var(--s1) 0 0', paddingLeft: 'var(--s4)' }}>
+             {p.notes.slice(0, -1).reverse().map((n) => (
+               <li key={n.at} style={{ marginBottom: 'var(--s1)' }}>
+                 {formatDate(n.at, zone())}: {n.text}{' '}
+                 <span className="dim">{noteState(n, 'Not Worked On')}</span>
+                 {n.answer?.solution && <span className="dim">{` · Worked ${(n.answer.label ?? ADJUSTMENTS[n.answer.solution as keyof typeof ADJUSTMENTS]?.label ?? n.answer.solution).toLowerCase()}: ${n.answer.before} before, ${n.answer.after} after${n.answer.now !== undefined ? `, ${n.answer.now} at the next call` : ''}`}</span>}
+               </li>
+             ))}
+           </ol>
+         </details>
+       )}
+       <div className="row gap-2" style={{ flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
+         <Gated feature="school.learn_part" className="btn btn-sm btn-ghost" disabled={Boolean(part)} title={part ?? 'An hour on the lines'} onClick={() => { const r = run<{ lines: number }>('school.learn_part', { which }); if (r.ok) toast(`An hour on the part: lines at ${pct(r.value!.lines)}.`, 'positive'); }}>Learn The Part</Gated>
+         <Gated feature="school.review_blocking" className="btn btn-sm btn-ghost" disabled={Boolean(blocking)} title={blocking ?? 'An hour with the stage manager’s book'} onClick={() => { const r = run<{ blocking: number }>('school.review_blocking', { which }); if (r.ok) toast(`Caught up from the book: blocking at ${pct(r.value!.blocking)}.`, 'positive'); }}>Catch Up The Blocking</Gated>
+         <Gated feature="school.work_note" className="btn btn-sm btn-ghost" disabled={Boolean(noteWhy)} title={noteWhy ?? (chosen ? `${chosen.label}, ${chosen.minutes} minutes` : 'An hour on the director’s note')} onClick={work}>{chosen ? `Work On The Note: ${chosen.label}` : 'Work On The Note'}</Gated>
+       </div>
+       <WhyNot reasons={[['Learn The Part', part], ['Catch Up The Blocking', blocking], ['Work On The Note', noteWhy]]} />
+       {forecast && <Segments e={forecast} caption="The Part Now, Movement By Movement" />}
+       {piece && <WorkThrough piece={`part:${which}`} />}
+       {materialOf((casting as { play?: string }).play) && <MaterialDemands material={materialOf((casting as { play?: string }).play)!} />}
+       {!partPlayingRefusal(sim, person, which) && (

+           preview={(c) => partPreview(sim, person, casting as never, c)}
+           onChoose={(c) => { const r = run<{ prep: number }>('school.choose_part_playing', { which, ...c }); if (r.ok) toast(`Chosen. You’ve rehearsed this way of playing it to ${pct(r.value!.prep)} so far.`, 'positive'); }} />
+       )}
+       <Fine>The stages and their order are a rehearsal’s; how far a call or an hour moves the lines and blocking, what a note asks and what answers it, and what they make of a night, are estimated. A night is judged movement by movement: each movement’s blocking, where stamina tells late in the evening, and a slip carried into the next.</Fine>

+ /**

+ /** A leave: asked for, waited on, begun, and the way back. */
+ export function LeavePanel() {
+   const { sim, run, toast } = useGame();
+   const person = useWorld((s) => s.player);
+   const school = person.school!;
+   const cur = saveCurrency(sim.universe);
+   const money = (c: number) => formatMoney(c, cur);
+   const [kind, setKind] = useState<LeaveKind>('medical');
+   const [reason, setReason] = useState<LeaveReason>('illness');
+   const [terms, setTerms] = useState<number>(LEAVE_RULES.terms);
+   const [asking, setAsking] = useState<'' | 'request' | 'cancel' | 'affiliate'>('');
+   const l = school.leave;
+   const ended = schoolEnded(school.standing);
+   if (ended && !(school.leaves ?? []).length) return null;
+   const no = ended ? undefined : leaveRefusal(sim, person, kind, reason);
+   const lengths = ended || school.termsBegun === 0 ? [] : leaveLengths(sim, school, kind);
+   const w = school.welfare;
+   const start = !ended && school.termsBegun > 0 ? leaveStart(sim, school, kind) : undefined;
+   // The leave's own terms, the figure `school.buy_affiliate` charges (from 2026-10-12: until then `LEAVE_RULES.terms`).
+   const affiliate = l ? affiliateQuote(sim, l) : undefined;
+   const noticeNo = l?.status === 'on' && l.kind === 'medical' ? clearedToReturn(person, sim.now) : undefined;
+   const shut = [...lengths.reduce((m, x) => (x.why ? m.set(x.why, [...(m.get(x.why) ?? []), x.terms]) : m), new Map<string, number[]>())];
+
+   return (
+     <div className="col gap-2">
+       <div className="row-between"><div className="eyebrow">A Leave Of Absence</div><HowItWorks help="school.leave" /></div>

The game’s own rules: a leave’s length must return you in the season you left, since most acting courses run fall to spring; five working days to decide; the physician’s view read from care, injury or illness in the last thirty days; the rebate schedule applied to the living scholarship. + /** Leave lengths as a line names them: One term, Two or three terms, One, two or three terms. */
+ const lengthWords = (ns: readonly number[]): string => {
+   const words = ns.map((n) => ['no', 'one', 'two', 'three'][n] ?? String(n));
+   const said = words.length > 1 ? `${words.slice(0, -1).join(', ')} or ${words.at(-1)}` : words[0]!;
+   return `${said.replace(/^\w/, (c) => c.toUpperCase())} ${ns.length === 1 && ns[0] === 1 ? 'term' : 'terms'}`;
+ };

+ /** A term's first morning in New Haven. */
+ const at9 = (term: number) => instantFromZoned({ ...termStart(term).date, hour: 9 }, 'America/New_York');

+ /**
+  * A leave the dean imposed (`MANDATORY_LEAVE`): why, and its appeal, on a leave under way or one granted from the next
+  * term (a function of its own from 2026-10-16, when the second came to be drawn: until then it was drawn only on a leave
+  * under way, though the dean's notice said it could be appealed from the decision).
+  */
+ function DeanLeave() {
+   const { sim, run, toast } = useGame();
+   const person = useWorld((s) => s.player);
+   const l = person.school!.leave!;
+   const m = l.mandatory!;
+   const open = !m.appeal && sim.now <= m.appealBy;
+   return (
+     <div className="row gap-2" style={{ flexWrap: 'wrap', alignItems: 'center' }}>
+       <span className="small"><strong>Imposed by the dean</strong> on Yale Health’s recommendation{l.status === 'granted' ? `, from ${termLabel(l.firstTerm)}` : ''}: {m.why} {m.appeal ? (m.appeal.outcome ? `Your appeal was ${m.appeal.outcome === 'rescinded' ? 'granted' : 'turned down'}: ${m.appeal.why}` : `Your appeal is with the dean, decided by ${formatDate(m.appeal.decideAt, sim.zone)}.`) : open ? `You can appeal in writing to the dean until ${formatDate(m.appealBy, sim.zone)}. The leave stands while the appeal is heard, and it’s overturned if you’re cleared with enough of the term left to resume${l.status === 'granted' ? ', as all of it is before the leave begins' : ''}. It isn’t yours to call off.` : 'It isn’t yours to call off.'}</span>
+       {open && <Gated feature="school.appeal_leave" className="btn btn-sm btn-ghost" onClick={() => { const r = run<{ decideAt: number }>('school.appeal_leave'); if (r.ok) toast(`Appealed: decided by ${formatDate(r.value!.decideAt, sim.zone)}.`, 'positive'); }}>Appeal To The Dean</Gated>}

+ /** A year asked to be repeated, SLATE's faculty model. */
+ export function RepeatPanel() {
+   const { sim, run, toast } = useGame();
+   const person = useWorld((s) => s.player);
+   const school = person.school!;
+   const [asking, setAsking] = useState<'' | 'request' | 'cancel'>('');
+   if (schoolEnded(school.standing) && !school.repeat) return null;
+   const no = repeatRefusal(sim, person);
+   const r = school.repeat;
+   const t = Math.max(0, school.termsBegun - 1);
+   const failed = repeatCourses(school, t);
+   const extra = extraRefusal(sim, person);
+   const ex = school.extraRequest;
+   const show = r || ex || school.extra || school.repeatBy !== undefined || failed.length > 0;
+   if (!show) return null;
+   // The degree’s terms with the year again, as the decision counts them: those enrolled, the year’s two, and the
+   // program’s terms still to come (`withRepeat`). Until 2026-10-13 this counted the year’s two alone, so a first or
+   // second year’s repeat, which takes the degree to eight terms, said nothing of the two billed past six; found by that
+   // day’s guide audit. The tuition is each billed term’s own, the degree’s last terms; until then it was the next term’s,
+   // which for a first year’s repeat is two years of Yale’s growth before the terms billed.
+   const enrolled = enrolledTerms(school).length;
+   const total = withRepeat(school, academicTerm(school, t));
+   const past = total - EXTENDED_STUDY.supportedTerms;
+   const cur = saveCurrency(sim.universe);
+   const billed = Array.from({ length: Math.max(0, past) }, (_, k) => termAccount(cur, false, t + total - enrolled - k).tuition).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
+   return (
+     <div className="col gap-2">
+       <div className="row-between"><div className="eyebrow">Finishing The Degree</div><HowItWorks help="school.repeat" /></div>
+       {r && <p className="small" style={{ margin: 0 }}>Year {r.year}, asked {formatDate(r.requestedAt, sim.zone)}: {r.status === 'pending' ? `with the chair and the dean, decided by ${formatDate(r.decideAt, sim.zone)}` : r.status === 'granted' ? 'granted' : r.status === 'refused' ? `refused. ${r.why ?? ''}` : 'called off'}{r.courses.length ? `, for ${spokenList(r.courses)}` : ''}.</p>}
+       {school.repeatBy !== undefined && <p className="small" style={{ margin: 0 }}>Your last year wasn’t passed. Ask by {formatDate(school.repeatBy, sim.zone)}, or the faculty won’t recommend the degree.</p>}
+       {!no && (
+         <div className="col gap-2">
+           {asking === 'request' && <p className="small" style={{ margin: 0 }}>Asking puts it to the chair and the dean, decided in five working days. Granted, you take year {Math.floor(academicTerm(school, t) / 2) + 1}’s courses again from {termLabel(t + 1)}, and what you did the first time stays on your record; the degree reads the pass.{past > 0 ? ` The tuition scholarship supports six terms, and with the year again the degree takes ${countWords(total)} terms: ${countWords(past)} would be billed to your Yale account, about ${formatMoney(billed, cur)} in tuition alone.` : ''}{f1(person) ? ' Your I-20 would be extended a year.' : ''}</p>}
+           <div className="row gap-2">
+             {asking !== 'request'
+               ? <button type="button" className="btn btn-sm btn-ghost" onClick={() => setAsking('request')}>Ask To Repeat The Year…</button>
+               : <>
+                   <Gated feature="school.request_repeat" className="btn btn-sm" onClick={() => { const a = run<{ decideAt: number }>('school.request_repeat'); if (a.ok) toast(`Asked: decided by ${formatDate(a.value!.decideAt, sim.zone)}.`, 'positive'); setAsking(''); }}>Ask</Gated>
+                   <button type="button" className="btn btn-sm btn-ghost" onClick={() => setAsking('')}>Not Now</button>
+                 </>}
+           </div>
+         </div>
+       )}
+       {ex && <p className="small" style={{ margin: 0 }}>An additional term, {termLabel(ex.term)}, asked {formatDate(ex.requestedAt, sim.zone)} to retake {spokenList(ex.courses.map((c) => c.name))}: {ex.status === 'pending' ? `with the chair and the dean, decided by ${formatDate(ex.decideAt, sim.zone)}` : ex.status === 'granted' ? 'granted' : `refused. ${ex.why ?? ''}`}.</p>}
+       {school.extra && <p className="small" style={{ margin: 0 }}>In {termLabel(school.extra.term)} you take only {spokenList(school.extra.courses.map((c) => c.name))}; passed, the degree is {termStart(school.extra.term).fall ? 'conferred at Yale’s December conferral' : 'conferred at Commencement in May'}.</p>}
+       {!extra.why && !ex && (
+         <div className="col gap-1">
+           <p className="small" style={{ margin: 0 }}>Or an additional term, {termLabel(extra.term!)}, to retake {spokenList(extra.courses!.map((c) => c.name))} alone, with the class then in that year{termStart(extra.term!).fall ? ', the degree conferred in December' : ''}.</p>
+           <div><Gated feature="school.request_extra_term" className="btn btn-sm btn-ghost" onClick={() => { const a = run<{ decideAt: number }>('school.request_extra_term'); if (a.ok) toast(`Asked: decided by ${formatDate(a.value!.decideAt, sim.zone)}.`, 'positive'); }}>Ask For An Additional Term</Gated></div>
+         </div>
+       )}
+       {/* Asked first, with what calling it off leaves, as Call Off The Leave… asks (from 2026-10-12: until then the button sent the confirm on its first press, and the command's warning never showed). */}
+       {r?.status === 'pending' && (
+         <div className="row gap-2" style={{ flexWrap: 'wrap', alignItems: 'center' }}>
+           {asking !== 'cancel'
+             ? <button type="button" className="btn btn-sm btn-ghost" onClick={() => setAsking('cancel')}>Call Off The Request…</button>
+             : <>
+                 <span className="small">{cancelRepeatWarning(sim, school)}</span>
+                 <Gated feature="school.cancel_repeat" className="btn btn-sm btn-danger" onClick={() => { if (run('school.cancel_repeat', { confirm: true }).ok) toast('Called off.', 'neutral'); setAsking(''); }}>Call It Off</Gated>
+                 <button type="button" className="btn btn-sm btn-ghost" onClick={() => setAsking('')}>Keep It</button>
+               </>}
+         </div>
+       )}
+       {no && failed.length > 0 && !r && <p className="xs dim" style={{ margin: 0 }}>{no}</p>}
+       <Fine>No rule for repeating a failed acting course was found in the Bulletin, so this is the game’s own, under the Bulletin’s nine semesters for the degree, six terms of tuition support and its disqualification at two Fails in a term or seven in all (pp.148, 182, 194). A year is approved once, asked at its end or within thirty days of the last year’s term review; after the last year, what’s unpassed can be retaken in an additional term of its season instead. The faculty review a disqualification rather than apply it: the first time, academic warning and the year to repeat. Source: {EXTENDED_STUDY.source}.</Fine>
+     </div>
+   );
+ }

+ const f1 = (person: { documents?: { kind: string; destination?: string; name: string }[] }) => (person.documents ?? []).some((d) => d.kind === 'visa' && d.destination === 'US' && d.name.startsWith('F-1'));

+ /** The Yale account: what's billed and paid on it, a hold, paying it, and the aid office's review of a term past six. */
+ export function YaleAccountPanel() {
+   const { sim, run, toast } = useGame();
+   const person = useWorld((s) => s.player);
+   const school = person.school!;
+   const cur = saveCurrency(sim.universe);
+   const money = (c: number) => formatMoney(c, cur);
+   const [amount, setAmount] = useState('');
+   const acc = yaleAccount(sim, person, false);
+   // The aid review is offered exactly when it can be asked, with an account open or not (`aidReviewRefusal`, from
+   // 2026-10-12: until then nothing here drew without an account, a review, an additional term or a granted repeat, so in
+   // the sixth term, when no account is usually open, Ask For An Aid Review never showed though the command took it).
+   const reviewNo = aidReviewRefusal(sim, person);
+   const ar = school.aidReview;
+   if (!acc && !ar && reviewNo) return null;
+   const owed = accountOwed(sim, person);
+   const lines = acc ? sim.universe.transactions.filter((t) => t.postings.some((p) => p.accountId === acc.id)).slice(-12).reverse() : [];
+   const value = Math.round(Number(amount) * 100);
+   return (
+     <div className="col gap-2">
+       {acc && <div className="grid grid-3">
+         <Stat label="Owed On Your Yale Account" value={money(Math.max(0, owed))} tone={owed > 0 ? 'warning' : undefined} />
+         <Stat label="Financial Hold" value={school.hold !== undefined ? `Since ${formatDate(school.hold, sim.zone)}` : 'None'} note={school.hold !== undefined ? 'No registration and no diploma while it stands' : undefined} tone={school.hold !== undefined ? 'negative' : undefined} />
+         <Stat label="Terms Enrolled" value={`${enrolledTerms(school).length}`} note={`Six have tuition support; the degree within ${EXTENDED_STUDY.maxSemesters}`} />
+       </div>}
+       {owed > 0 && (
+         <div className="row gap-2" style={{ flexWrap: 'wrap', alignItems: 'flex-end' }}>
+           <div className="field"><label htmlFor="yale-pay">Pay (Blank Pays It All)</label><input id="yale-pay" inputMode="decimal" value={amount} onChange={(e) => setAmount(e.target.value)} placeholder={(owed / 100).toFixed(2)} /></div>
+           <Gated feature="school.pay_balance" className="btn btn-sm" onClick={() => { const a = run<{ owed: number }>('school.pay_balance', amount ? { amount: value } : {}); if (a.ok) { toast(a.value!.owed > 0 ? `Paid. ${money(a.value!.owed)} still owed.` : 'Paid in full.', 'positive'); setAmount(''); } }}>Pay From Your Bank</Gated>
+         </div>
+       )}
+       {acc && <div className="table-scroll">
+         <table>
+           <thead><tr><th scope="col">Date</th><th scope="col">What</th><th scope="col" className="num">Charged</th><th scope="col" className="num">Paid Or Credited</th></tr></thead>
+           <tbody>
+             {lines.map((t) => {
+               const p = t.postings.find((q) => q.accountId === acc.id)!;
+               return <tr key={t.id}><td>{formatDate(t.at, sim.zone)}</td><td className="small">{t.memo}</td><td className="num mono">{p.amount < 0 ? money(-p.amount) : ''}</td><td className="num mono">{p.amount > 0 ? money(p.amount) : ''}</td></tr>;
+             })}
+           </tbody>
+         </table>
+       </div>}
+       {(ar || !reviewNo) && (
+         <div className="row gap-2" style={{ flexWrap: 'wrap', alignItems: 'center' }}>

Unpaid, the Bulletin’s late fee, {money(inSaveMoney(sim, EXTENDED_STUDY.lateFee, 'USD'))} a month to {money(inSaveMoney(sim, EXTENDED_STUDY.lateFeeTermCap, 'USD'))} a term, and a hold on registration and the diploma (p.184). A scholarship returned on a leave is charged here too. The balance is the sum of the account’s postings.</Fine>

+ /**
+  * SLATE — working a problem through, on screen (from 2026-10-12; `systems/workbook.ts`), and a piece's segments.
+  *
+  * `WorkThrough` is the process for any piece in progress, by its key (`brief:<id>`, `assignment:<id>`, `part:<which>`):
+  * the problems its forecast shows, each with why; the one being worked; the ways at it, each with what it is and its
+  * time; a change tried waiting to be kept or put back; the evidence of each try; and the discoveries kept, which every
+  * later forecast and performance reads. `Segments` shows a piece judged in its segments: each one's result, its own
+  * rehearsal against what it asks, the stamina it costs there, a slip and what it carried, and the continuity read from
+  * them. Neither runs anything but the commands on its buttons.
+  */
+
+ import { useGame, useWorld } from '@/app/game-context';
+ import { Fine, WhyNot } from '@/ui/components/primitives';
+ import { Gated } from '@/ui/guide/Guide';
+ import { ADJUSTMENTS, WORKBOOK } from '@/engine/content/workbook';
+ import { PIECE } from '@/engine/content/piece';
+ import type { Evaluation } from '@/engine/systems/evaluation';
+ import { discoveriesOf, identifyRefusal, optionsOf, problemsOf, tryRefusal, type Try } from '@/engine/systems/workbook';
+ import { workPiece } from '@/engine/systems/workpieces';
+ import { HowItWorks } from '@/ui/guide/HowItWorks';
+
+ const pct = (x: number) => `${Math.round(x * 100)}%`;
+ const TONE: Record<string, string> = { comic: 'Comic', grave: 'Grave', lyric: 'Lyric', grotesque: 'Grotesque' };
+
+ /** A piece's segments as the evaluation judged them, and the continuity read from them. */
+ export function Segments({ e, caption }: { e: Evaluation; caption?: string }) {
+   const p = e.piece;
+   if (!p || p.segments.length < 2) return null;
+   return (
+     <div className="col gap-1" data-segments="">
+       <div className="eyebrow">{caption ?? 'Part By Part'}</div>
+       <div className="table-scroll">
+         <table>
+           <thead><tr><th scope="col">Part</th><th scope="col">Tone</th><th scope="col" className="num">Result</th><th scope="col" className="num">Its Rehearsal</th><th scope="col">Stamina</th><th scope="col">What Happened</th></tr></thead>
+           <tbody>
+             {p.segments.map((s) => (
+               <tr key={s.label}>
+                 <td className="nowrap">{s.label}</td>
+                 <td className="xs">{s.tones.length ? s.tones.map((t) => TONE[t] ?? t).join(' And ') : 'Unknown'}</td>
+                 <td className="num mono">{s.overall.toFixed(1)}</td>
+                 <td className="num mono">{pct(s.part)} of {pct(s.required)}</td>
+                 <td className="xs">{s.drain < 1 ? `Tiring: ${pct(1 - s.drain)} off` : 'Holding'}</td>
+                 <td className="xs">{s.slip ? `A slip, ${s.slip} under what was expected` : s.shaken !== undefined ? `Shaken by the slip before: ${pct(1 - s.shaken)} off` : s.chief ? `${s.chief.label} cost it most` : 'As expected'}</td>
+               </tr>
+             ))}
+           </tbody>
+         </table>
+       </div>
+       <p className="xs dim" style={{ margin: 0 }}>Continuity, how evenly the character held from part to part: {p.continuity.toFixed(1)}. The whole is the average of the parts; continuity comes from them, and isn’t added to it.</p>
+     </div>
+   );
+ }
+
+ /** Working a problem through, for a piece in progress. */
+ export function WorkThrough({ piece: key }: { piece: string }) {
+   const { sim, run, toast } = useGame();
+   const person = useWorld((s) => s.player);
+   const piece = useWorld((s) => workPiece(s, s.player, key), [key]);
+   if (!piece) return null;
+   const book = piece.peek();
+   const pending = book?.tries.find((t) => t.verdict === 'pending');
+   const problems = problemsOf(piece);
+   const current = book?.problem;
+   const options = current ? optionsOf(piece, current) : [];
+   const discoveries = discoveriesOf(piece);
+   const tries = [...(book?.tries ?? [])].reverse().slice(0, 6);
+   const name = (t: Try) => `${ADJUSTMENTS[t.adjustment].label}${t.option ? ` (${t.option.split(':')[1]})` : ''}`;
+   const trying = (adjustment: string, option?: string) => {
+     const r = run<Try>('work.try', { piece: key, adjustment, ...(option ? { option } : {}) });
+     if (r.ok) toast(`${name(r.value!)}: ${r.value!.before} to ${r.value!.after}.${r.value!.verdict === 'pending' ? ' Keep it or put it back.' : ''}`, r.value!.after >= r.value!.before ? 'positive' : 'neutral');
+   };
+   return (
+     <div className="col gap-2" data-workbook={key}>
+       <div className="row-between"><div className="eyebrow">Work It Through</div><HowItWorks help="work.try" /></div>
+       {pending ? (
+         <div className="callout small">
+           <strong>{name(pending)}</strong>, tried on “{pending.label}”: {pending.before} before, {pending.after} after.{' '}
+           <Gated feature="work.settle" className="btn btn-sm btn-primary" onClick={() => { if (run('work.settle', { piece: key, keep: true }).ok) toast('Kept. Everything from now on includes it.', 'positive'); }}>Keep It</Gated>{' '}
+           <Gated feature="work.settle" className="btn btn-sm" onClick={() => { if (run('work.settle', { piece: key, keep: false }).ok) toast('Put back as it was. It won’t be offered for this again.', 'neutral'); }}>Put It Back</Gated>
+         </div>
+       ) : current ? (
+         <div className="col gap-1">
+           <p className="small" style={{ margin: 0 }}><strong>Working On: {current.label}.</strong> {current.why}</p>
+           {options.length ? (
+             <ul className="small" style={{ margin: 0, paddingLeft: 'var(--s4)' }}>
+               {options.map((o) => {
+                 const no = tryRefusal(sim, person, piece, o.adjustment, o.option);
+                 return (
+                   <li key={`${o.adjustment}:${o.option ?? ''}`} style={{ marginBottom: 'var(--s1)' }}>
+                     <Gated feature="work.try" className="btn btn-sm" disabled={Boolean(no)} title={no ?? o.words} onClick={() => trying(o.adjustment, o.option)}>{`${o.label} (${o.minutes} Min)`}</Gated>{' '}
+                     <span className="xs dim">{o.words}{ADJUSTMENTS[o.adjustment].kind === 'choice' ? ' You keep it or put it back.' : ''}</span>
+                   </li>
+                 );
+               })}
+             </ul>
+           ) : <p className="xs dim" style={{ margin: 0 }}>There’s no way left to work on it here: its own preparation step works on it, or the ways you tried were put back.</p>}
+           <WhyNot reasons={options.map((o) => [o.label, tryRefusal(sim, person, piece, o.adjustment, o.option)] as const)} />
+         </div>
+       ) : null}
+       {!pending && (
+         problems.length ? (
+           <div className="col gap-1">
+             <p className="xs dim" style={{ margin: 0 }}>{current ? 'Or pick another problem:' : 'What the forecast shows, worst first. Pick one to work on:'}</p>
+             <ul className="small" style={{ margin: 0, paddingLeft: 'var(--s4)' }}>
+               {problems.filter((p) => p.id !== current?.id).map((p) => {
+                 const no = identifyRefusal(piece, p.id);
+                 return (
+                   <li key={p.id} style={{ marginBottom: 'var(--s1)' }}>
+                     <Gated feature="work.identify" className="btn btn-sm btn-ghost" disabled={Boolean(no)} title={no ?? p.why} onClick={() => run('work.identify', { piece: key, problem: p.id })}>{p.label}</Gated>{' '}
+                     <span className="xs dim">{p.why}</span>
+                   </li>
+                 );
+               })}
+             </ul>
+           </div>
+         ) : <p className="xs dim" style={{ margin: 0 }}>The forecast shows nothing to work through: every part of it is where it needs to be.</p>
+       )}
+       {tries.length > 0 && (
+         <div className="table-scroll">
+           <table data-tries="">
+             <thead><tr><th scope="col">Tried</th><th scope="col">For</th><th scope="col" className="num">Before</th><th scope="col" className="num">After</th><th scope="col">Kept</th></tr></thead>
+             <tbody>{tries.map((t, i) => <tr key={`${t.at}-${i}`}><td className="xs">{name(t)}</td><td className="xs">{t.label}</td><td className="num mono">{t.before}</td><td className="num mono">{t.after}</td><td className="xs">{t.verdict === 'kept' ? 'Kept' : t.verdict === 'revised' ? 'Put back' : 'Waiting'}</td></tr>)}</tbody>
+           </table>
+         </div>
+       )}
+       {discoveries.length > 0 && (
+         <div className="col gap-1">
+           <div className="eyebrow">What You’ve Found</div>
+           <ul className="xs" style={{ margin: 0 }}>{discoveries.map((d) => <li key={d}>{d}</li>)}</ul>
+         </div>
+       )}
+       <Fine>Problems come from the piece’s own forecast, its expected result without luck, so the same way tried on the same day shows the same result. A way of playing part of it, or places to breathe, is kept or put back; work done is kept. Working a part slowly moves its own rehearsal by {pct(WORKBOOK.workGain)} of what’s left, and a part a turn leads into asks up to {pct(PIECE.brief.perTurn)} more of a brief’s rehearsal. The sizes are estimated.</Fine>
+     </div>
+   );
+ }

+ /**
+  * SLATE — shared presentation pieces.
+  *
+  * Kept small and unopinionated. Anything that encodes a rule belongs in the
+  * engine, not here.
+  */
+
+ import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, type ReactNode } from 'react';
+ import { formatMoney, formatMoneyCompact, type Money } from '@/engine/core/money';
+ import { clamp } from '@/engine/core/rng';
+ import { LookRegion, Open } from '@/ui/looks/Look';
+ import type { Subject } from '@/ui/looks/subject';
+ import { HowItWorks } from '@/ui/guide/HowItWorks';
+
+ /**
+  * Sources and estimates, folded behind a line: there to read, out of the way
+  * of playing. Until 2026-09-28 each panel ended in them in full.
+  */
+ /**
+  * Why a row's controls can't be used now, said under them (acceptance pass, 2026-10-11): until then the engine's reason
+  * was only a button's tooltip, which a phone never shows and a desktop player had to hover to find, so a row of grayed
+  * buttons said nothing. One line where every reason is the same; each labeled where they differ.
+  *
+  * Two or more labeled reasons are a list, one to a line (from 2026-10-20, brief 16, section 8). Until then they ran on in
+  * one paragraph, and a piece's six steps under Coursework read as six sentences in a row: "Read The Scene: You’re at
+  * Classes until 3:00 PM. Learn Lines: Read the scene first: …". The words of each are unchanged.
+  */
+ export function WhyNot({ reasons }: { reasons: readonly (readonly [label: string, why: string | undefined])[] }) {
+   const shut = reasons.filter((r): r is readonly [string, string] => Boolean(r[1]));
+   if (!shut.length) return null;
+   const distinct = [...new Set(shut.map(([, why]) => why))];
+   const all = shut.length === reasons.length;
+   if (distinct.length === 1 && all) return <p className="xs dim why-not" style={{ margin: 0 }}>{`Not now: ${distinct[0]}`}</p>;
+   if (shut.length === 1) return <p className="xs dim why-not" style={{ margin: 0 }}>{`${shut[0]![0]}: ${shut[0]![1]}`}</p>;
+   return (
+     <ul className="xs dim why-not" style={{ margin: 0, paddingLeft: '1.1rem' }}>
+       {shut.map(([label, why], i) => <li key={`${i}:${label}`}>{`${label}: ${why}`}</li>)}
+     </ul>
+   );
+ }
+
+ export function Fine({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
+   return (
+     <details className="fine">
+       <summary className="xs dim">Sources And Estimates</summary>
+       <p className="xs dim" style={{ margin: 'var(--s2) 0 0' }}>{children}</p>
+     </details>
+   );
+ }
+
+ export function Panel({
+   title, subtitle, actions, children, flush, tight, look, help,
+ }: {
+   title?: ReactNode;
+   subtitle?: ReactNode;
+   actions?: ReactNode;
+   children: ReactNode;
+   flush?: boolean;
+   tight?: boolean;
+   /**
+    * What the panel is about. A heading is the world's word for what is under
+    * it — "Weather", "The Land", "Standing" — so given a subject it becomes
+    * the way into it, and the panel hosts its own region so the look opens
+    * beneath the whole panel rather than inside one of its rows.
+    */
+   look?: Subject;
+   /**
+    * The guide's entry for what the panel holds (from 2026-10-12; `content/guide/`), by its id or a feature it covers:
+    * How This Works in the panel's head opens it over the screen.
+    */
+   help?: string;
+ }) {
+   const head = (title || actions || help) && (
+     <div className="panel-head" style={flush ? { padding: 'var(--s4) var(--s4) 0' } : undefined}>
+       <div>
+         {title && <h2>{look ? <Open subject={look}>{title}</Open> : title}</h2>}
+         {subtitle && <p className="muted small" style={{ margin: 0 }}>{subtitle}</p>}
+       </div>
+       {(actions || help) && <div className="row gap-2 panel-actions">{actions}{help && <HowItWorks help={help} />}</div>}
+     </div>
+   );
+   return (
+     <section className={`card${flush ? ' card-flush' : ''}${tight ? ' card-tight' : ''}`}>
+       {look
+         ? <LookRegion className="panel-body">{head}{children}</LookRegion>
+         : <>{head}{children}</>}
+     </section>
+   );
+ }
+
+ export function Stat({
+   label, value, note, tone, look,
+ }: {
+   label: string;
+   value: ReactNode;
+   note?: ReactNode;
+   tone?: 'positive' | 'negative' | 'warning';
+   /**
+    * The thing this figure is about. Given one, the label becomes the way in —
+    * the name is the control, so there is no button to add beside it.
+    */
+   look?: Subject;
+ }) {
+   // The whole tile is one control, not three. A player's hand goes to the
+   // figure as readily as to the word above it, and a number that does nothing
+   // under a word that does something is the exact inconsistency depth exists
+   // to remove. The label keeps the underline, so there is still one clear
+   // affordance rather than three.
+   const inner = (
+     <>
+       <span className="stat-label">{label}</span>
+       <span className={`stat-value${tone ? ` ${tone}` : ''}`}>{value}</span>
+       {note && <span className="stat-note">{note}</span>}
+     </>
+   );
+   return (
+     <div className="stat">
+       {look ? <Open subject={look}>{inner}</Open> : inner}
+     </div>
+   );
+ }
+
+ /**
+  * A meter always shows its number. Color alone is never the signal, because
+  * color alone is not accessible.
+  */
+ export function Meter({
+   label, value, max = 100, tone, hint, invert, look, line,
+ }: {
+   label: string;
+   value: number;
+   max?: number;
+   tone?: 'positive' | 'negative' | 'warning';
+   hint?: string;
+   invert?: boolean;
+   /** The dial this bar is drawing. Its label becomes the way in. */
+   look?: Subject;
+   /**
+    * Where the engine starts to charge for it, on the value's own scale: red past
+    * it, and amber the fifteen before. Without one, the bar's own quarters.
+    * Until 2026-09-27 every bar turned at its own lines, energy red at 25 where
+    * running on empty starts at 15 and stress at 70 where it costs at 75.
+    */
+   line?: number;
+ }) {
+   const pct = clamp((value / max) * 100, 0, 100);
+   const derived = tone ?? (line !== undefined
+     ? (invert
+       ? (value > line ? 'negative' : value > line - 15 ? 'warning' : 'positive')
+       : (value < line ? 'negative' : value < line + 15 ? 'warning' : 'positive'))
+     : invert
+       ? (pct > 70 ? 'negative' : pct > 40 ? 'warning' : 'positive')
+       : (pct < 25 ? 'negative' : pct < 50 ? 'warning' : 'positive'));
+   return (
+     <div>
+       <div className="row-between xs" style={{ marginBottom: 3 }}>
+         <span className="muted">{look ? <Open subject={look}>{label}</Open> : label}</span>
+         <span className="mono">
+           {look
+             ? <Open subject={look}>{Math.round(value)}{max === 100 ? '' : ` / ${max}`}</Open>
+             : <>{Math.round(value)}{max === 100 ? '' : ` / ${max}`}</>}
+         </span>
+       </div>
+       <div
+         className={`meter meter-${derived}`}
+         role="meter"
+         aria-valuenow={Math.round(value)}
+         aria-valuemin={0}
+         aria-valuemax={max}
+         aria-label={label}
+       >
+         <span style={{ width: `${pct}%` }} />
+       </div>
+       {hint && <div className="xs dim" style={{ marginTop: 2 }}>{hint}</div>}
+     </div>
+   );
+ }
+
+ export function MoneyText({ amount, currency, compact, signed }: { amount: Money; currency: string; compact?: boolean; signed?: boolean }) {
+   const text = compact ? formatMoneyCompact(amount, currency) : formatMoney(amount, currency);
+   const cls = amount > 0 ? 'positive' : amount < 0 ? 'negative' : 'muted';
+   return (
+     <span className={`mono ${signed ? cls : ''}`}>
+       {signed && amount > 0 ? '+' : ''}{text}
+     </span>
+   );
+ }
+
+ export function Empty({ title, body, action }: { title: string; body: string; action?: ReactNode }) {
+   return (
+     <div className="empty">
+       <h3>{title}</h3>
+       <p className="small" style={{ maxWidth: 420, margin: '0 auto var(--s4)' }}>{body}</p>
+       {action}
+     </div>
+   );
+ }
+
+ /** The dialogs open, oldest first: only the one on top answers Escape and keeps focus. */
+ const OPEN_DIALOGS: number[] = [];
+ let dialogCount = 0;
+ const FOCUSABLE = 'a[href], button:not([disabled]), input:not([disabled]), select:not([disabled]), textarea:not([disabled]), [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])';
+
+ /** Whether any dialog is open: the keyboard's shortcuts don't act behind one. */
+ export const dialogOpen = (): boolean => OPEN_DIALOGS.length > 0;
+
+ /**
+  * A dialog over the screen, which stays mounted under it with whatever was typed there.
+  *
+  * From 2026-10-12 it takes focus when it opens (its `data-autofocus` element, else its first control), keeps Tab and
+  * Shift-Tab inside it, and gives focus back to whatever opened it when it closes; Escape closes only the dialog on top,
+  * where until then one Escape closed every dialog stacked open, a plan's form under the guide with it. `keepOnOutside`
+  * keeps it open when the shade outside it is pressed, for a dialog with a form a stray press would lose.
+  */
+ export function Modal({
+   title, children, footer, onClose, wide, keepOnOutside,
+ }: {
+   title: string;
+   children: ReactNode;
+   footer?: ReactNode;
+   onClose: () => void;
+   wide?: boolean;
+   keepOnOutside?: boolean;
+ }) {
+   const box = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
+   const id = useMemo(() => ++dialogCount, []);
+   const close = useRef(onClose);
+   close.current = onClose;
+   // Escape closes it, the way every dialog on every platform closes. Without
+   // this a modal could only be left by finding its button, and anything
+   // underneath it stayed unreachable until then.
+   useEffect(() => {
+     const opener = document.activeElement instanceof HTMLElement ? document.activeElement : null;
+     OPEN_DIALOGS.push(id);
+     const node = box.current;
+     const first = node?.querySelector<HTMLElement>('[data-autofocus]') ?? node?.querySelector<HTMLElement>(FOCUSABLE);
+     (first ?? node)?.focus();
+     const onKey = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
+       if (OPEN_DIALOGS[OPEN_DIALOGS.length - 1] !== id) return;
+       if (event.key === 'Escape') { event.stopPropagation(); close.current(); return; }
+       if (event.key !== 'Tab' || !node) return;
+       const items = [...node.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(FOCUSABLE)].filter((x) => x.offsetParent !== null || x === document.activeElement);
+       if (!items.length) { event.preventDefault(); node.focus(); return; }
+       const [head, tail] = [items[0]!, items[items.length - 1]!];
+       if (event.shiftKey && (document.activeElement === head || document.activeElement === node)) { event.preventDefault(); tail.focus(); }
+       else if (!event.shiftKey && document.activeElement === tail) { event.preventDefault(); head.focus(); }
+     };
+     window.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
+     return () => {
+       window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
+       OPEN_DIALOGS.splice(OPEN_DIALOGS.indexOf(id), 1);
+       if (opener && document.contains(opener)) opener.focus();
+     };
+   }, [id]);
+   return (
+     <div className="overlay" onClick={keepOnOutside ? undefined : onClose}>
+       <div
+         ref={box}
+         tabIndex={-1}
+         className="modal"
+         style={wide ? { width: 'min(880px, 100%)' } : undefined}
+         onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
+         role="dialog"
+         aria-modal="true"
+         aria-label={title}
+       >
+         <div className="modal-head">
+           <div className="row-between">
+             <h2>{title}</h2>
+             <button className="btn btn-ghost btn-sm" onClick={onClose} aria-label="Close">✕</button>
+           </div>
+         </div>
+         <div className="modal-body">{children}</div>
+         {footer && <div className="modal-foot">{footer}</div>}
+       </div>
+     </div>
+   );
+ }
+
+ export function Term({ children, explain }: { children: ReactNode; explain: string }) {
+   return <span className="tooltip-term" title={explain}>{children}</span>;
+ }
