+       if (ahead) {
+         const unit = ahead.fahrenheit ? '°F' : '°C';
+         ways.push({
+           to: at('forecastday', `${city.id}/${ahead.dateKey}`),
+           label: 'The Sky',
+           detail: `${ahead.condition}, ${ahead.low}${unit} to ${ahead.high}${unit}`,
+         });
+       }
+     }
+
+     for (const step of [-1, 1]) {
+       const near = offset + step;
+       if (Math.abs(near) > REACH) continue;
+       const other = dayAt(sim, dateKey(addDays(day.start, step, zone), zone));
+       if (!other) continue;
+       ways.push({
+         to: at('day', other.key),
+         label: dayName(other.parts),
+         detail: step < 0
+           ? `One day back, and ${loadOf(other, 'before')}`
+           : `One day on, and ${loadOf(other, 'after')}`,
+       });
+     }
+
+     return {
+       name: dayName(day.parts),
+       kind: dayKindOf(offset),
+       // A day falls on a city whether or not the tax tables can reach it, so
+       // the parent is declared only where it would open.
+       parent: placeOpens(city) ? at('place', city.id) : undefined,
+       summary: daySentence(day, sim, keptHere),
+       body: (
+         <>
+           <p className="small muted">
+             {lightSentence(day)}{' '}
+             {offset === 0
+               ? `${day.season} here ${quarterSentence(day, false)}.`
+               : `${offset < 0 ? 'That was' : 'That’s'} ${day.season.toLowerCase()} in ${city.name}, and the season ${quarterSentence(day, offset < 0)} then.`}
+           </p>
+           <p className="small muted">
+             {entries.length === 0
+               ? offset < 0
+                 ? 'You had nothing booked on it.'
+                 : 'You have nothing booked on it yet.'
+               : `${entries.length === 1 ? 'There’s' : 'There are'} ${count(entries.length, 'thing')} on it: ${spokenList(entries.map((e) => asName(e.title)))}.`}
+             {/* Every one of them said as that (from 2026-10-20, brief 17): until then "There’s one thing on it: Classes.
+                 You need to be at one of them.", and "three of them" of three. */}
+             {wants.length > 0 && ` You need to be at ${wants.length < entries.length ? count(wants.length, 'of them', 'of them') : entries.length === 1 ? 'it' : entries.length === 2 ? 'both' : 'all of them'}.`}
+             {clashes.length > 0 && ` ${toStart(count(clashes.length, 'of them', 'of them'))} ${clashes.length === 1 ? 'clashes with something else' : 'clash'}.`}
+             {keptHere.length > 0 && ` ${spokenList(keptHere)} ${isAre(keptHere.length)} kept in ${country} that day.`}
+           </p>
+           {sim.zone !== zone && (
+             <p className="small muted">
+               The time where you are is {zoneAbbreviation(sim.now, sim.zone)}, and the calendar’s days still
+               follow {zoneAbbreviation(sim.now, zone)}, the time where you live.
+             </p>
+           )}
+           <div className="grid grid-3">
+             <Stat
+               label="Sunrise"
+               value={day.sun.polar ? 'None' : formatTime(day.sun.sunrise ?? 0, city.timeZone)}
+               note={day.sun.polar === 'day' ? 'It never gets dark' : day.sun.polar === 'night' ? 'It stays below the horizon' : 'Local time'}
+             />
+             <Stat
+               label="Sunset"
+               value={day.sun.polar ? 'None' : formatTime(day.sun.sunset ?? 0, city.timeZone)}
+               note={day.sun.polar ? 'The sun doesn’t cross the horizon' : 'Local time'}
+             />
+             <Stat
+               label="Daylight"
+               value={day.sun.polar === 'day' ? 'All Of It' : day.sun.polar === 'night' ? 'None Of It' : formatDaylight(day.sun.daylightMinutes)}
+               note={`${day.season} here`}
+               look={at('daylight', city.id)}
+             />
+             <Stat
+               label="On The Calendar"
+               value={entries.length}
+               note={entries.length > 0
+                 ? 'Plans and commitments'
+                 : holidays.length > 0 ? 'No plans, and a holiday' : 'No plans'}
+             />
+             <Stat
+               label="Commitments"
+               value={wants.length}
+               note={wants.length === 0 ? 'None of it needs you' : 'You need to be at these'}
+               tone={clashes.length > 0 ? 'negative' : undefined}
+             />
+             <Stat label="Where" value={city.name} note={zoneAbbreviation(day.start, city.timeZone)} look={placeOpens(city) ? at('place', city.id) : undefined} />
+           </div>
+         </>
+       ),
+       facets: observed.length > 0
+         ? [{
+           id: 'observed',
+           label: 'What’s Kept That Day',
+           body: (
+             <>
+               {byCountry.map(({ name, kept }) => (
+                 <p key={name} className="small">
+                   {`${name} keeps ${spokenList(kept.map(holidayLabel))} on it.`}
+                 </p>
+               ))}
+               <p className="small muted">
+                 {holidays.some((h) => h.type === 'public')
+                   ? 'Public ones close offices and banks in the places that keep them.'
+                   : holidays.some((h) => h.type === 'bank' || h.type === 'school')
+                     ? 'None of them is a public holiday, though the banks or the schools shut for one.'
+                     : 'None of them is a day off: they’re marked, not taken.'}
+                 {regional > 0
+                   ? ` ${count(regional, 'of them', 'of them')} ${isAre(regional)} kept here and not in the rest of ${country}.`
+                   : ''}
+               </p>
+             </>
+           ),
+         }]
+         : undefined,
+       ways,
+       provenance: 'Sunrise and sunset are calculated from the date and this latitude, not looked up. The holidays and observances are the ones kept where you are.',
+     };
+   },
+ });
+
+ /**
+  * What a day is carrying, in the half-line a way in gets. An empty day either
+  * side of this one is the common case, and the two lines sit one above the
+  * other, so an empty day says it in the tense it belongs to.
+  */
+ function loadOf(day: TheDay, when: 'before' | 'after' | 'around' = 'around'): string {
+   const empty = when === 'before'
+     ? 'nothing was booked on it'
+     : when === 'after' ? 'nothing on it yet' : 'nothing booked on it at all';
+   if (day.holidays.length > 0 && day.entries.length === 0) {
+     return `${empty}, and ${day.holidays[0]?.englishName ?? day.holidays[0]?.name} kept on it`;
+   }
+   const first = day.entries[0];
+   return first
+     ? `${count(day.entries.length, 'thing')} on it, starting with ${asName(first.title)}`
+     : empty;
+ }
+
+ /** The one sentence a day leads with. */
+ function daySentence(day: TheDay, sim: Simulation, keptHere: string[]): string {
+   const { city, entries, offset } = day;
+   const past = offset < 0;
+   // What is booked outranks what is kept: a commitment is the thing you act on.
+   const tail = entries.length > 0
+     ? `with ${count(entries.length, 'thing')} on the calendar`
+     : keptHere.length > 0
+       ? `and it’s ${spokenList(keptHere)} here`
+       : offset === 0
+         ? 'and the day is entirely yours'
+         : past ? 'and nothing was on it' : 'and nothing is on it yet';
+
+   // The clock is the city’s; the date is the calendar’s, which is cut by the
+   // zone the player keeps house in. Where those two disagree the sentence says
+   // so, because "7:30 AM in Los Angeles" was eight hours wrong the moment
+   // anybody traveled.
+   if (offset === 0) {
+     const local = formatTime(sim.now, city.timeZone);
+     return city.timeZone === day.zone
+       ? `It’s ${local} in ${city.name} on ${dayName(day.parts)}, ${tail}.`
+       : `It’s ${local} in ${city.name}, and ${dayName(day.parts)} back home, ${tail}.`;
+   }
+   if (offset === 1) return `Tomorrow’s ${dayName(day.parts)}, ${tail}.`;
+   if (offset === -1) return `Yesterday was ${dayName(day.parts)}, ${tail}.`;
+
+   const away = Math.abs(offset);
+   return past
+     ? `You’re looking back at ${dayName(day.parts)}, ${count(away, 'day')} ago, ${tail}.`
+     : `You’re looking at ${dayName(day.parts)}, ${count(away, 'day')} out, ${tail}.`;
+ }
+
+ /** What the light does on a day, said the way a person standing in it would. */
+ function lightSentence(day: TheDay): string {
+   const { sun, city } = day;
+   if (sun.polar === 'day') return 'The sun stays up all day and all night.';
+   if (sun.polar === 'night') return 'The sun stays below the horizon all day.';
+   return `Daylight from ${formatTime(sun.sunrise ?? 0, city.timeZone)} to ${formatTime(sun.sunset ?? 0, city.timeZone)}: ${formatDaylight(sun.daylightMinutes)}.`;
+ }
+
+ /** The same, compressed into the line a way into the light carries. */
+ function lightDetail(day: TheDay): string {
+   if (day.sun.polar === 'day') return 'The sun never sets on it here';
+   if (day.sun.polar === 'night') return 'The sun doesn’t rise on it here';
+   return `${formatTime(day.sun.sunrise ?? 0, day.city.timeZone)} to ${formatTime(day.sun.sunset ?? 0, day.city.timeZone)}, ${formatDaylight(day.sun.daylightMinutes)} of daylight`;
+ }
+
+ /** Where the day sits inside its season, without ever printing a fraction. */
+ function quarterSentence(day: TheDay, past: boolean): string {
+   const months = monthsOfSeason(day.city, day.season, day.parts.year);
+   const place = months.indexOf(day.parts.month);
+   if (place === 0) return past ? 'had only just started' : 'has only just started';
+   if (place === months.length - 1) return past ? 'was nearly over' : 'is nearly over';
+   return past ? 'was at its middle' : 'is at its middle';
+ }
+
+ // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+ // One thing on the calendar
+ // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+ interface TheEntry {
+   entry: CalendarEntry;
+   day: TheDay | undefined;
+   /** Commitments that want the player inside the same window. */
+   clashes: CalendarEntry[];
+   /** The next thing after it on the same day. */
+   next: CalendarEntry | undefined;
+   /** Where the player is standing, when that is not where this is. */
+   elsewhere: City | undefined;
+ }
+
+ defineLook<TheEntry>('entry', {
+   gone: 'That’s off the calendar now. Whatever it was, it isn’t waiting on you.',
+   resolve: (sim, id) => {
+     const item = sim.timeline.get(id);
+     if (!item) return undefined;
+
+     const zone = sim.homeZone;
+     const start = startOfDay(item.at, zone);
+     const dayEnd = startOfNextDay(start, zone);
+     const around = entriesBetween(sim, start - MS_DAY, dayEnd + MS_DAY);
+     const entry = around.find((e) => e.id === id);
+     if (!entry) return undefined;
+
+     const end = endOf(entry);
+     const clashes = entry.requiresPlayer && entry.status === 'pending'
+       ? around.filter((other) => other.id !== entry.id
+         && other.requiresPlayer && other.status === 'pending'
+         && other.at < end && endOf(other) > entry.at)
+       : [];
+
+     // Where the next date begins, as for the Day look: a day added to the
+     // start of the day of a jump reached into the next day’s first hour, and
+     // "next thing that day" offered something from the day after.
+     const next = around.find((other) => other.id !== entry.id
+       && other.at >= entry.at && other.at < dayEnd
+       && !clashes.some((c) => c.id === other.id));
+
+     const here = standingIn(sim);
+     const wanted = cityOf(entry);
+     const elsewhere = wanted && here && wanted.id !== here.id ? here : undefined;
+
+     return { entry, day: dayAt(sim, dateKey(entry.at, zone)), clashes, next, elsewhere };
+   },
+   seeds: (sim) => upcoming(sim, 8).map((entry) => entry.id),
+   look: (found, { sim }) => {
+     const { entry, clashes, next, elsewhere } = found;
+     const zone = sim.homeZone;
+     const legend = LEGEND_BY_CATEGORY[entry.category];
+     const city = cityOf(entry);
+     const clock = clockOf(entry, zone);
+     const length = lengthOf(entry);
+     const parts = zonedParts(entry.at, zone);
+
+     const ways: Way[] = clashes.map((other) => ({
+       to: at('entry', other.id),
+       label: asName(other.title),
+       detail: `It clashes with this one, at ${formatTime(other.at, clockOf(other, zone))}, and you need to be at both`,
+     }));
+
+     // The hours it actually takes, and the sky over them. A commitment is a
+     // window, not an instant, and the window is a thing you can look at.
+     if (length) {
+       ways.push({
+         to: at('stretch', entry.id),
+         label: `${formatTime(entry.at, clock)} To ${formatTime(endOf(entry), clock)}`,
+         detail: 'Its hours, and the weather across them',
+       });
+     }
+     // Everything else you decided to do, where this is one of them.
+     if (sim.timeline.get(entry.id)?.kind === PLAN_KIND) {
+       ways.push({
+         to: at('plans'),
+         label: 'Your Own Plans',
+         detail: 'Everything else you’ve put on the calendar yourself',
+       });
+     }
+
+     if (city && placeOpens(city)) {
+       ways.push({
+         to: at('place', city.id),
+         label: city.name,
+         detail: elsewhere
+           ? `Where it is. You’re in ${elsewhere.name}`
+           : 'Where it is, and you’re already there',
+       });
+     }
+     if (next) {
+       ways.push({
+         to: at('entry', next.id),
+         label: asName(next.title),
+         detail: `Next thing that day: ${entryDetail(next, zone)}`,
+       });
+     }
+     if (found.day) {
+       ways.push({
+         to: at('day', found.day.key),
+         label: dayName(found.day.parts),
+         detail: `The day it’s on: ${loadOf(found.day)}`,
+       });
+     }
+
+     return {
+       name: asName(entry.title),
+       kind: entry.status === 'observance'
+         ? 'An Observance'
+         : entry.requiresPlayer ? 'A Commitment' : 'Happens Without You',
+       // The day it sits in, and where that cannot be read, the city it names —
+       // never `at('place', '')`, which resolves to wherever the player happens
+       // to be standing and would hang the thing beneath a town it is not in.
+       parent: found.day ? at('day', found.day.key)
+         : city && placeOpens(city) ? at('place', city.id) : undefined,
+       summary: entrySentence(found, sim),
+       body: (
+         <>
+           <p className="small">
+             {entry.status === 'observance'
+               ? 'An observance. It’s on the calendar so you know, and there’s nothing for you to do about it.'
+               : entry.requiresPlayer
+                 ? `You need to be there, awake${city ? ` and in ${city.name}` : ''}, when the clock reaches it. If you aren’t, it’s missed${missCost(sim, entry.id)}.`
+                 : 'It happens on its own when the clock reaches it, without you needing to be there.'}
+             {length && ` It runs ${length}, ${formatTime(entry.at, clock)} to ${formatTime(endOf(entry), clock)}.`}
+           </p>
+           {/* Until 2026-10-12 an entry somewhere else said "a job’s travel takes you there on its own, and anything
+               else needs you to be there by then". There’s been no job since 2026-10-09, and nothing writes where the
+               player is after a life begins (`world/bootstrap.ts`), so one that wants them and hasn’t come round says
+               it’ll be missed, as its handler has it (from 2026-10-12). */}
+           <p className="small muted">
+             {city
+               ? elsewhere
+                 ? <>It’s in <Open subject={at('place', city.id)}>{city.name}</Open> and you’re in {elsewhere.name}{entry.requiresPlayer && entry.status === 'pending' ? ', and nothing takes you there, so it’ll be missed' : ''}.</>
+                 : <>It’s in <Open subject={at('place', city.id)}>{city.name}</Open>, where you already are.</>
+               : 'It isn’t tied to a city, so wherever you are is fine.'}
+             {clashes.length > 0
+               ? ` ${spokenList(clashes.map((c) => asName(c.title)))} ${isAre(clashes.length)} at the same time, and you need to be at ${clashes.length === 1 ? 'both' : 'all of them'}.`
+               : entry.requiresPlayer && entry.status === 'pending'
+                 ? ' It doesn’t clash with anything else.'
+                 : ''}
+           </p>
+           <div className="grid grid-2">
+             <Stat
+               label="When"
+               value={formatTime(entry.at, clock)}
+               note={clock === zone ? formatDate(entry.at, zone) : `${formatDate(entry.at, clock)}, ${zoneAbbreviation(entry.at, clock)}`}
+             />
+             <Stat label="Length" value={length ?? 'As Long As It Takes'} note={length ? `Ends ${formatTime(endOf(entry), clock)}` : 'No end time on it'} />
+             <Stat
+               label="Kind"
+               value={legend?.label ?? titleCaseLabel(entry.category)}
+               note={city?.name}
+               look={city && placeOpens(city) ? at('place', city.id) : undefined}
+             />
+             <Stat
+               label="Status"
+               value={statusWord(entry)}
+               tone={entry.status === 'missed' || entry.status === 'cancelled' ? 'negative'
+                 : entry.status === 'done' ? 'positive' : undefined}
+               note={`${WEEKDAY_NAMES[parts.weekday]}, ${spokenWhen(entry.at, sim, zone)}`}
+             />
+             {entry.bookedAt !== undefined && (
+               <Stat label="Booked" value={formatDate(entry.bookedAt, zone)} note={formatTime(entry.bookedAt, zone)} />
+             )}
+             {entry.settledAt !== undefined && entry.status !== 'pending' && (
+               <Stat label={entry.status === 'cancelled' ? 'Called Off' : entry.status === 'missed' ? 'Missed' : 'Done'} value={formatDate(entry.settledAt, zone)} note={formatTime(entry.settledAt, zone)} />
+             )}
+           </div>
+         </>
+       ),
+       ways,
+       provenance: 'The calendar flags anything you need to be at that overlaps something else, before you get to it.',
+     };
+   },
+ });
+
+ /** The one sentence an entry leads with. */
+ function entrySentence(found: TheEntry, sim: Simulation): string {
+   const { entry, clashes, elsewhere } = found;
+   const zone = sim.homeZone;
+   const when = spokenWhen(entry.at, sim, zone);
+   const city = cityOf(entry);
+   // Local to the thing, not to the ledger: see `clockOf`.
+   const time = formatTime(entry.at, clockOf(entry, zone));
+
+   // Counted off the clock rather than off `found.day`, which is undefined
+   // wherever the player is standing nowhere the gazetteer knows — and a day
+   // that cannot be read is no reason to tell somebody a thing is tomorrow.
+   const offset = daysBetween(sim.now, entry.at, zone);
+
+   // "in three hours, at 10:30 AM" for today; "at 4:00 PM on Saturday, in six
+   // weeks" for anything further off, and never the same word twice.
+   const lead = offset === 0 ? `${when}, at ${time}`
+     : Math.abs(offset) === 1 ? `at ${time} ${when}`
+       : `at ${time} on ${WEEKDAY_NAMES[zonedParts(entry.at, zone).weekday]}, ${when}`;
+
+   if (entry.status === 'observance') {
+     return `That’s ${when}. It’s an observance, on the calendar so you know, and there’s nothing for you to do about it.`;
+   }
+   if (entry.status !== 'pending') {
+     return `That was ${lead}, and it’s marked ${statusWord(entry).toLowerCase()}.`;
+   }
+   if (clashes.length > 0) {
+     return `You need to be at it ${lead}, and at ${asName(clashes[0]?.title ?? 'something else')} too.`;
+   }
+   if (elsewhere && city) {
+     return `It’s in ${city.name} ${lead}, and you’re in ${elsewhere.name}.`;
+   }
+   if (entry.requiresPlayer) {
+     return `You need to be at it ${lead}${city ? `, in ${city.name}` : ''}.`;
+   }
+   return `It happens ${lead}, without you needing to be there.`;
+ }
+
+ // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+ // The season the day sits in
+ // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+ interface TheSeason {
+   city: City;
+   season: Season;
+   /** The months it runs here, in order, 1-12. */
+   months: number[];
+   now: Season;
+   /** Midday at the middle of it. */
+   middle: Instant;
+   sun: SunTimes;
+ }
+
+ /** The months a season covers in a place, asked of the engine rather than tabled. */
+ function monthsOfSeason(city: City, season: Season, year: number): number[] {
+   const found: number[] = [];
+   for (let month = 1; month <= 12; month++) {
+     const mid = instantFromZoned({ year, month, day: 15, hour: 12 }, city.timeZone);
+     if (seasonOf(mid, city.timeZone, city.latitude) === season) found.push(month);
+   }
+   if (found.length === 0) return found;
+   // December, January, February reads in that order, not January, February, December.
+   const head = found.find((m) => !found.includes(m === 1 ? 12 : m - 1)) ?? found[0]!;
+   const start = found.indexOf(head);
+   return [...found.slice(start), ...found.slice(0, start)];
+ }
+
+ /** `cityId/Season`, so a season belongs to a place rather than to the year. */
+ function splitSeasonId(id: string): { cityId: string; season: Season } | undefined {
+   const cut = id.lastIndexOf('/');
+   if (cut <= 0) return undefined;
+   const season = id.slice(cut + 1) as Season;
+   if (!SEASONS.includes(season)) return undefined;
+   return { cityId: id.slice(0, cut), season };
+ }
+
+ defineLook<TheSeason>('season', {
+   gone: 'There’s no season by that name where you are.',
+   resolve: (sim, id) => {
+     const split = splitSeasonId(id);
+     if (!split) return undefined;
+     const city = CITIES.get(split.cityId);
+     if (!city) return undefined;
+
+     const year = zonedParts(sim.now, city.timeZone).year;
+     const months = monthsOfSeason(city, split.season, year);
+     if (months.length === 0) return undefined;
+
+     const middleMonth = months[Math.floor(months.length / 2)] ?? months[0]!;
+     const middle = instantFromZoned({ year, month: middleMonth, day: 15, hour: 12 }, city.timeZone);
+     return {
+       city,
+       season: split.season,
+       months,
+       now: seasonOf(sim.now, city.timeZone, city.latitude),
+       middle,
+       sun: sunTimes(middle, city.latitude, city.longitude, city.timeZone),
+     };
+   },
+   seeds: (sim) => {
+     const city = standingIn(sim);
+     if (!city) return [];
+     return SEASONS.map((season) => `${city.id}/${season}`);
+   },
+   look: (season, { sim }) => {
+     const { city, months, sun } = season;
+     const isNow = season.now === season.season;
+     const names = months.map((m) => MONTH_NAMES[m - 1] ?? '');
+     const middleMonth = months[Math.floor(months.length / 2)] ?? months[0]!;
+     const normal = normalFor(city, middleMonth, 15);
+     const warm = usesFahrenheit(city.countryId);
+     const unit = warm ? '°F' : '°C';
+     const high = warm ? toFahrenheit(normal.high) : Math.round(normal.high);
+     const low = warm ? toFahrenheit(normal.low) : Math.round(normal.low);
+     const wet = Math.round(normal.wetChance * 100);
+     const south = city.latitude < 0;
+     const after = SEASONS[(SEASONS.indexOf(season.season) + 1) % SEASONS.length]!;
+
+     const ways: Way[] = [
+       {
+         to: at('season', `${city.id}/${after}`),
+         label: after,
+         detail: `What comes after it here: ${spokenList(monthsOfSeason(city, after, zonedParts(sim.now, city.timeZone).year).map((m) => MONTH_NAMES[m - 1] ?? ''))}`,
+       },
+       {
+         to: at('daylight', city.id),
+         label: 'Daylight',
+         detail: `Today’s daylight in ${city.name}, and whether the days are getting longer`,
+       },
+     ];
+
+     return {
+       name: season.season,
+       kind: 'Season',
+       parent: placeOpens(city) ? at('place', city.id) : undefined,
+       summary: isNow
+         ? `It’s ${season.season.toLowerCase()} in ${city.name}. Here it runs through ${spokenList(names)}.`
+         : `${season.season} in ${city.name} runs through ${spokenList(names)}. It’s ${count(monthsUntil(season, sim), 'month')} away.`,
+       body: (
+         <>
+           <p className="small muted">
+             {city.name} is at {Math.abs(Math.round(city.latitude))}° {south ? 'south' : 'north'},{' '}
+             {south
+               ? `so its seasons run the other way round from the northern half of the world’s: ${season.season.toLowerCase()} is ${spokenList(names)} here.`
+               : `so ${season.season.toLowerCase()} is ${spokenList(names)}, as in the rest of the northern half of the world.`}
+           </p>
+           <p className="small muted">
+             In the middle of it, a day here usually reaches {high}{unit} and falls to {low}{unit},
+             with {sun.polar === 'day' ? 'the sun never setting' : sun.polar === 'night' ? 'the sun never rising' : `${formatDaylight(sun.daylightMinutes)} of daylight`}.
+             {' '}About {spokenNumber(wet)} days in a hundred are wet.
+           </p>
+           <div className="grid grid-3">
+             <Stat label="Runs" value={`${names[0]} To ${names[names.length - 1]}`} note={`${plural(months.length, 'month')} of the year`} />
+             <Stat label="Typical High" value={`${high}${unit}`} note="At the middle of it" />
+             <Stat label="Typical Low" value={`${low}${unit}`} note="Overnight, at the middle of it" />
+             <Stat
+               label="Light Then"
+               value={sun.polar === 'day' ? 'All Of It' : sun.polar === 'night' ? 'None Of It' : formatDaylight(sun.daylightMinutes)}
+               note="On the middle day of it"
+             />
+             <Stat label="Wet Days" value={`${wet}%`} note="Of the days in it" />
+             <Stat label="Where" value={city.name} note={isNow ? 'The season you’re in now' : 'Not the season you’re in'} look={placeOpens(city) ? at('place', city.id) : undefined} />
+           </div>
+         </>
+       ),
+       ways,
+       provenance: 'Estimated from a climate model for this latitude and this kind of place: what the date usually brings here, not a forecast.',
+     };
+   },
+ });
+
+ /**
+  * How many months until a season starts here, counted forward only.
+  *
+  * The short way round the year was wrong in a way that read as fact: in March
+  * the nearest Winter month is last February, and "one month off Winter" is a
+  * sentence about a winter that has already been. Seasons that are not this
+  * one are ahead of you, so they are counted ahead.
+  */
+ function monthsUntil(season: TheSeason, sim: Simulation): number {
+   const month = zonedParts(sim.now, season.city.timeZone).month;
+   const first = season.months[0] ?? month;
+   // A season starting this month is the season you are in, and never lands here.
+   return (first - month + 12) % 12 || 12;
+ }
+
+ /**
+  * SLATE — depth, assembled.
+  *
+  * Importing this registers every kind the game knows how to open. A screen
+  * imports `Open`, `LookRegion` and `at` from here and nothing else; it never
+  * imports a declaration, because a screen never writes what is inside a thing.
+  *
+  * The registrations live in ./all, one line per kind, so the whole graph can
+  * be loaded by a test without loading React alongside it.
+  */
+
+ import './all';
+
+ export { LookRegion, Open } from './Look';
+ export { at, subjectKey, parseSubject, subjectForRef, sameSubject, type Subject } from './subject';
+ export {
+   defineLook, lookKinds, lookExists, resolveLook, trailTo, hasKind, seedsFor,
+   type Looked, type LookView, type Way, type Facet,
+ } from './registry';
+
+ /**
+  * SLATE — the money, and what it comes to.
+  *
+  * Home prints four money facts and every one of them is a dead end: the name
+  * of the account you spend from, the balance in it, a net worth, and what is
+  * owed. None of them is a made-up figure. A balance is the sum of its postings
+  * (`core/ledger.ts`), net worth is recomputed from the ledger every time it
+  * is asked for (`systems/finance.ts`), and neither is stored
+  * anywhere a screen could get them wrong.
+  *
+  * Three kinds live here. An `account` is a thing — a real account at a real
+  * institution, with a balance, a last four and, where it is a card, a limit
+  * and a rate. That is a floor a chain is allowed to end on. `networth` is a
+  * figure rather than a thing, and it is treated the way readiness is: it opens
+  * into a sentence about what makes it up and ways into the accounts actually
+  * making it, because an account is a thing and a subtraction is not. `debt` is
+  * the same again for the other side of the sheet.
+  *
+  * That the ledger is double-entry and audits clean is worth one line at the
+  * foot of net worth. It is not worth a lecture, and it is never a level.
+  */
+
+ import { formatMoney, saveCurrency, type Money } from '@/engine/core/money';
+ import { Ledger, isLiability, type Account, type AccountKind } from '@/engine/core/ledger';
+ import { MS_DAY, formatDate } from '@/engine/core/time';
+ import { titleCaseLabel } from '@/engine/core/text';
+ import { netWorth, type Worth } from '@/engine/systems/finance';
+ import type { Person } from '@/engine/domain/model';
+ import type { Simulation } from '@/engine';
+ import { Stat } from '@/ui/components/primitives';
+ import { defineLook, type Way } from './registry';
+ import { at } from './subject';
+ import { isAre, spokenList } from './words';
+ import { cardTerms, stateOf } from '@/engine/systems/credit';
+ import { lendingOf } from '@/engine/systems/lending';
+ import { cashOwedOn } from '@/engine/systems/cash';
+ import { planLeftOf, transferRate } from '@/engine/systems/cardoffers';
+ import { bankById } from '@/engine/content/banks';
+ import { balanceText } from '@/engine/systems/abroad';
+
+ /** The window every "lately" sentence in this file means, and its word. */
+ const RECENT_DAYS = 30;
+ const RECENT_WORDS = 'thirty days';
+
+ /** What the world calls each sort of account, in its plain name (from 2026-10-17: until then “What You Spend From”, “A Line Of Credit” and the like). Never the engine’s word for it. */
+ const ACCOUNT_KIND: Readonly<Record<AccountKind, string>> = {
+   checking: 'Checking Account',
+   savings: 'Savings Account',
+   cash: 'Cash In Hand',
+   credit_card: 'Credit Card',
+   loan: 'Loan',
+   mortgage: 'Mortgage',
+   auto_loan: 'Car Loan',
+   brokerage: 'Investments',
+   company_cash: 'Company Account',
+   company_credit: 'Company Card',
+   escrow: 'Money Held For Later',
+   production_account: 'Production Account',
+   // Nominal accounts never resolve, so these are here for completeness only.
+   income: 'Where Money Comes From',
+   expense: 'Where Money Goes',
+   equity: 'What Was There To Start',
+   asset_value: 'What A Thing Is Worth',
+   liability_other: 'Something Owed',
+ };
+
+ /** How a spend category is written where a person reads it. */
+ const CATEGORY_WORDS: Readonly<Record<string, string>> = {
+   opening: 'Carried From Before',
+   groceries: 'Food',
+ };
+
+ const categoryWords = (key: string): string =>
+   CATEGORY_WORDS[key] ?? titleCaseLabel(key.replace(/_/g, ' '));
+
+ const personIn = (sim: Simulation, id: string): Person | undefined =>
+   sim.universe.people[id || sim.universe.playerId];
+
+ /** What a liability account actually has against it. Never negative. */
+ const owedOn = (a: Account): number => Math.max(0, -a.balance);
+
+ /** "22.49%", from a rate stored as a decimal. */
+ const ratePercent = (apr: number): string => `${(apr * 100).toFixed(2)}%`;
+
+ /**
+  * The rate an account is charged at now: a card’s by its terms (an
+  * introductory rate, a penalty rate, the legal cap, `cardTerms`), anything
+  * else’s as written. Until 2026-09-27 a card’s look read the rate written on
+  * it, 24.99% through a 0% introduction that Home showed as 0%.
+  */
+ function rateOf(sim: Simulation, a: Account): number | undefined {
+   // A current account overdrawn, or with one arranged, is charged its overdraft’s rate day by day (`systems/lending.ts`):
+   // until 2026-09-27 it read as charging nothing. Bills Owed, what went unpaid, carries none, and read as 0%; until
+   // 2026-10-12 this called it what’s owed the landlord, which it was until the home went on 2026-10-09.
+   if (a.kind === 'checking') {
+     const od = a.bankId ? lendingOf(bankById(a.bankId)).overdraft : undefined;
+     const rate = a.overdraftRate ?? (od && 'rate' in od ? od.rate : undefined);
+     return a.balance < 0 || (a.overdraftLimit ?? 0) > 0 ? rate : undefined;
+   }
+   if (a.category === 'arrears' || a.apr === 0) return undefined;
+   if (a.kind !== 'credit_card' || a.apr === undefined) return a.apr;
+   const owner = a.ownerId ? sim.universe.people[a.ownerId] : undefined;
+   return cardTerms(sim, a, owner?.credit?.score ?? 650).apr;
+ }
+
+ /**
+  * A year of interest on what an account owes, as the engine charges it: a
+  * card’s cash and transfers at their own rates, a plan charged as interest at
+  * its own and a plan with a fee at none (its fee is in place of interest), and
+  * the rest at the purchase rate. Until 2026-09-27 the whole card was taken at
+  * the purchase rate; until 2026-10-12 a plan’s balance was too, as the engine
+  * never charges it (`planLeftOf`), so a plan charged as interest during a 0%
+  * introduction read as "charged no interest today" while its interest posted.
+  */
+ function yearOfInterest(sim: Simulation, a: Account): Money {
+   const owed = owedOn(a);
+   const owner = a.ownerId ? sim.universe.people[a.ownerId] : undefined;
+   if (a.kind !== 'credit_card' || !owner?.credit) return Math.round(owed * (rateOf(sim, a) ?? 0));
+   const terms = cardTerms(sim, a, owner.credit.score);
+   const cash = cashOwedOn(owner, a);
+   let transfers = 0;
+   let transferInterest = 0;
+   const state = stateOf(owner, a);
+   for (const one of state.transfers ?? []) { transfers += one.owed; transferInterest += one.owed * transferRate(sim, state, one); }
+   const planInterest = (state.plans ?? []).reduce((s, plan) => s + plan.left * (plan.apr ?? 0), 0);
+   const rest = Math.max(0, owed - cash - transfers - planLeftOf(state));
+   return Math.round(rest * terms.apr + cash * (terms.cashApr ?? terms.apr) + transferInterest + planInterest);
+ }
+
+ /** How long it has been there, in the words a person uses for it. */
+ function heldFor(sim: Simulation, openedAt: number): string {
+   const days = Math.max(0, Math.round((sim.now - openedAt) / MS_DAY));
+   if (days < 30) return 'this month';
+   if (days < 60) return 'last month';
+   const months = Math.round(days / 30);
+   if (months < 24) return `${months} months ago`;
+   return `${Math.round(days / 365)} years ago`;
+ }
+
+ /** What has crossed an account lately, as money in and money out. */
+ function movement(sim: Simulation, accountId: string): { inward: number; outward: number } {
+   const since = sim.now - RECENT_DAYS * MS_DAY;
+   let inward = 0;
+   let outward = 0;
+   for (const txn of sim.ledger.history(accountId, 400)) {
+     if (txn.at < since) continue;
+     const delta = Ledger.effectOn(txn, accountId);
+     if (delta > 0) inward += delta;
+     else outward += -delta;
+   }
+   return { inward, outward };
+ }
+
+ /** The accounts with something standing against them, worst first. */
+ function debtsOf(sim: Simulation, ownerId: string): Account[] {
+   return sim.ledger.accountsOf(ownerId)
+     .filter((a) => isLiability(a.kind) && owedOn(a) > 0)
+     .sort((a, b) => owedOn(b) - owedOn(a));
+ }
+
+ // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+ // One account
+ // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+ defineLook<Account>('account', {
+   gone: 'That account is closed. What was in it went elsewhere when it closed.',
+   resolve: (sim, id) => {
+     const account = sim.ledger.tryAccount(id);
+     if (!account || account.nominal || account.closedAt) return undefined;
+     return account;
+   },
+   seeds: (sim) => sim.ledger.accountsOf(sim.universe.playerId).map((a) => a.id),
+   look: (account, { sim }) => {
+     // Company and production accounts are owned by a company, not a person, so
+     // neither the trail up nor the way across to Owed is theirs to offer.
+     const owner = sim.universe.people[account.ownerId];
+     const ways: Way[] = [];
+     if (owner && isLiability(account.kind) && owedOn(account) > 0) {
+       ways.push({
+         to: at('debt', account.ownerId),
+         label: 'Owed',
+         detail: 'Everything you owe, and what a year of interest on it would cost at today’s rates',
+       });
+     }
+     return {
+       name: account.name,
+       kind: ACCOUNT_KIND[account.kind],
+       parent: owner ? at('person', owner.id) : undefined,
+       summary: accountSentence(account, sim),
+       body: accountBody(account, sim),
+       ways,
+       // Without the ledger’s own rule in it (from brief 15, 2026-10-19): until then “…, not a figure anybody typed in.”
+       provenance: account.apr === undefined
+         ? 'The balance is the sum of every payment into and out of the account.'
+         : 'The balance is the sum of every payment into and out of the account. The rate is what the terms charge today, and it’s charged at each statement on any balance the last statement didn’t clear.',
+     };
+   },
+ });
+
+ /** What the account is doing right now, in one sentence. */
+ function accountSentence(a: Account, sim: Simulation): string {
+   const cur = saveCurrency(sim.universe);
+   const where = a.institution ? ` at ${a.institution}` : '';
+   const spendsFromIt = sim.universe.people[a.ownerId]?.primaryAccountId === a.id;
+
+   if (isLiability(a.kind)) {
+     const owed = owedOn(a);
+     const limit = a.creditLimit ?? 0;
+     // A card paid past what it owed holds the rest (from 2026-10-17, brief 14's dynamic cases: until then it read as
+     // owing nothing with the whole limit free, beside a Left To Spend over the limit).
+     if (owed === 0 && a.balance > 0) {
+       return limit > 0
+         ? `You owe nothing on it${where}, and it holds ${formatMoney(a.balance, cur)} of your money on top of the whole ${formatMoney(limit, cur)} limit.`
+         : `You owe nothing on it${where}, and it holds ${formatMoney(a.balance, cur)} of your money.`;
+     }
+     if (owed === 0) {
+       return limit > 0
+         ? `You owe nothing on it${where}, and the whole ${formatMoney(limit, cur)} limit is free to use.`
+         : `You owe nothing on it${where}.`;
+     }
+     const free = Math.max(0, limit + a.balance);
+     return limit > 0
+       ? `You owe ${formatMoney(owed, cur)} on it${where}, which leaves ${formatMoney(free, cur)} of its ${formatMoney(limit, cur)} limit free to use.`
+       : a.category === 'arrears'
+         // Settled each night from the current account and then its savings (`settleArrears`, `systems/spending.ts`).
+         // Until 2026-10-12 this ended "unless you pay rent by hand": the rent went with the home on 2026-10-09.
+         ? `You owe ${formatMoney(owed, cur)} on it${where}. Each night it’s paid from the first money in your primary account, then from your savings at the same bank.`
+         : `You owe ${formatMoney(owed, cur)} on it${where}, and it only goes down as you pay it.`;
+   }
+
+   if (a.balance < 0) {
+     return `It’s ${a.currency ? balanceText(sim, a, -a.balance, -(a.held ?? 0)) : formatMoney(-a.balance, cur)} overdrawn${where}, and every day it stays overdrawn can cost you.`;
+   }
+   if (a.balance === 0) {
+     return `There’s nothing in it${where}. ${tailFor(a.kind, spendsFromIt)}`;
+   }
+   // An account kept at home in its own money, the dollars beside (`balanceText`, from 2026-10-16).
+   return `You have ${balanceText(sim, a)} in it${where}. ${tailFor(a.kind, spendsFromIt)}`;
+ }
+
+ /** What has crossed it lately, without saying "and nothing" twice. */
+ function movementSentence(inward: number, outward: number, cur: string): string {
+   if (inward === 0 && outward === 0) return `No money has gone in or out in the last ${RECENT_WORDS}.`;
+   if (outward === 0) return `${formatMoney(inward, cur)} has come in over the last ${RECENT_WORDS}, and none has gone out.`;
+   if (inward === 0) return `${formatMoney(outward, cur)} has gone out over the last ${RECENT_WORDS}, and none has come in.`;
+   return `Over the last ${RECENT_WORDS}, ${formatMoney(inward, cur)} came in and ${formatMoney(outward, cur)} went out.`;
+ }
+
+ /** What the money in this sort of account is for. */
+ function tailFor(kind: AccountKind, spendsFromIt: boolean): string {
+   switch (kind) {
+     // Until 2026-10-12 the last of it was "for what’s owed the landlord": what went unpaid has been Bills Owed since
+     // the home went on 2026-10-09, and savings is drawn on for it each night (`settleArrears`, `systems/spending.ts`).
+     case 'savings':
+       return 'It’s money set aside. Where you’ve linked it, it pays what the checking account can’t, and it pays off anything left unpaid.';
+     case 'brokerage':
+       return 'What it’s worth moves with the market.';
+     case 'escrow':
+       return 'It’s held for one purpose, and you can use it only when that happens.';
+     case 'cash':
+       return 'It’s yours to spend, with no bank involved.';
+     default:
+       return spendsFromIt ? 'It’s your primary account, so the day’s spending comes out of it.' : 'It stays there until you move it.';
+   }
+ }
+
+ function accountBody(a: Account, sim: Simulation) {
+   const cur = saveCurrency(sim.universe);
+   const { inward, outward } = movement(sim, a.id);
+   const owed = owedOn(a);
+   const limit = a.creditLimit ?? 0;
+   const liability = isLiability(a.kind);
+
+   const stats = [
+     <Stat
+       key="balance"
+       label={liability ? 'Owed' : 'Balance'}
+       // Overdrawn, with a minus sign, as Money writes it (from 2026-10-17, brief 14's dynamic cases: until then "-$41.10").
+       value={<span className="mono">{liability ? formatMoney(owed, cur) : a.balance < 0 ? `−${balanceText(sim, a, -a.balance, a.currency ? -(a.held ?? 0) : undefined)}` : balanceText(sim, a)}</span>}
+       tone={liability ? (owed > 0 ? 'negative' : undefined) : (a.balance < 0 ? 'negative' : undefined)}
+       note={liability ? 'What you owe on it' : 'What’s in it now'}
+     />,
+   ];
+   if (limit > 0) {
+     stats.push(
+       <Stat
+         key="free"
+         label="Left To Spend"
+         value={<span className="mono">{formatMoney(Math.max(0, limit + a.balance), cur)}</span>}
+         note={`Of a ${formatMoney(limit, cur)} limit`}
+       />,
+     );
+   }
+   const rate = rateOf(sim, a);
+   if (rate !== undefined) {
+     stats.push(
+       <Stat key="rate" label="Rate" value={ratePercent(rate)} note={a.kind === 'credit_card' ? 'A year, as the card charges it now' : 'A year, as the account states it'} />,
+     );
+   }
+   if (a.last4) {
+     stats.push(<Stat key="last4" label="Ends In" value={<span className="mono">{a.last4}</span>} note="The last four digits of its number" />);
+   }
+
+   return (
+     <>
+       <p className="small">
+         {a.institution ?? 'The bank'} opened it {heldFor(sim, a.openedAt)}
+         {a.last4 ? `, and it ends ${a.last4}` : ''}.{' '}
+         {rate !== undefined && a.kind === 'checking'
+           ? `When it’s overdrawn, it’s charged ${ratePercent(rate)} a year on the overdrawn amount, day by day, and the interest is taken on the 1st. Any fees are shown on Money.`
+           : rate !== undefined
+           ? `What’s still owed on it is charged ${ratePercent(rate)} a year: interest is on what’s left, not on what it started at.`
+           : a.kind === 'checking' || a.kind === 'savings' ? 'It charges no interest. Any fee for keeping it is shown on Money.' : 'It charges no interest.'}
+       </p>
+       <p className="small">{movementSentence(inward, outward, cur)}</p>
+       <div className="grid grid-3">{stats}</div>
+     </>
+   );
+ }
+
+ // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+ // What it all comes to
+ // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+ interface Holdings {
+   person: Person;
+   worth: Worth;
+   accounts: Account[];
+ }
+
+ defineLook<Holdings>('networth', {
+   gone: 'There’s nobody here for the money to belong to.',
+   resolve: (sim, id) => {
+     const person = personIn(sim, id);
+     if (!person) return undefined;
+     return {
+       person,
+       worth: netWorth(sim, person.id),
+       accounts: sim.ledger.accountsOf(person.id),
+     };
+   },
+   seeds: (sim) => [sim.universe.playerId],
+   look: (held, { sim }) => {
+     const cur = saveCurrency(sim.universe);
+     const { person, worth, accounts } = held;
+
+     const ways: Way[] = accounts.map((a) => ({
+       to: at('account', a.id),
+       label: a.name,
+       detail: isLiability(a.kind)
+         ? `${a.institution ?? 'A lender'}, and ${formatMoney(owedOn(a), cur)} owed on it`
+         : `${a.institution ?? 'A bank'}, and ${balanceText(sim, a)} in it`,
+     }));
+     if (worth.liabilities > 0) {
+       ways.push({
+         to: at('debt', person.id),
+         label: 'Owed',
+         detail: `${formatMoney(worth.liabilities, cur)} owed, and what a year of interest on it would cost at today’s rates`,
+       });
+     }
+
+     return {
+       name: 'Net Worth',
+       kind: 'What It All Comes To',
+       parent: at('person', person.id),
+       summary: worthSentence(worth, cur, inHand(accounts)),
+       body: worthBody(held, cur),
+       facets: [
+         {
+           id: 'went',
+           label: 'Where It Went',
+           body: spendBody(sim, person.id),
+         },
+       ],
+       ways,
+       // Without the bookkeeping (from brief 15, 2026-10-19): until then “Added up from your accounts each time you look,
+       // and stored nowhere. Every payment behind it has a matching entry on the other side, and the books balance to the
+       // cent.”
+       provenance: 'It’s added up from all your accounts each time you look, so it’s right to the cent.',
+     };
+   },
+ });
+
+ /**
+  * Whether any of `Worth.cash` is cash in hand (`systems/cash.ts`), which it counts with the bank. Until 2026-10-12
+  * net worth called all of it "in the bank".
+  */
+ const inHand = (accounts: readonly Account[]): boolean => accounts.some((a) => a.kind === 'cash' && !a.closedAt && a.balance > 0);
+
+ /**
+  * What the money an escrow account holds is doing, by the account’s category, in the net-worth sentence: money sent
+  * between the holder’s banks (`systems/bankmoves.ts`) and SNAP on the EBT card (`systems/assistance.ts`). Any other is
+  * held for later, as the account’s own kind is called.
+  */
+ const HELD_AS: Readonly<Record<string, string>> = {
+   in_transit: 'on its way between your banks',
+   ebt: 'in SNAP on your EBT card',
+ };
+
+ /** Both sides of it, spoken. */
+ function worthSentence(w: Worth, cur: string, withCash: boolean): string {
+   // One precision through the sentence: whole units where any figure is past where formatMoney drops cents.
+   const whole = [w.cash, w.held, w.pension, w.liabilities, w.total].some((x) => Math.abs(x) >= 100_000_00);
+   const say = (c: number) => formatMoney(c, cur, { cents: !whole });
+   const parts: string[] = [];
+   if (w.cash > 0) parts.push(`${say(w.cash)} ${withCash ? 'in the bank or in hand' : 'in the bank'}`);
+   if (w.cash < 0) parts.push(`${say(-w.cash)} overdrawn`);
+   // Held is what an escrow account holds, each part named from the account that holds it (`Worth.heldAs`). It was a
+   // landlord’s deposit until the home went on 2026-10-09, and this said "held as a deposit" until 2026-10-12. For part
+   // of 2026-10-12 it said of all of it "held apart, on its way between your banks or as SNAP on an EBT card", which
+   // told a Torontonian moving money between banks that it might be a US benefit.
+   for (const [as, amount] of Object.entries(w.heldAs)) if (amount > 0) parts.push(`${say(amount)} ${HELD_AS[as] ?? 'held for later'}`);
+   if (w.pension > 0) parts.push(`${say(w.pension)} in a pension, locked until you retire`);
+   // A home, cars and land were said here too until they went in the scope reset of 2026-10-09.
+   if (w.liabilities > 0) parts.push(`${say(w.liabilities)} owed against it`);
+   if (parts.length === 0) {
+     return 'You’re worth nothing today: no money anywhere, and nothing owed.';
+   }
+   return `You’re worth ${say(w.total)}: ${spokenList(parts)}.`;
+ }
+
+ function worthBody(held: Holdings, cur: string) {
+   const { worth, accounts } = held;
+   const names = accounts.map((a) => a.name);
+   const spending = accounts.find((a) => a.id === held.person.primaryAccountId);
+
+   return (
+     <>
+       <p className="small">
+         {names.length === 0
+           ? 'You have no accounts open anywhere, so any money you have is cash in hand.'
+           : `${spokenList(names)} ${isAre(names.length)} open in your name`}
+         {names.length > 0 && spending ? `, and ${spending.name} is your primary account, where the day’s spending comes from.` : names.length > 0 ? '.' : ''}
+       </p>
+       <div className="grid grid-3">
+         {/* Cash in hand is counted here with the bank; until 2026-10-12 the label said "In The Bank" over it all. */}
+         {inHand(accounts)
+           ? <Stat label="In The Bank And In Hand" value={<span className="mono">{formatMoney(worth.cash, cur)}</span>} note="Every account, and the cash on you" />
+           : <Stat label="In The Bank" value={<span className="mono">{formatMoney(worth.cash, cur)}</span>} note="Across every account" />}
+         <Stat
+           label="Owed"
+           value={<span className="mono">{formatMoney(worth.liabilities, cur)}</span>}
+           tone={worth.liabilities > 0 ? 'negative' : undefined}
+           note="Taken off the total"
+         />
+         <Stat
+           label="Net"
+           value={<span className="mono">{formatMoney(worth.total, cur)}</span>}
+           tone={worth.total < 0 ? 'negative' : 'positive'}
+           note="What you’d have once everything owed is paid"
+         />
+       </div>
+     </>
+   );
+ }
+
+ /** The other face of the same figure: what has been leaving it. */
+ function spendBody(sim: Simulation, ownerId: string) {
+   const cur = saveCurrency(sim.universe);
+   const spend = sim.ledger.spendByCategory(ownerId, sim.now - RECENT_DAYS * MS_DAY, sim.now);
+   const rows = Object.entries(spend).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]);
+   if (rows.length === 0) {
+     return <p className="small">You have spent nothing at all in the last {RECENT_WORDS}.</p>;
+   }
+   const total = rows.reduce((s, [, amount]) => s + amount, 0);
+   const top = rows.slice(0, 3).map(([key]) => categoryWords(key).toLowerCase());
+
+   return (
+     <>
+       <p className="small">
+         {formatMoney(total, cur)} has gone out in the last {RECENT_WORDS}, and {spokenList(top)}{' '}
+         {isAre(top.length)} where most of it went.
+       </p>
+       <div className="col gap-2">
+         {rows.slice(0, 6).map(([key, amount]) => (
+           <div key={key} className="row-between small">
+             <span>{categoryWords(key)}</span>
+             <span className="mono dim">{formatMoney(amount, cur)}</span>
+           </div>
+         ))}
+       </div>
+     </>
+   );
+ }
+
+ // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+ // What is owed
+ // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+ interface Owing { person: Person; debts: Account[]; total: number }
+
+ defineLook<Owing>('debt', {
+   gone: 'You don’t owe anyone anything, so there’s nothing to show here.',
+   resolve: (sim, id) => {
+     const person = personIn(sim, id);
+     if (!person) return undefined;
+     const debts = debtsOf(sim, person.id);
+     if (debts.length === 0) return undefined;
+     return { person, debts, total: debts.reduce((s, a) => s + owedOn(a), 0) };
+   },
+   seeds: (sim) => (debtsOf(sim, sim.universe.playerId).length > 0 ? [sim.universe.playerId] : []),
+   look: (owing, { sim }) => { const cur = saveCurrency(sim.universe); return ({
+     name: 'Owed',
+     kind: 'What You Owe',
+     parent: at('networth', owing.person.id),
+     summary: owing.debts.length === 1 && owing.debts[0]
+       ? `You owe ${formatMoney(owing.total, cur)}, all of it on the ${owing.debts[0].name}.`
+       : `You owe ${formatMoney(owing.total, cur)}, spread across ${spokenList(owing.debts.map((a) => a.name))}.`,
+     body: debtBody(owing, cur, sim),
+     ways: owing.debts.map((a) => ({
+       to: at('account', a.id),
+       label: a.name,
+       detail: rateOf(sim, a) !== undefined
+         ? `${formatMoney(owedOn(a), cur)} on it at ${ratePercent(rateOf(sim, a)!)}`
+         : `${formatMoney(owedOn(a), cur)} on it, at no stated rate`,
+     })),
+     provenance: 'The rates are the accounts’ own, and a card’s is charged at each statement on a balance carried. These are the balances right now, not a projection.',
+   }); },
+ });
+
+ function debtBody(owing: Owing, cur: string, sim: Simulation) {
+   const yearly = owing.debts.reduce((s, a) => s + yearOfInterest(sim, a), 0);
+   // Every line open to them, a card with nothing on it among them, as a bureau reads it.
+   const lines = Object.values(sim.universe.accounts).filter((a) => a.ownerId === owing.person.id && !a.closedAt && a.kind === 'credit_card' && (a.creditLimit ?? 0) > 0);
+   const limits = lines.reduce((s, a) => s + (a.creditLimit ?? 0), 0);
+   const revolving = lines;
+   const used = limits > 0
+     ? Math.round((revolving.reduce((s, a) => s + owedOn(a), 0) / limits) * 100)
+     : 0;
+   // Only a rate above nothing is expensive. Until 2026-10-12 a card in a 0% introduction was "the expensive one, at
+   // 0.00%", after "None of them carries a rate".
+   const dearest = owing.debts
+     .filter((a) => (rateOf(sim, a) ?? 0) > 0)
+     .sort((a, b) => (rateOf(sim, b) ?? 0) - (rateOf(sim, a) ?? 0))[0];
+   // A card in its introduction, and when its own rate comes: `cardTerms` gives a `standardApr` only while one is in
+   // force. The year above stays at the rate charged now.
+   const intros = owing.debts.flatMap((a) => {
+     if (a.kind !== 'credit_card') return [];
+     const owner = sim.universe.people[a.ownerId];
+     const terms = cardTerms(sim, a, owner?.credit?.score ?? 650);
+     return terms.standardApr !== undefined && terms.introUntil !== undefined
+       ? [`The ${a.name} is at ${ratePercent(terms.apr)} until ${formatDate(terms.introUntil, sim.zone)}, then ${ratePercent(terms.standardApr)}.`]
+       : [];
+   });
+   const said = [
+     yearly > 0
+       ? `At today’s rates, carrying it would cost about ${formatMoney(yearly, cur)} a year, or ${formatMoney(Math.round(yearly / 12), cur)} a month, if the balances stay as they are. A card paid in full each month is charged none of it.`
+       : intros.length > 0
+         ? 'They’re charged no interest today.'
+         : 'None of them carries a rate, so the balance stays where it is until you pay it.',
+     ...intros,
+     ...(dearest ? [`The ${dearest.name} is the expensive one, at ${ratePercent(rateOf(sim, dearest) ?? 0)}.`] : []),
+   ];
+
+   return (
+     <>
+       <p className="small">{said.join(' ')}</p>
+       <p className="small">
+         {limits > 0
+           ? `You’re using ${used}% of the ${formatMoney(limits, cur)} of credit open to you. Above 30%, each month’s credit report takes points off your credit score, and the more you use, the more it takes.`
+           : 'None of it is on a card or a credit line, so there’s no limit to use up.'}
+       </p>
+       <div className="grid grid-3">
+         <Stat label="Owed" value={<span className="mono">{formatMoney(owing.total, cur)}</span>} tone="negative" note="Across everything" />
+         <Stat
+           label="A Year Of Interest"
+           value={<span className="mono">{formatMoney(yearly, cur)}</span>}
+           note="What carrying it would cost"
+         />
+         <Stat
+           label="Credit Used"
+           value={limits > 0 ? `${used}%` : 'None open'}
+           tone={used > 30 ? 'warning' : undefined}
+           note={limits > 0 ? `Of ${formatMoney(limits, cur)}` : 'No card or credit line'}
+         />
+       </div>
+     </>
+   );
+ }
+
+ /**
+  * SLATE — one of your papers.
+  *
+  * The Papers screen lists every passport, visa, travel authorization,
+  * license, permit and ID card a life has held, and until 2026-10-02 each was a
+  * row of dead text. A document is a thing: a country or an authority issued
+  * it, it carries a number, and it was issued on a day and runs out on another.
+  * Until 2026-10-09 it let you do something — cross a border, drive, work — or
+  * it didn’t any more; crossing a border, driving, and applying for a visa or a
+  * travel authorization went in that day’s scope reset. So it opens, and what it
+  * says is read from `systems/documents.ts` at the moment you look: whether it
+  * is in force, how many of the countries SLATE has entry rules for would let
+  * you in on it today, and whether it would let you drive where you stand, each
+  * a reading. Until 2026-10-12 a passport’s page still called it the one you
+  * travel on, and a visa’s said it let you into its country; from 2026-10-12 the
+  * passport is the one in force in your name, which a new bank and the Social
+  * Security office ask for, and a visa would let you in.
+  *
+  * Its ways lead to the country that issued it, the country it is for, the
+  * passport a visa is issued on (and back), and the days it was issued and runs
+  * out.
+  */
+
+ import { dateKey, formatDate } from '@/engine/core/time';
+ import { CITIES, COUNTRIES, REGIONS } from '@/engine/content/geography';
+ import { ENTRY } from '@/engine/content/entry';
+ import { LICENSES } from '@/engine/content/licenses';
+ import {
+   documentsOf, inForce, mayDrive, mayEnter, passportOf, theCountry, type PersonDocument,
+ } from '@/engine/systems/documents';
+ import { idCardOnItsWay } from '@/engine/systems/identity';
+ import { VISITS, visitWords } from '@/engine/systems/papervisits';
+ import type { Person } from '@/engine/domain/model';
+ import type { Simulation } from '@/engine';
+ import { Stat } from '@/ui/components/primitives';
+ import { defineLook, lookExists, type Way } from './registry';
+ import { nameable } from './words';
+ import { at } from './subject';
+
+ /** What each sort of document is, in the world’s words. */
+ const KIND_WORD: Record<PersonDocument['kind'], string> = {
+   passport: 'Travel Document',
+   authorization: 'Permission To Travel',
+   visa: 'Permission To Enter',
+   license: 'Permission To Drive',
+   idp: 'License Translation',
+   permit: 'Permission To Work',
+   idcard: 'Proof Of Identity',
+ };
+
+ /** What to call it where its own name won’t do as a name. */
+ const PLAIN_NAME: Record<PersonDocument['kind'], string> = {
+   passport: 'Passport', authorization: 'Travel Authorization', visa: 'Visa', license: 'Driving License', idp: 'International Driving Permit', permit: 'Work Permit', idcard: 'ID Card',
+ };
+
+ /** The country an ISO code names, where the world has it. Britain is "uk" in the atlas and "GB" on a passport. */
+ const countryOfIso = (iso: string) => COUNTRIES.all().find((c) => c.iso2?.toUpperCase() === iso.toUpperCase());
+
+ /** Who issued it, as a place in the world: a country, or for a license the state or country whose authority it is. */
+ function issuerCountry(doc: PersonDocument) {
+   const iso = doc.kind === 'license' || doc.kind === 'idp' || doc.kind === 'idcard' ? doc.issuer.split('-')[0]! : doc.issuer;
+   return countryOfIso(iso === 'uk' ? 'gb' : iso);
+ }
+
+ /** The region a license names, for a state or province that issues its own. */
+ function issuerRegion(doc: PersonDocument) {
+   if (!doc.issuer.includes('-')) return undefined;
+   return REGIONS.get(doc.issuer) ?? REGIONS.get(doc.issuer.toUpperCase());
+ }
+
+ /** Each word given its capital, as a label is written, without touching a word that opens on a marked letter. */
+ const capitalised = (text: string): string => text.split(' ').map((w) => w.replace(/^[a-z]/, (c) => c.toUpperCase())).join(' ');
+
+ /** Whether a string reads as a name: no identifier shapes, and a plain capital or digit first. */
+ const passesAsName = nameable;
+
+ /** A document’s name, in Title Case, as the world spells it. */
+ function nameOf(doc: PersonDocument): string {
+   const own = capitalised(doc.name.trim());
+   if (passesAsName(own)) return own;
+   // A name in the issuer’s language that opens on a marked letter, with the English printed beside it in brackets: the English.
+   const english = /\(([^)]+)\)\s*$/.exec(own)?.[1];
+   if (english && passesAsName(capitalised(english))) return capitalised(english);
+   return PLAIN_NAME[doc.kind];
+ }
+
+ /** The last digits of its number, as a clerk reads them back to you. */
+ const lastOf = (number: string): string => number.replace(/\W/g, '').slice(-4);
+
+ interface ThePaper { doc: PersonDocument; person: Person }
+
+ /** Where it stands now, in a word a person uses. */
+ function standingOf(doc: PersonDocument, now: number): 'pending' | 'valid' | 'lost' | 'cancelled' | 'expired' {
+   if (doc.status === 'valid' && doc.expiresAt !== undefined && doc.expiresAt <= now) return 'expired';
+   return doc.status;
+ }
+
+ /** What it lets you do, read from the rules today. */
+ function whatItDoes(sim: Simulation, { doc, person }: ThePaper): string {
+   const now = sim.now;
+   const live = inForce(doc, now);
+   // A country as a sentence says it, the United Kingdom, as `mayEnter` says a citizenship (from 2026-10-12: until then
+   // “It would let you into United Kingdom”, and a permit’s “It lets you work in United States”).
+   const where = (iso?: string) => (iso ? theCountry(countryOfIso(iso)?.name ?? iso) : 'the country it names');
+   switch (doc.kind) {
+     case 'passport': {
+       // Said, not played: nothing crosses a border since the scope reset of 2026-10-09. Until 2026-10-12 this called
+       // it "the passport you travel on", and said one out of force "takes you across no border now".
+       if (!live) return 'It’s no longer in force, so a bank or an office won’t accept it.';
+       const carried = passportOf(person, now)?.id === doc.id;
+       const rules = Object.keys(ENTRY);
+       const open = carried ? rules.filter((iso) => mayEnter(person, iso, now).ok).length : 0;
+       return carried
+         ? `It’s the passport in force in your name. Of the ${rules.length} countries the game has entry rules for, ${open} would let you in on it today for a week’s visit. Travel isn’t part of the game, so this is for reference.`
+         : 'It’s in force, but another passport is the one in force in your name.';
+     }
+     case 'visa':
+     case 'authorization': {
+       if (!live) return `${where(doc.destination).replace(/^./, (c) => c.toUpperCase())} won’t let you in on it now.`;
+       const answer = doc.destination ? mayEnter(person, doc.destination, now) : undefined;
+       // A reading, as the passport’s is: until 2026-10-12 it said "It lets you into" the country, and "the visit".
+       return answer?.ok
+         ? `It would let you into ${where(doc.destination)}, and nothing else is missing for a week’s visit there. ${answer.stay ?? ''}`.trim()
+         : `It’s in force for ${where(doc.destination)}, but a week’s visit there would still need more: ${answer?.missing[0] ?? 'the rule wasn’t found'}`;
+     }
+     case 'license': {
+       if (!live) return 'It doesn’t let you drive anywhere now that it’s out of force.';
+       const here = CITIES.get(person.currentLocationId)?.name ?? 'where you are';
+       const may = mayDrive(person, person.currentLocationId, now, now, doc.vehicleClass ?? 'car');
+       // Said, not played: nothing is driven since the car went in the scope reset of 2026-10-09.
+       return `${may.ok ? `In ${here}, it would let you drive.` : `In ${here}, it wouldn’t let you drive. ${may.why ?? ''}`.trim()} Driving isn’t part of the game, so this is for reference.`;
+     }
+     case 'idp':
+       return live ? 'It goes with your license abroad, where a country asks for a translation of it.' : 'Now that it’s out of force, it no longer counts with your license.';
+     case 'permit':
+       return live ? `It lets you work in ${where(doc.destination ?? doc.issuer)}${doc.bookingId ? ', for the one job it was issued for' : ''}.` : 'It no longer lets you work anywhere: it’s out of force.';
+     case 'idcard':
+       return live
+         ? 'It proves who you are, anywhere a card is asked for.'
+         : 'It no longer proves who you are, because it’s out of force.';
+   }
+ }
+
+ defineLook<ThePaper>('document', {
+   gone: 'You don’t hold that document any more, so there’s nothing to show.',
+   resolve: (sim, id) => {
+     const person = sim.universe.people[sim.universe.playerId];
+     if (!person) return undefined;
+     const doc = documentsOf(person).find((d) => d.id === id);
+     return doc ? { doc, person } : undefined;
+   },
+   seeds: (sim) => {
+     const person = sim.universe.people[sim.universe.playerId];
+     return person ? documentsOf(person).map((d) => d.id) : [];
+   },
+   look: (paper, { sim }) => {
+     const { doc, person } = paper;
+     const zone = sim.zone;
+     const state = standingOf(doc, sim.now);
+     const country = issuerCountry(doc);
+     const region = issuerRegion(doc);
+     // A country opens the sentence as one says it, the United Kingdom (from 2026-10-12: until then “United Kingdom issued it”).
+     const issuer = (doc.kind === 'license' && LICENSES[doc.issuer] ? LICENSES[doc.issuer]!.authority : region?.name ?? (country ? theCountry(country.name) : doc.issuer.toUpperCase())).replace(/^./, (c) => c.toUpperCase());
+     const last = lastOf(doc.number);
+
+     // The interview or biometrics it waits on, from 2026-10-06 (`systems/papervisits.ts`).
+     const visit = doc.visit && doc.visit.keptAt === undefined ? `It’s waiting on your ${visitWords(doc.visit.rule)} in ${CITIES.get(doc.visit.cityId)?.name ?? 'town'} on ${formatDate(doc.visit.at, zone)}. Be there, or ${VISITS[doc.visit.rule].again && !doc.visit.missed ? 'it’s booked once more, and if you miss that too, the application' : 'the application'} ends. ` : '';
+     // An ID card past every check is being made and mailed, not decided (from 2026-10-17, `idCardOnItsWay`): until then
+     // a citizen’s said "it’s being decided" while the toast said it was on its way.
+     const mailed = idCardOnItsWay(doc, sim.now);
+     const summary = state === 'pending'
+       ? mailed ? `You’ve applied and paid, and the card is on its way. It should arrive by ${formatDate(doc.readyAt!, zone)}.` : `${visit}You’ve applied, and it’s being decided. It should be ready ${doc.readyAt ? `by ${formatDate(doc.readyAt, zone)}` : 'soon'}.`
+       : state === 'lost' ? `You reported it ${doc.stolen ? 'stolen' : 'lost'}, so the number ending ${last} is canceled.`
+         : state === 'cancelled' ? `It’s canceled, so the number ending ${last} is no use to you now.`
+           : state === 'expired' ? `It ran out on ${formatDate(doc.expiresAt!, zone)} and no longer counts for anything.`
+             : doc.expiresAt ? `It’s in force until ${formatDate(doc.expiresAt, zone)}, and its number ends ${last}.` : `It’s in force with no end date, and its number ends ${last}.`;
+
+     const ways: Way[] = [];
+     if (country && lookExists(sim, at('country', country.id))) {
+       ways.push({ to: at('country', country.id), label: country.name, detail: doc.kind === 'license' ? 'The country whose roads it was issued for' : 'The country that issued it, and whose citizen it says you are' });
+     }
+     if (region && lookExists(sim, at('region', region.id))) {
+       ways.push({ to: at('region', region.id), label: region.name, detail: 'The state or province whose authority issued it' });
+     }
+     const dest = doc.destination ? countryOfIso(doc.destination) : undefined;
+     if (dest && dest.id !== country?.id && lookExists(sim, at('country', dest.id))) {
+       ways.push({ to: at('country', dest.id), label: dest.name, detail: 'The country it would let you into, and what that country is like' });
+     }
+     const on = doc.passportId ? documentsOf(person).find((d) => d.id === doc.passportId) : undefined;
+     if (on) ways.push({ to: at('document', on.id), label: nameOf(on), detail: `The passport it was issued on, ending ${lastOf(on.number)}` });
+     for (const child of documentsOf(person).filter((d) => d.passportId === doc.id)) {
+       ways.push({ to: at('document', child.id), label: nameOf(child), detail: `Issued on this passport${child.destination ? `, for ${theCountry(countryOfIso(child.destination)?.name ?? child.destination)}` : ''}` });
+     }
+     if (doc.issuedAt !== undefined) {
+       ways.push({ to: at('day', dateKey(doc.issuedAt, sim.homeZone)), label: `Issued ${formatDate(doc.issuedAt, zone)}`, detail: 'Its first day, and what else happened then' });
+     }
+     if (doc.expiresAt !== undefined) {
+       ways.push({ to: at('day', dateKey(doc.expiresAt, sim.homeZone)), label: `${doc.expiresAt > sim.now ? 'Runs Out' : 'Ran Out'} ${formatDate(doc.expiresAt, zone)}`, detail: 'The day it stops counting, and what else is on that day' });
+     }
+     ways.push({ to: at('person', person.id), label: 'You', detail: 'Who it names, and the rest of your life' });
+
+     return {
+       name: nameOf(doc),
+       kind: KIND_WORD[doc.kind],
+       parent: at('person', person.id),
+       summary,
+       body: (
+         <>
+           <p className="small">
+             {issuer} issued it{doc.issuedAt ? ` on ${formatDate(doc.issuedAt, zone)}` : ''}.{' '}
+             {state === 'valid' ? whatItDoes(sim, paper) : state === 'pending' ? 'You don’t hold it yet, so it doesn’t let you do anything until it arrives.' : ''}
+             {/* A US state card issued non-verified says so, as the card itself does (from 2026-10-16: a non-citizen’s
+                 Connecticut card was marked REAL ID until then, `documents.apply_idcard`). */}
+             {doc.realId ? ' It meets REAL ID.' : doc.kind === 'idcard' && doc.issuer.startsWith('us-') && doc.realId === false ? ' It’s marked Not For Federal Identification: it isn’t REAL ID.' : ''}
+           </p>
+           <div className="grid grid-3">
+             <Stat label="Number Ends" value={<span className="mono">{last}</span>} note="The last digits of its number" />
+             {/* Not yet while pending (from 2026-10-17), as the row: a replacement carries the lost card’s date until it comes. */}
+             <Stat label="Issued" value={doc.issuedAt && state !== 'pending' ? formatDate(doc.issuedAt, zone) : 'Not Yet'} note={doc.appliedAt ? `Applied for ${formatDate(doc.appliedAt, zone)}` : 'Issued directly, with no application on record'} />
+             <Stat
+               label={state === 'expired' ? 'Ran Out' : 'Runs Out'}
+               value={doc.expiresAt ? formatDate(doc.expiresAt, zone) : 'No End Date'}
+               tone={state === 'valid' ? undefined : 'warning'}
+               note={state === 'valid' ? 'In force until then' : state === 'pending' ? (mailed ? 'On its way' : 'Being decided') : 'No longer in force'}
+             />
+           </div>
+         </>
+       ),
+       ways,
+       provenance: 'What it lets you do comes from each country’s entry and driving rules, as the game has them today.',
+     };
+   },
+ });
+
+ /**
+  * SLATE — where you are, and everything that hangs off it.
+  *
+  * Home’s Where You Are panel printed eleven figures about a city — a local
+  * clock, a daylight span, a currency, a cost index, three tax rates, an
+  * industry rating, a jobs figure, a language list and a country line — and
+  * every one of them was a dead end. The rest are real, from the gazetteer and
+  * the jurisdiction tables the simulation already runs on; the industry rating
+  * and the jobs figure were SLATE’s calibration, read by nothing, and went on
+  * 2026-09-27.
+  *
+  * The chain declared here is the gazetteer’s own chain rather than an invented
+  * one: a city hangs beneath its region and a region beneath its country
+  * because `parentId` says so, and `placeProfile` reads the live world every
+  * time. The money hangs beneath the country that issues it. The light hangs
+  * beneath the city it falls on — and at Reykjavík’s latitude that is not a
+  * footnote, because the sun does polar things up there and a person standing
+  * in it would say so.
+  *
+  * Where a figure is SLATE’s calibration rather than public record — a rent, a
+  * cost index, an exchange rate — one provenance line at
+  * the foot of the body says so, and that is the whole of it.
+  */
+
+ import { CITIES, COUNTRIES, REGIONS, type City, type Country, type Region } from '@/engine/content/geography';
+ import { CLIMATE_NAMES, climateTypeFor, usesFahrenheit, usesMiles } from '@/engine/content/climate';
+ import { RATES_NOTE, currencyInfo, formatLocal, type CurrencyInfo, formatAtlasCompact} from '@/engine/content/currency';
+ import { languageNames } from '@/engine/content/languages';
+ import {
+   PROPERTY_TAX_RULES, SALES_TAX_RULES, resolveIncomeTaxLayers, resolveRule,
+ } from '@/engine/content/tax';
+ import { formatDaylight, sunTimes, type SunTimes } from '@/engine/core/sun';
+ import { addDays, formatDurationWords, formatTime, MS_MINUTE, zoneAbbreviation, zonedParts } from '@/engine/core/time';
+ import { plural, titleCaseLabel } from '@/engine/core/text';
+ import { formatPeople, homeCityOf, placeKindLabel, placeProfile, type PlaceProfile } from '@/engine/world/place';
+ import type { Person } from '@/engine/domain/model';
+ import type { Simulation } from '@/engine';
+ import { Stat } from '@/ui/components/primitives';
+ import { Open } from './Look';
+ import { defineLook, type Way } from './registry';
+ import { at } from './subject';
+ import { rentAt } from '@/engine/content/rents';
+ import { isAre, said, spokenList } from './words';
+
+ // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+ // Reading the world
+ // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+ /**
+  * A gazetteer name, said the way a person says it.
+  *
+  * Five regions are written with a slash — Tunapuna/Piarco, Penal/Debe — and so
+  * are two hundred and seventy-nine of the towns that arrive the moment a
+  * country’s full list is loaded. Said aloud there is an "and" in the gap, so
+  * that is what goes in the gap.
+  *
+  * Twenty-nine more of those towns are census tracts written Ct 0014, and a run
+  * of four digits is an identifier rather than a name. So the number is read as
+  * a number: the padding goes, and anything genuinely long gets the comma a
+  * person would write it with.
+  */
+ const spokenName = (name: string): string => name
+   .replace(/\s*\/\s*/g, ' and ')
+   .replace(/_+/g, ' ')
+   .replace(/\d{4,}/g, (run) => Number(run).toLocaleString('en-US'));
+
+ /**
+  * "the United States", "the Netherlands", "Iceland".
+  *
+  * English puts a "the" in front of a country whose name is a plural or a
+  * description rather than a proper noun, and "you’re not in United States" is
+  * the tell that a machine wrote the sentence.
+  */
+ const THE_COUNTRY = /^(United|Democratic|Netherlands|Philippines|Bahamas|Gambia|Maldives|Comoros|Seychelles|Falkland|Cayman|Marshall|Solomon|Faroe|Cook)\b|(Islands|Republic|Emirates|Kingdom|States|Federation|Congo)$/;
+
+ const theCountry = (name: string): string => {
+   // The gazetteer already writes one of them as "The Netherlands", and a
+   // capital T in the middle of a sentence is the tell that nobody read it.
+   if (/^The\s/.test(name)) return `the ${name.slice(4)}`;
+   return THE_COUNTRY.test(name) ? `the ${name}` : name;
+ };
+
+ /** "a, b, c and 32 more", which is how a person reads a list that ran long. */
+ function spokenSome(names: readonly string[], shown: number): string {
+   const named = names.slice(0, shown);
+   const rest = names.length - named.length;
+   // Under ten in words, as prose says them (from 2026-10-20, brief 17): until then "… Jersey and 1 more".
+   return spokenList(rest > 0 ? [...named, said(rest, 'more', 'more')] : named);
+ }
+
+ const playerIn = (sim: Simulation): Person | undefined => sim.universe.people[sim.universe.playerId];
+
+ /** The city the player is standing in, falling back to the one they live in. */
+ function standingIn(sim: Simulation): City | undefined {
+   const player = playerIn(sim);
+   if (!player) return undefined;
+   return CITIES.get(player.currentLocationId) ?? homeCityOf(sim);
+ }
+
+ /**
+  * A city SLATE can profile.
+  *
+  * The jurisdiction resolver walks city, then region, then country, so a city
+  * whose gazetteer row carries no region — a handful of territories do — has no
+  * tax to read and no profile to build. Better to say nothing about such a
+  * place than to open onto a throw.
+  */
+ function profileFor(sim: Simulation, city: City | undefined): PlaceProfile | undefined {
+   if (!city || !REGIONS.get(city.parentId)) return undefined;
+   return placeProfile(sim, city.id);
+ }
+
+ const cityFor = (sim: Simulation, id: string): City | undefined =>
+   (id ? CITIES.get(id) : standingIn(sim));
+
+ /**
+  * Whether a city opens onto anything.
+  *
+  * Same condition `profileFor` resolves on: no region, no jurisdiction to read
+  * taxes through, no profile. A name is never painted as a way in unless it is
+  * one, so every way that names a town asks this first.
+  */
+ const placeOpens = (city: City | undefined): boolean => !!city && !!REGIONS.get(city.parentId);
+
+ /** "2 hours ahead of home", "half an hour behind home", "on the same clock as home". */
+ function clockAgainstHome(hours: number): string {
+   if (hours === 0) return 'on the same clock as home';
+   const size = Math.abs(hours);
+   // India, Nepal and Newfoundland all sit on a half hour, and "0.5 hours" is
+   // not a thing anybody says out loud.
+   const gap = size === 0.5 ? 'half an hour' : plural(size, 'hour');
+   return `${gap} ${hours > 0 ? 'ahead of' : 'behind'} home`;
+ }
+
+ /** What the Daylight tile says, and what a way into the light says. */
+ function lightLine(sun: SunTimes, zone: string): string {
+   if (sun.polar === 'day') return 'The sun never sets today';
+   if (sun.polar === 'night') return 'The sun doesn’t rise here today';
+   if (sun.sunrise === undefined || sun.sunset === undefined) return 'No sunrise on file';
+   // In words in a sentence (from 2026-10-17): until then “12h 45m of daylight”, the Stat’s form below.
+   return `${formatTime(sun.sunrise, zone)} to ${formatTime(sun.sunset, zone)}, ${formatDurationWords(sun.daylightMinutes * MS_MINUTE)} of daylight`;
+ }
+
+ /** What SLATE thinks a unit of this money is worth, said honestly. */
+ function rateLine(info: CurrencyInfo): string {
+   if (info.code === 'USD') return 'The currency every exchange rate is quoted against';
+   if (info.unitsPerUsd === undefined) return 'No exchange rate on file, so nothing is converted into it';
+   return `About ${info.unitsPerUsd.toLocaleString('en-US')} to the US dollar, estimated`;
+ }
+
+ // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
