+ function normalHigh(sim: Simulation, city: City, day: DayWeather): number {
+   const parts = zonedParts(sim.now, city.timeZone);
+   const normal = normalFor(city, parts.month, parts.day);
+   return day.fahrenheit ? toFahrenheit(normal.high) : Math.round(normal.high);
+ }
+
+
+ // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+ // The sky over one city, at this hour
+ // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+ interface Sky { city: City; now: WeatherNow; week: DayWeather[] }
+
+ defineLook<Sky>('weather', {
+   gone: 'That place isn’t on the map, so there’s no weather to show for it.',
+   resolve: (sim, id) => {
+     const city = cityFor(sim, id);
+     if (!city) return undefined;
+     const now = weatherAt(sim, city.id);
+     if (!now) return undefined;
+     return { city, now, week: forecastFor(sim, city.id, WEEK) };
+   },
+   seeds: (sim) => [sim.player.currentLocationId],
+   look: (sky, { sim }) => {
+     const { city, now, week } = sky;
+     const unit = unitOf(now);
+     const ahead = week.slice(1);
+     const wetNames = ahead
+       .map((d, i) => (d.precipitation === 'none' ? '' : weekdayAt(sim, city, i + 1)))
+       .filter((name) => name !== '');
+
+     // Three ways, and only three. The five weekdays used to hang off the sky
+     // directly, which put the whole week at one level and left no way at all
+     // into the hours you are standing in. What a person asks is what happens
+     // for the rest of today, what tomorrow is, and what the week looks like,
+     // so those are the three things the sky opens onto — and each of them
+     // opens further.
+     const today = week[0];
+     const tomorrow = week[1];
+     const ways: Way[] = [];
+     if (today) {
+       const left = hoursOn(sim, city.id, sim.now).length;
+       ways.push({
+         to: at('hours', `${city.id}/${today.dateKey}`),
+         label: 'The Rest Of Today',
+         detail: left <= 1
+           ? 'The last hour of the day, and its weather'
+           : `${toStart(countWord(left))} hours left, hour by hour to midnight`,
+       });
+     }
+     if (tomorrow) {
+       ways.push({
+         to: at('forecastday', `${city.id}/${tomorrow.dateKey}`),
+         label: 'Tomorrow',
+         detail: `${tomorrow.condition}, ${tomorrow.low}${unit} to ${tomorrow.high}${unit}`,
+       });
+     }
+     ways.push({
+       to: at('skyweek', city.id),
+       label: 'The Week Ahead',
+       detail: `${toStart(countWord(week.length))} days, each of which you can open`,
+     });
+
+     return {
+       name: `Weather In ${spokenName(city.name)}`,
+       kind: 'Weather Now',
+       parent: at('place', city.id),
+       summary: city.id === sim.player.currentLocationId
+         ? `It’s ${now.temperature}${unit} and ${DOING[now.condition]} where you are, `
+           + `with a high of ${now.high}${unit} and a low of ${now.low}${unit} today.`
+         : `It’s ${now.temperature}${unit} and ${DOING[now.condition]} in ${spokenName(city.name)}, `
+           + `with a high of ${now.high}${unit} and a low of ${now.low}${unit} today. You’re not there.`,
+       body: (
+         <>
+           <p className="small">
+             The wind is {windOf(now)} and the humidity is {now.humidity}%. Today is{' '}
+             {againstNormal(now)}.
+           </p>
+           <p className="small">
+             {wetNames.length === 0
+               ? `The ${countWord(ahead.length)} days after today are all dry.`
+               : wetNames.length === ahead.length
+                 ? `The ${countWord(ahead.length)} days after today are all wet.`
+                 : `${spokenList(wetNames)} ${isAre(wetNames.length)} wet, and the rest of the week is dry.`}
+           </p>
+           <div className="grid grid-3">
+             <Stat label="Right Now" value={`${now.temperature}${unit}`} note={now.condition} />
+             <Stat label="High" value={`${now.high}${unit}`} note="The warmest it gets today" />
+             <Stat label="Low" value={`${now.low}${unit}`} note="Overnight" />
+             <Stat label="Wind" value={windOf(now)} note={now.condition === 'Windy' ? 'A windy day' : 'Not a windy day'} />
+             <Stat label="Humidity" value={`${now.humidity}%`} note="How much water is in the air" />
+             <Stat
+               label="Against Usual"
+               value={`${offNormal(now) > 0 ? '+' : ''}${offNormal(now)}°`}
+               note="Compared with this date’s normal"
+             />
+           </div>
+         </>
+       ),
+       facets: [
+         {
+           id: 'band',
+           label: 'What It’s Usually Like',
+           body: (
+             <>
+               <p className="small">
+                 {spokenName(city.name)} has a {now.climateName.toLowerCase()} climate: {BAND[now.climate]}.
+               </p>
+               <p className="small">
+                 On {dateWords(now.dateKey)} it usually reaches about {normalHigh(sim, city, now)}{unit} here,
+                 and today is {againstNormal(now)}.
+               </p>
+               {/* Where the thunder’s count comes from: until 2026-09-27 its source was kept and not shown. */}
+               <p className="xs dim">
+                 About {thunderDaysFor(city.id, now.climate)} days of thunder a year here{THUNDER_DAYS[city.id] ? `, as published: ${THUNDER_DAYS[city.id]!.source}` : `, estimated for a ${now.climateName.toLowerCase()} climate`}.
+               </p>
+             </>
+           ),
+         },
+       ],
+       ways,
+       provenance: `Estimated from a climate model for ${spokenName(city.name)}: the season, the latitude and the kind of climate it has. It isn’t a real forecast.`,
+     };
+   },
+ });
+
+ // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+ // One day of the week ahead
+ // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+ interface Ahead { city: City; day: DayWeather; offset: number }
+
+ /** `cityId/dateKey`, so a day belongs to a place rather than to the calendar. */
+ function splitDayId(id: string): { cityId: string; dateKey: string } | undefined {
+   const cut = id.lastIndexOf('/');
+   if (cut <= 0) return undefined;
+   return { cityId: id.slice(0, cut), dateKey: id.slice(cut + 1) };
+ }
+
+ defineLook<Ahead>('forecastday', {
+   gone: 'That day has passed, so it’s no longer in the week ahead.',
+   resolve: (sim, id) => {
+     const split = splitDayId(id);
+     if (!split) return undefined;
+     const city = CITIES.get(split.cityId);
+     if (!city) return undefined;
+     const found = dayOfKey(sim, city, split.dateKey);
+     return found ? { city, day: found.day, offset: found.offset } : undefined;
+   },
+   seeds: (sim) => {
+     const city = cityFor(sim, '');
+     if (!city) return [];
+     return forecastFor(sim, city.id, WEEK).map((d) => `${city.id}/${d.dateKey}`);
+   },
+   look: (ahead, { sim }) => {
+     const { city, day, offset } = ahead;
+     const unit = unitOf(day);
+     const when = offset === 0 ? 'today' : offset === 1 ? 'tomorrow' : `on ${weekdayAt(sim, city, offset)}`;
+     const instant = noonOf(sim.now, offset, city.timeZone);
+
+     const ways: Way[] = [{
+       to: at('hours', `${city.id}/${day.dateKey}`),
+       label: offset === 0 ? 'The Rest Of Today' : 'Hour By Hour',
+       detail: offset === 0
+         ? 'The hours left today, one at a time'
+         // From the day’s first hour, which is one where the clocks skip midnight.
+         : `Its weather through the day, ${clockSaid(zonedParts(startOfDay(instant, city.timeZone), city.timeZone).hour)} to ${clockSaid(23)}`,
+     }];
+     // Either side of it, but only inside the week. Any day resolves — a
+     // commitment three weeks out opens into the sky over it — and offering
+     // each of those a day before and a day after would make the graph an
+     // endless line, walkable forever and worth walking nowhere. Near the
+     // present, stepping through the days is what a person does; far from it,
+     // you got here from the thing that happens on it.
+     const nearby = Math.abs(offset) < WEEK;
+     const neighbour = (step: -1 | 1) => forecastFor(sim, city.id, 1, noonOf(sim.now, offset + step, city.timeZone))[0];
+     for (const step of nearby ? ([-1, 1] as const) : []) {
+       const beside = neighbour(step);
+       if (!beside) continue;
+       ways.push({
+         to: at('forecastday', `${city.id}/${beside.dateKey}`),
+         label: weekdayAt(sim, city, offset + step),
+         detail: step < 0
+           ? `The day before it: ${beside.condition}, ${beside.low}${unit} to ${beside.high}${unit}`
+           : `The day after it: ${beside.condition}, ${beside.low}${unit} to ${beside.high}${unit}`,
+       });
+     }
+
+     return {
+       name: weekdayAt(sim, city, offset),
+       kind: WHEN_KIND[offset] ?? (offset < 0 ? 'A Day Gone' : 'Further Out'),
+       // A day sits inside the week, and the week inside the sky. The trail
+       // reads Reykjavík · Weather · The Week Ahead · Thursday, which is the
+       // way a person got there.
+       parent: at('skyweek', city.id),
+       summary: `${toStart(BRINGS[day.condition])} in ${spokenName(city.name)} ${when}, `
+         + `${day.low}${unit} to ${day.high}${unit}.`,
+       body: (
+         <>
+           <p className="small">
+             {dateWords(day.dateKey)}: wind {windOf(day)}, humidity {day.humidity}%, and the day is{' '}
+             {againstNormal(day)}.
+           </p>
+           <div className="grid grid-3">
+             <Stat label="High" value={`${day.high}${unit}`} note="Around 3 PM" />
+             <Stat label="Low" value={`${day.low}${unit}`} note="Around 3 AM" />
+             <Stat label="Wind" value={windOf(day)} note={day.condition} />
+           </div>
+         </>
+       ),
+       ways,
+       provenance: 'Each day’s weather is simulated and blended with the two days before it, so a cold snap lasts and a wet spell lingers.',
+     };
+   },
+ });
+
+ // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+ // The rest of today, and the hours of any day
+ // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+ /**
+  * `cityId/dateKey`, the same shape a forecast day uses.
+  *
+  * Asked for today it gives the hours you have left; asked for any other day it
+  * gives every hour its clock reads, once. That is not two kinds — it is the same thing, read
+  * from where you are standing in it, which is exactly what "the rest of today"
+  * means to a person.
+  */
+ interface Hours { city: City; day: DayWeather; hours: HourWeather[]; today: boolean; offset: number }
+
+ /**
+  * The stretch of the day an hour belongs to, in the words a person uses.
+  *
+  * Noon and midnight name themselves, so they get nothing: "at noon it’s five
+  * degrees, in the afternoon" is the sentence a clock would write and not one
+  * a person would.
+  */
+ function stretchOf(hour: number): string {
+   if (hour === 0 || hour === 12) return '';
+   if (hour < 5) return 'the small hours';
+   if (hour < 12) return 'the morning';
+   if (hour < 17) return 'the afternoon';
+   if (hour < 21) return 'the evening';
+   return 'the night';
+ }
+
+ /** "3 PM", "Midnight", "Noon" — never "15:00". A name, so Title Case. */
+ export function clockWord(hour: number): string {
+   if (hour === 0) return 'Midnight';
+   if (hour === 12) return 'Noon';
+   const twelve = hour % 12 === 0 ? 12 : hour % 12;
+   return `${twelve} ${hour < 12 ? 'AM' : 'PM'}`;
+ }
+
+ /**
+  * The same clock inside a sentence.
+  *
+  * "midnight" and "noon" are ordinary words and lowercase there, but AM and PM
+  * are not — lowercasing the whole thing gave "at 9 am", which no style sheet
+  * in the world writes.
+  */
+ function clockSaid(hour: number): string {
+   if (hour === 0 || hour === 12) return clockWord(hour).toLowerCase();
+   return clockWord(hour);
+ }
+
+ /**
+  * The warmest and coldest hour, tie broken where the curve actually turns.
+  *
+  * The reading is whole degrees, so on a day with a three-degree range one in
+  * the afternoon through five all say the same thing. Keeping whichever a scan
+  * met first named one o’clock as the warmest hour of a day that peaks at
+  * three, which is true of the printed number and false about the day.
+  */
+ function extremesOf(hours: readonly HourWeather[]): { warmest: HourWeather; coldest: HourWeather } {
+   const nearest = (pick: HourWeather[], turn: number) =>
+     pick.reduce((a, b) => (Math.abs(b.hour - turn) < Math.abs(a.hour - turn) ? b : a));
+   const top = Math.max(...hours.map((h) => h.temperature));
+   const bottom = Math.min(...hours.map((h) => h.temperature));
+   return {
+     warmest: nearest(hours.filter((h) => h.temperature === top), 15),
+     coldest: nearest(hours.filter((h) => h.temperature === bottom), 4),
+   };
+ }
+
+ /**
+  * How many days a date key sits from today, in this city’s own reckoning.
+  *
+  * Worked out from the key rather than by searching the week, so the sky is
+  * askable about any day the calendar can reach. It used to scan a six-day
+  * forecast and return nothing beyond it, which meant a commitment three weeks
+  * out could not open into the hour it happens in — the chain simply stopped,
+  * with nothing saying why.
+  */
+ function offsetOfDay(sim: Simulation, city: City, key: string): number | undefined {
+   if (!A_DATE.test(key)) return undefined;
+   const [year, month, day] = key.split('-').map(Number);
+   if (!year || !month || !day) return undefined;
+   const midnight = instantFromZoned({ year, month, day, hour: 12 }, city.timeZone);
+   const today = startOfDay(sim.now, city.timeZone);
+   const offset = Math.round((startOfDay(midnight, city.timeZone) - today) / MS_DAY);
+   return Math.abs(offset) <= HORIZON_DAYS ? offset : undefined;
+ }
+
+ /** The weather on the day a key names, wherever it falls. */
+ function dayOfKey(sim: Simulation, city: City, key: string): { day: DayWeather; offset: number } | undefined {
+   const offset = offsetOfDay(sim, city, key);
+   if (offset === undefined) return undefined;
+   const day = forecastFor(sim, city.id, 1, noonOf(sim.now, offset, city.timeZone))[0];
+   return day && day.dateKey === key ? { day, offset } : undefined;
+ }
+
+ /** Where a day’s hours start from: now if it is today, the start of the day otherwise (one in the morning where the clocks skip midnight). */
+ function hoursFor(sim: Simulation, city: City, key: string): { hours: HourWeather[]; today: boolean; offset: number } {
+   const offset = offsetOfDay(sim, city, key);
+   if (offset === undefined) return { hours: [], today: false, offset: -1 };
+   const today = offset === 0;
+   const from = today ? sim.now : startOfDay(noonOf(sim.now, offset, city.timeZone), city.timeZone);
+   return { hours: hoursOn(sim, city.id, from), today, offset };
+ }
+
+ /** When the wet stretch of a day runs, said as a person would say it. */
+ function spellSentence(hours: readonly HourWeather[]): string {
+   const wet = hours.filter((h) => h.wet);
+   if (wet.length === 0) return 'They’re all dry.';
+   const first = wet[0]!;
+   const last = wet[wet.length - 1]!;
+   if (wet.length === 1) return `It’s wet for one hour, around ${clockSaid(first.hour)}.`;
+   return `It’s wet from around ${clockSaid(first.hour)} until about `
+     + `${clockSaid(Math.min(23, last.hour + 1))}: ${countWord(wet.length)} hours.`;
+ }
+
+ defineLook<Hours>('hours', {
+   gone: 'That day has passed, so its hours aren’t shown any more.',
+   resolve: (sim, id) => {
+     const split = splitDayId(id);
+     if (!split) return undefined;
+     const city = CITIES.get(split.cityId);
+     if (!city) return undefined;
+     const day = dayOfKey(sim, city, split.dateKey)?.day;
+     if (!day) return undefined;
+     const { hours, today, offset } = hoursFor(sim, city, split.dateKey);
+     if (hours.length === 0) return undefined;
+     return { city, day, hours, today, offset };
+   },
+   seeds: (sim) => {
+     const city = cityFor(sim, '');
+     if (!city) return [];
+     return forecastFor(sim, city.id, WEEK).map((d) => `${city.id}/${d.dateKey}`);
+   },
+   look: (found, { sim }) => {
+     const { city, day, hours, today, offset } = found;
+     const unit = unitOf(day);
+     const { warmest, coldest } = extremesOf(hours);
+     const dark = hours.filter((h) => !h.daylight).length;
+
+     return {
+       name: today ? 'The Rest Of Today' : `${weekdayAt(sim, city, offset)}’s Hours`,
+       kind: 'Hour By Hour',
+       parent: at('forecastday', `${city.id}/${day.dateKey}`),
+       summary: today
+         ? `There are ${countWord(hours.length)} hours of ${dateWords(day.dateKey)} left, between `
+           + `${coldest.temperature}${unit} and ${warmest.temperature}${unit}.`
+         : `${dateWords(day.dateKey)} goes from ${coldest.temperature}${unit} at ${clockSaid(coldest.hour)} up to `
+           + `${warmest.temperature}${unit} at ${clockSaid(warmest.hour)}.`,
+       body: (
+         <>
+           <p className="small">
+             The warmest hour is {clockSaid(warmest.hour)}, at {warmest.temperature}{unit}, and the
+             coldest is {clockSaid(coldest.hour)}, at {coldest.temperature}{unit}.{' '}
+             {dark === 0 ? 'The sun is up for all of them.' : dark === hours.length ? 'They’re all after dark.' : `${toStart(countWord(dark))} of them ${dark === 1 ? 'is' : 'are'} after dark.`}
+           </p>
+           <p className="small">{spellSentence(hours)}</p>
+         </>
+       ),
+       waysAs: 'strip',
+       ways: hours.map((hour) => ({
+         to: at('skyhour', `${city.id}/${day.dateKey}/${hour.hour}`),
+         label: clockWord(hour.hour),
+         detail: `${hour.temperature}${unit}, ${hour.condition.toLowerCase()}${hour.daylight ? '' : ', after dark'}`,
+         glance: {
+           icon: WEATHER_EMOJI[hour.condition],
+           lines: [`${hour.temperature}°`, hour.daylight ? 'Light' : 'Dark'],
+         },
+       })),
+       provenance: 'Each hour is estimated from one curve between the day’s high and low, coldest around 3 AM and warmest around 3 PM, with any wet spell at the time of day the forecast gives it.',
+     };
+   },
+ });
+
+ // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+ // One hour — the floor of the sky
+ // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+ interface OneHour { city: City; day: DayWeather; hour: HourWeather; hours: HourWeather[]; index: number }
+
+ defineLook<OneHour>('skyhour', {
+   gone: 'That hour has passed, so it isn’t shown any more.',
+   resolve: (sim, id) => {
+     const cut = id.lastIndexOf('/');
+     if (cut <= 0) return undefined;
+     const wanted = Number(id.slice(cut + 1));
+     const split = splitDayId(id.slice(0, cut));
+     if (!split || !Number.isInteger(wanted)) return undefined;
+     const city = CITIES.get(split.cityId);
+     if (!city) return undefined;
+     const day = dayOfKey(sim, city, split.dateKey)?.day;
+     if (!day) return undefined;
+     const { hours } = hoursFor(sim, city, split.dateKey);
+     const index = hours.findIndex((h) => h.hour === wanted);
+     const hour = hours[index];
+     if (!hour) return undefined;
+     return { city, day, hour, hours, index };
+   },
+   seeds: (sim) => {
+     const city = cityFor(sim, '');
+     if (!city) return [];
+     const day = forecastFor(sim, city.id, WEEK)[0];
+     if (!day) return [];
+     return hoursOn(sim, city.id, sim.now).slice(0, 4).map((h) => `${city.id}/${day.dateKey}/${h.hour}`);
+   },
+   look: (found) => {
+     const { city, day, hour, hours, index } = found;
+     const unit = unitOf(day);
+     const before = hours[index - 1];
+     const after = hours[index + 1];
+     const swing = after ? after.temperature - hour.temperature : 0;
+
+     const ways: Way[] = [];
+     if (before) {
+       ways.push({
+         to: at('skyhour', `${city.id}/${day.dateKey}/${before.hour}`),
+         label: clockWord(before.hour),
+         detail: `The hour before it: ${before.temperature}${unit}, ${before.condition.toLowerCase()}`,
+       });
+     }
+     if (after) {
+       ways.push({
+         to: at('skyhour', `${city.id}/${day.dateKey}/${after.hour}`),
+         label: clockWord(after.hour),
+         detail: `The hour after it: ${after.temperature}${unit}, ${after.condition.toLowerCase()}`,
+       });
+     }
+
+     return {
+       name: clockWord(hour.hour),
+       kind: 'One Hour',
+       parent: at('hours', `${city.id}/${day.dateKey}`),
+       summary: `At ${clockSaid(hour.hour)} it’s ${hour.temperature}${unit} and ${DOING[hour.condition]} `
+         + `in ${spokenName(city.name)}${stretchOf(hour.hour) ? `, in ${stretchOf(hour.hour)}` : ''}.`,
+       body: (
+         <>
+           <p className="small">
+             {hour.daylight ? 'The sun is up' : 'It’s dark'}, the wind is {windOf(day)}, and{' '}
+             {hour.wet
+               ? `there’s ${BRINGS[hour.condition]}.`
+               : 'it’s dry.'}
+             {' '}
+             {swing === 0 ? 'The next hour is the same temperature.'
+               : swing > 0 ? `The next hour is ${countWord(Math.abs(swing))} degrees warmer.`
+                 : `The next hour is ${countWord(Math.abs(swing))} degrees colder.`}
+           </p>
+         </>
+       ),
+       ways,
+       provenance: `Estimated from ${dateWords(day.dateKey)}’s forecast, and the same every time you look.`,
+     };
+   },
+ });
+
+ // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+ // The week ahead, held in one view
+ // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+ interface TheWeek { city: City; days: DayWeather[] }
+
+ defineLook<TheWeek>('skyweek', {
+   gone: 'That place isn’t on the map, so there’s no week of weather to show for it.',
+   resolve: (sim, id) => {
+     const city = cityFor(sim, id);
+     if (!city) return undefined;
+     const days = forecastFor(sim, city.id, WEEK);
+     return days.length > 0 ? { city, days } : undefined;
+   },
+   seeds: (sim) => [sim.player.currentLocationId],
+   look: (found, { sim }) => {
+     const { city, days } = found;
+     const unit = unitOf(days[0] ?? ({ fahrenheit: false } as DayWeather));
+     const highs = days.map((d) => d.high);
+     const lows = days.map((d) => d.low);
+     const warmest = days.reduce((a, b) => (b.high > a.high ? b : a));
+     const wet = days.filter((d) => d.precipitation !== 'none');
+     // Today and tomorrow have names of their own. Calling today "Monday" in a
+     // sentence a person reads on Monday is what a table does, not a person.
+     const dayName = (i: number) => (i === 0 ? 'today' : i === 1 ? 'tomorrow' : weekdayAt(sim, city, i));
+     const wetNames = wet.map((d) => dayName(days.indexOf(d)));
+
+     return {
+       name: 'The Week Ahead',
+       kind: 'Six Days Of Weather',
+       parent: at('weather', city.id),
+       summary: `${sentenceStart(countWord(days.length))} days in ${spokenName(city.name)}, from ${Math.min(...lows)}${unit} `
+         + `to ${Math.max(...highs)}${unit}, ${wet.length === 0 ? 'and all of them dry' : `with ${countWord(wet.length)} of them wet`}.`,
+       body: (
+         <>
+           <p className="small">
+             The warmest is {dayName(days.indexOf(warmest))} at {warmest.high}{unit}.{' '}
+             {wetNames.length === 0
+               ? 'It’s dry all week.'
+               : wetNames.length === days.length
+                 ? `All ${countWord(days.length)} days are wet.`
+                 : `${sentenceStart(spokenList(wetNames))} ${isAre(wetNames.length)} the wet ${wetNames.length === 1 ? 'one' : 'ones'}.`}
+           </p>
+           <p className="small">
+             Each day’s weather is blended with the two days before it, so the days follow on from each other:
+             a cold snap lasts, and a wet spell lingers.
+           </p>
+         </>
+       ),
+       waysAs: 'strip',
+       ways: days.map((day, i) => ({
+         to: at('forecastday', `${city.id}/${day.dateKey}`),
+         label: i === 0 ? 'Today' : i === 1 ? 'Tomorrow' : weekdayAt(sim, city, i).slice(0, 3),
+         detail: `${day.condition}, ${day.low}${unit} to ${day.high}${unit}`,
+         glance: {
+           icon: WEATHER_EMOJI[day.condition],
+           lines: [weatherShort(day.condition), `${day.high}° / ${day.low}°`],
+         },
+       })),
+       provenance: 'Six days estimated from a climate model. It isn’t a real forecast.',
+     };
+   },
+ });
+
+ /**
+  * SLATE — you, and the eight dials the day moves.
+  *
+  * Home shows two of them under a readiness figure. The other six, sleep debt,
+  * morale, condition, fitness, nourishment and hygiene, appeared on no screen
+  * until this page, which said so to the player long after it was showing them.
+  * This is exposure, not invention — every sentence below is
+  * `person.wellbeing`, read out.
+  *
+  * Travel fatigue was a ninth until the sweep that took it out. Nothing in this
+  * build ever raised it, so it sat at nought for a whole life and its term in
+  * readiness was a fixed 1.0; a dial a player is invited to watch has to be able
+  * to move.
+  *
+  * Readiness is the exception and is treated as one. It is a product of seven
+  * of the eight, six until condition joined them, and it is not stored
+  * anywhere. It opens into a sentence about what
+  * is holding it back and ways into the dials actually doing the holding,
+  * because a dial is a thing and a multiplication is not.
+  */
+
+ import {
+   A_NORMAL_DAYS_DEBT, EMPTY, EVERYDAY_FITNESS, FITNESS, OVERWROUGHT, mendsTo, moraleSettlesAt, readiness, readinessParts, wellbeingSummary, workoutCosts,
+ } from '@/engine/systems/life';
+ import { EVALUATION } from '@/engine/content/tasks';
+ import { theCountry } from '@/engine/systems/documents';
+ import { plural } from '@/engine/core/text';
+ import type { Person, Wellbeing } from '@/engine/domain/model';
+ import { ESTIMATE as SCHOOL_ESTIMATE, schoolEnded } from '@/engine/systems/school';
+ import type { Simulation } from '@/engine';
+ import { defineLook, type Way } from './registry';
+ import { at } from './subject';
+ import { isAre, outOf, spokenList } from './words';
+ import { GENRE_BY_ID } from '@/engine/content/film-genres';
+ import { KNOB_READS, PERSONALITY_TRAIT_BY_ID, type PersonalityKnob } from '@/engine/content/personality-traits';
+ import { personalityOf } from '@/engine/systems/personality';
+ import { CONDITION_LABEL, type Condition } from '@/engine/systems/health';
+ import { CHRONIC } from '@/engine/content/safetynet';
+ import { ageWords, ceilingAt } from '@/engine/content/lifespan';
+ import { describeEthnicity } from '@/engine/content/ethnicity';
+ import { COUNTRIES } from '@/engine/content/geography';
+ import { bmiOf, bmiWord, bodyUnits, type Body } from '@/engine/systems/body';
+ import { injuryKeeps, injuryOf } from '@/engine/systems/injury';
+ import { formatDate } from '@/engine/core/time';
+ import { INJURY_KIND } from '@/engine/content/injury';
+ import { ONSET } from '@/engine/content/body';
+
+ /**
+  * A body in words: its height and weight, in feet and pounds or centimeters and kilograms, and its body mass index in
+  * the WHO’s range. Until 2026-10-17 (brief 14) the range was tacked on after a colon, "a body mass index of 22.5:
+  * healthy weight".
+  */
+ function bodyWords(body: Body, imperial: boolean): string {
+   const bmi = bmiOf(body);
+   const index = `with a body mass index of ${bmi.toFixed(1)}, in the ${bmiWord(bmi).toLowerCase()} range`;
+   if (imperial) {
+     const inches = Math.round(body.heightCm / 2.54);
+     return `${Math.floor(inches / 12)} ft ${inches % 12} in and ${Math.round(body.weightKg / 0.45359237)} lb, ${index}`;
+   }
+   return `${Math.round(body.heightCm)} cm and ${body.weightKg.toFixed(1)} kg, ${index}`;
+ }
+
+ /** The words somebody is spoken of in: "you" for the player, and anybody else in their own pronouns. */
+ interface Spoken { they: string; them: string; their: string; are: string; s: (verb: string) => string }
+
+ /**
+  * The player is "you". Anybody else is spoken of in the pronouns on their papers: she/her and he/him in the singular,
+  * and they/them, or pronouns SLATE doesn’t know, as "they" (from 2026-10-15). Until then the person look, the trait
+  * look and the condition look said "they" of everybody but the player, so a she/her person read "Their body." above
+  * "On their papers. she/her": changing her pronouns changed only that line.
+  */
+ function spokenOf(person: Person, isYou: boolean): Spoken {
+   const third = (v: string) => (/[^aeiou]y$/.test(v) ? `${v.slice(0, -1)}ies` : `${v}s`);
+   if (isYou) return { they: 'you', them: 'you', their: 'your', are: 'are', s: (v) => v };
+   if (/^\s*she\b/i.test(person.pronouns ?? '')) return { they: 'she', them: 'her', their: 'her', are: 'is', s: third };
+   if (/^\s*he\b/i.test(person.pronouns ?? '')) return { they: 'he', them: 'him', their: 'his', are: 'is', s: third };
+   return { they: 'they', them: 'them', their: 'their', are: 'are', s: (v) => v };
+ }
+ const upper = (w: string) => w.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + w.slice(1);
+ /** A label said in a sentence: "A Broken Bone" as "A broken bone". */
+ const sentenceCase = (label: string) => label.charAt(0) + label.slice(1).toLowerCase();
+
+ /**
+  * The eight, in the order a person would notice them.
+  *
+  * `behind` is what the way in says next to the figure. The figure alone —
+  * "82/100" — names the dial twice and says nothing about what moves it, which
+  * is the whole reason a person would open one. Each names what the dial
+  * decides, and the engine does what it names: morale said "whether the work
+  * feels worth doing", condition "what a long day would find" and fitness
+  * "what a physical day would cost" while nothing read any of the three.
+  * It is said of whoever the dials belong to (from 2026-10-15: until then
+  * another person’s look said "what the day has left in you" of them).
+  *
+  * From 2026-10-17 (brief 14) `behind` says what the measure is before what it
+  * decides, in sentences: until then it was a clause after the figure, "82/100,
+  * and how far rest can mend you, and what a workout costs", which named what
+  * fitness decided and never what fitness was. `what` is the player’s own
+  * explanation, the body of the measure’s look, and the place the game says
+  * plainly that energy, condition, fitness (the Player Profile’s Stamina) and
+  * health are four things.
+  */
+ const DIALS = [
+   { key: 'energy', name: 'Energy', unit: 'level', behind: (p: Spoken) => `What’s left in ${p.them} for today. Sleep brings it back` },
+   { key: 'stress', name: 'Stress', unit: 'level', behind: (p: Spoken) => `How wound up ${p.they} ${p.are}. High stress spoils ${p.their} sleep` },
+   { key: 'sleepDebt', name: 'Sleep Debt', unit: 'hours', behind: (p: Spoken) => `Sleep ${p.they} ${p.s('owe')}, which a night pays back` },
+   { key: 'morale', name: 'Morale', unit: 'level', behind: (p: Spoken) => `${upper(p.their)} mood. When it’s up, a night clears more of the day’s stress` },
+   { key: 'condition', name: 'Condition', unit: 'level', behind: (p: Spoken) => `How sound ${p.their} body is. It sets how much energy a night gives back, where ${p.their} morale settles, when a sick day is excused, and how likely a year is to be ${p.their} last` },
+   { key: 'fitness', name: 'Fitness', unit: 'level', behind: (p: Spoken) => `How trained ${p.their} body is${p.they === 'you' ? ': the Stamina on your Player Profile' : ''}. It sets how far rest can mend ${p.their} condition and how much energy a workout costs` },
+   { key: 'nourishment', name: 'Nourishment', unit: 'level', behind: (p: Spoken) => `How well fed ${p.they} ${p.are}. A meal puts it back` },
+   { key: 'hygiene', name: 'Hygiene', unit: 'level', behind: (p: Spoken) => `How clean ${p.they} ${p.are}. When it’s low, it drags on ${p.their} morale, and on readiness a little` },

+ /** What each measure is, said to the player on its own look (from 2026-10-17, brief 14). */
+ const WHAT: Record<DialKey, string> = {
+   energy: 'Energy is what you have left for today. It runs down every hour you’re awake, faster when you owe sleep. Only sleep brings it back: a meal doesn’t. Your stamina is something else: how long you can keep going in a long scene or a night on stage. So is your condition: how sound your body is.',
+   stress: `Stress is how wound up you are. It eases while you have energy left and climbs once you run out, and money you owe adds to it every day. Over ${OVERWROUGHT}, it wears your condition down every hour.`,

+   morale: 'Morale is your mood. Meals, workouts, unwinding and good nights lift it. Hunger, grime, money trouble and an injury pull it down.',
+   condition: 'Condition is how sound your body is. Illness, hunger, stress and short nights wear it down, and a good night’s rest mends it, as far as your fitness allows. Energy is about today, and condition changes more slowly. Your health is something else again: a long-term condition such as asthma, your health cover and your medical care are on Papers, under Health Cover.',

Working out builds it. It holds for ${plural(FITNESS.heldDays, 'day')} after a workout, then slowly falls. Rest doesn’t build it: rest brings back energy and condition.`,
+   nourishment: 'Nourishment is how well fed you are. It falls every hour you’re awake, and a meal puts it back.',
+   hygiene: 'Hygiene is how clean you are. It falls through the day, and a shower puts it back.',

+ type DialKey = typeof DIALS[number]['key'];

+ const dialOf = (key: string) => DIALS.find((d) => d.key === key);
+ const valueOf = (w: Wellbeing, key: DialKey): number => Number(w[key] ?? 0);

+ /** `personId/dial`, so a dial belongs to somebody rather than to the game. */
+ function splitDialId(id: string): { personId: string; key: string } | undefined {
+   const cut = id.lastIndexOf('/');

+         {`${person.pronouns?.trim() ? `Pronouns ${person.pronouns.trim()}. ` : ''}A citizen of ${theCountry(COUNTRIES.get(person.citizenshipId)?.name ?? person.citizenshipId)}.`}
+       </p>,

+       name: isYou ? (person.displayName || person.firstName) : person.displayName,

+ // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+ // One of the eight
+ // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+ interface Dial { person: Person; key: DialKey; name: string; value: number; unit: string }
+
+ defineLook<Dial>('dial', {
+   gone: 'That isn’t something the body keeps track of any more.',
+   resolve: (sim, id) => {
+     const split = splitDialId(id);
+     if (!split) return undefined;
+     const person = personIn(sim, split.personId);
+     const dial = dialOf(split.key);
+     if (!person || !dial) return undefined;
+     return { person, key: dial.key, name: dial.name, value: valueOf(person.wellbeing, dial.key), unit: dial.unit };
+   },
+   seeds: (sim) => DIALS.map((d) => `${sim.universe.playerId}/${d.key}`),
+   // Whose wellbeing it is, and, for the player, what the measure is (from 2026-10-17, brief 14: until then the kind was
+   // "One Of Eight" and the look said where the figure stood but never what it was).
+   look: (dial, { sim }) => {
+     const isYou = dial.person.id === sim.universe.playerId;
+     const p = spokenOf(dial.person, isYou);
+     return {
+       name: dial.name,
+       kind: `${upper(p.their)} Wellbeing`,
+       parent: at('person', dial.person.id),
+       summary: sentenceFor(dial, sim.now, p),
+       body: isYou ? <p className="small">{WHAT[dial.key]}</p> : undefined,
+       // A sentence, where it was the fragment "From 0 to 100." (until 2026-10-20, brief 17).
+       provenance: dial.unit === 'hours'
+         ? 'Counted in hours. Each waking hour adds about a third of an hour, and a night pays it back, a long night faster. A night under six hours adds some too, and the shortest add more than they pay back.'
+         : 'It runs from 0 to 100, and it changes with every hour the clock runs.',
+     };
+   },
+ });
+
+ /**
+  * What the number actually means, right now, said of whoever the dial belongs to: "you" of the player, and anybody else
+  * in their own pronouns (`spokenOf`). Until 2026-10-15 it was said in the second person of everybody, so another
+  * person’s Energy, one press from her look’s "what the day has left in her", read "you’ve a full day in you".
+  *
+  * Where a dial decides something, the sentence says what, with the engine’s
+  * own figure: condition, fitness, morale and hygiene read what the night, a
+  * workout and the mood are actually given. They said "long days will find
+  * it", "A stunt day would cost you a week" and "Rooms notice" when nothing
+  * did any of it.
+  */
+ function sentenceFor(dial: Dial, now: number, p: Spoken): string {
+   const n = Math.round(dial.value);
+   const w = dial.person.wellbeing;
+   const one = p.are === 'is';
+   // "You’re", "she’s", "they’re". "You’ve had" and "she has" a day in her went with their sentences on 2026-10-17.
+   const theyAre = `${p.they}’${one ? 's' : 're'}`;
+   switch (dial.key) {
+     case 'energy':
+       return n > 75 ? `${n}. Plenty for a full day.`
+         : n > 40 ? `${n}. Enough for today, but not much more.`
+           : dial.value >= EMPTY ? `${n}. ${upper(theyAre)} running low, and it pulls readiness down. Under ${EMPTY}, stress starts to climb.`
+             : `${n}. ${upper(theyAre)} running on empty, so stress is climbing and readiness is down. Only sleep brings energy back.`;
+     case 'stress':
+       return n < 25 ? `${n}. Not much is adding to it. Running out of energy would, and so would money trouble or bad nights.`
+         : n < 60 ? `${n}. Noticeable, but manageable. The higher it is, the longer it takes to clear.`
+           : `${n}. High enough to spoil ${p.their} sleep, and bad sleep adds more.${n > OVERWROUGHT ? ` Over ${OVERWROUGHT}, it’s wearing ${p.their} condition down every hour.` : ''}`;
+     case 'sleepDebt':
+       // A day awake puts debt on the books as it goes, 5.4 hours by eleven
+       // after a day up from seven, and a night pays it back. Counted as owed,
+       // this said "5 hours owed. One long night would clear it." while the
+       // Sleep dialog offered the same evening a normal eight hours. It is the
+       // day’s only when they woke owing next to nothing: in the morning after
+       // a short night, the same five hours are what the night left.
+       return n < 2 ? `None to speak of. ${upper(theyAre)} caught up on sleep.`
+         : (dial.person.wokeWithDebt ?? dial.value) < 2 && dial.value < A_NORMAL_DAYS_DEBT + 2
+           ? `${plural(n, 'hour')}, about what a normal day awake adds. A night’s sleep pays it back.`
+           : n < 12 ? `${plural(n, 'hour')} owed. One long night would clear it.`
+             : `${plural(n, 'hour')} owed. Until it’s paid back, ${p.their} energy runs down faster and a night gives back less.`;
+     case 'morale': {
+       // Even at 62.5, where a night clears its usual share of stress.
+       const settles = Math.round(moraleSettlesAt(dial.person, w.condition, now));
+       const mood = n > 70 ? 'In good spirits' : n > 40 ? 'Steady' : 'Low';
+       return `${n}. ${mood}. Each night moves it toward ${settles}. `
+         + (n >= 63 ? 'Above 62, a night clears more of the day’s stress than usual.'
+           : 'Under 63, a night clears less of the day’s stress than usual.');
+     }
+     case 'condition': {
+       const mends = Math.round(mendsTo(dial.person, now));
+       const share = Math.round(100 * (0.8 + 0.2 * Math.min(1, w.condition / mendsTo(dial.person, now))));
+       // What the dial decides, and the midnight pull toward the same mark.
+       // On the figure the school reads, not the one shown rounded (from 2026-10-13: until then 54.8, shown as 55, left the
+       // line out where the school would excuse the day; found by the review of that day).
+       const also = `${dial.person.school && dial.value < SCHOOL_ESTIMATE.sickBelow ? ` Under ${SCHOOL_ESTIMATE.sickBelow}, a sick day from classes is excused.` : ''} The lower it is, the likelier a year is to be ${p.their} last.`;
+       return n >= mends ? `${n}. As sound as rest can make ${p.them} at ${p.their} fitness.${n > mends ? ` Above ${mends}, it settles back toward ${mends} each midnight.` : ''}${also}`
+         : `${n}. Rest can mend it to ${mends} at ${p.their} fitness, and each midnight brings it a little closer.${share < 100 ? ` Until then, a night gives back only ${share}% of the energy it normally would.` : ''}${also}`;
+     }
+     case 'fitness': {
+       const mends = Math.round(mendsTo(dial.person, now));
+       const costs = Math.round(workoutCosts(dial.person));
+       // The age’s ceiling, which training can’t pass, and what the years are like now.
+       const age = (now - dial.person.birthInstant) / (365.2425 * 86_400_000);
+       return `${n}. At this fitness, rest can mend ${p.their} condition to ${mends}, and a workout costs ${costs} energy.`
+         + (dial.value <= EVERYDAY_FITNESS ? ' This is where everyday life keeps it without training.' : '')
+         + ` At ${Math.floor(age)}, training can take it to ${Math.round(ceilingAt(age).fitness)} at most. ${ageWords(age)}`;
+     }
+     case 'nourishment':
+       // With the day’s meals: at least 76 each morning when the food is paid for, 40 when it can’t be.
+       return (n > 70 ? `${n}. Well fed.`
+         : n >= 20 ? `${n}. Getting hungry. Under 20, hunger costs condition and morale every hour.`
+           : `${n}. Hungry, and it’s costing condition and morale every hour.`)
+         + ' Each morning the day’s groceries bring it up to at least 76, or only to 40 on a day there’s no money for food.';
+     case 'hygiene':
+       return (n >= 50 ? `${n}. Clean enough not to bother ${p.them}.`
+         : `${n}. Under 50, it wears on ${p.their} morale every hour. A shower puts it back.`)
+         + ' The morning shower brings it up to at least 82.';
+     default:
+       return `${n}.`;
+   }
+ }
+
+ // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+ // Readiness — a figure, not a dial
+ // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+ interface Ready { person: Person; value: number; drags: { key: DialKey; name: string; value: number }[] }
+
+ /** The dials pulling readiness down hardest, worst first, by what each takes off it: a dial costing more than a twentieth of it. */
+ function dragsOn(person: Person): { key: DialKey; name: string; value: number }[] {
+   const w = person.wellbeing;
+   return readinessParts(person)
+     .map((part) => ({ key: part.key as DialKey, name: DIALS.find((d) => d.key === part.key)!.name, value: part.key === 'hygiene' ? w.hygiene ?? 80 : w[part.key], hurt: 1 - part.factor / part.best }))
+     .filter((c) => c.hurt > 0.05).sort((a, b) => b.hurt - a.hurt).slice(0, 3)
+     .map(({ key, name, value }) => ({ key, name, value }));
+ }
+
+ defineLook<Ready>('readiness', {
+   gone: 'There’s nobody here to be ready.',
+   resolve: (sim, id) => {
+     const person = personIn(sim, id || sim.universe.playerId);
+     if (!person) return undefined;
+     return { person, value: readiness(person), drags: dragsOn(person) };
+   },
+   seeds: (sim) => [sim.universe.playerId],
+   // Said of whoever it belongs to (`spokenOf`, from 2026-10-15: until then another person’s readiness was "How Well You
+   // Would Do Today" and "what’s costing you", one press from her look, which said her dials of her).
+   look: (ready, { sim }) => {
+     const p = spokenOf(ready.person, ready.person.id === sim.universe.playerId);
+     // From 2026-10-17 (brief 14): the kind says how ready, the drags hold back rather than "cost", and the footnote says
+     // what judged work does with it. Until then it said "the work judged that day reads it as its condition".
+     return {
+       name: 'Readiness',
+       kind: `How Ready ${upper(p.they)} ${upper(p.are)} Today`,
+       parent: at('person', ready.person.id),
+       summary: ready.drags.length === 0
+         ? `${Math.round(ready.value)}. Very little is holding ${p.them} back.${ready.value >= 99.5 ? ' This is as good as a day gets.' : ''}`
+         // At the ceiling a measure short of its best takes nothing off the figure shown (`readiness` clamps at 100), so it
+         // isn’t said to hold anybody back (from 2026-10-17: until then "100, and nourishment is what’s costing you").
+         : ready.value >= 99.5
+           ? `${Math.round(ready.value)}. As good as a day gets, even with ${spokenList(ready.drags.map((d) => d.name.toLowerCase()))} short of ${p.their} best.`

+       ways: ready.drags.map((d) => ({
+         to: at('dial', `${ready.person.id}/${d.key}`),
+         label: d.name,
+         // At the ceiling a measure short of its best takes nothing off the figure shown (`readiness` clamps at 100), so it
+         // isn’t said to pull it down (from 2026-10-19, brief 15: until then the summary said “As good as a day gets” over a
+         // way that said “At 63, and pulling readiness down.”).
+         detail: `${d.key === 'sleepDebt' ? `${plural(Math.round(d.value), 'hour')} owed` : `At ${Math.round(d.value)}`}${ready.value >= 99.5 ? ', short of its best.' : ', and pulling readiness down.'}`,
+       })),
+       // A sentence with a subject from 2026-10-20 (brief 17): until then "Seven of the eight measures, all but fitness, from
+       // 5 to 100.", a fragment.
+       provenance: `It comes from seven of the eight measures, all but fitness, and runs from 5 to 100. It sets how much a class, a lab, a rehearsal, an hour of practice or a workout builds, and under ${EVALUATION.sufficientReadiness} it costs ${p.them} in judged work.`,
+     };

+ interface Carried { person: Person; key: Condition | 'injury' }
+
+ /**
+  * What a condition left untreated does, by the week, in the measures' words (`CHRONIC.untreated`), and whether keeping it
+  * up undoes anything. Said of the type a diabetes is (from 2026-10-17: until then a type 2 read what type 1 does).
+  */
+ function leftAlone(c: Condition, typeOne?: boolean): { untreated: string; keptUp: boolean } {
+   const u = CHRONIC.untreated;
+   const likely = (x: number) => (x === 2 ? 'twice as likely' : `${x} times as likely`);
+   if (c === 'depression') return { untreated: `Left untreated, it takes ${u.moraleAWeek} from morale every week.`, keptUp: true };
+   if (c === 'asthma') return { untreated: `Left untreated, it makes an asthma emergency ${likely(u.asthmaEmergencies)}.`, keptUp: true };
+   if (c === 'diabetes') {
+     return {
+       untreated: typeOne
+         ? `Left untreated, it makes an emergency ${likely(u.diabetesEmergencies)}, and it takes ${u.diabetesConditionAWeek} from condition every week.`
+         : `Left untreated, it takes ${u.diabetesConditionAWeek} from condition every week.`,
+       keptUp: true,
+     };
+   }
+   if (c === 'arthritis') return { untreated: `Left untreated, it takes ${u.arthritisEnergyAWeek} from energy every week.`, keptUp: true };
+   return { untreated: 'Left untreated, it has no effect in the game, and its care costs nothing.', keptUp: false };
+ }
+
+ defineLook<Carried>('condition', {
+   // Said of whoever the look was of, the player or not (until 2026-10-15 “You don’t carry that now.”, of anyone).
+   gone: 'That isn’t there any more.',
+   // The person the look is of, named in the id (`person/condition`) as a trait’s is, or the player. Until 2026-10-14
+   // every condition resolved against the player, as the trait look did until earlier that day, so another person’s
+   // Depression opened a look of the player’s, or none when the player carried none (found by that day’s third round of
+   // evidence).
+   resolve: (sim, raw) => {

+     const id = split ? split.key : raw;
+     if (!person) return undefined;
+     if (id === 'injury') return injuryOf(person, sim.now) ? { person, key: 'injury' } : undefined;
+     return person.health?.chronic?.[id as Condition] ? { person, key: id as Condition } : undefined;
+   },
+   seeds: (sim) => [...Object.keys(sim.player.health?.chronic ?? {}), ...(injuryOf(sim.player, sim.now) ? ['injury'] : [])],
+   look: ({ person, key }, { sim }) => {

+         kind: 'An Injury',
+         // What it keeps them from, by what it limits (from 2026-10-17, brief 14): until then only an injury that lays them
+         // up said so, and a sprained ankle, which keeps them from training too (`trainingRefusal`), said nothing. The same
+         // day, the health journey found it didn’t say Call In Sick excuses a day of classes for it, as the flu’s notice does.

+         // classes it keeps them from are excused, a cut or a knock said nothing of what it keeps them from, though the
+         // way in promised it, and Call In Sick "excuses a day of classes" read as one day in all.
+         summary: `It mends by ${formatDate(hurt.until, sim.zone)}. ${injuryKeeps(hurt.kind, isYou && Boolean(person.school && !schoolEnded(person.school.standing)), { they: p.they, them: p.them, their: p.their, theyAre })}`,
+         parent: at('person', person.id),
+         ways: [{ to: at('dial', `${person.id}/condition`), label: 'Condition', detail: `How sound ${p.their} body is. An injury doesn’t lower it, but it adds to ${p.their} stress and lowers ${p.their} morale each day.` }],
+         provenance: 'How long it takes depends on the injury and on how resilient the body is.',
+       };
+     }
+     const state = person.health!.chronic![key]!;
+     const dial = key === 'depression' ? 'morale' : key === 'diabetes' ? 'condition' : key === 'arthritis' ? 'energy' : undefined;
+     return {
+       name: CONDITION_LABEL[key] + (key === 'diabetes' ? (state.typeOne ? ', Type 1' : ', Type 2') : ''),
+       // A long-term condition, so it isn’t read as the Condition measure (from 2026-10-17, brief 14: until then "A
+       // Condition She Carries", one press from her Condition), and where it’s kept up or let go, by the buttons' names.
+       kind: 'A Long-Term Condition',

+         ? (state.lapsed
+           ? `${upper(theyAre)} keeping it up, but this month’s care went unpaid, so it goes untreated until next month.`

+         : `${upper(theyAre)} leaving it untreated. That costs nothing, but it has the effects below.`,
+       parent: at('person', person.id),
+       body: (() => {

+         return <p className="small">{left.untreated}{left.keptUp ? ' Kept up, it does none of that.' : ''}{isYou ? ' To change it, go to Papers, then Health Cover, and press Keep It Up or Let It Go beside it.' : ''}</p>;
+       })(),
+       ways: dial ? [{ to: at('dial', `${person.id}/${dial}`), label: dial[0]!.toUpperCase() + dial.slice(1), detail: 'The measure it lowers when it’s left untreated.' }] : [],
+       // Some begin later in a life too (`onsetMonth`, from 2026-09-28): until 2026-10-17 this said every one was drawn once.
+       provenance: `${key in ONSET.yearly ? 'It can be there from the start, at young adults’ rate, or begin later, more often in a heavier body.' : 'It can only be there from the start, at young adults’ rate.'} Source: ${CHRONIC.source}.`,
+     };

+ /**
+  * SLATE — joining things the way a person says them.
+  *
+  * A look’s summary is a sentence, so a list inside one is spoken, not
+  * comma-separated: "morale, nourishment and hygiene", never "morale and
+  * nourishment and hygiene", which is what naive joining produces and what
+  * shipped in the first draft of the readiness sentence.
+  */
+
+ /** "a", "a and b", "a, b and c": the engine’s own, from 2026-10-17, so a sentence there joins a list the same way. */
+ export { spokenList } from '@/engine/core/text';
+
+ /** Agreement for a list that becomes the subject of a sentence. */
+ export const isAre = (n: number): string => (n === 1 ? 'is' : 'are');
+
+ /**
+  * A count and its noun, spelled the way a person says it.
+  *
+  * Numbers under ten are words in prose and figures in facts, which is the
+  * house rule and the thing four of these files each wrote their own list for.
+  * `zero` is the word for none of them, because "no towns", "nought" and
+  * "none" are all right in different sentences and none of them is right in
+  * all three.
+  */
+ const SMALL = ['', 'one', 'two', 'three', 'four', 'five', 'six', 'seven', 'eight', 'nine'] as const;
+
+ export function said(count: number, one: string, many = `${one}s`, zero = 'no'): string {
+   const n = Math.round(count);
+   // A fraction is a figure. "Half an hour" is the caller’s to say, not this.
+   if (!Number.isInteger(count)) return `${count} ${many}`;
+   const figure = n === 0 ? zero : (n > 0 && n < SMALL.length ? SMALL[n]! : n.toLocaleString('en-US'));
+   return `${figure} ${n === 1 ? one : many}`;
+ }
+
+ /**
+  * The same words, capitalized for the front of a sentence.
+  *
+  * `said` spells small numbers out, which is right in the middle of a sentence
+  * and wrong at the start of one: the household shipped reading "four people
+  * live under the one roof". Only the first letter is touched, so a name or an
+  * acronym already in place comes back unchanged.
+  */
+ export function toStart(words: string): string {
+   return words.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + words.slice(1);
+ }
+
+ /**
+  * A figure on the nought-to-a-hundred scale, written the way it is read.
+  *
+  * "82/100", never "82 out of a hundred". The words were four times the width
+  * of the figure and said nothing the slash does not, and a column of them next
+  * to each other could not be scanned: nine dials each ending in the same five
+  * words is a wall, and nine ending in /100 is a list.
+  */
+ export function outOf(value: number): string {
+   return `${Math.round(value)}/100`;
+ }
+
+ /**
+  * Whether a string can stand as a look’s name: no underscore, slash or run of
+  * four digits, no lowercase word running into a capital, and a capital
+  * (accented ones too) or a digit first. The rule in docs/DRILL-DOWN.md, once.
+  */
+ export const nameable = (text: string): boolean => !/_|\/|\d{4}/.test(text) && !/\b[a-z]+[A-Z]/.test(text) && /^[\p{Lu}0-9]/u.test(text);

+  * travel authorizations they hold; the state ID card; and permission to work, a

+ export function PassportPane() {
+   const { sim, run, toast } = useGame();
+   const person = useWorld((s) => s.player);
+   const cur = saveCurrency(sim.universe);
+   const money = (c: number) => formatMoney(c, cur);

+ /** A number under ten in words, as prose writes one. */
+ const inWords = (n: number): string => ['no', 'one', 'two', 'three', 'four', 'five', 'six', 'seven', 'eight', 'nine'][n] ?? String(n);

+ /**
+  * What Get costs, how the card comes and how long it's good for, said before it's pressed, from the rules
+  * `documents.apply_idcard` follows (from 2026-10-20, brief 17, section 8: until then the fee, the wait and the term came
+  * only in the toast after it). Somebody not a citizen at a US state's counter waits on SAVE first, and their card's term
+  * is the fine print's (`noncitizenTermNote`).
+  */
+ function idCardWords(sim: Simulation, person: Person, here: NonNullable<ReturnType<typeof idCardHere>>): string {
+   const { card, jurisdiction } = here;
+   const fee = idCardFee(sim, card);
+   const checked = jurisdiction.startsWith('us-') && !citizenOf(person, 'US');
+   const cost = fee > 0 ? `It costs ${formatMoney(fee, saveCurrency(sim.universe))}` : 'It’s free';
+   const comes = checked
+     ? `. The DMV checks your lawful presence first, which takes ${NONCITIZEN_ID.saveBusinessDays} federal workdays, and ${card.mailedBusinessDays ? `the card comes by mail ${card.mailedBusinessDays} business days after that` : 'you have the card then'}.`
+     : card.mailedBusinessDays ? ` and comes by mail ${card.mailedBusinessDays} business days after you apply.` : ', and you have it at once.';
+   const term = checked || !card.years ? '' : ` It’s good ${card.toBirthday ? `until your first birthday after ${inWords(card.years)} years` : `for ${inWords(card.years)} years`}${card.passportBook ? ', or until your passport book runs out, if that’s sooner' : ''}.`;
+   return `${cost}${comes}${term}`;
+ }

+ /**
+  * SLATE — three save slots, three separate universes.
+  */
+
+ import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
+ import type { SaveAdapter, SaveSlotInfo, Slot } from '@/engine/persistence/adapter';
+ import type { SaveUniverse } from '@/engine/domain/model';
+ import { SAVE_SCHEMA_VERSION } from '@/engine/domain/model';
+ import { loadPlacesFor, openSlot, validateUniverse } from '@/engine';
+ import { APP_VERSION } from '@/engine/world/bootstrap';
+
+ export function SaveSlots({
+   adapter, initialSlots, onNew, onContinue,
+ }: {
+   adapter: SaveAdapter;
+   initialSlots: SaveSlotInfo[];
+   onNew: (slot: Slot) => void;
+   onContinue: (universe: SaveUniverse) => void;
+ }) {
+   const [slots, setSlots] = useState(initialSlots);
+   const [busy, setBusy] = useState<Slot | null>(null);
+   const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
+   /** What a check found wrong with a save, for a player who wants it: behind a disclosure, not in the sentence. */
+   const [errorDetail, setErrorDetail] = useState<string[]>([]);
+   const [confirmDelete, setConfirmDelete] = useState<Slot | null>(null);
+
+   const reload = useCallback(async () => {
+     try {
+       setSlots(await adapter.listSlots());
+     } catch (e) {
+       setError((e as Error).message);
+     }
+   }, [adapter]);
+
+   useEffect(() => { void reload(); }, [reload]);
+
+   const load = async (slot: Slot, fromBackup = false) => {
+     setBusy(slot);
+     setError(null);
+     setErrorDetail([]);
+     try {
+       const opened = await openSlot(adapter, slot, { fromBackup });
+       if ('error' in opened) {
+         setError(opened.error);
+         return;
+       }
+       const { universe } = opened;
+
+       // The save's towns are known only once their countries are loaded.
+       await loadPlacesFor(universe);
+       const validation = validateUniverse(universe);
+       // What the check found is a developer's words, kept behind What’s Wrong With It (from 2026-10-17, brief 14):
+       // until then the sentence was "That save didn’t pass validation: <the first of them> (and n more)."
+       if (!validation.ok) {
+         setError(`The save in Slot ${slot} is damaged, so it can’t be opened.${slots.find((s) => s.slot === slot)?.hasBackup ? ' Press Restore Backup to open its backup instead.' : ''}`);
+         setErrorDetail(validation.errors);
+         return;
+       }
+
+       onContinue(universe);
+     } catch (e) {
+       setError((e as Error).message);
+     } finally {
+       setBusy(null);
+     }
+   };
+
+   const remove = async (slot: Slot) => {
+     setBusy(slot);
+     try {
+       await adapter.remove(slot);
+       setConfirmDelete(null);
+       await reload();
+     } catch (e) {
+       setError((e as Error).message);
+     } finally {
+       setBusy(null);
+     }
+   };
+
+   /** Whose life a delete would end, where the slot can read the name. */
+   const doomed = confirmDelete === null ? undefined : slots.find((s) => s.slot === confirmDelete)?.meta?.characterName;
+
+   return (
+     <div className="main">
+       <div className="main-inner">
+         <div className="center" style={{ marginBottom: 'var(--s7)', paddingTop: 'var(--s6)' }}>
+           <div style={{ fontSize: 44, marginBottom: 'var(--s3)' }} aria-hidden="true">🎬</div>
+           <div className="wordmark" style={{ fontSize: 32 }}>SLATE</div>
+           <p className="muted">Three slots, three separate lives. What happens in one never touches the others.</p>
+         </div>
+
+         {error && (
+           <div className="callout callout-negative" style={{ marginBottom: 'var(--s5)' }}>
+             {error}
+             {errorDetail.length > 0 && (
+               <details style={{ marginTop: 'var(--s2)' }}>
+                 <summary className="xs">What’s Wrong With It</summary>
+                 <ul className="xs" style={{ margin: 'var(--s2) 0 0', paddingLeft: 'var(--s4)' }}>
+                   {errorDetail.map((one) => <li key={one}>{one}</li>)}
+                 </ul>
+               </details>
+             )}
+           </div>
+         )}
+
+         <div className="slot-grid">
+           {([1, 2, 3] as Slot[]).map((slot) => {
+             const info = slots.find((s) => s.slot === slot) ?? { slot, occupied: false, hasBackup: false };
+             const working = busy === slot;
+
+             if (!info.occupied) {
+               return (
+                 <div key={slot} className="slot slot-empty">
+                   <div className="slot-number">Slot {slot}</div>
+                   <p className="small dim center" style={{ maxWidth: 220 }}>
+                     {info.hasBackup
+                       ? 'Empty, but there’s a backup of the save that was here.'
+                       : 'An empty slot. Press New Save to start a life here.'}
+                   </p>
+                   <div className="col gap-2" style={{ alignItems: 'center' }}>
+                     <button className="btn btn-primary" onClick={() => onNew(slot)} disabled={working}>
+                       New Save
+                     </button>
+                     {info.hasBackup && (
+                       <>
+                         <button className="btn btn-sm" onClick={() => void load(slot, true)} disabled={working}>
+                           {working ? 'Opening…' : 'Restore Backup'}
+                         </button>
+                         <BackupNote label={info.backupDateLabel} center />
+                       </>
+                     )}
+                   </div>
+                 </div>
+               );
+             }
+
+             const meta = info.meta;
+             // A finished life opens onto how it ended; the clock in it doesn’t run.
+             const finished = meta?.endedAt !== undefined || /, Died At \d+$/.test(meta?.careerLabel ?? '');
+             return (
+               <div key={slot} className="slot">
+                 <div className="slot-number">Slot {slot}</div>
+
+                 {info.error ? (
+                   <>
+                     <div className="slot-name" style={{ fontSize: 'var(--size-md)' }}>Unreadable Save</div>
+                     <p className="small negative">{info.error}</p>
+                     <div className="col gap-2" style={{ marginTop: 'auto' }}>
+                       {info.hasBackup && (
+                         <>
+                           <button className="btn" onClick={() => void load(slot, true)} disabled={working}>
+                             Restore Backup
+                           </button>
+                           <BackupNote label={info.backupDateLabel} />
+                         </>
+                       )}
+                       <button className="btn btn-danger btn-sm" onClick={() => setConfirmDelete(slot)} disabled={working}>
+                         Delete
+                       </button>
+                     </div>
+                   </>
+                 ) : (
+                   <>
+                     <div className="row gap-3" style={{ alignItems: 'center' }}>
+                       {meta?.portrait && (
+                         <img
+                           className="headshot headshot-sm"
+                           src={meta.portrait}
+                           alt={`Headshot for ${meta.characterName}`}
+                         />
+                       )}
+                       <div style={{ minWidth: 0 }}>
+                         <div className="slot-name">{meta?.characterName}</div>
+                         <div className="muted small">{meta?.careerLabel || '—'}</div>
+                       </div>
+                     </div>
+
+                     <div className="slot-meta">
+                       <div className="stat">
+                         <span className="stat-label">Date</span>
+                         <span className="small">{meta?.worldDateLabel || '—'}</span>
+                       </div>
+                       <div className="stat">
+                         <span className="stat-label">Location</span>
+                         <span className="small">{meta?.locationLabel || '—'}</span>
+                       </div>
+                       <div className="stat">
+                         <span className="stat-label">Net Worth</span>
+                         <span className="small mono">{meta?.netWorthLabel || '—'}</span>
+                       </div>
+                       <div className="stat">
+                         <span className="stat-label">Played</span>
+                         <span className="small mono">{formatPlaytime(meta?.playtimeSeconds ?? 0)}</span>
+                       </div>
+                     </div>
+
+                     <div className="xs dim">
+                       Version {meta?.appVersion ?? '—'} · Save Format {meta?.schemaVersion ?? '—'}
+                       {meta && meta.schemaVersion < SAVE_SCHEMA_VERSION && ' · Updated When Opened'}
+                       {info.bytes !== undefined && ` · ${formatBytes(info.bytes)}`}
+                     </div>
+                     {info.hasBackup && <BackupNote label={info.backupDateLabel} />}
+
+                     <div className="col gap-2" style={{ marginTop: 'auto' }}>
+                       <button className="btn btn-primary btn-block" onClick={() => void load(slot)} disabled={working}>
+                         {working ? 'Opening…' : finished ? 'See How It Ended' : 'Continue'}
+                       </button>
+                       <div className="row gap-2">
+                         {info.hasBackup && (
+                           <button className="btn btn-sm grow" onClick={() => void load(slot, true)} disabled={working}>
+                             Restore Backup
+                           </button>
+                         )}
+                         <button className="btn btn-danger btn-sm grow" onClick={() => setConfirmDelete(slot)} disabled={working}>
+                           Delete
+                         </button>
+                       </div>
+                     </div>
+                   </>
+                 )}
+               </div>
+             );
+           })}
+         </div>
+
+         <p className="center dim xs" style={{ marginTop: 'var(--s7)' }}>
+           SLATE {APP_VERSION} · Saved To {adapter.name}
+           {adapter.serverAuthoritative ? ' · The Server Checks Each Save' : ''}
+         </p>
+       </div>
+
+       {confirmDelete !== null && (
+         <div className="overlay" onClick={() => setConfirmDelete(null)}>
+           <div className="modal" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()} role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Confirm Deletion">
+             <div className="modal-head">
+               <h2>Delete Slot {confirmDelete}?</h2>
+             </div>
+             <div className="modal-body">
+               <p>
+                 {/* The life by its character’s name, where the slot can read one (from 2026-10-19, brief 15: until then
+                     “This ends that universe. The character, everywhere they’ve been and everything that happened to
+                     them is gone from the slot.”, the save’s own word for itself). */}
+                 {doomed
+                   ? `This deletes ${doomed}’s life from the slot, with everything that happened in it.`
+                   : 'This deletes the save in this slot.'}
+               </p>
+               <p className="muted small">
+                 {restorableAfterDelete(slots.find((s) => s.slot === confirmDelete))
+                   ? 'SLATE keeps a backup, so if you change your mind, press Restore Backup on this slot to bring it back.'
+                   : 'This slot has no backup, so you can’t bring it back afterwards.'}
+               </p>
+             </div>
+             <div className="modal-foot">
+               <button className="btn" onClick={() => setConfirmDelete(null)}>Keep It</button>
+               <button className="btn btn-danger" onClick={() => void remove(confirmDelete)}>
+                 Delete Slot {confirmDelete}
+               </button>
+             </div>
+           </div>
+         </div>
+       )}
+     </div>
+   );
+ }
+
+ /**
+  * What restoring would go back to. A backup the player cannot date is a step
+  * they cannot weigh, so the date is the whole point of the note; a stored save
+  * from before the date was kept has to say that rather than invent one.
+  */
+ function BackupNote({ label, center = false }: { label?: string; center?: boolean }) {
+   return (
+     <div className={`xs dim${center ? ' center' : ''}`}>
+       {label ? `Backup from ${label}` : 'Backup from an unknown date'}
+     </div>
+   );
+ }
+
+ /**
+  * Whether deleting this slot leaves something the player can bring back.
+  * A readable save becomes its own backup on the way out; an unreadable one
+  * does not, so it can only fall back to a backup that is already there.
+  */
+ function restorableAfterDelete(info: SaveSlotInfo | undefined): boolean {
+   if (!info) return false;
+   return info.error ? info.hasBackup : info.occupied;
+ }
+
+ function formatPlaytime(seconds: number): string {
+   if (seconds < 60) return `${Math.round(seconds)}s`;
+   const minutes = Math.floor(seconds / 60);
+   if (minutes < 60) return `${minutes}m`;
+   const hours = Math.floor(minutes / 60);
+   return `${hours}h ${minutes % 60}m`;
+ }
+
+ function formatBytes(bytes: number): string {
+   if (bytes < 1024) return `${bytes} B`;
+   if (bytes < 1024 * 1024) return `${Math.round(bytes / 1024)} KB`;
+   return `${(bytes / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1)} MB`;
+ }
+
+ /**
+  * SLATE — HOME.
+  *
+  * Immediate life. Where am I, what day is it, what happens next, what needs
+  * attention, how am I doing. A command surface, not a place to bury depth.
+  *
+  * Its Home, Career, Travel, Cars and Land panels went with those systems in
+  * the scope reset of 2026-10-09; the rest is as it stood on 2026-09-29.
+  */
+

+ import { placeProfile, placeKindLabel, formatPeople, type PlaceProfile } from '@/engine/world/place';

+ import { balanceText, heldOf } from '@/engine/systems/abroad';
+ import { cardsOf, stateOf } from '@/engine/systems/credit';

+ import { latePenaltyAll, owedEverywhere, unassessedBalance } from '@/engine/systems/taxreturn';
+ import { LookRegion, Open, at } from '@/ui/looks';
