+
+ export function Home() {
+   const { sim, navigate, run } = useGame();
+   const snapshot = useWorld(lifeSnapshot);
+   const decisions = useWorld(openDecisions);
+   const next = useWorld(nextCommitment);
+   const soon = useWorld((s) => upcoming(s, 6));
+   const worth = useWorld((s) => netWorth(s, s.player.id));
+   const cur = saveCurrency(sim.universe);
+   const unread = useWorld(unreadNotifications);
+   // Every unread notice drawn, not only the six heaviest (from 2026-10-17, brief 13's interface playthroughs): until then
+   // the panel drew six and said nothing of the rest, and Mark N Read marked them all, so a notice past the sixth was on
+   // no screen at all. A new life has fourteen unread by its first Saturday, and The Courses And What They Ask was the
+   // thirteenth.
+   const [allNotices, setAllNotices] = useState(false);
+   // What still weighs with nothing to decide: a notice, what money weighs
+   // with (`troubles`, which the day's worry reads too), a clash in the next
+   // month. "All Clear" was said over all of them, and until 2026-09-27 it
+   // read only the rent of the money.
+   const weighing = useWorld((s) => {
+     const clash = entriesBetween(s, s.now, s.now + 30 * MS_DAY).some((e) => e.conflicted);
+     const cur = saveCurrency(s.universe);
+     const m = (cents: number) => formatMoney(cents, cur, { cents: false });
+     const said: string[] = [];
+     for (const t of troubles(s, s.player)) {
+       if (t.kind === 'owed') said.push(`You owe ${m(t.amount)} that went unpaid.`);
+       else if (t.kind === 'overdrawn') said.push(`Your account is ${m(t.amount)} overdrawn.`);
+       else if (t.kind === 'card') said.push(`Your card is nearly at its limit, owing ${m(t.amount)}.`);
+       else if (t.kind === 'card_behind') {
+         // The card named, where there's more than one.
+         const card = t.accountId ? s.universe.accounts[t.accountId] : undefined;
+         const state = card && s.player.credit ? stateOf(s.player, card) : s.player.credit;
+         const which = card && cardsOf(s, s.player).length > 1 ? `The ${card.name}` : 'Your card';
+         // Unsuspended, a card is one payment behind: the second missed suspends it (`SUSPEND_AFTER`), and every way a
+         // suspension lifts puts the count back to none. “N payments behind” for two or more went on 2026-10-13, reached by
+         // no played life once a card paid off reset its count (defect 68 of that day’s third round; found by its final checks).
+         said.push(`${which} is ${state?.suspended ? 'suspended' : 'a payment behind'}, owing ${m(t.amount)}.`);
+       }
+       else if (t.kind === 'return_late') said.push(`A tax return is past its due date and not filed yet. You owe ${m(t.amount)}, including the penalty so far.`);
+       else if (t.kind === 'medical') said.push(`You owe ${m(t.amount)} for medical care.`);
+       else if (t.kind === 'collections') said.push(`${m(t.amount)} you owe is with a collection agency.`);
+       else said.push(`You owe ${m(t.amount)} of income tax.`);
+     }
+     if (clash) said.push('Two things on your calendar in the next month are at the same time.');
+     return said;
+   });
+
+   const player = snapshot.player;
+   const city = snapshot.city ?? CITIES.get(player.currentLocationId);
+   const ready = readiness(player);
+   const accounts = useWorld((s) => s.ledger.accountsOf(s.player.id));
+   const primary = accounts.find((a) => a.id === player.primaryAccountId) ?? accounts[0];
+   // Accounts kept at home, by bank, in their own money (from 2026-10-16): the money line says them beside the primary.
+   const kept = new Map<string, { currency: string; held: number }>();
+   for (const a of accounts) {
+     if (!a.currency || a.closedAt || a.id === primary?.id) continue;
+     const was = kept.get(a.institution ?? '') ?? { currency: a.currency, held: 0 };
+     kept.set(a.institution ?? '', { currency: was.currency, held: was.held + heldOf(a) });
+   }
+   // A negative written with the minus sign, as Money writes an overdrawn balance (“−$3.30”), from 2026-10-17 (brief 14):
+   // until then Home's line said “Worth -$227” where Money said “−$227”.
+   const signed = (text: string) => text.replace(/(^|\()-/g, '$1−');
+   const keptWords = [...kept].map(([bank, k]) => `, and ${signed(formatMoney(k.held, k.currency))} at ${bank}`).join('');
+   const place = city ? placeProfile(sim, city.id) : undefined;
+   const today = dateKey(sim.now, sim.zone);
+   const season = seasonOf(sim.now, sim.zone, city?.latitude ?? 34);
+   const weather = city ? weatherAt(sim, city.id) : undefined;
+   const week = city ? forecastFor(sim, city.id, 6) : [];
+   const unit = weather?.fahrenheit ? '°F' : '°C';
+   // Each panel opens with its chapter in the guide (`content/tutorial.ts`).
+   const shows = {
+     calendar: useFeature('ui.calendar').open,
+     needs: useFeature('ui.needs').open,
+     how: useFeature('ui.how').open,
+     where: useFeature('ui.where').open,
+     weather: useFeature('ui.weather').open,
+     money: useFeature('ui.money').open,
+     school: useFeature('ui.school').open,
+     papers: useFeature('ui.papers').open,
+   };
+
+   return (
+     <>
+       {/*
+         Six nouns in three lines, and until now not one of them opened: the
+         date, your title, your own name, the city, the season and the sky.
+         Each names the thing it is, and the thing knows what it opens into.
+       */}
+       <LookRegion className="page-head">
+         <div className="eyebrow">
+           <Open subject={at('day', today)}>{formatWeekdayDate(sim.now, sim.zone)}</Open>
+           {' · '}
+           <Open subject={at('person', player.id)}>{PERFORMER_NOUN[player.performerTitle]}</Open>
+         </div>
+         <h1>
+           Good {partOfDay(sim.now, sim.zone)},{' '}
+           <Open subject={at('person', player.id)}>{calledBy(player)}</Open>.
+         </h1>
+         <p className="muted">
+           <Open subject={at('day', today)}>{formatTime(sim.now, sim.zone)}</Open> in{' '}
+           {city ? <Open subject={at('place', city.id)}>{city.name}</Open> : 'an unknown place'} ·{' '}
+           {city
+             ? <Open subject={at('place', city.id)}>{zoneAbbreviation(sim.now, sim.zone)}</Open>
+             : zoneAbbreviation(sim.now, sim.zone)} ·{' '}
+           {city
+             ? <Open subject={at('season', `${city.id}/${season}`)}>{season}</Open>
+             : season}
+           {weather && city && (
+             <>
+               {' · '}
+               <span aria-hidden="true">{WEATHER_EMOJI[weather.condition]}</span>
+               {' '}
+               <Open subject={at('weather', city.id)}>
+                 {weather.temperature}{unit} {titleCaseLabel(weather.condition)}
+               </Open>
+             </>
+           )}
+         </p>
+       </LookRegion>
+
+       {/*
+         The calendar is a section of the hub rather than a tile pointing at
+         one. What is coming is part of standing in the day, not somewhere else
+         to go, and it reads that way at the top of Home. One button into the
+         month, in the header: there used to be three, all going to the same
+         screen.
+       */}
+       {!shows.calendar ? <LockedPanel feature="ui.calendar" title="Calendar" /> : (
+       <Panel
+         look={at('day', today)}
+         title="Calendar"
+         subtitle={next ? 'What’s coming up, and when.' : undefined}
+         actions={(
+           <Gated feature="ui.open-calendar" className="btn btn-sm btn-primary" onClick={() => navigate('/workspace/calendar', 'Calendar')}>
+             Open Calendar
+           </Gated>
+         )}
+         help="day.calendar"
+       >
+         <LookRegion>
+           {next ? (
+             <div className="stat">
+               <span className="stat-label">
+                 <Open subject={at('entry', next.id)}>{formatRelative(next.at, sim.now)}</Open>
+               </span>
+               <span className="stat-value" style={{ fontSize: 'var(--size-md)' }}>
+                 <Open subject={at('entry', next.id)}>{titleCaseLabel(next.title)}</Open>
+               </span>
+               <span className="stat-note">
+                 <Open subject={at('day', dateKey(next.at, sim.zone))}>{formatDate(next.at, sim.zone)}</Open>
+                 {' at '}
+                 {/* The call's own clock, where it names another city: until 2026-09-27 the home clock with no zone. */}
+                 <Open subject={at('entry', next.id)}>{(() => { const tz = next.locationId ? CITIES.get(next.locationId)?.timeZone : undefined; return tz && tz !== sim.zone ? `${formatTime(next.at, tz)} ${zoneAbbreviation(next.at, tz)}` : formatTime(next.at, sim.zone); })()}</Open>
+                 {next.locationId && next.locationId !== player.currentLocationId && (
+                   <span className="negative">
+                     {' · you’re not in '}
+                     <Open subject={at('place', next.locationId)}>{CITIES.get(next.locationId)?.name ?? 'that place'}</Open>

+               No plans or commitments ahead. <Open subject={at('day', today)}>The day</Open> is yours.
+             </p>
+           )}
+
+           {soon.some((entry) => entry.id !== next?.id) && (

+               <hr className="divider" />
+               <div className="col gap-2">
+                 {soon.filter((entry) => entry.id !== next?.id).slice(0, 5).map((entry) => (
+                   <div key={entry.id} className="row-between">
+                     {/* Two lines before it's cut (from 2026-10-17, brief 14's document journey): one line cut "Yale Cabaret,
+                         Season 59: The Show Ends" short at 390 wide. */}
+                     <span className="small clamp-2" style={{ minWidth: 0 }}>
+                       <Open subject={at('entry', entry.id)}>{titleCaseLabel(entry.title)}</Open>
+                     </span>
+                     <span className="xs dim nowrap">
+                       <Open subject={at('entry', entry.id)}>{formatRelative(entry.at, sim.now)}</Open>
+                     </span>
+                   </div>
+                 ))}
+               </div>
+             </>
+           )}
+           <div className="row" style={{ justifyContent: 'flex-end', marginTop: 'var(--s2)' }}>
+             <HowItWorks help="ui.open-calendar" label="How Your Own Plans Work" />
+           </div>
+         </LookRegion>
+       </Panel>
+       )}
+
+       <div className="grid grid-2" style={{ marginBottom: 'var(--s5)' }}>
+         {!shows.needs ? <LockedPanel feature="ui.needs" title="What Needs You" /> : (
+         <Panel
+           title="What Needs You"
+           subtitle={decisions.length === 0 ? 'No questions are waiting on you.' : `${decisions.length} open`}
+           flush
+           actions={unread.length > 0 ? (
+             <Gated feature="world.mark_read" className="btn btn-ghost btn-sm" onClick={() => run('world.mark_read')}>
+               Mark {unread.length} Read
+             </Gated>
+           ) : undefined}
+           help="day.needs"
+         >
+           {decisions.length === 0 && unread.length === 0 ? (
+             weighing.length === 0 ? (
+               <Empty
+                 title="All Clear"
+                 body="You owe nobody anything past due, the bank and the card are in order, and the calendar doesn’t clash. Go and do something you want to do."
+               />
+             ) : (
+               <Empty title="No Questions Waiting" body={weighing.join(' ')} />
+             )
+           ) : (
+             <LookRegion className="list">
+               {decisions.slice(0, 6).map((decision) => (
+                 <div
+                   key={decision.id}
+                   className="decision"
+                   data-urgency={decision.urgency >= 85 ? 'critical' : decision.urgency >= 65 ? 'high' : 'normal'}
+                 >
+                   <div className="decision-urgency" aria-hidden="true" />
+                   <div className="grow">
+                     <div className="row-between">
+                       <span className="small strong">
+                         <Open subject={at('decision', decision.id)}>{titleCaseLabel(decision.title)}</Open>
+                       </span>
+                       {/* Every row has a date from 2026-10-14; until then an undated one showed none here. */}
+                       <span className={`xs ${decision.dueAt < sim.now ? 'negative' : 'dim'}`}>
+                         <Open subject={at('decision', decision.id)}>
+                           {decision.dueAt < sim.now ? 'Overdue' : formatRelative(decision.dueAt, sim.now)}
+                         </Open>
+                       </span>
+                     </div>
+                     <p className="xs muted" style={{ margin: '2px 0 0' }}>{decision.detail}</p>
+                     <div className="row gap-2 wrap" style={{ marginTop: 'var(--s2)' }}>
+                       {decision.actions.map((action, index) => (
+                         <Gated
+                           key={action.label}
+                           feature="world.take_decision_action"
+                           className="btn btn-sm btn-primary"
+                           onClick={() => run('world.take_decision_action', { decisionId: decision.id, actionIndex: index })}
+                         >
+                           {action.label}
+                         </Gated>
+                       ))}
+                       {decision.route && (
+                         <button className="btn btn-sm" onClick={() => navigate(decision.route!)}>
+                           Go There
+                         </button>
+                       )}
+                       <Gated
+                         feature="world.dismiss_decision"
+                         className="btn btn-ghost btn-sm"
+                         onClick={() => run('world.dismiss_decision', { decisionId: decision.id })}
+                       >
+                         Dismiss
+                       </Gated>
+                     </div>
+                   </div>
+                 </div>
+               ))}
+               {decisions.length > 6 && (
+                 <div className="xs dim" style={{ padding: 'var(--s3) var(--s4)' }}>
+                   {/* Past the sixth there's nothing to open: each comes up as one above it closes (`openDecisions`' order). */}
+                   {decisions.length - 6} more waiting. Each one comes up here as one above it closes.
+                 </div>
+               )}
+             </LookRegion>
+           )}
+           {unread.length > 0 && (
+             <LookRegion className="list">
+               {(allNotices ? unread : unread.slice(0, 6)).map((note) => (
+                 <div key={note.id} className="list-item list-static">
+                   <div className="grow">
+                     <div className="small strong">
+                       <Open subject={at('notification', note.id)}>{titleCaseLabel(note.title)}</Open>
+                     </div>
+                     <div className="xs muted">{note.body}</div>
+                   </div>
+                   <span className="xs dim nowrap">
+                     <Open subject={at('notification', note.id)}>{formatRelative(note.at, sim.now)}</Open>
+                   </span>
+                   {note.route && (
+                     <button
+                       className="btn btn-sm"
+                       onClick={() => navigate(note.route!, titleCaseLabel(note.title))}
+                     >
+                       Go There
+                     </button>
+                   )}
+                 </div>
+               ))}
+             </LookRegion>
+           )}
+           {unread.length > 6 && (
+             <div className="row-between xs dim" style={{ padding: 'var(--s3) var(--s4)' }}>
+               {/* Why these six (from 2026-10-20, brief 17): until then "304 more unread." under a list whose order said
+                   nothing, a welcome eight months old above yesterday's note. The order is `unreadNotifications`'. */}
+               <span>{allNotices ? `All ${unread.length} unread, the most important first.` : `These six are the most important. ${unread.length - 6} more are unread.`}</span>
+               <button type="button" className="btn btn-ghost btn-sm" onClick={() => setAllNotices(!allNotices)}>
+                 {allNotices ? 'Show The Six Most Important' : `Show All ${unread.length}`}
+               </button>
+             </div>
+           )}
+         </Panel>
+         )}
+
+         <div className="col gap-4">
+           {!shows.how ? <LockedPanel feature="ui.how" title="How You Are" /> : (
+           <Panel title="How You Are" tight look={at('person', player.id)} help="body.how">
+             {/*
+               The summary names you, and the three bars name their dials, so
+               each is the way into itself. Six more dials are simulated every
+               hour and have never been on a screen — they are behind the
+               person, one press away, rather than crowded onto this panel.
+             */}
+             <LookRegion>
+               <p className="small muted" style={{ marginBottom: 'var(--s3)' }}>
+                 <Open subject={at('person', player.id)}>{wellbeingSummary(player, true, { at: sim.now, zone: sim.zone })}</Open>
+               </p>
+               <div className="col gap-3">
+                 <Meter label="Energy" value={player.wellbeing.energy} line={EMPTY} look={at('dial', `${player.id}/energy`)} />
+                 <Meter label="Stress" value={player.wellbeing.stress} invert line={OVERWROUGHT} look={at('dial', `${player.id}/stress`)} />
+                 <Meter label="Readiness" value={ready} look={at('readiness', player.id)} />
+               </div>
+             </LookRegion>
+           </Panel>
+           )}
+

+           {place && shows.where && (
+             <Panel title="Where You Are" tight look={at('place', place.city.id)} help="start.home">
+               <LookRegion>
+                 <div className="strong">
+                   <Open subject={at('place', place.city.id)}>{place.city.name}</Open>

+                     <>
+                       {', '}
+                       <Open subject={at('region', place.city.parentId)}>{place.regionName}</Open>
+                     </>
+                   )}
+                   {' · '}
+                   <Open subject={at('country', place.city.countryId)}>{place.countryName}</Open>
+                 </div>
+                 {/* Until 2026-10-13 this line said the distance and the hours from home when away, and Local Time’s note
+                     the hours from home; none since the scope of 2026-10-09, as the city Home profiles is the one
+                     `homeCityOf` gives (found by that day’s evidence pass). The place look still says them for another
+                     city. Until 2026-10-17 it began “Home.”, the screen’s own name, where it means the player’s. */}
+                 <div className="xs dim" style={{ marginBottom: 'var(--s3)' }}>
+                   <Open subject={at('place', place.city.id)}>
+                     Your home.
+                     {placeLine(place) && ` ${placeLine(place)}.`}
+                   </Open>
+                 </div>

+                 <Stat
+                   label="Local Time"
+                   value={place.localTime}
+                   note={place.zoneAbbreviation}
+                   look={at('day', today)}
+                 />
+                 <Stat
+                   label="Daylight"
+                   value={place.sun.polar === 'day' ? 'Midnight Sun' : place.sun.polar === 'night' ? 'Polar Night'
+                     : `${formatTime(place.sun.sunrise ?? sim.now, place.zone)} – ${formatTime(place.sun.sunset ?? sim.now, place.zone)}`}
+                   note={`${formatDaylight(place.sun.daylightMinutes)} of daylight`}
+                   look={at('daylight', place.city.id)}
+                 />
+                 </div>
+                 {/* Let Home breathe (from 2026-10-09): the currency, the cost of living, the taxes, the languages, the
+                     country and its roads were six more tiles here; each is on the place’s and the country’s looks. */}
+                 <p className="xs dim" style={{ margin: 'var(--s2) 0 0' }}>
+                   <Open subject={at('place', place.city.id)}>Its money, costs, taxes and languages</Open>
+                 </p>
+               </LookRegion>
+             </Panel>
+           )}

+           {!shows.weather && <LockedPanel feature="ui.weather" title="Weather" />}
+           {weather && city && shows.weather && (

+               {/*
+                 Every day in the strip is its own moment and opens as one. The
+                 climate band used to sit in the header as a chip that did
+                 nothing; it is a face of the sky now, one press inside it, so
+                 the header carries no control at all.
+               */}
+               <LookRegion>
+                 <div className="weather-now">
+                   <div className="grow">
+                     <div className="weather-temp mono">
+                       <span aria-hidden="true" style={{ marginRight: 8 }}>{WEATHER_EMOJI[weather.condition]}</span>
+                       <Open subject={at('weather', city.id)}>{weather.temperature}{unit}</Open>
+                     </div>
+                     <div className="small muted">
+                       <Open subject={at('weather', city.id)}>
+                         {titleCaseLabel(weather.condition)} · High {weather.high}{unit} · Low {weather.low}{unit}
+                       </Open>
+                     </div>
+                     <div className="xs dim">
+                       <Open subject={at('weather', city.id)}>
+                         Humidity {weather.humidity}% · Wind {weather.fahrenheit ? `${Math.round(weather.windKph * 0.621)} mph` : `${weather.windKph} km/h`}
+                       </Open>
+                       {' · '}<Open subject={at('weather', city.id)}>{weather.climateName}</Open>
+                     </div>
+                   </div>
+                 </div>
+                 <div className="weather-week" aria-label="The Days Ahead">
+                   {week.slice(1).map((day) => {
+                     const [y, m, d] = day.dateKey.split('-').map(Number);
+                     const weekday = WEEKDAY_NAMES[new Date(Date.UTC(y ?? 2026, (m ?? 1) - 1, d ?? 1)).getUTCDay()] ?? '';
+                     return (
+                       <div key={day.dateKey} className="weather-day">

+                           <Open subject={at('forecastday', `${city.id}/${day.dateKey}`)}>{weekday.slice(0, 3)}</Open>

+                         <div aria-hidden="true">{WEATHER_EMOJI[day.condition]}</div>
+                         <div className="xs weather-cond">
+                           <Open subject={at('forecastday', `${city.id}/${day.dateKey}`)}>{weatherShort(day.condition)}</Open>
+                         </div>
+                         <div className="xs mono">
+                           <Open subject={at('forecastday', `${city.id}/${day.dateKey}`)}>{day.high}° / {day.low}°</Open>
+                         </div>
+                       </div>
+                     );
+                   })}
+                 </div>
+               </LookRegion>
+             </Panel>
+           )}
+         </div>
+       </div>
+
+       {/* Your affairs, in a line each (from 2026-10-10): money, the school and the papers were three panels of their own
+           here, each with three or four tiles, the same figures as their workspaces. Each is a summary now, with only what
+           needs doing as an alert, and its workspace for the rest. */}

+               collections leaves the checking named (tests/evidence3-home.test.ts measured both). Kept for a save that
+               comes to have no primary account by some way play doesn't reach, and tested as that guard from 2026-10-15
+               (tests/scope-money.test.ts). */}
+           {!shows.money ? <LockedPanel feature="ui.money" title="Money" /> : (
+             <AffairLine
+               title="Money"

Worth ${signed(formatMoney(worth.total, cur, { cents: false }))}${worth.liabilities > 0 ? `, after ${formatMoney(worth.liabilities, cur, { cents: false })} owed.` : '.'}`}
+               alert={(primary?.balance ?? 0) < 0 ? 'Your account is overdrawn.' : undefined}

+           {player.school && (!shows.papers ? <LockedPanel feature="ui.papers" title="Papers" /> : <PapersLine cur={cur} />)}
+         </div>
+       </Panel>

+ /** One of your affairs on Home: what it is, one line of where it stands, what needs doing if anything, and the way in. */
+ function AffairLine({ title, line, alert, action, help }: { title: string; line: string; alert?: string; action: React.ReactNode; help: string }) {
+   return (
+     <div className="row gap-3 wrap" style={{ alignItems: 'baseline' }}>
+       <strong className="small" style={{ minWidth: 64 }}>{title}</strong>
+       <span className="small grow" style={{ minWidth: 0 }}>{line}{alert && <span className="xs" style={{ display: 'block', color: 'var(--warning)' }}>{alert}</span>}</span>
+       {action}
+       <HowItWorks help={help} />
+     </div>
+   );
+ }
+
+ /**
+  * Where the life began: the year and standing, the place in the class, and
+  * the next thing the school has on the calendar (`systems/school.ts`). Until
+  * 2026-09-26 it said what scholarship the next term paid in, which a family
+  * with means isn't paid.
+  */
+ function SchoolLine() {
+   const { sim, navigate } = useGame();
+   const person = useWorld((s) => s.player);
+   const school = person.school;
+   if (!school) return null;
+   const zone = CITIES.require(YALE_DRAMA.cityId).timeZone;
+   const booked = sim.universe.scheduled
+     .filter((item) => item.status === 'pending' && item.category === 'school' && item.requiresPlayer && item.payload.personId === person.id)
+     .sort((x, y) => x.at - y.at)[0];
+   // What the calendar holds, or past this week, the next classes, while there are classes to go to.
+   const enrolled = !schoolEnded(school.standing);
+   const classes = enrolled ? nextClasses(sim.now, school) : undefined;
+   const next = enrolled ? booked ?? (classes !== undefined ? { label: 'Classes', at: classes } : undefined) : undefined;
+   // Left without the degree, not a year of study (from 2026-10-10: until then a dismissed student was "Year 2").
+   const where = school.standing === 'graduated' ? 'Graduated' : !enrolled ? 'Left the School' : school.termsBegun === 0 ? 'Arriving' : school.leave?.status === 'on' ? 'On Leave' : `Year ${yearOfStudy(person)}`;
+   const troubled = school.standing === 'concern' || school.standing === 'warning' || school.standing === 'dismissed';
+   // The standing after where they are, except where that already says it: until 2026-10-13 a graduate's line read
+   // "Graduated, graduated, …" (found by the review of that day).
+   const standing = school.standing === 'graduated' ? '' : `, ${STANDING_LABEL[school.standing].toLowerCase()}`;
+   return (
+     <AffairLine
+       title="School"
+       line={`${where}${standing}, ${ordinal(rankIn(person))} of ${YALE_DRAMA.classSize} in the class.${next ? ` Next: ${next.label}, ${formatDateTime(next.at, zone)}.` : ''}`}
+       alert={troubled ? `Your standing is ${STANDING_LABEL[school.standing].toLowerCase()}. The School screen says why.` : undefined}
+       action={<Gated feature="ui.school" className="btn btn-sm" onClick={() => navigate('/workspace/school', 'School')}>{YALE_DRAMA.short}</Gated>}
+       help="school.standing"
+     />
+   );
+ }
+
+ /**
+  * Taxes and cover (`systems/health.ts`, `systems/taxreturn.ts`,
+  * `systems/unemployment.ts`): what covers them, the next return, and a claim.
+  */
+ function PapersLine({ cur }: { cur: string }) {
+   const { sim, navigate } = useGame();
+   const person = useWorld((s) => s.player);
+   const cover = coverOn(person, sim.now);
+   // The open return with something to pay, the newest first, or the newest open. Until 2026-10-14 it was the first
+   // open one by year, so a 2026 return owing nothing, Connecticut’s $3.35 taken by levy, was named on 1 February 2028
+   // as “due April 15, 2027”, and the 2027 return’s $2,286 to pay wasn’t (found by that day’s third round of evidence).
+   const opens = Object.values(person.returns ?? {}).filter((r) => r.filedAt === undefined).sort((a, b) => b.year - a.year);
+   const open = opens.find((r) => unassessedBalance(person, r) > 0) ?? opens[0];
+   // Past its day, the penalty filing now would add; filed and unpaid, what's owed and growing. Until 2026-09-27 neither showed.
+   const penalty = open && open.figures.balance > 0 && sim.now > open.due ? latePenaltyAll(person, open, sim.now, cur) : 0;
+   // What's owed today, its interest and late-payment penalty since it was last brought up to date (`owedOn`), as Papers
+   // says it: until 2026-10-10 the line read the balance as last stored, short of both.
+   const owedTax = owedEverywhere(person, sim.now);
+   // What filing it would pay: what no authority has assessed yet, a state's own assessment being in `owedTax` (from
+   // 2026-10-11: until then it was in both).
+   const toPay = open ? unassessedBalance(person, open) : 0;
+   const claim = person.unemployment?.claim;
+   // Growing once something owed is past its return's due date, from which the IRS's interest and late-payment penalty
+   // run (IRC 6601(a), 6651(a)(2)), and a state's too (`accrueState`, from the return's due date). Until 2026-10-13 the
+   // alert said so from the day a return was filed early and left unpaid, when nothing grows (found by that day's
+   // evidence pass).
+   const growing = Object.values(person.returns ?? {}).some((r) => sim.now > r.due
+     && ((r.owed ?? 0) > 0 || Object.values(r.stateDue ?? {}).some((d) => (d.owed ?? 0) > 0)));
+   // Only what needs doing is an alert: no cover, a return open or late, tax owed. The rest is the line. Past its due
+   // date, as the penalty counts it, an open return “was due” on it: until 2026-10-14 it still “is due” a day gone.
+   const alerts = [
+     !cover ? 'You have no health cover.' : '',
+     open ? `The ${open.year} return ${sim.now > open.due ? 'was' : 'is'} due ${formatDateTime(open.due, 'America/New_York').split(' at ')[0]}${toPay > 0 ? `, ${formatMoney(toPay + penalty, cur, { cents: false })} to pay${penalty > 0 ? ', a late penalty in it' : ''}` : ''}.` : '',
+     owedTax > 0 ? `${formatMoney(owedTax, cur, { cents: false })} of tax owed${growing ? ', with its interest and a late penalty growing each month' : ''}.` : '',
+   ].filter(Boolean);
+   return (
+     <AffairLine
+       title="Papers"
+       line={`Cover: ${coverLabel(person, sim.now) ?? 'none'}.${claim ? ` Unemployment, ${formatMoney(claim.weekly, cur, { cents: false })} a week.` : ''}`}
+       alert={alerts.length ? alerts.join(' ') : undefined}
+       action={<Gated feature="ui.papers" className="btn btn-sm" onClick={() => navigate('/workspace/papers', 'Papers')}>Papers</Gated>}
+       help="papers.overview"
+     />
+   );
+ }
+
+ function partOfDay(instant: number, zone: string): string {
+   const hour = Number(formatTime(instant, zone).split(':')[0]) % 12;
+   const isPm = formatTime(instant, zone).includes('PM');
+   const h24 = isPm ? (hour === 0 ? 12 : hour + 12) : (hour === 12 ? 0 : hour);
+   if (h24 < 5) return 'Night';
+   if (h24 < 12) return 'Morning';
+   if (h24 < 18) return 'Afternoon';
+   return 'Evening';
+ }
+
+
+ /** What kind of place this is: its tags if SLATE has them, else its kind and its size. */
+ function placeLine(place: PlaceProfile): string {
+   if (place.tags.length > 0) return place.tags.map(titleCaseLabel).join(' · ');
+   const parts = [placeKindLabel(place.city), place.cityPopulation > 0 ? `${formatPeople(place.cityPopulation)} people` : undefined];
+   return parts.filter((p): p is string => !!p).join(' · ');
+ }
+
+ /**
+  * What they're called day to day: the preferred name Identity asks for, and
+  * their first name when they gave none. The greeting used the first name
+  * whatever they'd said.
+  */
+ function calledBy(person: { firstName: string; lastName: string; middleName?: string; displayName: string }): string {
+   const full = [person.firstName, person.middleName, person.lastName].filter(Boolean).join(' ');
+   const plain = `${person.firstName} ${person.lastName}`;
+   return person.displayName && person.displayName !== full && person.displayName !== plain ? person.displayName : person.firstName;
+ }

+ /**
+  * SLATE — the shell.
+  *
+  * HOME for immediate life, and the calendar for what is coming. Context is
+  * preserved: the breadcrumbs survive moving around.
+  *
+  * The rail down the left is every destination, always in reach, with Home at
+  * the top wearing the count of what is waiting on you. It is words only: no
+  * icons. Below a
+  * laptop it folds into a drawer behind the Menu button. A destination joins
+  * the rail when the guide’s chapter that opens it is read; your name at the
+  * foot opens the Player Profile.
+  *
+  * The bar across the top keeps its two sides apart on purpose. Left is the
+  * world: the mark, the clock, and the controls that move it. Right is you:
+  * the tools you reach for, then the state of your save.
+  */
+
+ import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
+ import { useGame, useWorld } from '@/app/game-context';
+ import { LifeEnded } from './LifeEnded';

+ import { isOpen } from '@/engine/world/tutorial';
+ import { openDecisions, unreadNotifications } from '@/engine/world/world';
+ import { TimeControls } from './TimeControls';
+ import { GuideButton, GuideProvider, GuideStrip } from '@/ui/guide/Guide';
+ import { HelpProvider } from '@/ui/guide/Help';
+ import { Home } from '@/ui/screens/Home';
+ import { WorkspaceRouter } from '@/ui/workspaces/WorkspaceRouter';
+ import { formatDate, formatTime, zoneAbbreviation } from '@/engine/core/time';
+ import { PERFORMER_NOUN } from '@/engine/core/performer';
+
+
+ export function GameShell() {
+   const game = useGame();
+   const { sim, route, navigate, breadcrumbs, toasts } = game;
+   const [railOpen, setRailOpen] = useState(false);
+   const waiting = useWorld((s) => openDecisions(s).length);
+   const unread = useWorld((s) => unreadNotifications(s).length);
+   // The destinations the guide has opened, by group, none left empty.
+   const railGroups = useWorld((s) => RAIL_DESTINATIONS.map((g) => ({ ...g, items: g.items.filter((i) => isOpen(s, i.feature)) })).filter((g) => g.items.length > 0));
+   const profileOpen = useWorld((s) => isOpen(s, 'ui.profile'));
+
+   // Escape closes the drawer, the way it closes the dialogs. Without it the
+   // only ways out were the Menu button and a shade the drawer covers most of,
+   // and a keyboard had neither.
+   useEffect(() => {
+     if (!railOpen) return;
+     const onKey = (event: KeyboardEvent) => { if (event.key === 'Escape') setRailOpen(false); };
+     window.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
+     return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
+   }, [railOpen]);
+
+   // A life that has ended opens onto how it ended, and nothing else.
+   const ended = useWorld((s) => s.universe.meta.endedAt !== undefined);
+
+   const go = (to: string, label: string) => {
+     navigate(to, label);
+     setRailOpen(false);
+   };
+
+   if (ended) return <LifeEnded />;
+
+   return (
+     <GuideProvider>
+     <HelpProvider>
+     <div className="shell">
+       {/* To the content without a history entry or an address that names no screen (from 2026-10-13: until then the link
+           changed the address to #main, which the game read as Home). */}
+       <a className="skip-link" href="#main" onClick={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); document.getElementById('main')?.focus(); }}>Skip To Content</a>
+
+       <header className="topbar">
+         <button
+           className="btn btn-ghost btn-sm rail-toggle"
+           onClick={() => setRailOpen((open) => !open)}
+           aria-expanded={railOpen}
+           aria-controls="rail"
+         >
+           {/* Named by its word, Menu, as it's seen (from 2026-10-17, brief 14): until then its accessible name was
+               "Toggle Navigation", which a player using speech to press "Menu" couldn't reach. */}
+           Menu
+         </button>
+
+         <button
+           className="topbar-brand btn btn-ghost"
+           onClick={() => navigate('/home', 'Home')}
+           aria-label="SLATE, Go To Home"
+         >
+           <span role="img" aria-hidden="true">🎬</span>
+           <span className="hide-sm">SLATE</span>
+         </button>
+
+         <div className="topbar-clock" aria-live="polite">
+           <strong>{formatTime(sim.now, sim.zone)}</strong>
+           <span className="topbar-clock-sep" aria-hidden="true">·</span>
+           <span className="topbar-clock-date">{formatDate(sim.now, sim.zone)}</span>
+           <span className="topbar-clock-zone">{zoneAbbreviation(sim.now, sim.zone)}</span>
+         </div>
+
+         <TimeControls />
+
+         <div className="grow" />
+
+         <span className="topbar-divider" aria-hidden="true" />
+
+         <div className="topbar-group" role="group" aria-label="Your Save">
+           <GuideButton />
+           <SaveIndicator />
+
+           <button className="btn btn-ghost btn-sm" onClick={game.exitToMenu}>
+             Save &amp; Exit
+           </button>
+         </div>
+       </header>
+
+       <div className="shell-body">
+         <nav className="rail" id="rail" data-open={railOpen} aria-label="Main Navigation">
+           <div className="rail-group">
+             <button
+               className="rail-item"
+               aria-current={route === '/home' ? 'page' : undefined}
+               onClick={() => go('/home', 'Home')}
+             >
+               <span className="grow truncate">Home</span>
+               {waiting + unread > 0 && (
+                 <span className="rail-badge" aria-label={`${waiting + unread} Waiting On You`}>
+                   {waiting + unread > 99 ? '99+' : waiting + unread}
+                 </span>
+               )}
+             </button>
+           </div>
+
+           {railGroups.map((group) => (
+             <div key={group.label} className="rail-group">
+               <div className="rail-group-label">{group.label}</div>
+               {group.items.map((item) => (
+                 <button
+                   key={item.route}
+                   className="rail-item"
+                   aria-current={route === item.route ? 'page' : undefined}
+                   title={item.detail}
+                   onClick={() => go(item.route, item.label)}
+                 >
+                   <span className="grow truncate">{item.label}</span>
+                 </button>
+               ))}
+             </div>
+           ))}
+
+           <div className="rail-group rail-player">
+             <div className="rail-group-label">You</div>
+             <button
+               type="button"
+               className="rail-you rail-item"
+               aria-current={route === '/workspace/profile' ? 'page' : undefined}
+               aria-label={`${sim.player.displayName}, Open Your Player Profile`}
+               title={profileOpen ? 'Your Player Profile' : 'Locked until you read its chapter in the guide'}
+               onClick={() => go('/workspace/profile', 'Player Profile')}
+             >
+               <span className="col">
+                 <span className="small strong truncate">{sim.player.displayName}</span>
+                 <span className="xs dim truncate">
+                   {PERFORMER_NOUN[sim.player.performerTitle]} · {unread > 0 ? `${unread} Unread` : 'All Read'}
+                 </span>
+               </span>
+             </button>
+           </div>
+         </nav>
+
+         {railOpen && (
+           <button
+             type="button"
+             className="rail-shade"
+             aria-label="Close Navigation"
+             onClick={() => setRailOpen(false)}
+           />
+         )}
+
+         <main className="main" id="main" tabIndex={-1}>
+           <div className="main-inner">
+             <GuideStrip />
+             {breadcrumbs.length > 1 && (
+               <nav className="breadcrumbs" aria-label="Breadcrumb">
+                 {breadcrumbs.map((crumb, index) => (
+                   <span key={crumb.route + index} className="row gap-2">
+                     {index > 0 && <span aria-hidden="true">›</span>}
+                     {index === breadcrumbs.length - 1 ? (
+                       <span className="muted">{crumb.label}</span>
+                     ) : (
+                       <button onClick={() => navigate(crumb.route, crumb.label)}>{crumb.label}</button>
+                     )}
+                   </span>
+                 ))}
+               </nav>
+             )}
+
+             <Screen route={route} />
+           </div>
+         </main>
+       </div>
+
+       <div className="toasts" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="false">
+         {toasts.map((toast) => (
+           <div key={toast.id} className="toast" data-tone={toast.tone}>{toast.message}</div>
+         ))}
+       </div>
+     </div>
+     </HelpProvider>
+     </GuideProvider>
+   );
+ }

+ function Screen({ route }: { route: string }) {
+   if (route === '/home') return <Home />;

+ /**
+  * Where the save stands (from 2026-10-12: until then it said Saved whenever no save was under way, through up to the
+  * 45 seconds of play before the next autosave, and phones never showed it).
+  */
+ function SaveIndicator() {
+   const { saving, saveError, saveNow, unsaved } = useGame();
+   if (saveError) {
+     return (
+       <button className="btn btn-sm btn-danger" onClick={() => void saveNow()} title={saveError}>
+         Save Failed: Try Again
+       </button>
+     );
+   }
+   return (
+     <span className="xs dim" aria-live="polite" style={{ minWidth: 52, textAlign: 'right' }}>
+       {saving ? 'Saving…' : unsaved() ? 'Not Saved Yet' : 'Saved'}
+     </span>
+   );
+ }

+ /**
+  * SLATE — the end of a life.
+  *
+  * What a save shows once the player's life has ended (`systems/mortality.ts`):
+  * who they were, the dates, where, and what the years came to, read out of
+  * the save and the ledger rather than kept anywhere. The clock doesn't run
+  * again. The way on is back to the slots, where the life stays until it is
+  * deleted and another begins.

+ import { useGame } from '@/app/game-context';
+ import { formatDate } from '@/engine/core/time';
+ import { formatMoney, saveCurrency } from '@/engine/core/money';

+ export function LifeEnded() {
+   const { sim, exitToMenu } = useGame();
+   const player = sim.player;
+   const cur = saveCurrency(sim.universe);
+   const endedAt = sim.universe.meta.endedAt ?? sim.now;
+   const age = sim.universe.meta.endedAge;
+   const town = CITIES.get(homeOf(player))?.name ?? 'where they lived';
+   const worth = netWorth(sim, player.id);
+   // What the work paid, from the record the returns read (`systems/earnings.ts`): acting's wages, since the career went
+   // on 2026-10-09 the Summer Cabaret's stipend alone, and work-study's, before tax. Until 2026-10-17 the note said
+   // "before tax and commission", and no commission has been taken since the agent went with the career. Until 2026-10-13
+   // this said residuals were among them; nothing has recorded one since the career went. Until 2026-09-27 it summed
+   // what the bank was paid under a "tips" category that no longer existed, per diem and stipends among the wages.
+   const earned = Object.values(player.earnings?.years ?? {}).reduce((sum, y) => sum + y.acting + y.workStudy, 0);
+   const years = Math.max(0, (endedAt - sim.universe.meta.createdAt) / (365.2425 * 86_400_000));
+   // Under a year, counted in months, one of them a Month (from 2026-10-13: until then "1 Months").
+   const months = Math.round(years * 12);
+   const money = (cents: number) => formatMoney(cents, cur, { cents: false });
+
+   return (
+     <div className="startup">
+       <div className="startup-inner" style={{ width: 'min(720px, 92vw)', textAlign: 'center' }}>
+         <div className="eyebrow">A Life, Ended</div>
+         <h1 style={{ margin: 'var(--s2) 0' }}>{player.displayName}</h1>
+         <p className="muted">
+           {formatDate(player.birthInstant, sim.homeZone)} – {formatDate(endedAt, sim.zone)}
+           {age !== undefined ? ` · Aged ${age}` : ''} · {PERFORMER_NOUN[player.performerTitle]} · {town}
+         </p>
+         <div className="grid grid-3" style={{ margin: 'var(--s5) 0', textAlign: 'left' }}>
+           <div className="stat">
+             <span className="stat-label">Years In The World</span>
+             <span className="stat-value">{years < 1 ? plural(months, 'Month') : `${years.toFixed(1)} Years`}</span>
+             <span className="stat-note">From the first day to the last, in game time</span>
+           </div>
+           <div className="stat">
+             <span className="stat-label">Earned</span>
+             <span className="stat-value mono">{money(earned)}</span>
+             <span className="stat-note">Wages, before tax</span>
+           </div>
+           <div className="stat">
+             <span className="stat-label">Left Behind</span>
+             <span className="stat-value mono">{money(worth.total)}</span>
+             <span className="stat-note">Their net worth at the end</span>
+           </div>
+         </div>
+         <p className="small muted">
+           The clock won’t run in this save again. It stays in its slot until you delete it, and you can start a new life in any empty slot.
+         </p>
+         <button className="btn btn-primary" style={{ marginTop: 'var(--s4)' }} onClick={exitToMenu}>
+           Back To The Slots
+         </button>
+       </div>
+     </div>
+   );
+ }

+ /**
+  * SLATE — time controls.
+  *
+  * Sleep and Skip to Event both go through the one advancement path, so the
+  * world processes everything that comes due either way.

+ import { titleCaseLabel } from '@/engine/core/text';
+ import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
+ import { useGame, useWorld } from '@/app/game-context';
+ import { Modal, WhyNot, dialogOpen } from '@/ui/components/primitives';

+ /** The foot of a top-bar menu, where its How This Works sits: the bar itself has no room for one. */
+ const MENU_FOOT = { padding: 'var(--s2) var(--s3) var(--s1)', marginTop: 'var(--s1)', borderTop: '1px solid var(--line)' } as const;
+
+ /** The dials, as the menu names them. */
+ const DIAL_LABEL: Partial<Record<string, string>> = {
+   energy: 'Energy', stress: 'Stress', sleepDebt: 'Sleep Debt', nourishment: 'Nourishment', morale: 'Morale', hygiene: 'Hygiene', condition: 'Condition', fitness: 'Fitness',
+ };
+
+ /**
+  * A dial as the menu says it: a whole number, and fitness, stamina's own figure, to the tenth the Player Profile keeps it
+  * to (from 2026-10-17, brief 11, T1). Until then a workout's gain under a point read as none: at 50.6 a run building 0.8
+  * said "Fitness 51 → 51".
+  */
+ const dialFigure = (dial: string, x: number): string => (dial === 'fitness' ? x.toFixed(1) : String(Math.round(x)));
+
+ /**
+  * The live clock held while a dialog that moves it is open (from 2026-10-20, the owner's brief 19, D4: brief 18's S4), as
+  * the guide and the reference hold it (`hold`, `app/game-context.tsx`): Sleep, On The Way and Skip To Event each say where
+  * the clock would go from now, and a clock running behind them made what they said untrue. Closed without moving it, the
+  * clock goes on from where it was, the time the dialog was open not counted; a sleep or a jump moves it as it always did.
+  * Until then only the guide and the reference held it, and with Play on the Sleep dialog's Now and its suggestion moved
+  * under the player (11:00 PM became 11:01 PM in a minute open on the built app, brief 19's walk).
+  */
+ function useHeld(key: string, on = true): void {
+   const { hold } = useGame();
+   useEffect(() => {
+     hold(key, on);
+     return () => hold(key, false);
+   }, [hold, key, on]);
+ }
+
+ /** How far ahead Skip To Event foresees the stops not on the calendar yet: a month. */
+ const FORESEEN_DAYS = 31;
+
+ /** "a, or b, or c": the stop's choices as On The Way offers them. */
+ const orList = (items: readonly string[]): string => items.join(', or ');
+
+ /** What On The Way says of the choices the commitments it lists offer beyond Go and Stand Here, and what each does to the jump. */
+ function choicesAhead(missed: readonly OnTheWay[]): string {
+   const seen = new Map<string, StopChoice>();
+   for (const { item } of missed) for (const c of stopChoices(item.kind)) seen.set(c.command, c);
+   const carry = [...seen.values()].filter((c) => c.then === 'carry-on').map((c) => c.ahead);
+   const stay = [...seen.values()].filter((c) => c.then === 'stay').map((c) => c.ahead);
+   const after = (n: number) => (n === 1 ? 'the clock then carries on' : n === 2 ? 'the clock carries on after either' : 'the clock carries on after any of them');
+   return [
+     carry.length ? ` You can also ${orList(carry)}, and ${after(carry.length)}.` : '',
+     stay.length ? ` You can also ${orList(stay)}, and the clock then stays paused there.` : '',
+   ].join('');
+ }

+ export function TimeControls() {
+   // Why sleep can't start now, as the command has it: in the middle of a commitment.
+   const sleepBusy = useWorld((s) => { const busy = occupiedAt(s, s.now); return busy ? `You’re at ${busy.label} until ${formatTime(busy.at + busy.durationMinutes! * 60_000, s.zone)}.` : undefined; });
+   const sleepGate = useFeature('ui.sleep');
+   const { sim, advanceTo, run, refresh, standingAt, clearStandingAt } = useGame();
+   const [sleepOpen, setSleepOpen] = useState(false);
+   const [skipOpen, setSkipOpen] = useState(false);
+   const [confirm, setConfirm] = useState<{ at: Instant; label: string; missed: OnTheWay[] } | null>(null);
+   const speed = sim.universe.preferences.timeSpeed;
+   useHeld('on-the-way', confirm !== null);
+
+   /**
+    * Moving the clock, and standing still when something wants you.
+    *
+    * Every way of moving the clock stops at anything that needs the player
+    * rather than running it over, and the halt is held by the provider because
+    * the live tick can be halted too. That halt is the whole decision: you are
+    * at the thing, and you either go — which spends the hours it takes — or you
+    * do not, and they find out you were not there.
+    */
+   const due = standingAt;
+
+   // Through the command, the way every other change to the save goes. It was
+   // an assignment into `sim.universe` from a React component, which is the one
+   // write in the interface that skipped the engine entirely.
+   const setSpeed = (next: typeof speed) => {
+     run('world.set_preferences', { timeSpeed: next }, { silent: true });
+     refresh();
+   };
+
+   return (
+     <>
+       <div className="row gap-1 topbar-time" role="group" aria-label="Time Controls">
+         {/* Play or Pause names what a press does, and has no pressed state. Until 2026-10-13 it was also a toggle,
+             `aria-pressed` on while paused, so a screen reader said “Play, pressed” with the clock stopped and “Pause, not
+             pressed” with it running: a toggle’s name stays the same while its state changes (WAI-ARIA Authoring
+             Practices, Button pattern), and this one’s changes. */}
+         <Gated
+           feature="ui.play"
+           className="btn btn-ghost btn-sm"
+           onClick={() => setSpeed(speed === 'paused' ? 'live' : 'paused')}
+           title={speed === 'paused' ? 'Resume Time' : 'Pause Time'}
+         >
+           {speed === 'paused' ? 'Play' : 'Pause'}
+         </Gated>
+         <Gated feature="ui.sleep" className="btn btn-sm" disabled={Boolean(sleepBusy)} title={sleepBusy} onClick={() => setSleepOpen(true)}>Sleep</Gated>
+         <LookAfterMenu />
+         <AdvanceMenu
+           onAdvance={(at, label) => {
+             // What the jump would stop at, those not on the calendar yet among them (`onTheWay`, from 2026-10-20, brief
+             // 19's D5): until then the calendar's own alone (`missedBy`), and One Week from a Friday evening asked nothing
+             // and stopped at Monday's classes, which the School puts on the calendar the Sunday before.
+             const missed = onTheWay(sim, at);
+             if (missed.length > 0) setConfirm({ at, label, missed });
+             else advanceTo(at);
+           }}
+           onChooseEvent={() => setSkipOpen(true)}
+         />
+       </div>
+       {/* Why Sleep is grayed out, in words on a row of its own at the foot of the bar (from 2026-10-12): until then it
+           was only Sleep's tooltip, which a phone never shows and a keyboard never reaches. The bar's other controls are
+           listed, never refused, so the line names Sleep rather than saying "Not now". Its row is the bar's own
+           (`.topbar-why`): first written as an item beside the controls, it squeezed the bar on a desktop or a tablet and
+           pushed Save & Exit off its edge. Not said while the guide still has Sleep locked, when it isn't grayed out. */}
+       {sleepBusy && sleepGate.open && (
+         <div className="topbar-why">
+           <WhyNot reasons={[[speed === 'paused' ? 'Play' : 'Pause', undefined], ['Sleep', sleepBusy], ['Look After Yourself', undefined], ['Advance', undefined]]} />
+         </div>
+       )}
+
+       {due && (
+         <DueNow
+           stop={due}
+           // Carrying on is the same jump the stop broke off, not a new one, through the commitment's own hours
+           // (`carryOnTo`, `world/clock.ts`).
+           onGo={() => {
+             clearStandingAt();
+             advanceTo(carryOnTo(due, 'go')!, due.sentFrom);
+           }}
+           onClose={clearStandingAt}
+         />
+       )}
+
+       {sleepOpen && <SleepDialog onClose={() => setSleepOpen(false)} />}
+       {skipOpen && <SkipDialog onClose={() => setSkipOpen(false)} onSkip={(at) => { advanceTo(at); setSkipOpen(false); }} />}
+       {confirm && (
+         <Modal
+           title="On The Way"
+           onClose={() => setConfirm(null)}
+           footer={
+             <>
+               <button className="btn" onClick={() => setConfirm(null)}>Cancel</button>
+               <button className="btn btn-primary" onClick={() => { advanceTo(confirm.at); setConfirm(null); }}>
+                 Advance
+               </button>
+             </>
+           }
+         >
+           {/* What each stop offers is DueNow's: Go and Stand Here always, and what a kind of commitment declares
+               (`stopChoices`, `world/clock.ts`). What each does to this move is said (from 2026-10-20, brief 17): Go carries
+               the move on to where it was headed and Stand Here ends it, the clock paused at the stop (`onGo`, `onClose`).
+               Until then it said "press Go, or Stand Here to wait", which didn't say the move stops there. From later that
+               day (brief 19, D1) it names only the choices of the commitments it lists, and that the move carries on after
+               them: until then it named Skip It and Call It Off whatever was on the way, and nothing said where the clock
+               went after either. */}
+           <p className="small muted">
+             Moving the clock to <strong>{confirm.label}</strong> ({formatDateTime(confirm.at, sim.zone)}) passes{' '}
+             {said(confirm.missed.length, 'commitment')}. The clock stops at {confirm.missed.length === 1 ? 'it' : 'each one'} so
+             you can choose: press Go to be there and carry on, or Stand Here to stop the clock there.{choicesAhead(confirm.missed)}
+           </p>
+           <ul className="small" style={{ margin: 'var(--s2) 0 0', paddingLeft: 'var(--s4)' }}>
+             {confirm.missed.slice(0, 8).map(({ item, foreseen }) => (
+               <li key={`${item.id}${foreseen ? ' ahead' : ''}`}>{titleCaseLabel(item.label)} — {formatDateTime(item.at, sim.zone)}{foreseen ? ', not on your calendar yet' : ''}</li>
+             ))}
+           </ul>
+           {confirm.missed.some((w) => w.foreseen) && (
+             <p className="xs dim" style={{ marginTop: 'var(--s2)' }}>
+               What isn’t on your calendar yet goes on it as the clock moves, before it comes.
+             </p>
+           )}
+         </Modal>
+       )}
+     </>
+   );
+ }

+ function SleepDialog({ onClose }: { onClose: () => void }) {
+   const { sim, run } = useGame();
+   // The clock waits while the hours are chosen (from 2026-10-20, brief 19's D4): Not Yet leaves it where it was, and
+   // Sleep moves it as the night does.
+   useHeld('sleep');
+   const suggestion = useWorld((s) => suggestedSleep(s));
+   const untilNext = useWorld((s) => hoursUntilNextCommitment(s));
+   const [hours, setHours] = useState(suggestion.hours);
+
+   const wakeAt = sim.now + hours * MS_HOUR;
+   const crossed = sim.timeline.between(sim.now, wakeAt).filter((i) => i.requiresPlayer);
+   // Said, because the suggestion can be one: three hours before something at
+   // three in the morning is tonight’s night, and they are up from half past
+   // two to the next midnight.
+   const tonight = sleepStandsForTheNight(sim, hours);
+
+   const sleep = () => {
+     const result = run('life.sleep', { hours });
+     if (result.ok) onClose();
+   };
+
+   return (
+     <Modal
+       title="Sleep"
+       onClose={onClose}
+       footer={
+         <>
+           <HowItWorks help="body.sleep" />
+           <button className="btn" onClick={onClose}>Not Yet</button>
+           <Gated feature="life.sleep" className="btn btn-primary" onClick={sleep}>
+             Sleep {plural(hours, 'Hour')}
+           </Gated>
+         </>
+       }
+     >
+       <p className="muted">{suggestion.reason}</p>
+
+       <div className="field">
+         <div className="row-between">
+           <label htmlFor="sleep-hours" style={{ marginBottom: 0 }}>Hours</label>
+           <span className="mono">{hours}</span>
+         </div>
+         {/* The engine's own floor and ceiling (from 2026-10-12): the slider started at 1 until then, under a suggestion
+             that can be half an hour. */}
+         <input
+           id="sleep-hours" type="range" min={SHORTEST_SLEEP} max={LONGEST_NIGHT} step={0.5}
+           value={hours} onChange={(e) => setHours(Number(e.target.value))}
+         />
+       </div>
+
+       <div className="grid grid-2">
+         <div className="stat">
+           <span className="stat-label">Now</span>
+           <span className="small">{formatTime(sim.now, sim.zone)}</span>
+         </div>
+         <div className="stat">
+           <span className="stat-label">You’d Wake At</span>
+           <span className="small">{formatTime(wakeAt, sim.zone)}, {formatDate(wakeAt, sim.zone)}</span>
+         </div>
+       </div>
+
+       {/* Standing at it, it's now (from 2026-10-12). Until then this line left it out, and counted from now it would
+           have said "in less than a minute". */}
+       {untilNext !== undefined && (
+         <div className="callout" style={{ marginTop: 'var(--s4)' }}>
+           {untilNext <= 0 ? 'Your next commitment is now, and you’re standing at it.' : `Your next commitment is in ${formatDurationWords(untilNext * MS_HOUR)}.`}
+         </div>
+       )}
+
+       {tonight && (
+         <div className="callout callout-warning" style={{ marginTop: 'var(--s4)' }}>
+           This would count as tonight’s sleep. You’d be up from {formatTime(wakeAt, sim.zone)}, and you wouldn’t
+           sleep the rest of the night.
+         </div>
+       )}
+
+       {crossed.length > 0 && (
+         <div className="callout callout-warning" style={{ marginTop: 'var(--s3)' }}>
+           <strong>You’d sleep through {said(crossed.length, 'commitment')}:</strong>
+           <ul className="small" style={{ margin: 'var(--s2) 0 0', paddingLeft: 'var(--s4)' }}>
+             {crossed.slice(0, 5).map((item) => (
+               <li key={item.id}>{item.label} — {formatTime(item.at, sim.zone)}</li>
+             ))}
+           </ul>
+         </div>
+       )}
+
+       {/* Until 2026-10-20 (brief 17) this said "anything on your calendar in those hours happens without you", where a
+           commitment slept through is missed (`life.sleep`'s You Slept Through notice), and only what happens without
+           you runs on its own. */}
+       <p className="xs dim" style={{ marginTop: 'var(--s4)' }}>
+         The clock moves on while you sleep. What happens without you still happens, and you miss any commitment in
+         those hours.
+       </p>
+     </Modal>
+   );
+ }
+
+ /**
+  * You are at it. Go, or do not.
+  *
+  * The one place in the game where turning up is a decision rather than a
+  * consequence. Going costs the hours it takes, which is why not going is a
+  * real option.
+  *
+  * Its buttons beyond Go and Stand Here are the commitment's kind's own (`stopChoices`, `world/clock.ts`, from 2026-10-20,
+  * the owner's brief 19, D1): Skip It on a plan of your own and Call It Off on a rehearsal with a partner, as they were,
+  * and what a career appointment declares. Each says what it does to the jump before it's pressed, and does it: its
+  * command run, then the jump carried on to where it was headed (`carryOnTo`), or, refused, the stop left open with the
+  * refusal said. Until then Skip It carried the jump on and Call It Off ended it, neither said, and a refused Skip It
+  * closed the stop and left the jump there.
+  */
+ function DueNow({ stop, onGo, onClose }: {
+   stop: Stop;
+   onGo: () => void;
+   onClose: () => void;
+ }) {
+   const { sim, run, toast, advanceTo, clearStandingAt } = useGame();
+   const zone = sim.zone;
+   const { item, wanted } = stop;
+   const choices = stopChoices(item.kind);
+   const partner = item.kind === PARTNER_KIND;
+   // Your own care asks only that you're awake and out of hospital (`presentForCare`); anything else, that you're in its
+   // town and not laid up by an injury too (`present`).
+   const care = item.kind === APPOINTMENT_KIND || item.kind === THERAPY_SESSION_KIND;
+   const runs = item.durationMinutes ?? 0;
+   const name = titleCaseLabel(item.label);
+   // Where the clock goes after a choice, in words: a stop the live clock made is a second from where it was headed.
+   const onward = (choice: StopChoice) => {
+     const to = carryOnTo(stop, choice);
+     return to !== undefined && to - item.at >= MS_MINUTE
+       ? `the clock carries on to ${formatDateTime(to, zone)}, stopping at the next commitment on the way`
+       : 'the clock stays paused here';
+   };
+   // A rehearsal with a partner can be called off even now, late (from 2026-10-12): until then this said it wasn’t
+   // the player’s to walk away from, while Call It Off on the Coursework tab worked at this very moment.
+   const choose = (choice: StopChoice) => {
+     // Not silent about a refusal: if the world won't let you walk away from something, the reason is the answer, and
+     // the stop stays where it is.
+     const refused = refusalOf(run(choice.command, choice.payload(item), { silent: true }));
+     if (refused) { toast(refused, 'negative'); return; }
+     clearStandingAt();
+     if (choice.done) toast(choice.done, 'neutral');
+     const to = carryOnTo(stop, choice);
+     if (to !== undefined) advanceTo(to, stop.sentFrom);
+   };
+
+   return (
+     <Modal
+       title={name}
+       onClose={onClose}
+       footer={(
+         <>
+           <HowItWorks help="day.calendar" />
+           <button className="btn btn-ghost" onClick={onClose}>Stand Here</button>
+           {choices.map((choice) => (
+             <Gated key={choice.command} feature={choice.command} className="btn" onClick={() => choose(choice)}>{choice.label}</Gated>
+           ))}
+           <Gated feature="ui.go" className="btn btn-primary" onClick={onGo}>Go</Gated>
+         </>
+       )}
+     >
+       <p className="small">
+         It’s {formatTime(item.at, zone)} on {formatDate(item.at, zone)}, and this needs you now.
+         {' '}Going takes {formatDurationWords(runs * 60_000)}
+         {`, and the clock moves on to ${formatDateTime(Math.max(wanted, item.at + runs * 60_000), zone)}.`}
+       </p>
+       {choices.length === 0 && (
+         <p className="small muted">
+           {/* What starts and who's there, said (from 2026-10-20, brief 16, section 8): until then "It happens the next time
+               the clock moves, and you’re there if you’re awake and in the right city", which left out the hospital and an
+               injury, and didn't say what "it" was. What to press comes first, and why there's no Skip It last (brief 17,
+               the same day): until then the paragraph opened on the button that isn't there, and "Stand Here to wait"
+               didn't say the clock waits paused, as the stop pauses it (`halt` in `game-context.tsx`). */}
+           Press Go, or Stand Here to wait with the clock paused.
+           {` ${name} starts the next time the clock moves, and you’re there if you’re awake${care ? ' and out of hospital' : ', in its town, and not in hospital or laid up with an injury'}.`}
+           {' '}Only a plan of your own can be skipped, so there’s no Skip It button here.
+         </p>
+       )}
+       {partner && (
+         <p className="small muted">
+           Your partner is expecting you. You can go or call it off, but at this short notice calling it off costs their
+           trust, and they’ll remember it.{' '}
+           <HowItWorks help="coursework.partners" />
+         </p>
+       )}
+       {choices.length > 0 && (
+         <p className="small muted">
+           {choices.map((choice) => `${choice.label} ${choice.does}, and ${onward(choice)}. `).join('')}
+           {`Stand Here keeps the clock paused here, and ${name} starts the next time it moves.`}
+         </p>
+       )}
+     </Modal>
+   );
+ }

+ /** Exported for `tests/whynot-time.test.ts`, which renders it: the bar opens it from Advance's Choose An Event. */
+ export function SkipDialog({ onClose, onSkip }: { onClose: () => void; onSkip: (at: number) => void }) {
+   const { sim } = useGame();
+   // Held while it's open, as Sleep and On The Way are (from 2026-10-20, brief 19's D4).
+   useHeld('skip');
+   const targets = useWorld((s) => skipTargets(s, 14));
+   const [selected, setSelected] = useState<string | null>(targets[0]?.item.id ?? null);
+   const target = targets.find((t) => t.item.id === selected);
+   // The stops on the way that aren't on the calendar yet, foreseen once for the list as it opens (`onTheWay`, from
+   // 2026-10-20, brief 19's D5), as far as its last event or a month ahead, whichever is sooner: a month's jump played
+   // ahead takes a tenth of a second or so, a year's could take seconds. Until then each event's count and list were the
+   // calendar's alone, and the week's classes the School hadn't put on it yet weren't counted.
+   const ids = targets.map((t) => t.item.id).join(' ');
+   const ahead = useMemo(() => {
+     const last = targets.at(-1)?.item.at;
+     return last === undefined ? [] : onTheWay(sim, Math.min(last, sim.now + FORESEEN_DAYS * MS_DAY)).filter((w) => w.foreseen);
+     // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
+   }, [sim, ids]);
+   // Not one the clock is standing at, which the jump runs at once, with no stop (as On The Way, `onTheWay`).
+   const stopsBefore = (t: SkipTarget) => [
+     ...t.missed.filter((e) => e.at > sim.now).map((e) => ({ id: e.id, title: e.title, at: e.at, foreseen: false })),
+     ...ahead.filter((w) => w.item.at < t.item.at).map((w) => ({ id: `${w.item.id} ahead`, title: titleCaseLabel(w.item.label), at: w.item.at, foreseen: true })),
+   ].sort((a, b) => a.at - b.at);
+   const missed = target ? stopsBefore(target) : [];
+
+   return (
+     <Modal
+       title="Skip To Event"
+       onClose={onClose}
+       wide
+       footer={
+         <>
+           <button className="btn" onClick={onClose}>Cancel</button>
+           <button
+             className="btn btn-primary"
+             disabled={!target}
+             onClick={() => target && onSkip(target.item.at)}
+           >
+             Skip {target ? `To ${titleCaseLabel(target.entry.title)}` : ''}
+           </button>
+         </>
+       }
+     >
+       {targets.length === 0 ? (
+         <p className="muted">There’s nothing on your calendar ahead of you.</p>
+       ) : (
+         <>
+           <div className="list card card-flush" style={{ maxHeight: 260, overflowY: 'auto' }}>
+             {targets.map((entry) => (
+               <button
+                 key={entry.item.id}
+                 className="list-item"
+                 aria-selected={selected === entry.item.id}
+                 onClick={() => setSelected(entry.item.id)}
+               >
+                 <div className="grow">
+                   <div className="small strong">{entry.entry.title}</div>
+                   <div className="xs dim">
+                     {formatDate(entry.item.at, sim.zone)} at {formatTime(entry.item.at, sim.zone)}
+                     {entry.daysAway > 0 && ` · in ${entry.daysAway} day${entry.daysAway === 1 ? '' : 's'}`}
+                   </div>
+                 </div>
+                 {stopsBefore(entry).length > 0 && (
+                   <span className="chip chip-warning">{stopsBefore(entry).length} on the way</span>
+                 )}
+                 {/* Until 2026-10-12 it was a Travel chip, for travel that went with the scope reset of 2026-10-09. */}
+                 {entry.elsewhere && <span className="chip chip-negative">Elsewhere</span>}
+               </button>
+             ))}
+           </div>
+
+           {/* Skip grayed out with events on the list and none picked, said under the list (from 2026-10-12): the one
+               picked when this opened went by on a live clock, or nothing was ahead then. Until then nothing said why.
+               With nothing ahead at all, the line in the list's place says it. */}
+           {!target && (
+             <div style={{ marginTop: 'var(--s2)' }}>
+               <WhyNot reasons={[['Cancel', undefined], ['Skip', 'Pick an event from the list.']]} />
+             </div>
+           )}
+
+           {target && (
+             <div style={{ marginTop: 'var(--s4)' }}>
+               <div className="eyebrow" style={{ marginBottom: 'var(--s2) ' }}>On The Way</div>
+
+               {target.travelNote && (
+                 <div className="callout callout-negative" style={{ marginBottom: 'var(--s3)' }}>
+                   {target.travelNote}
+                 </div>
+               )}
+
+               {missed.length > 0 ? (
+                 <div className="callout callout-warning" style={{ marginBottom: 'var(--s3)' }}>
+                   <strong>The clock will stop at {said(missed.length, 'commitment')} on the way and ask what you want to do:</strong>
+                   <ul className="small" style={{ margin: 'var(--s2) 0 0', paddingLeft: 'var(--s4)' }}>
+                     {missed.slice(0, 6).map((entry) => (
+                       <li key={entry.id}>{entry.title} — {formatDate(entry.at, sim.zone)}{entry.foreseen ? ', not on your calendar yet' : ''}</li>
+                     ))}
+                   </ul>
+                 </div>
+               ) : (
+                 <p className="small muted">You have no commitments before it.</p>
+               )}
+
+               <p className="xs dim">
+                 {target.crossed.length === 0
+                   ? 'It’s the next thing on your calendar.'
+                   : `${toStart(said(target.crossed.length, 'thing'))} on your calendar ${target.crossed.length === 1 ? 'happens' : 'happen'} on the way, in order. The clock only moves forward.`}
+               </p>
+             </div>
+           )}
+         </>
+       )}
+     </Modal>
+   );
+ }

+ /**
+  * Advance: the world moved forward on purpose.
+  *
+  * Live time is a minute a minute. This is for when you do not want to wait —
+  * the hour until a call, the night until a morning, the week until a
+  * decision. Every jump goes through the one world clock, everything on the
+  * way is processed in order, and a jump that would skip past a commitment
+  * asks first.
+  */
+ function AdvanceMenu({
+   onAdvance, onChooseEvent,
+ }: {
+   onAdvance: (at: Instant, label: string) => void;
+   onChooseEvent: () => void;
+ }) {
+   const { sim } = useGame();
+   const nextEvent = useWorld((s) => skipTargets(s, 1)[0]);
+   const { open, setOpen, anchor } = useDropdown();
+   const gate = useFeature('ui.advance');
+   const choosing = useFeature('ui.skip');
+
+   const zone = sim.zone;
+   const now = sim.now;
+   // Each line says the day and the time it lands (from 2026-10-20, brief 19's D2): until then One Hour said the time
+   // alone and the rest a date with no day, and at 2 AM Tomorrow Morning said the next date's seven, where it then went.
+   // It goes to the next seven now (`nextAtHour`, `world/clock.ts`), the same date's after midnight.
+   const lands = (at: Instant) => `${formatTime(at, zone)} · ${formatWeekdayDate(at, zone)}`;
+   const line = (label: string, at: Instant) => ({ label, detail: lands(at), at });
+
+   const items: { label: string; detail: string; at?: Instant; choose?: boolean }[] = [
+     line('One Hour', now + MS_HOUR),
+     line('This Evening', nextAtHour(now, zone, ADVANCE_HOURS.evening)),
+     line('Tonight', nextAtHour(now, zone, ADVANCE_HOURS.tonight)),
+     line('Tomorrow Morning', nextAtHour(now, zone, ADVANCE_HOURS.morning)),
+     {
+       label: 'Next Event',
+       detail: nextEvent ? `${nextEvent.entry.title} · ${formatDateTime(nextEvent.item.at, zone)}` : 'No plans or commitments ahead',
+       at: nextEvent?.item.at,
+     },
+     line('Next Monday', nextMondayAt(now, zone)),
+     line('One Week', addDays(now, 7, zone)),
+     { label: 'Choose An Event…', detail: 'Pick from everything on the calendar', choose: true },
+   ];
+
+   return (
+     <div className="menu-anchor" ref={anchor}>
+       <button
+         type="button"
+         className={`btn btn-sm${gate.open ? '' : ' is-locked'}`}
+         aria-haspopup="menu"
+         aria-expanded={open}
+         title={gate.reason}
+         onClick={() => (gate.open ? setOpen((o) => !o) : gate.ask())}
+       >
+         {/* The arrow is drawn, not said (from 2026-10-17, brief 14's editorial review): until then the button's accessible
+             name was “Advance ▾”, which a screen reader says with the arrow's name in it. Look After Yourself's likewise. */}
+         Advance <span aria-hidden="true">▾</span>{!gate.open && <span className="lock-word">Locked</span>}
+       </button>
+       {open && (
+         <div className="menu" role="menu" aria-label="Advance Time">
+           {items.map((item) => (
+             <button
+               key={item.label}
+               type="button"
+               role="menuitem"
+               className="menu-item"
+               disabled={!item.choose && item.at === undefined}
+               onClick={() => {
+                 setOpen(false);
+                 if (item.choose && !choosing.open) choosing.ask();
+                 else if (item.choose) onChooseEvent();
+                 else if (item.at !== undefined) onAdvance(item.at, item.label);
+               }}
+             >
+               <span className="menu-item-label">{item.label}</span>
+               <span className="menu-item-detail">{item.detail}</span>
+             </button>
+           ))}
+           <div role="none" className="row gap-2 wrap" style={MENU_FOOT}>
+             <HowItWorks help="day.advance" />
+             <HowItWorks help="day.clock" label="How Play And Pause Work" />
+           </div>
+         </div>
+       )}
+     </div>
+   );
+ }
