+ /**
+  * A menu that closes on a click outside it or on Escape, but not while a dialog is open over it: the press or the
+  * Escape is the dialog’s, and the menu is left as it was under it, with the control that opened the dialog, which
+  * gets focus back when the dialog closes. Until 2026-10-13 it closed on either, so How This Works in the menu opened
+  * the help and the help’s own Close, or Escape, shut the menu under it and lost the focus (found by the guide audit
+  * of that day).
+  */
+ function useDropdown() {
+   const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
+   const anchor = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
+
+   useEffect(() => {
+     if (!open) return;
+     const away = (event: MouseEvent) => {
+       if (dialogOpen()) return;
+       if (anchor.current && !anchor.current.contains(event.target as Node)) setOpen(false);
+     };
+     const escape = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
+       if (dialogOpen()) return;
+       if (event.key === 'Escape') setOpen(false);
+     };
+     document.addEventListener('mousedown', away);
+     document.addEventListener('keydown', escape);
+     return () => {
+       document.removeEventListener('mousedown', away);
+       document.removeEventListener('keydown', escape);
+     };
+   }, [open]);
+
+   return { open, setOpen, anchor };
+ }
+
+ /**
+  * Look after yourself: the things besides sleep a player does for their body.
+  *
+  * Each item says how long it takes, what it costs, why it stands where it
+  * does and what it would do to the dials, or, when the engine would refuse
+  * it, why, and is grayed out. The order is the engine's (`lookAfterOptions`,
+  * from 2026-10-09): what's costing the body every hour first, then by the
+  * readiness it gives back. Until then the menu was a fixed list. Nothing on it
+  * happens until it's chosen.
+  */
+ function LookAfterMenu() {
+   const { sim, run, toast } = useGame();
+   const { open, setOpen, anchor } = useDropdown();
+   const gate = useFeature('ui.look-after');
+   const doing = useFeature('life.look_after');
+   // Asked again whenever the world changes, so a meal eaten or a clock moved since counts.
+   const options = useWorld((s) => lookAfterOptions(s));
+   const cur = saveCurrency(sim.universe);
+
+   const act = (action: LookAfter) => {
+     setOpen(false);
+     const result = run<{ doneAt: number }>('life.look_after', { action });
+     if (result.ok && result.value) {
+       toast(`${labelFor(sim, action)}: done at ${formatTime(result.value.doneAt, sim.zone)}.`, 'positive');
+     }
+   };
+
+   return (
+     <div className="menu-anchor" ref={anchor}>
+       <button
+         type="button"
+         className={`btn btn-sm${gate.open ? '' : ' is-locked'}`}
+         aria-haspopup="menu"
+         aria-expanded={open}
+         title={gate.reason}
+         onClick={() => (gate.open ? setOpen((o) => !o) : gate.ask())}
+       >
+         Look After Yourself <span aria-hidden="true">▾</span>{!gate.open && <span className="lock-word">Locked</span>}
+       </button>
+       {open && (
+         <div className="menu" role="menu" aria-label="Look After Yourself">
+           {options.map((o, i) => {
+             const { action, refused } = o;
+             const first = i === 0 && !refused && (o.urgent || o.gain >= 0.5);
+             return (
+               <button
+                 key={action}
+                 type="button"
+                 role="menuitem"
+                 className="menu-item"
+                 disabled={refused !== undefined}
+                 onClick={() => (doing.open ? act(action) : doing.ask())}
+               >
+                 <span className="menu-item-label">
+                   {o.label}
+                   {first && <span className={`chip ${o.urgent ? 'chip-warning' : 'chip-accent'}`} style={{ marginLeft: 8 }}>{o.urgent ? 'Needed Now' : 'Most Worth It'}</span>}
+                 </span>
+                 <span className="menu-item-detail">
+                   {formatDuration(o.minutes * 60_000)}{o.cost > 0 ? ` · ${formatMoney(o.cost, cur)}` : ''} · {refused ?? o.why}
+                 </span>
+                 {!refused && o.changes.length > 0 && (
+                   <span className="menu-item-detail">
+                     {o.changes.map((c) => `${DIAL_LABEL[c.dial] ?? c.dial} ${dialFigure(c.dial, c.from)} → ${dialFigure(c.dial, c.to)}`).join(' · ')}
+                     {/* Named as the measures beside it are (from 2026-10-20, brief 17): until then "Morale 84 → 86 · readiness +0.4". */}
+                     {o.gain !== 0 ? ` · Readiness ${o.gain > 0 ? '+' : ''}${o.gain.toFixed(1)}` : ''}
+                   </span>
+                 )}
+               </button>
+             );
+           })}
+           <div role="none" className="row gap-2 wrap" style={MENU_FOOT}>
+             <HowItWorks help="body.look-after" />
+           </div>
+         </div>
+       )}
+     </div>
+   );
+ }

+ /**
+  * Everywhere you can go, in one list.
+  *
+  * There is not much of it left. Keeping the list here rather than in the
+  * screen means the rail, the breadcrumbs and Home cannot disagree about what
+  * exists.
+  *
+  * Entries are text. No emoji, no glyph icons: a symbol that renders as a
+  * picture on one platform and a box on another is not a label, and a
+  * screen reader has nothing to say about it. A destination that existed and
+  * didn’t open, `locked`, went on 2026-09-27: none had been for a long time.

+    * are standing in, so it belongs beside the day rather than in a list of
+    * other places to be.

+ /**
+  * SLATE — the sections inside a screen, its tabs, said once (from 2026-10-08).
+  *
+  * The screen draws its tabs from here, so a section is named the same
+  * wherever it's offered. Which tab is showing is kept by `tabKey`, so a
+  * screen keeps its tab while the player is elsewhere.
+  *
+  * The career's, the industry's and the homes' went with them in the scope
+  * reset of 2026-10-09, and so did Papers' Driving with the cars; Papers'
+  * Passport And Travel is Passport And ID, the journeys gone. The Career came
+  * back on 2026-10-20 (brief 19) with two tabs, Overview and Portfolio, and
+  * Representation came on 2026-10-21 with the agent's system; its others come
+  * with the systems they show, never before.
+  */

+ /** Where a screen's showing tab is kept (`ui/kept.ts`). */
+ export const tabKey = (route: string) => `tab:${route}`;
+
+ /**
+  * SLATE — the opening.
+  *
+  * The first thing the screen says is what the game is: a life simulator. It
+  * is under the mark rather than buried in an about box because it is the
+  * premise, and the revamp will say more about it there when it has more to
+  * say.
+  *
+  * The progression is real. Each stage does actual work — resolving persistence,
+  * reading the slots, saying what a slot that won’t read is, checking schema
+  * versions — and the bar reflects it. A failure stops with a specific reason
+  * and a way forward rather than a spinner that never ends. Until 2026-09-27 it
+  * opened on a stage that only waited, "Starting The Projector", closed on
+  * another, and waited between the rest, about 850 milliseconds of a bar
+  * moving for nothing; and "Validating Universes" validated nothing, only
+  * said what reading the slots had found.
+  */
+
+ import { titleCaseLabel } from '@/engine/core/text';
+ import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
+ import { resolveAdapter } from '@/engine/persistence/base44';
+ import type { SaveAdapter, SaveSlotInfo } from '@/engine/persistence/adapter';
+ import { SAVE_SCHEMA_VERSION } from '@/engine/domain/model';
+ import { APP_VERSION } from '@/engine/world/bootstrap';
+
+ export interface StartupResult {
+   adapter: SaveAdapter;
+   slots: SaveSlotInfo[];
+ }
+
+ type StageState = 'waiting' | 'active' | 'done' | 'failed';
+
+ interface Stage {
+   id: string;
+   label: string;
+   /** Fraction of the bar this stage accounts for. */
+   weight: number;
+   run: (context: StartupContext) => Promise<void>;
+ }
+
+ interface StartupContext {
+   adapter?: SaveAdapter;
+   slots?: SaveSlotInfo[];
+   warnings: string[];
+ }
+
+ /** Each stage of the opening, in order; exported so a test can run the stages that read the slots. */
+ export const STAGES: Stage[] = [
+   {
+     id: 'storage', label: 'Connecting To Storage', weight: 30,
+     run: async (context) => {
+       context.adapter = await resolveAdapter();
+     },
+   },
+   {
+     id: 'saves', label: 'Reading Save Slots', weight: 25,
+     run: async (context) => {
+       if (!context.adapter) throw new Error('SLATE couldn’t find where your saves are kept.');
+       context.slots = await context.adapter.listSlots();
+     },
+   },
+   {
+     id: 'validate', label: 'Checking Each Save', weight: 25,
+     run: async (context) => {
+       for (const slot of context.slots ?? []) {
+         // The way on by the slot's own button (from 2026-10-20, brief 17): until then "You can restore its backup from the
+         // save slots", where the slot's card offers Restore Backup.
+         if (slot.error) {
+           context.warnings.push(`Slot ${slot.slot}: ${slot.error}${slot.hasBackup ? ' Press Restore Backup on the slot to open its backup.' : ''}`);
+         }
+       }
+     },
+   },
+   {
+     id: 'migrations', label: 'Checking Save Versions', weight: 20,
+     run: async (context) => {
+       for (const slot of context.slots ?? []) {
+         const version = slot.meta?.schemaVersion;
+         if (version === undefined) continue;
+         if (version > SAVE_SCHEMA_VERSION) {
+           context.warnings.push(
+             `Slot ${slot.slot} was saved by a newer version of SLATE, so this version won’t open it. That keeps the save safe.`,
+           );
+         } else if (version < SAVE_SCHEMA_VERSION) {
+           context.warnings.push(
+             // `openSlot` keeps a backup of the slot before it writes the save brought forward.
+             `Slot ${slot.slot} was saved by an older version of SLATE. When you open it, SLATE keeps a backup and then updates it.`,
+           );
+         }
+       }
+     },
+   },
+ ];
+
+ export function StartupSequence({ onReady }: { onReady: (result: StartupResult) => void }) {
+   const [progress, setProgress] = useState(0);
+   const [states, setStates] = useState<Record<string, StageState>>({});
+   const [failure, setFailure] = useState<{ stage: string; message: string } | null>(null);
+   const [warnings, setWarnings] = useState<string[]>([]);
+   const [attempt, setAttempt] = useState(0);
+   const cancelled = useRef(false);
+
+   const start = useCallback(async () => {
+     const context: StartupContext = { warnings: [] };
+     let completed = 0;
+     setFailure(null);
+     setWarnings([]);
+     setProgress(0);
+     setStates({});
+
+     for (const stage of STAGES) {
+       if (cancelled.current) return;
+       setStates((s) => ({ ...s, [stage.id]: 'active' }));
+       try {
+         await stage.run(context);
+       } catch (error) {
+         setStates((s) => ({ ...s, [stage.id]: 'failed' }));
+         setFailure({ stage: stage.label, message: (error as Error).message });
+         return;
+       }
+       completed += stage.weight;
+       setStates((s) => ({ ...s, [stage.id]: 'done' }));
+       setProgress(completed);
+     }
+
+     setWarnings(context.warnings);
+     if (!context.adapter || !context.slots) {
+       setFailure({ stage: 'Startup', message: 'Your saves’ storage didn’t answer.' });
+       return;
+     }
+
+     // Warnings are surfaced but never block. The player decides.
+     if (context.warnings.length === 0) {
+       if (!cancelled.current) onReady({ adapter: context.adapter, slots: context.slots });
+     } else {
+       (window as unknown as { __slateStartup?: StartupResult }).__slateStartup = {
+         adapter: context.adapter, slots: context.slots,
+       };
+     }
+   }, [onReady]);
+
+   useEffect(() => {
+     cancelled.current = false;
+     void start();
+     return () => { cancelled.current = true; };
+   }, [start, attempt]);
+
+   const proceed = () => {
+     const stored = (window as unknown as { __slateStartup?: StartupResult }).__slateStartup;
+     if (stored) onReady(stored);
+   };
+
+   return (
+     <div className="startup">
+       <div className="startup-inner">
+         <span className="clapper" role="img" aria-label="SLATE">🎬</span>
+         <div className="wordmark">SLATE</div>
+         {/*
+           "life simulator" is bound together so the line breaks before it on a
+           phone. Left to itself it wraps after "life" and leaves "simulator"
+           alone on the second line.
+         */}
+         <div className="wordmark-sub">A life{'\u00A0'}simulator</div>
+
+         <div
+           className="startup-bar"
+           role="progressbar"
+           aria-valuenow={progress}
+           aria-valuemin={0}
+           aria-valuemax={100}
+           aria-label="Startup Progress"
+         >
+           <span style={{ width: `${progress}%` }} />
+         </div>
+         <div className="startup-status">
+           <span>{failure ? 'Startup Stopped' : progress >= 100 ? 'Ready' : currentLabel(states)}</span>
+           <span className="mono">{progress}%</span>
+         </div>
+
+         <div className="startup-stages" aria-live="polite">
+           {STAGES.map((stage) => {
+             const state = states[stage.id] ?? 'waiting';
+             return (
+               <div key={stage.id} className="startup-stage" data-state={state}>
+                 <span aria-hidden="true">
+                   {state === 'done' ? '✓' : state === 'failed' ? '✕' : state === 'active' ? '▸' : '·'}
+                 </span>
+                 <span>{stage.label}</span>
+               </div>
+             );
+           })}
+         </div>
+
+         {failure && (
+           <div className="callout callout-negative" style={{ marginTop: 'var(--s5)', textAlign: 'left' }}>
+             <strong>{titleCaseLabel(failure.stage)} failed.</strong>
+             <p className="small" style={{ marginTop: 'var(--s1)' }}>{failure.message}</p>
+             <div className="row gap-2" style={{ marginTop: 'var(--s3)' }}>
+               <button className="btn btn-primary btn-sm" onClick={() => setAttempt((a) => a + 1)}>
+                 Try Again
+               </button>
+             </div>
+           </div>
+         )}
+
+         {warnings.length > 0 && !failure && (
+           <div className="callout callout-warning" style={{ marginTop: 'var(--s5)', textAlign: 'left' }}>
+             <strong>Before You Continue</strong>
+             <ul className="small" style={{ margin: 'var(--s2) 0 0', paddingLeft: 'var(--s4)' }}>
+               {warnings.map((warning) => <li key={warning}>{warning}</li>)}
+             </ul>
+             <div className="row gap-2" style={{ marginTop: 'var(--s3)' }}>
+               <button className="btn btn-primary btn-sm" onClick={proceed}>Continue</button>
+             </div>
+           </div>
+         )}
+
+         <div className="dim xs" style={{ marginTop: 'var(--s6)' }}>
+           Version {APP_VERSION} · Save Format {SAVE_SCHEMA_VERSION}
+         </div>
+       </div>
+     </div>
+   );
+ }
+
+ function currentLabel(states: Record<string, StageState>): string {
+   const active = STAGES.find((s) => states[s.id] === 'active');
+   return active?.label ?? 'Starting';
+ }

+ /**
+  * SLATE — your bank.
+  *
+  * The bank a person keeps their money with, as that bank has it: its name,
+  * the accounts by the names it sells them under, each account's number the
+  * way the country writes it, what savings pays and what the current account
+  * costs and how the fee is waived, in five tabs: accounts, cards, payments
+  * and cash, borrowing, and statements. The deposit guarantee behind the
+  * money was said here until 2026-09-26, and nothing read it. Money moves between the accounts here, and a
+  * savings account is opened or closed (`systems/banking.ts`). The credit
+  * card is the bank's too, and is run here (`ui/bank/BankCard.tsx`); until
+  * 2026-09-26 it was run from the Money panel and this screen left it out.
+  *
+  * Every figure the bank publishes says where it came from; a figure that is
+  * SLATE's estimate says that instead.
+  */
+
+ import { useState } from 'react';
+ import { SECTIONS, tabKey } from '@/ui/shell/sections';
+ import { useKept } from '@/ui/kept';
+ import { useGame, useWorld } from '@/app/game-context';
+ import { Panel, Empty, Fine } from '@/ui/components/primitives';
+ import { Gated } from '@/ui/guide/Guide';
+ import { BankLending, TermDeposits } from '@/ui/bank/BankLending';
+ import { BankMoves } from '@/ui/bank/BankMoves';
+ import { BankCard } from '@/ui/bank/BankCard';
+ import { BankCardOffers } from '@/ui/bank/BankCardOffers';
+ import { BankSecurity } from '@/ui/bank/BankSecurity';
+ import { BankStatements } from '@/ui/bank/BankStatements';
+ import { BankPayments } from '@/ui/bank/BankPayments';
+ import { BankCash } from '@/ui/bank/BankCash';

+ import { bankById, bankingIn } from '@/engine/content/banks';

+ import type { Product } from '@/engine/content/banks';
+ import { bankAccountsOf, introStep, rateOn, bankOf, directDeposits, feeFor, inSaveMoney, interestTaxOn, interestTaxFor, interestAllowanceLeft, monthEndAfter, monthStartOf, productOf, closesQuarterly, feesPostAt, savingsNotice, tierRate, earningBalance, cardYearWords } from '@/engine/systems/banking';
+ import { savingsDebit } from '@/engine/systems/accountlife';

+ import { CHEX, checkingAt, checkingsOf } from '@/engine/systems/lending';
+ import type { Account } from '@/engine/core/ledger';
+ import { LookRegion, Open, at } from '@/ui/looks';
+ import { abroadQuote, heldOf, heldText, homeAccountLines, quoteWords } from '@/engine/systems/abroad';

+ export function BankWorkspace() {
+   const { sim, run, toast } = useGame();
+   const cur = saveCurrency(sim.universe);
+   const money = (cents: number) => formatMoney(cents, cur, { cents: false });
+   // A balance as the tile and the From list show it: overdrawn, to the cent with a minus sign, where whole dollars and a
+   // hyphen read "-$3" of -$3.30 (from 2026-10-17, the before-walk's find on the missed-plan save).
+   const balanceOf = (cents: number) => (cents < 0 ? `−${formatMoney(-cents, cur)}` : money(cents));
+   const bank = useWorld((s) => bankOf(s, s.player));
+   const accounts = useWorld((s) => bankAccountsOf(s, s.player));
+   const currents = useWorld((s) => checkingsOf(s, s.player));
+   const [from, setFrom] = useState<string>('');
+   const [to, setTo] = useState<string>('');
+   const [amount, setAmount] = useState('');
+   const [tab, setTab] = useKept<BankTab>(tabKey('/workspace/bank'), 'accounts');
+
+   if (!bank) {
+     return <Empty title="No Bank" body="None of your money is at a bank the game covers, so there’s nothing to show here." />;
+   }
+
+   const here = accounts.filter((a) => a.bankId === bank.id);
+   // The primary account (from 2026-10-10: until then the first current account found, which with two banks could be the
+   // other one, named as where savings closes and where Move Money starts from).
+   const current = accounts.find((a) => a.id === sim.player.primaryAccountId) ?? accounts.find((a) => a.kind === 'checking');
+   // Savings to open: at each bank kept with a current account and no savings there, as `bank.open_savings` opens it
+   // (from 2026-10-12: until then one panel, shown only while no bank held savings, opened at the primary account's bank
+   // alone, so savings at a second bank hid the primary bank's and a second bank's couldn't be opened from any screen).
+   const unsaved = [...new Set(currents.map((a) => a.bankId))]
+     .map((id) => (id ? bankById(id) : undefined))
+     .filter((b): b is NonNullable<typeof b> => !!b && !accounts.some((a) => a.kind === 'savings' && a.bankId === b.id));
+   const fromId = from || current?.id || '';
+   const toId = to || accounts.find((a) => a.id !== fromId)?.id || '';
+   const monthStart = monthStartOf(sim, sim.now);
+   const monthEnd = monthEndAfter(sim, sim.now);
+   // When this month's fee comes off, by the bank's own schedule (`feesPostAt`, from 2026-10-16: until then every German
+   // bank's was said to go to the quarter's closing, ING's and Commerzbank's among them).
+   const dueWords = (account: import('@/engine/core/ledger').Account) => {
+     const posts = feesPostAt(account);
+     return posts === 'quarter' ? 'charged at the quarter’s close' : posts === 'next' ? `charged ${formatDate(monthStartOf(sim, monthEnd + 2 * 3_600_000), sim.zone)}` : `due ${formatDate(monthEnd, sim.zone)}`;
+   };
+
+   // What a move out of savings costs, and what Germany's month still lets out, before it's made.
+   const moving = accounts.find((a) => a.id === fromId);
+   const savingsTerms = moving?.kind === 'savings' ? savingsDebit(sim, moving) : undefined;
+   // By the rules of the bank the savings is at, as `savingsDebit` charges (from 2026-10-12: until then the primary
+   // account's bank's, so savings elsewhere had its fee unsaid, or was told of a fee its bank doesn't charge).
+   const rules = moving?.kind === 'savings' && moving.bankId ? ACCOUNT_LIFE[moving.bankId] : undefined;
+   const freeLeft = rules?.freeWithdrawals !== undefined && rules.withdrawalFee ? savingsTerms!.fee === 0 : undefined;
+   const allowanceLeft = moving ? savingsLeftThisMonth(sim, moving) : undefined;
+
+   // In the sending account's own money where it's kept in another (from 2026-10-16): pounds from a pound account.
+   const sendIn = moving?.currency ?? cur;
+   const target = accounts.find((a) => a.id === toId);
+   // Between banks in two countries, what the payment costs and when it lands, from the rule the command keeps.
+   const abroad = moving && target && moving.bankId && target.bankId && bankById(moving.bankId)?.iso !== bankById(target.bankId)?.iso && centsFromTyped(amount) > 0
+     ? abroadQuote(sim, sim.player, moving, target, centsFromTyped(amount))
+     : undefined;
+   // Between two banks in one country, when it would arrive, from the day `sendBetweenBanks` sets it (`arrivalOf`), said
+   // before Move It (from 2026-10-20, brief 17, section 8): until then only the toast after it said the day, and the
+   // panel's subtitle that it "takes as long as the sending bank takes".
+   const between = moving && target && moving.bankId && target.bankId && moving.bankId !== target.bankId && !abroad && bankById(moving.bankId)?.iso === bankById(target.bankId)?.iso
+     ? arrivalOf(sim, moving, sim.player)
+     : undefined;
+
+   const move = () => {
+     // Typed in whole units of the money, as a banking app takes it.
+     const cents = centsFromTyped(amount);
+     const answer = run<{ moved: number; arrivesAt?: number; sent?: number; sentIn?: string }>('bank.transfer', { fromId, toId, amount: cents, ...(moving?.currency ? { in: moving.currency } : {}) });
+     if (answer.ok && answer.value) {
+       const later = answer.value.arrivesAt !== undefined && answer.value.arrivesAt > sim.now;
+       const what = answer.value.sentIn ? formatMoney(answer.value.sent!, answer.value.sentIn) : money(answer.value.moved);
+       toast(later ? `Sent ${what} to ${target?.name ?? 'your other account'}. It arrives ${formatDate(answer.value.arrivesAt!, sim.zone)}.` : `Moved ${what} to ${target?.name ?? 'your other account'}.`, 'positive');
+       setAmount('');
+     }
+   };
+
+   const panes: Record<BankTab, JSX.Element> = {
+     accounts: (
+       <>
+       <div className="grid grid-2" style={{ marginBottom: 'var(--s5)' }}>
+         {accounts.map((account) => {
+           const product = productOf(account);
+           const fee = feeFor(sim, account, monthStart);
+           const tax = interestTaxOn(sim, account);
+           // As the bank counts them: until 2026-09-27 wages only, where the bank counts any electronic deposit.
+           const paidIn = directDeposits(sim, account, monthStart, product?.deposits);
+           // Each account by its own bank's terms and money (from 2026-10-16): until then every panel read the primary
+           // account's bank's currency, and an account kept at home showed its balance, fees and rates in dollars.
+           const own = (account.bankId ? bankById(account.bankId) : undefined) ?? bank;
+           const home = account.currency !== undefined;
+           const inBank = (x: number) => (home ? formatMoney(x, own.currency, { cents: false }) : money(inSaveMoney(sim, x, own.currency)));
+           return (
+             <Panel key={account.id} title={account.name} subtitle={<Open subject={at('account', account.id)}>{account.institution} {account.number}{home ? ', Held From Abroad' : ''}</Open>} look={at('account', account.id)} help={home ? 'bank.home-account' : 'bank.accounts'}>
+               <div className="col gap-3">
+                 <div className="stat">
+                   <Open subject={at('account', account.id)}>
+                     <span className="stat-label">Balance</span>{' '}
+                     <span className="stat-value mono">{home ? heldText(sim, account) : balanceOf(account.balance)}</span>
+                   </Open>
+                   {home && <span className="stat-note">About {formatMoney(account.balance, cur)} at an estimated exchange rate</span>}
+                   {!home && account.balance < 0 && <span className="stat-note">Overdrawn</span>}
+                 </div>
+                 <p className="small" style={{ margin: 0 }}>{interestWords(sim, product, tax, money, own.currency, account.openedAt, closesQuarterly(account), account, home ? inBank : undefined)}</p>
+                 {account.secondChance ? (
+                   <p className="small" style={{ margin: 0 }}>A second-chance account: {formatMoney(inSaveMoney(sim, CHEX.secondChanceFee, 'USD'), cur)} a month instead of the usual fee, and no overdraft.</p>
+                 ) : product?.monthlyFee ? (
+                   <p className="small" style={{ margin: 0 }}>
+                     {home ? formatMoney(product.monthlyFee, own.currency) : formatMoney(inSaveMoney(sim, product.monthlyFee, own.currency), cur)} a month
+                     {waiverWords(product, inBank)}
+                     {'. '}
+                     {fee.fee === 0
+                       ? `It’s waived this month so far${fee.waivedBy === 'deposits' ? `, with ${money(paidIn)} paid in` : ''}.`
+                       : fee.waivedBy
+                         ? `So far this month it’s lowered to ${home && fee.native !== undefined ? formatMoney(fee.native, own.currency) : formatMoney(fee.fee, cur)}${fee.waivedBy === 'deposits' ? `, with ${money(paidIn)} paid in` : ''}, and it’s ${dueWords(account)}.`
+                         : feesPostAt(account) === 'quarter' ? 'It isn’t waived this month so far. Unless one of those conditions is met, it’s added to the fees charged at the quarter’s close.' : `It isn’t waived this month so far. Unless one of those conditions is met, it’s ${dueWords(account)}.`}
+                     {(account.feesDue ?? 0) > 0 ? ` ${feesPostAt(account) === 'quarter' ? 'The quarter’s fees so far' : 'Last month’s fees'}, ${home ? formatMoney(account.feesDueHeld ?? 0, own.currency) : money(account.feesDue ?? 0)}, ${feesPostAt(account) === 'quarter' ? 'are charged at its close' : `are charged ${formatDate(monthStartOf(sim, monthEnd + 2 * 3_600_000), sim.zone)}`}.` : ''}
+                   </p>
+                 ) : (
+                   <p className="small" style={{ margin: 0 }}>No monthly fee.</p>
+                 )}
+                 {homeAccountLines(sim, account).map((line) => <p key={line} className="small" style={{ margin: 0 }}>{line}</p>)}
+                 {/* The debit card's year (`cardYearWords`, from brief 10, 2026-10-16): until then no panel said it. */}
+                 {cardYearWords(sim, account) && <p className="small" style={{ margin: 0 }}>{cardYearWords(sim, account)}</p>}
+                 {product && <Fine>{product.estimate ? 'Estimated' : 'Source'}: {product.source}, {formatDateKey(product.asOf)}.{CONFIDENCE[own.confidence ?? 'H']}{account.secondChance ? ' The second-chance account’s fee is estimated.' : ''}</Fine>}
+                 {account.kind === 'savings' && (() => {
+                   // Where closing it sends the money, as `closeSavings` does: the current account at its own bank, or the
+                   // primary with none there (from 2026-10-16: until then both lines named the primary, so a Berlin-raised
+                   // student's Flexgeld at Deutsche Bank said it moved to Chase Total Checking, where it goes to the
+                   // AktivKonto; tests/integration-savings-notice.test.ts).
+                   const into = checkingAt(sim, sim.player, account.bankId) ?? current;
+                   return (
+                   <div className="row gap-2" style={{ flexWrap: 'wrap', alignItems: 'center' }}>
+                     {savingsNotice(sim, account)
+                       ? <span className="xs dim">You’ve given notice. It closes <Open subject={at('day', dateKey(savingsNotice(sim, account)!.at, sim.homeZone))}>{formatDate(savingsNotice(sim, account)!.at, sim.zone)}</Open>, and what it holds moves to {into ? <Open subject={at('account', into.id)}>{into.name}</Open> : 'your checking account'} then.</span>
+                       : <>

It closes ${formatDate(a.value.on, sim.zone)}.`, 'positive'); }}>

+               </div>

+                 {[...accounts].sort((a, b) => a.balance - b.balance).map((a) => <option key={a.id} value={a.id}>{a.name} ···{a.last4}, {a.institution} ({a.currency ? heldText(sim, a) : balanceOf(a.balance)})</option>)}

+               </select>

+         <p className="muted">
+           <Open subject={at('bank', bank.id)}>{sumText(here, balanceOf)}</Open> held here, in{' '}
+           {here.length === 1 && here[0]

+ type BankTab = 'accounts' | 'cards' | 'payments' | 'borrowing' | 'statements';
+
+ /**
+  * Borrowing at any bank held (from 2026-10-10): the lender chosen first, then that bank's own overdraft and loan, on the
+  * current account there. Until then only the primary account's bank lent. Until 2026-10-13 this said its term deposits
+  * were here too; they are on Accounts, a panel for each bank (`TermDeposits`).
+  */
+ function BorrowingAt({ primaryBank }: { primaryBank: import('@/engine/content/banks').Bank }) {
+   const currents = useWorld((s) => checkingsOf(s, s.player));
+   const [lender, setLender] = useState(primaryBank.id);
+   const account = currents.find((a) => a.bankId === lender) ?? currents[0];
+   const bank = (account?.bankId ? bankById(account.bankId) : undefined) ?? primaryBank;
+   return (
+     <div className="col gap-3">
+       {currents.length > 1 && (

+           <label htmlFor="lender">Borrow At</label>

+             {currents.map((a) => <option key={a.id} value={a.bankId}>{a.institution}</option>)}
+           </select>
+         </div>
+       )}
+       <BankLending bank={bank} account={account} show={['borrowing']} />
+     </div>
+   );
+ }

+ /** The screen's parts, each under its own tab. Until 2026-09-26 they ran down one page, fourteen to sixteen panels long. */
+ /** Its tabs, as the rail lists them too (`ui/shell/sections.ts`, from 2026-10-08). */
+ const BANK_TABS = SECTIONS['/workspace/bank'] as readonly { id: BankTab; label: string }[];
+
+ /** The tabs, as a tab list: arrows move between them, Home and End go to the ends. */
+ function BankTabs({ tab, onTab }: { tab: BankTab; onTab: (tab: BankTab) => void }) {
+   const go = (index: number) => {
+     const next = BANK_TABS[(index + BANK_TABS.length) % BANK_TABS.length]!;
+     onTab(next.id);
+     document.getElementById(`bank-tab-${next.id}`)?.focus();
+   };
+   return (
+     <div className="tabs" role="tablist" aria-label="Your Bank">
+       {BANK_TABS.map((one, i) => (
+         <button
+           key={one.id}
+           id={`bank-tab-${one.id}`}
+           type="button"
+           role="tab"
+           className="tab"
+           aria-selected={one.id === tab}
+           aria-controls={`bank-pane-${one.id}`}
+           tabIndex={one.id === tab ? 0 : -1}
+           onClick={() => onTab(one.id)}
+           onKeyDown={(e) => {
+             if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') { e.preventDefault(); go(i + 1); }
+             else if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') { e.preventDefault(); go(i - 1); }
+             else if (e.key === 'Home') { e.preventDefault(); go(0); }
+             else if (e.key === 'End') { e.preventDefault(); go(BANK_TABS.length - 1); }
+           }}
+         >
+           {one.label}
+         </button>
+       ))}
+     </div>
+   );
+ }

+ /**
+  * What a set of accounts holds, for the page's head line (from 2026-10-16): accounts all kept in one other currency, in
+  * it with the dollars beside; any other set, in the save's money.
+  */
+ /**
+  * What a bank holds, summed: in the save's money as the tiles write a balance, below zero with its minus sign and to the
+  * cent (from 2026-10-20, brief 17: until then "-$600 held here", a hyphen and whole dollars, where the tile beside it read
+  * −$600.00), and in the bank's own money first where every account there is kept in it.
+  */
+ function sumText(list: Account[], money: (cents: number) => string): string {
+   const total = money(list.reduce((sum, a) => sum + a.balance, 0));
+   const kept = list[0]?.currency;
+   if (!kept || list.some((a) => a.currency !== kept)) return total;
+   const held = list.reduce((sum, a) => sum + heldOf(a), 0);
+   return `${held < 0 ? `−${formatMoney(-held, kept)}` : formatMoney(held, kept, { cents: false })} (${total})`;
+ }
+
+ /** The other banks' sum in the save's money, and of it what each bank abroad holds in its own: "$7,065 at your other banks, £5,581 of it at HSBC UK". */
+ function othersText(list: Account[], money: (cents: number) => string): string {
+   const byBank = new Map<string, Account[]>();
+   for (const a of list) if (a.currency) byBank.set(a.institution ?? '', [...(byBank.get(a.institution ?? '') ?? []), a]);
+   const total = money(list.reduce((sum, a) => sum + a.balance, 0));
+   if (byBank.size === 0) return `${total} at your other banks`;
+   return `${total} at your other banks, ${[...byBank].map(([name, held]) => `${formatMoney(held.reduce((sum, a) => sum + heldOf(a), 0), held[0]!.currency!, { cents: false })} of it at ${name}`).join(' and ')}`;
+ }
+
+ /** How sure the research was of a bank outside the thirteen, where it wasn't sure. */
+ const CONFIDENCE: Record<'H' | 'M' | 'L', string> = {
+   H: '',
+   M: ' Some of this bank’s figures couldn’t be fully confirmed.',
+   L: ' This bank’s figures couldn’t be confirmed.',
+ };
+
+ /** Percent, to as many places as the figure has. */
+ const pct = (rate: number) => `${Number((rate * 100).toFixed(3))}%`;
+ const MONTH_NAMES = ['January', 'February', 'March', 'April', 'May', 'June', 'July', 'August', 'September', 'October', 'November', 'December'];
+
+ /**
+  * What an account pays, said the way the bank's terms put it: the rate, any
+  * change announced, a floor or a cap, a bonus and what earns it, when it is
+  * paid, and what the bank takes off it for tax.
+  */
+ function interestWords(sim: Simulation, product: Product | undefined, tax: number, money: (cents: number) => string, currency: string, openedAt: number, quarterly = false, account?: Account, own?: (units: number) => string): string {
+   const step = introStep(sim, product, openedAt, sim.now);
+   // The bank's own figures: in its money on an account kept in it (`own`, from 2026-10-16), in the save's otherwise.
+   const inBank = (x: number) => (own ? own(x) : money(inSaveMoney(sim, x, currency)));
+   // The tier the balance is in leads, as the engine pays it: until 2026-09-27 the headline was the base rate.
+   const bankMoney = (x: number) => inSaveMoney(sim, x, currency);
+   const tiered = account ? tierRate(product, account, earningBalance(product, account.balance, bankMoney), bankMoney) : undefined;
+   const rate = tiered ?? step ?? rateOn(product, sim.now, sim.homeZone);
+   // A rate the research didn't find isn't a rate of none: until 2026-09-26 Citi's savings said it paid no interest.
+   if (product && product.rate === undefined && /no published rate/i.test(product.source) && !product.changes?.length && !product.tiers?.length && !product.bonus && !product.intro) return 'No published rate was found for it, so it earns no interest in the game.';
+   if (!product || (rate <= 0 && !product.bonus && !product.intro)) return 'Pays no interest.';
+   // The yield with the interest left in, credited monthly or in the bank's months (B31).
+   const said: string[] = [`Pays ${pct(rate)} a year${tiered !== undefined ? ' on this balance' : ''} (${pct(Number(apyOf(rate, product.pays?.length ?? 12).toFixed(5)))} APY)`];
+   if (step !== undefined) {
+     // The steps still to come, and what it pays after them.
+     let through = 0;
+     const ahead: string[] = [];
+     for (const one of product.intro ?? []) {
+       through += one.months;
+       ahead.push(`${pct(one.rate)} until month ${through}`);
+     }
+     said.push(` for now: ${ahead.join(', ')}, then ${pct(rateOn(product, sim.now, sim.homeZone))}, counted from when it opened`);
+   }
+   // The bank's day, as the engine reads it: until 2026-09-27 a UTC one.
+   const next = (product.changes ?? []).find((c) => c.from > dateKey(sim.now, sim.homeZone));
+   if (next) { const [y, m, d] = next.from.split('-').map(Number); said.push(`, ${pct(next.rate)} from ${formatDate(Date.UTC(y!, m! - 1, d!, 12), 'UTC')}`); }
+   for (const tier of product.tiers ?? []) said.push(`, and ${pct(tier.rate)} on the whole balance once it’s ${inBank(tier.from)} or more`);
+   if (product.rateFrom !== undefined) said.push(`, on a balance of ${inBank(product.rateFrom)} or more`);
+   if (product.rateUpTo !== undefined) said.push(`, on up to ${inBank(product.rateUpTo)}`);
+   said.push('.');
+   if (product.bonus) {
+     const earn = product.bonus.when === 'no_withdrawals'
+       ? 'you take nothing out'
+       : product.bonus.growBy !== undefined ? `the balance grows by ${inBank(product.bonus.growBy)}` : 'the balance grows';
+     said.push(` It pays another ${pct(product.bonus.rate)} in any month ${earn}.`);
+   }
+   // As the engine pays it: in the bank’s months, at Germany’s quarterly closing, or each month’s end.
+   said.push(product.pays
+     ? ` Interest builds up daily and is paid in ${product.pays.map((m) => MONTH_NAMES[m - 1]).join(' and ')}.`
+     : quarterly
+       ? ' Interest builds up daily and is paid at each quarter’s close: the end of March, June, September and December.'
+       : ' Interest builds up daily and is paid on the last day of the month.');
+   if (product.taxFree) said.push(' The interest is tax-free.');
+   else if (tax > 0) {
+     // Past the year's allowance, where the country has one: until 2026-09-27 it read as tax on all of it.
+     const iso = account?.bankId ? bankById(account.bankId)?.iso : undefined;
+     const levy = iso ? bankingIn(iso)?.interestTax : undefined;
+     const left = account ? interestAllowanceLeft(sim, account) : undefined;
+     said.push(levy?.allowance !== undefined
+       ? ` The bank keeps back ${pct(tax)} for tax on interest past the first ${inBank(levy.allowance)} each year${left !== undefined ? `, and ${money(left)} of that allowance is left this year` : ''}.`
+       : ` The bank keeps back ${pct(tax)} of it for tax.`);
+     if (levy?.source) said.push(` Source: ${levy.source}.`);
+   }
+   return said.join('');
+ }
+
+ /** The bank's charges that aren't an account's monthly fee, and the tax the country gives back. */
+ function OtherCharges({ bank }: { bank: import('@/engine/content/banks').Bank }) {
+   const { sim } = useGame();
+   const cur = saveCurrency(sim.universe);
+   const money = (c: number) => formatMoney(inSaveMoney(sim, c, bank.currency), cur);
+   const refund = bankingIn(bank.iso)?.interestTax;
+   const lines: string[] = [];
+   if (bank.card) {
+     // Paid for the year ahead, and its days left given back on a close (from 2026-10-16, `Bank.card.ahead` until brief 10);
+     // charged behind, and its days used charged on a close, and where the timing is SLATE's, said to be simulated and
+     // unverified (`Bank.card.year`, from brief 10).
+     const year = bank.card.yearly !== undefined ? bank.card.year : undefined;
+     const timing = year ? (year.paid === 'ahead' ? '. It’s paid for the year ahead, and what’s left of the year is refunded if the account closes' : '. It’s charged at the end of each card year, and the days used so far are charged if the account closes') : '';
+     const simulated = year?.simulated ? ` The timing is estimated: ${year.simulated}.` : '';
+     lines.push(`The debit card costs ${bank.card.yearly !== undefined ? `${money(bank.card.yearly)} a year` : 'nothing a year'}${bank.card.perPurchase !== undefined ? ` and ${money(bank.card.perPurchase)} a purchase` : ''}${bank.card.freeUnder !== undefined ? `, or nothing at ${bank.card.freeUnder - 1} and under` : ''}${timing}. Source: ${bank.card.source}.${simulated}`);
+   }
+   if (bank.returned) lines.push(`A payment the bank returns unpaid costs ${money(bank.returned.fee)}${bank.returned.ifShortAtLeast !== undefined ? `, or nothing when the account is less than ${money(bank.returned.ifShortAtLeast)} short` : ''}${bank.returned.gapDays > 1 ? `, at most once every ${bank.returned.gapDays} business days` : ''}. Source: ${bank.returned.source}.`);
+   if (bank.dormant) lines.push(`An account left unused for ${bank.dormant.afterYears} years costs ${money(bank.dormant.yearly)} a year${bank.dormant.belowBalance !== undefined ? ` while it holds less than ${money(bank.dormant.belowBalance)}` : ''}. Source: ${bank.dormant.source}.`);
+   if (bank.quietMonth) lines.push(`A month with fewer than ${bank.quietMonth.minTransactions} transactions costs ${money(bank.quietMonth.fee)}${bank.quietMonth.unlessWages ? ', unless wages are paid in' : ''}. Source: ${bank.quietMonth.source}.`);
+   if (refund?.refund) {
+     const day = `${MONTH_NAMES[refund.refund.month - 1]} ${refund.refund.day}`;
+     lines.push(`${refund.note} It’s paid here on ${day}.${refund.refund.estimateDate ? ' The day is estimated.' : ''}`);
+   }
+   if (lines.length === 0) return null;
+   return (
+     <Panel title="Other Charges">
+       <div className="col gap-2">
+         {lines.map((line) => <p key={line} className="small" style={{ margin: 0 }}>{line}</p>)}
+       </div>
+     </Panel>
+   );
+ }
+
+ /**
+  * What closing savings moves: the balance, with this month's interest paid
+  * less its tax. Until 2026-09-27 it said the balance, and more moved. From
+  * 2026-10-17 it says the figure to the cent, and an overdrawn savings account
+  * says what closing takes to clear it (`closeSavings` posts the shortfall from
+  * the current account), where it had said "Its -$3, moves to …".
+  */
+ function closingWords(sim: Simulation, account: Account, into: string): string {
+   const cur = saveCurrency(sim.universe);
+   const money = (c: number) => formatMoney(c, cur);
+   const earned = Math.floor(account.accrued ?? 0);
+   const net = earned - (earned > 0 ? interestTaxFor(sim, account, earned) : 0);
+   const taxed = earned > net ? ' after tax' : '';
+   const left = savingsLeftThisMonth(sim, account);
+   if (left !== undefined && account.balance + earned > left) return `It holds more than the ${money(left)} you can take out this month without notice, so closing it gives three months’ notice, as the law requires. The money moves to ${into} then.`;
+   // An account kept at home in its own money, the month's interest so far turned into it at the game's rate (from 2026-10-16).
+   if (account.currency) {
+     const built = exchange(net, cur, account.currency) ?? 0;
+     const total = heldOf(account) + built;
+     if (total < 0) return `It’s overdrawn by ${heldText(sim, account, -total)}. Closing it takes that from ${into} to clear it.`;
+     if (total === 0) return 'It’s empty, so closing it moves nothing.';
+     return `Closing it moves its ${heldText(sim, account, total)} to ${into}${built > 0 ? `, including ${heldText(sim, account, built)} of interest from this month${taxed}` : ''}.`;
+   }
+   const total = account.balance + net;
+   if (total < 0) return `It’s overdrawn by ${money(-total)}. Closing it takes ${money(-total)} from ${into} to clear it.`;
+   if (total === 0) return 'It’s empty, so closing it moves nothing.';
+   return `Closing it moves its ${money(total)} to ${into}${net > 0 ? `, including ${money(net)} of interest from this month${taxed}` : ''}.`;
+ }

+ // `waiverWords` moved to `ui/bank/feeWords.ts` on 2026-10-16, so the opening panel says the fee before Apply.

+ const WEEKDAYS = ['Sun', 'Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri', 'Sat'];
+
+ export function CalendarWorkspace() {
+   const { sim, refresh } = useGame();
+   const today = zonedParts(sim.now, sim.homeZone);
+
+   // Every calendar this life keeps, fetched once per country.
+   const wanted = keptCalendars(sim).map((c) => c.countryId).join(',');
+   useEffect(() => {
+     const ids = wanted.split(',').filter((id) => id && !isHolidaysLoaded(id));
+     if (ids.length === 0) return;
+     let cancelled = false;
+     Promise.all(ids.map((id) => loadCountryHolidays(id).catch(() => 0)))
+       .then(() => { if (!cancelled) refresh(); });
+     return () => { cancelled = true; };
+   }, [wanted, refresh]);
+   const [view, setView] = useState({ year: today.year, month: today.month });
+   const [selected, setSelected] = useState<string | null>(null);
+   const [detail, setDetail] = useState<CalendarEntry | null>(null);
+   const [planning, setPlanning] = useState<string | null>(null);
+
+   const days = useWorld((s) => monthGrid(s, view.year, view.month), [view.year, view.month]);
+   // What is still coming. A plan you called off is not in the next thirty
+   // days, however recently it was.
+   const next30 = useWorld((s) => entriesBetween(s, s.now, s.now + 30 * MS_DAY).filter(stillStands));
+   const conflicts = next30.filter((e) => e.conflicted);
+   const collisions = [...conflicts].sort((x, y) => x.at - y.at).reduce((runs, e) => {
+     const last = runs[runs.length - 1];
+     if (last && e.at < last.end) { last.end = Math.max(last.end, e.endsAt ?? e.at); return runs; }
+     runs.push({ end: e.endsAt ?? e.at });
+     return runs;
+   }, [] as { end: number }[]).length;
+   const selectedDay = days.find((d) => d.key === selected);
+   const planningDay = days.find((d) => d.key === planning);
+
+   const shift = (delta: number) => {
+     setView((v) => {
+       const month = v.month + delta;
+       if (month < 1) return { year: v.year - 1, month: 12 };
+       if (month > 12) return { year: v.year + 1, month: 1 };
+       return { year: v.year, month };
+     });
+   };
+
+   return (
+     <>
+       <div className="page-head">
+         <div className="eyebrow">Calendar</div>
+         <h1>Your Plans And Commitments</h1>
+         <p className="muted">
+           Everything on your calendar, and the public holidays where you are. When two things you need to be at
+           overlap, they’re marked Clash.
+         </p>
+       </div>
+
+       {/* A collision is a run of items that overlap, however many are in it: until 2026-09-27 it was the items over two, rounded up, so three at once read as two. */}
+       {conflicts.length > 0 && (
+         <div className="callout callout-negative" style={{ marginBottom: 'var(--s5)' }}>
+           <strong>{collisions === 1 ? 'A clash' : toStart(said(collisions, 'clash', 'clashes'))} in the next month.</strong>
+           <ul className="small" style={{ margin: 'var(--s2) 0 0', paddingLeft: 'var(--s4)' }}>
+             {conflicts.slice(0, 6).map((entry) => (
+               <li key={entry.id}>
+                 {titleCaseLabel(entry.title)} — {formatDate(entry.at, sim.homeZone)} at {formatTime(entry.at, sim.homeZone)}
+               </li>
+             ))}
+           </ul>
+         </div>
+       )}
+
+       <Panel
+         title={`${MONTHS[view.month - 1]} ${view.year}`}
+         actions={
+           <>
+             <button className="btn btn-sm" onClick={() => shift(-1)} aria-label="Previous Month">‹</button>
+             <button className="btn btn-sm" onClick={() => setView({ year: today.year, month: today.month })}>Today</button>
+             <button className="btn btn-sm" onClick={() => shift(1)} aria-label="Next Month">›</button>
+           </>
+         }
+       >
+         <div className="cal-grid">
+           {WEEKDAYS.map((day) => <div key={day} className="cal-weekday">{day}</div>)}
+           {days.map((day) => (
+             <button
+               key={day.key}
+               className="cal-day"
+               data-out={!day.inMonth}
+               data-today={day.isToday}
+               onClick={() => setSelected(day.key === selected ? null : day.key)}
+               aria-label={dayLabel(day, sim.homeZone)}
+               style={{ textAlign: 'left', border: 0, font: 'inherit', color: 'inherit', cursor: 'pointer' }}
+             >
+               <div className="row-between">
+                 <span className="cal-daynum">{day.dayOfMonth}</span>
+                 {day.holidays.length > 0 && <span className="xs dim cal-holiday-mark" aria-hidden="true">✦</span>}
+               </div>
+               {day.holidays.slice(0, holidayChips(day)).map((holiday) => (
+                 <span
+                   key={`${day.key}:${holiday.name}`}
+                   className="cal-event"
+                   style={{ '--event-colour': LEGEND_BY_CATEGORY.holiday?.colour, opacity: holiday.type === 'public' ? 1 : 0.7 } as CSSProperties}
+                   title={holidayLabel(holiday)}
+                 >
+                   {holiday.name === holiday.englishName ? titleCaseLabel(holiday.name) : holiday.name}
+                 </span>
+               ))}
+               {standingIn(day).slice(0, roomFor(day)).map((entry) => (
+                 <span
+                   key={entry.id}
+                   className="cal-event"
+                   data-conflict={entry.conflicted}
+                   style={{ '--event-colour': LEGEND_BY_CATEGORY[entry.category]?.colour } as CSSProperties}
+                   title={titleCaseLabel(entry.title)}
+                 >
+                   {titleCaseLabel(entry.title)}
+                 </span>
+               ))}
+               {hiddenIn(day) > 0 && (
+                 <span className="xs dim cal-more">+{hiddenIn(day)} more</span>
+               )}
+             </button>
+           ))}
+         </div>
+
+         <hr className="divider" />
+         <div className="cal-legend">
+           {CALENDAR_LEGEND.filter((e) => e.category !== 'system').map((entry) => (
+             <span key={titleCaseLabel(entry.category)} className="cal-legend-item" title={entry.description}>
+               <span className="cal-swatch" style={{ background: entry.colour }} />
+               {entry.label}
+             </span>
+           ))}
+         </div>
+       </Panel>
+
+       {selectedDay && (
+         <Panel
+           title={formatDate(selectedDay.date, sim.homeZone)}
+           subtitle={selectedDay.holidays.length > 0 ? selectedDay.holidays.map(holidayLabel).join(' · ') : `${selectedDay.season}`}
+           flush
+           actions={(
+             <>
+               {canPlan(selectedDay, sim.now, sim.homeZone) && (
+                 <Gated feature="calendar.schedule" className="btn btn-sm btn-primary" onClick={() => setPlanning(selectedDay.key)}>
+                   Put Something On It
+                 </Gated>
+               )}
+               <button className="btn btn-ghost btn-sm" onClick={() => setSelected(null)}>Close</button>
+             </>
+           )}
+           help="day.plans"
+         >
+           {selectedDay.entries.length === 0 ? (
+             <Empty
+               title="No Plans"
+               body={canPlan(selectedDay, sim.now, sim.homeZone)
+                 ? 'You have nothing on that day. Press Put Something On It to add a plan.'
+                 : 'You had nothing on that day.'}
+             />
+           ) : (
+             <div className="list">
+               {selectedDay.entries.map((entry) => (
+                 <button key={entry.id} className="list-item" onClick={() => setDetail(entry)}>
+                   <span
+                     className="cal-swatch"
+                     style={{ background: LEGEND_BY_CATEGORY[entry.category]?.colour, width: 4, height: 32, borderRadius: 2 }}
+                     aria-hidden="true"
+                   />
+                   <div className="grow">
+                     <div className="small strong">{titleCaseLabel(entry.title)}</div>
+                     <div className="xs dim">
+                       {formatTime(entry.at, sim.homeZone)}
+                       {entry.durationMinutes ? ` · ${formatDuration(entry.durationMinutes * MS_MINUTE)}` : ''}
+                       {entry.locationId ? ` · ${CITIES.get(entry.locationId)?.name ?? ''}` : ''}
+                     </div>
+                   </div>
+                   {entry.conflicted && <span className="chip chip-negative">Clash</span>}
+                   {statusOf(entry) !== 'pending' && <span className="chip">{statusWords(statusOf(entry))}</span>}
+                 </button>
+               ))}
+             </div>
+           )}
+         </Panel>
+       )}
+
+
+       <Panel title="Next Thirty Days" flush>
+         {next30.length === 0 ? (
+           <Empty
+             title="No Plans Ahead"
+             body="No plans or commitments in the next thirty days. Holidays are marked on the month above, not listed here."
+           />
+         ) : (
+           <div className="list">
+             {next30.slice(0, 20).map((entry) => (
+               <button key={entry.id} className="list-item" onClick={() => setDetail(entry)}>
+                 <span
+                   className="cal-swatch"
+                   style={{ background: LEGEND_BY_CATEGORY[entry.category]?.colour }}
+                   aria-hidden="true"
+                 />
+                 <div className="grow">
+                   <div className="small">{titleCaseLabel(entry.title)}</div>
+                   <div className="xs dim">
+                     {formatDate(entry.at, sim.homeZone)} · {formatTime(entry.at, sim.homeZone)}
+                   </div>
+                 </div>
+                 {entry.requiresPlayer && <span className="chip">You</span>}
+                 {entry.conflicted && <span className="chip chip-negative">Clash</span>}
+               </button>
+             ))}
+           </div>
+         )}
+       </Panel>
+
+       {detail && <EntryDetail entry={detail} onClose={() => setDetail(null)} />}
+       {planningDay && (
+         <PlanForm
+           day={planningDay}
+           onClose={() => setPlanning(null)}
+           onDone={() => { setPlanning(null); refresh(); }}
+         />
+       )}
+     </>
+   );
+ }
+
+ /**
+  * Putting something on a day.
+  *
+  * A modal, because it asks a question and changes the world — which is the
+  * one thing a look never does. Three questions and no more: what it is, when
+  * it starts, and how long it takes. It used to ask which kind of day it was
+  * and who it was with; the family was the only other kind and the only
+  * company, and both went with it.
+  *
+  * No "where" yet. Every plan is where you are standing. When it was written
+  * nothing in the game moved you anywhere else; travel to a job, a sublet and
+  * a move all do now, and a plan is still made where you are at the time, so
+  * a city you won't be in is never offered.
+  */
+ function PlanForm({ day, onClose, onDone }: { day: CalendarDay; onClose: () => void; onDone: () => void }) {
+   const { sim, run } = useGame();
+   const zone = sim.homeZone;
+   const [title, setTitle] = useState('');
+   const [minute, setMinute] = useState(() => firstFreeSlot(day, sim.now, zone));
+   const [minutes, setMinutes] = useState(60);
+   const [error, setError] = useState<string | undefined>();
+
+   const at = startOfDay(day.date, zone) + minute * MS_MINUTE;
+   const slots = openSlots(day, sim.now, zone);
+
+   const put = () => {
+     // The command succeeds even when the calendar declines the plan: a
+     // refusal is an answer, not a failure, and it belongs beside the field
+     // rather than in a toast that slides away while you are still reading it.
+     const result = run<PlanResult>('calendar.schedule', {
+       title, at, durationMinutes: minutes,
+     });
+     if (result.value?.ok) { onDone(); return; }
+     setError(result.value?.error ?? result.error ?? 'That plan couldn’t be added, so the calendar is as it was.');
+   };
+
+   return (
+     <Modal
+       title={`Put Something On ${formatDate(day.date, zone)}`}
+       onClose={onClose}
+       footer={(
+         <>
+           <button className="btn btn-ghost" onClick={onClose}>Never Mind</button>
+           <button className="btn btn-primary" onClick={put} disabled={title.trim().length === 0}>
+             Put It On
+           </button>
+         </>
+       )}
+     >
+       <div className="field">
+         <label htmlFor="plan-title">What Is It</label>
+         <input
+           id="plan-title"
+           type="text"
+           value={title}
+           maxLength={LONGEST_TITLE}
+           placeholder="A name you’ll recognize on the day"
+           onChange={(e) => { setTitle(e.target.value); setError(undefined); }}
+         />
+       </div>
+       <div className="field-row">
+         <div className="field">
+           <label htmlFor="plan-at">When It Starts</label>
+           <select id="plan-at" value={minute} onChange={(e) => { setMinute(Number(e.target.value)); setError(undefined); }}>
+             {slots.map((slot) => (
+               <option key={slot} value={slot}>
+                 {formatTime(startOfDay(day.date, zone) + slot * MS_MINUTE, zone)}
+               </option>
+             ))}
+           </select>
+         </div>
+         <div className="field">
+           <label htmlFor="plan-length">How Long It Takes</label>
+           <select id="plan-length" value={minutes} onChange={(e) => setMinutes(Number(e.target.value))}>
+             {PLAN_LENGTHS.map((length) => (
+               <option key={length.minutes} value={length.minutes}>{length.label}</option>
+             ))}
+           </select>
+         </div>
+       </div>
+       {/* The clash by the chip's own word (from 2026-10-20, brief 17), as the screen's heading has it: until then "the calendar
+           marks the clash". */}
+       <p className="xs dim" style={{ margin: 0 }}>
+         You’ll need to be in {CITIES.get(sim.player.currentLocationId)?.name ?? 'the place you are now'} for it, and the clock
+         stops when it’s time. You can have two things at the same time, and the calendar marks them Clash.
+       </p>
+       {error && <p className="small negative" style={{ marginTop: 'var(--s3)' }}>{error}</p>}
+     </Modal>
+   );
+ }
+
+ /** An entry's own state, in the word the screen shows. */
+ function statusOf(entry: CalendarEntry): string {
+   return entry.status === 'done' ? 'completed' : entry.status;
+ }
+
+ /**
+  * One entry, opened.
+  *
+  * What it is, when it is, how long it runs and what state it is in. The one
+  * thing here that is yours is a plan you made: you can call it off, and
+  * nothing else on the calendar can be argued with — a holiday is a country's
+  * and a world event belongs to the clock.
+  */
+ function EntryDetail({ entry, onClose }: { entry: CalendarEntry; onClose: () => void }) {
+   const { sim, run, refresh } = useGame();
+   const legend = LEGEND_BY_CATEGORY[entry.category];
+   const status = statusOf(entry);
+   const city = entry.locationId ? CITIES.get(entry.locationId)?.name : undefined;
+   const [error, setError] = useState<string | undefined>();
+   const mine = sim.timeline.get(entry.id)?.kind === PLAN_KIND && entry.status === 'pending';
+
+   const callOff = () => {
+     const result = run<PlanResult>('calendar.cancel', { entryId: entry.id });
+     if (result.value?.ok) { refresh(); onClose(); return; }
+     setError(result.value?.error ?? result.error ?? 'It couldn’t be taken off the calendar, so it’s still there.');
+   };
+
+   return (
+     <Modal
+       title={titleCaseLabel(entry.title)}
+       onClose={onClose}
+       footer={mine ? (
+         <>
+           <HowItWorks help="calendar.cancel" />
+           <button className="btn btn-ghost" onClick={onClose}>Leave It</button>
+           <Gated feature="calendar.cancel" className="btn" onClick={callOff}>Call It Off</Gated>
+         </>
+       ) : undefined}
+     >
+       <div className="grid grid-2" style={{ marginBottom: 'var(--s4)' }}>
+         <Stat label="When" value={formatTime(entry.at, sim.homeZone)} note={formatDate(entry.at, sim.homeZone)} />
+         <Stat label="Length" value={entry.durationMinutes ? formatDuration(entry.durationMinutes * MS_MINUTE) : '—'} />
+         <Stat label="Kind" value={legend?.label ?? titleCaseLabel(entry.category)} note={city} />
+         <Stat
+           label="Status"
+           value={statusWords(status)}
+           tone={status === 'missed' || status === 'cancelled' ? 'negative' : status === 'completed' ? 'positive' : undefined}
+         />
+       </div>
+
+       <p className="small muted">
+         {entry.status === 'observance'
+           ? 'An observance. It’s on the calendar so you know, and there’s nothing for you to do about it.'
+           : entry.requiresPlayer
+             ? 'You need to be there. The clock stops when it’s time, so you can go.'
+             : 'It happens on its own when the clock reaches it.'}
+         {mine && ' You put it there, so you can take it off again.'}
+       </p>
+       {error && <p className="small negative">{error}</p>}
+     </Modal>
+   );
+ }
+
+ const MONTHS = [
+   'January', 'February', 'March', 'April', 'May', 'June',
+   'July', 'August', 'September', 'October', 'November', 'December',
+ ];
+
+ /**
+  * A status as the screen says it, in American spelling. The save keeps the
+  * status with a doubled l; the Day look already wrote Canceled while this
+  * wrote the doubled spelling beside it.
+  */
+ function statusWords(status: string): string {
+   return status === 'cancelled' ? 'Canceled' : titleCaseLabel(status);
+ }
+
+ /**
+  * SLATE — the Career screen (from 2026-10-20, the owner's brief 19): where an actor stands as a professional, and the
+  * portfolio a submission or an approach sends (`systems/pro.ts`). It had two tabs, Overview and Portfolio, until
+  * 2026-10-21, when the agent's Representation came with its system (`ui/career/RepresentationPane.tsx`); the
+  * opportunities' and the work's tabs come with theirs, and none is shown before it's playable (`ui/shell/sections.ts`).
+  *
+  * Every line is read from the record where the engine keeps it, worked out as it's drawn (`profileOf`,
+  * `materialsCheck`, `reelSources`), and every control runs a command through `run`, behind its guide chapter
+  * (`<Gated>`), with the command's own refusal said under it before it's pressed (`WhyNot`).
+  */
+
+ import { useState } from 'react';
+ import { SECTIONS, tabKey } from '@/ui/shell/sections';
+ import { useKept } from '@/ui/kept';
+ import { useGame, useWorld } from '@/app/game-context';
+ import { Panel, Fine, WhyNot } from '@/ui/components/primitives';
+ import { Gated } from '@/ui/guide/Guide';
+ import { RepresentationPane } from '@/ui/career/RepresentationPane';
+ import { formatMoney, saveCurrency } from '@/engine/core/money';
+ import { formatDate } from '@/engine/core/time';
+ import { plural } from '@/engine/core/text';
+ import { countWords } from '@/engine/systems/school';
+ import {
+   HEADSHOTS, NAME_MOST, REEL, RESUME, SKILL_LISTED_AT, currentOf, headshotCost, headshotRefusal, materialsCheck, nameRefusal,
+   pathwayOf, pieceWords, proCreditWords, profileOf, reelCost, reelRefusal, reelSources, resumeBehind, resumeRefusal,
+   schoolCreditWords, type MaterialProblem,
+ } from '@/engine/systems/pro';
+
+ type CareerTab = 'overview' | 'portfolio' | 'representation';
+
+ /** Its tabs, as the rail lists them too (`ui/shell/sections.ts`). */
+ const CAREER_TABS = SECTIONS['/workspace/career'] as readonly { id: CareerTab; label: string }[];
+
+ export function CareerWorkspace() {
+   const [tab, setTab] = useKept<CareerTab>(tabKey('/workspace/career'), 'overview');
+   const panes: Record<CareerTab, JSX.Element> = { overview: <OverviewPane toPortfolio={() => setTab('portfolio')} />, portfolio: <PortfolioPane />, representation: <RepresentationPane /> };
+   return (
+     <>
+       <div className="page-head">
+         <div className="eyebrow">Your Work</div>
+         <h1>Career</h1>
+         <p className="muted">Where you stand as a professional actor, and your portfolio: your profile, headshots, résumé and reel.</p>
+       </div>
+       <div className="tabs" role="tablist" aria-label="Career">
+         {CAREER_TABS.map((one, i) => (
+           <button
+             key={one.id} id={`career-tab-${one.id}`} type="button" role="tab" className="tab"
+             aria-selected={one.id === tab} aria-controls={`career-pane-${one.id}`} tabIndex={one.id === tab ? 0 : -1}
+             onClick={() => setTab(one.id)}
+             onKeyDown={(e) => {
+               const go = (n: number) => { const next = CAREER_TABS[(n + CAREER_TABS.length) % CAREER_TABS.length]!; setTab(next.id); document.getElementById(`career-tab-${next.id}`)?.focus(); };
+               if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') { e.preventDefault(); go(i + 1); }
+               else if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') { e.preventDefault(); go(i - 1); }
+               else if (e.key === 'Home') { e.preventDefault(); go(0); }
+               else if (e.key === 'End') { e.preventDefault(); go(CAREER_TABS.length - 1); }
+             }}
+           >
+             {one.label}
+           </button>
+         ))}
+       </div>
+       <div role="tabpanel" id={`career-pane-${tab}`} aria-labelledby={`career-tab-${tab}`} tabIndex={0}>
+         {panes[tab]}
+       </div>
+     </>
+   );
+ }

+ /** A list of problems, each a sentence. */
+ function Problems({ problems }: { problems: readonly MaterialProblem[] }) {
+   return (
+     <ul className="small" style={{ margin: 0, paddingLeft: '1.1rem' }}>
+       {problems.map((p) => <li key={`${p.kind}:${p.problem}`}>{p.words}</li>)}
+     </ul>
+   );
+ }

+ /** Where you stand, the way you're on, what's missing and what's next. */
+ function OverviewPane({ toPortfolio }: { toPortfolio: () => void }) {

+   const p = profileOf(person, sim.now);
+   const way = pathwayOf(person);
+   const problems = materialsCheck(person, 'screen', sim.now);
+   const needed = problems.filter((x) => x.blocking);
+   const better = problems.filter((x) => !x.blocking);
+   return (
+     <div className="col gap-5">
+       <Panel title="Where You Stand" help="ui.career">
+         <dl className="col gap-2 small" style={{ margin: 0 }}>
+           <div><dt className="strong">Training</dt><dd style={{ margin: 0 }}>{p.training.words}</dd></div>
+           <div><dt className="strong">Availability</dt><dd style={{ margin: 0 }}>{p.availability.words}</dd></div>
+           <div><dt className="strong">Based In</dt><dd style={{ margin: 0 }}>{p.location.city}</dd></div>
+           <div><dt className="strong">Permission To Work</dt><dd style={{ margin: 0 }}>{p.eligibility.words}</dd></div>
+           <div><dt className="strong">Unions</dt><dd style={{ margin: 0 }}>{p.unions.words}</dd></div>

+       </Panel>

+         <p className="small" style={{ margin: 0 }}>{way.words}</p>
+       </Panel>
+       <Panel title="What’s Missing">
+         <div className="col gap-3">
+           {!problems.length && <p className="small" style={{ margin: 0 }}>Your headshots, résumé and reel are all current.</p>}
+           {needed.length > 0 && (
+             <div className="col gap-2">
+               <h3 className="eyebrow" style={{ margin: 0 }}>Needed For Any Submission</h3>
+               <Problems problems={needed} />
+             </div>
+           )}
+           {better.length > 0 && (
+             <div className="col gap-2">
+               <h3 className="eyebrow" style={{ margin: 0 }}>Worth Doing</h3>
+               <Problems problems={better} />
+             </div>
+           )}
+         </div>
+       </Panel>
+       <Panel title="What’s Next">
+         <div className="col gap-2">
+           <p className="small" style={{ margin: 0 }}>
+             {problems.length
+               ? `Start with ${problems[0]!.kind === 'headshot' ? 'your headshots' : problems[0]!.kind === 'resume' ? 'your résumé' : 'your reel'}, on the Portfolio tab. Each says its time and cost before you press it.`
+               : 'Keep your portfolio current. A new credit makes your résumé fall behind, and new recorded work is worth adding to your reel. The Portfolio tab says when.'}
+           </p>
+           <div><button type="button" className="btn btn-sm" onClick={toPortfolio}>Go To Portfolio</button></div>
+         </div>
+       </Panel>
+     </div>

+ /** The profile, headshots, résumé and reel, each with where it came from and its control. */
+ function PortfolioPane() {
+   return (
+     <div className="col gap-5">
+       <ProfilePanel />
+       <HeadshotsPanel />

+ function ProfilePanel() {
+   const { sim, run, toast } = useGame();
+   const person = useWorld((s) => s.player);
+   const p = profileOf(person, sim.now);
+   const [name, setName] = useState('');
+   const no = nameRefusal(person, name);
+   return (
+     <Panel title="Your Profile" help="career.profile">
+       <div className="col gap-4">
+         <div className="col gap-2">
+           <p className="small" style={{ margin: 0 }}>{p.nameSet ? `You work as ${p.name}. Your résumé uses it.` : `You work under your own name, ${p.name}, until you choose another. Your résumé uses it.`}</p>
+           <div className="row gap-2" style={{ flexWrap: 'wrap', alignItems: 'flex-end' }}>
+             <div className="field">

+ function ReelPanel() {
+   const { sim, run, toast } = useGame();
+   const person = useWorld((s) => s.player);
+   const cur = saveCurrency(sim.universe);
+   const current = currentOf(person.pro, 'reel');
+   const sources = reelSources(person, sim.now);
+   const usable = sources.filter((s) => s.usable);
+   const unusable = sources.filter((s) => !s.usable);
+   const [chosen, setChosen] = useState<string[]>([]);
+   const no = reelRefusal(sim, person, chosen);
+   const notes = materialsCheck(person, 'screen', sim.now).filter((x) => x.kind === 'reel' && x.problem !== 'missing');
+   const label = `Cut A Reel (${plural(REEL.minutes / 60, 'Hour')}, ${formatMoney(reelCost(sim), cur)})`;
+   const toggle = (ref: string) => setChosen((was) => (was.includes(ref) ? was.filter((x) => x !== ref) : [...was, ref]));
+   return (
+     <Panel title="Reel" help="career.reel">
+       <div className="col gap-3">
+         {current ? (
+           <dl className="col gap-2 small" style={{ margin: 0 }}>
+             <div><dt className="strong">Cut</dt><dd style={{ margin: 0 }}>{formatDate(current.made, sim.zone)}</dd></div>
+             <div><dt className="strong">Where It Came From</dt><dd style={{ margin: 0 }}>{current.source}</dd></div>
+             <div>
+               <dt className="strong">What’s On It</dt>
+               <dd style={{ margin: 0 }}><ul style={{ margin: 0, paddingLeft: '1.1rem' }}>{current.contains.map((line, i) => <li key={i}>{line}</li>)}</ul></dd>
+             </div>
+           </dl>
+         ) : <p className="small" style={{ margin: 0 }}>You have no reel yet. A reel is cut only from work that was recorded: your self-tapes, the School’s filmed monologues once they’re posted, and screen work once it’s released.</p>}
+         {notes.length > 0 && <Problems problems={notes} />}
+         {usable.length > 0 ? (
+           <fieldset className="col gap-2" style={{ border: 0, padding: 0, margin: 0 }}>
+             <legend className="small strong">Recorded Work To Cut From</legend>
+             <p className="xs dim" style={{ margin: 0 }}>{`Choose up to ${countWords(REEL.most)} pieces. Each shows how it was judged.`}</p>
+             <ul className="small" style={{ margin: 0, padding: 0, listStyle: 'none' }}>
+               {usable.map((s, i) => (
+                 <li key={s.ref} className="row gap-2" style={{ alignItems: 'baseline' }}>
+                   <input type="checkbox" id={`reel-piece-${i}`} checked={chosen.includes(s.ref)} onChange={() => toggle(s.ref)} />
+                   <label htmlFor={`reel-piece-${i}`}>{pieceWords(s, sim.zone)}</label>
+                 </li>
+               ))}
+             </ul>
+           </fieldset>
+         ) : <p className="small" style={{ margin: 0 }}>No recorded work yet. Tape a practice brief on the Player Profile, and it’s here to cut from.</p>}
+         {unusable.length > 0 && (
+           <details className="small">
+             <summary>{`Recorded, But Not For A Reel (${unusable.length})`}</summary>
+             <ul style={{ margin: 'var(--s2) 0 0', paddingLeft: '1.1rem' }}>{unusable.map((s) => <li key={s.ref}>{`${pieceWords(s, sim.zone)}. ${s.why}`}</li>)}</ul>
+           </details>
+         )}
+         <div className="row gap-2" style={{ flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
+           <Gated feature="pro.cut_reel" className="btn btn-sm" disabled={!!no} title={no} onClick={() => { const r = run<{ cost: number; pieces: number }>('pro.cut_reel', { pieces: chosen }); if (r.ok) { toast(`Your reel is cut: ${plural(r.value!.pieces, 'piece')}, ${formatMoney(r.value!.cost, cur)}.`, 'positive'); setChosen([]); } }}>{label}</Gated>
+         </div>
+         <WhyNot reasons={[[label, no]]} />
+         <Fine>The edit’s price and the two hours are estimated. A night on stage and a class piece aren’t recorded, so they can’t go on a reel.</Fine>
+       </div>
+     </Panel>
+   );
+ }

+ /** Its tabs, as the rail lists them too (`ui/shell/sections.ts`, from 2026-10-08). */
+ const PAPERS_TABS = SECTIONS['/workspace/papers'] as readonly { id: PapersTab; label: string }[];
